        sa.Column('result_json', sa.Text(), nullable=True),
        sa.Column('created_at', sa.String(50), nullable=True),
    )

    # Dependency Edges
    op.create_table(
        'dependency_edges',
        sa.Column('id', sa.String(64), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column('business_id', sa.String(64), sa.ForeignKey('businesses.id', ondelete='CASCADE'), index=True, nullable=False),
        sa.Column('source_id', sa.String(64), nullable=False),
        sa.Column('source_type', sa.String(50), nullable=False),
        sa.Column('target_id', sa.String(64), nullable=False),
        sa.Column('target_type', sa.String(50), nullable=False),
        sa.Column('label', sa.String(255), nullable=False),
        sa.Column('lag_days', sa.Integer(), default=0, nullable=False),
    )

    # App Settings
    op.create_table(
        'app_settings',
        sa.Column('id', sa.String(64), primary_key=True),
        sa.Column('business_id', sa.String(64), sa.ForeignKey('businesses.id', ondelete='CASCADE'), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False),
        sa.Column('notification_preferences_json', sa.Text(), nullable=True),
        sa.Column('app_preferences_json', sa.Text(), nullable=True),
        sa.Column('updated_at', sa.String(50), nullable=True),
    )

def downgrade() -> None:
    op.drop_table('app_settings')
    op.drop_table('dependency_edges')
    op.drop_table('simulation_scenarios')
    op.drop_table('cash_flow_events')
    op.drop_table('payments')

    op.drop_table('businesses')

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from logging.config import fileConfig

from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config
from sqlalchemy import pool

from alembic import context

# Add parent directory to sys.path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from app.config import settings
from app.database import Base
import app.models  # load all models

config = context.config

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata

def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = settings.normalized_database_url
    context.configure(
        url=url,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )

    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()

def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    configuration = config.get_section(config.config_ini_section) or {}
    configuration["sqlalchemy.url"] = settings.normalized_database_url

    connectable = engine_from_config(
        configuration,
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )

    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(
            connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata
        )

        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()

if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

import uuid
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.business import Business, BusinessMembership
from app.models.settings import AppSettingsModel
from app.services.auth import hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token
from app.schemas.auth import RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, AuthResponse, UserResponse, BusinessResponse
from app.api.deps import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["auth"])

def _build_business_response(b: Business) -> BusinessResponse:
    return BusinessResponse(
        id=b.id,
        name=b.name,
        currency=b.currency,
        openingCashPaise=b.opening_cash_paise,
        safetyThresholdPaise=b.safety_threshold_paise,
        industry=b.industry,
        ownerName=b.owner_name,
        ownerEmail=b.owner_email,
        phone=b.phone,
        address=b.address,
        taxRatePercent=b.tax_rate_percent,
        defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays=b.default_supplier_payment_terms_days,
        defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays=b.default_customer_payment_terms_days,
        defaultForecastHorizonDays=b.default_forecast_horizon_days,
    )

@router.post("/register", response_model=AuthResponse)
def register(req: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == req.email.lower().strip()).first()
    if existing_user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="A user with this email already exists"
        )

    user_id = f"usr_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    user = User(
        id=user_id,
        email=req.email.lower().strip(),
        hashed_password=hash_password(req.password),
        full_name=req.full_name.strip(),
    )
    db.add(user)
    db.flush()

    business_id = f"biz_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    business = Business(
        id=business_id,
        name=req.business_name or "My Business",
        currency="INR",
        opening_cash_paise=1_000_000,
        safety_threshold_paise=500_000,
        owner_name=user.full_name,
        owner_email=user.email,
    )
    db.add(business)
    db.flush()

    membership = BusinessMembership(
        id=f"mem_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        user_id=user.id,
        business_id=business.id,
        role="owner",
    )
    db.add(membership)

    settings_record = AppSettingsModel(
        id=f"set_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        notification_preferences_json='{"overduePayments":true,"upcomingSupplierPayments":true,"overdueInvoices":true,"lowCash":true,"delayedDeliveries":true,"highRippleImpact":true}',
        app_preferences_json='{"theme":"system","compactTables":false,"version":"1.0.0"}',
    )
    db.add(settings_record)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(user)
    db.refresh(business)

    token = create_access_token(user_id=user.id, business_id=business.id)
    b_resp = _build_business_response(business)

    return AuthResponse(
        access_token=token,
        user=UserResponse(id=user.id, email=user.email, full_name=user.full_name),
        business=b_resp,
        businesses=[b_resp],
    )

@router.post("/login", response_model=AuthResponse)
def login(req: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == req.email.lower().strip()).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(req.password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Incorrect email or password",
        )

    memberships = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id).all()
    if not memberships:
        # Create a default business if none exists
        business = Business(
            id=f"biz_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            name="My Business",
            currency="INR",
            opening_cash_paise=1_000_000,
            safety_threshold_paise=500_000,
            owner_name=user.full_name,
            owner_email=user.email,
        )
        db.add(business)
        db.flush()
        membership = BusinessMembership(
            id=f"mem_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            user_id=user.id,
            business_id=business.id,
            role="owner",
        )
        db.add(membership)
        db.commit()
        memberships = [membership]

    all_businesses = []
    active_business = None
    for m in memberships:
        b = db.query(Business).filter(Business.id == m.business_id).first()
        if b:
            b_resp = _build_business_response(b)
            all_businesses.append(b_resp)
            if active_business is None:
                active_business = b_resp

    if not active_business:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="No business found for user")

    token = create_access_token(user_id=user.id, business_id=active_business.id)
    return AuthResponse(
        access_token=token,
        user=UserResponse(id=user.id, email=user.email, full_name=user.full_name),
        business=active_business,
        businesses=all_businesses,
    )

@router.get("/me")
def get_me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    memberships = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id).all()
    all_businesses = []
    active_business = None
    for m in memberships:
        b = db.query(Business).filter(Business.id == m.business_id).first()
        if b:
            b_resp = _build_business_response(b)
            all_businesses.append(b_resp)
            if active_business is None:
                active_business = b_resp

    return {
        "user": UserResponse(id=user.id, email=user.email, full_name=user.full_name),
        "business": active_business,
        "businesses": all_businesses,
    }

@router.post("/switch-business/{business_id}", response_model=AuthResponse)
def switch_business(business_id: str, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    membership = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(
        BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id,
        BusinessMembership.business_id == business_id
    ).first()
    if not membership:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="You do not have access to this business")

    target_business = db.query(Business).filter(Business.id == business_id).first()
    if not target_business:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Business not found")

    memberships = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id).all()
    all_businesses = []
    for m in memberships:
        b = db.query(Business).filter(Business.id == m.business_id).first()
        if b:
            all_businesses.append(_build_business_response(b))

    target_resp = _build_business_response(target_business)
    token = create_access_token(user_id=user.id, business_id=target_business.id)
    return AuthResponse(
        access_token=token,
        user=UserResponse(id=user.id, email=user.email, full_name=user.full_name),
        business=target_resp,
        businesses=all_businesses,
    )

from datetime import date
import uuid
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.api.deps import get_current_business
from app.models.business import Business
from app.models.customer import Customer
from app.models.order import CustomerOrder
from app.models.invoice import Invoice
from app.models.payment import Payment
from app.services.financial import enrich_customer, get_customer_summary, to_iso_date

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/customers", tags=["customers"])

@router.get("")
def list_customers(
    search: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    sortBy: str | None = None,
    sortDir: str | None = "asc",
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    pageSize: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100),
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.business_id == business.id)

    if status and status != "all":
        query = query.filter(Customer.status == status)

    if search:
        s = f"%{search.strip().lower()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            (Customer.name.ilike(s)) |
            (Customer.contact_name.ilike(s)) |
            (Customer.email.ilike(s))
        )

    all_customers = query.all()
    today = date.today()
    enriched = [enrich_customer(c, db, today) for c in all_customers]

    reverse = (sortDir == "desc")
    if sortBy == "name":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"].lower(), reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "outstanding":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["calculatedOutstandingPaise"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "overdue":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["overdueAmountPaise"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "terms":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["creditTermsDays"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "orders":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["orderCount"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "reliability":
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: (x["reliability"]["score"] or 0), reverse=reverse)
    else:
        enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"].lower())

    total = len(enriched)
    start = (page - 1) * pageSize
    paged = enriched[start : start + pageSize]

    return {
        "data": paged,
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "pageSize": pageSize,
    }

@router.get("/summary")
def customer_summary(

    if not customer:

@router.get("/{id}/details")
def get_customer_details(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    customer = db.query(Customer).filter(
        Customer.id == id,
        Customer.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not customer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")

    today = date.today()
    enriched_c = enrich_customer(customer, db, today)

    orders = db.query(CustomerOrder).filter(CustomerOrder.customer_id == id).all()
    invoices = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.customer_id == id, Invoice.type == "receivable").all()
    payments = db.query(Payment).filter(Payment.customer_id == id).all()

    total_orders_paise = sum(o.total_paise for o in orders)
    open_invoices_count = sum(1 for inv in invoices if inv.amount_paid_paise < inv.amount_paise and inv.status not in ("void", "cancelled"))

    return {
        "customer": enriched_c,
        "metrics": {
            "totalOrdersPaise": total_orders_paise,
            "totalInvoicedPaise": enriched_c["totalInvoicedPaise"],
            "totalPaidPaise": enriched_c["totalPaidPaise"],
            "outstandingPaise": enriched_c["calculatedOutstandingPaise"],
            "overdueBalancePaise": enriched_c["overdueAmountPaise"],
            "openInvoicesCount": open_invoices_count,
            "overdueInvoicesCount": enriched_c["overdueInvoicesCount"],
            "totalOrdersCount": len(orders),
            "reliability": enriched_c["reliability"],
        },
        "orders": [
            {
                "id": o.id,
                "customerId": o.customer_id,
                "productId": o.product_id,
                "quantity": o.quantity,
                "totalPaise": o.total_paise,
                "status": o.status,
                "orderDate": o.order_date,
                "deliveryDate": o.delivery_date,
            }
            for o in orders
        ],
        "invoices": [
            {
                "id": inv.id,
                "invoiceNumber": inv.invoice_number,
                "type": inv.type,
                "customerId": inv.customer_id,
                "amountPaise": inv.amount_paise,
                "amountPaidPaise": inv.amount_paid_paise,
                "status": inv.status,
                "issueDate": inv.issue_date,
                "dueDate": inv.due_date,
                "notes": inv.notes,
            }
            for inv in invoices
        ],
        "payments": [
            {
                "id": pay.id,
                "direction": pay.direction,
                "invoiceId": pay.invoice_id,
                "customerId": pay.customer_id,
                "amountPaise": pay.amount_paise,
                "status": pay.status,
                "scheduledDate": pay.scheduled_date,
                "completedDate": pay.completed_date,
                "method": pay.method,
            }
            for pay in payments
        ],
    }

@router.post("", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_customer(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    name = payload.get("name", "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Customer name is required")

    customer = Customer(
        id=f"cus_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        name=name,
        contact_name=payload.get("contactName"),
        email=payload.get("email"),
        phone=payload.get("phone"),
        address=payload.get("address"),
        tax_id=payload.get("taxId"),
        credit_terms_days=payload.get("creditTermsDays", 15),
        outstanding_paise=0,
        status=payload.get("status", "active"),
        notes=payload.get("notes"),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(customer)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(customer)
    return enrich_customer(customer, db)

@router.patch("/{id}")
def update_customer(
    id: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    customer = db.query(Customer).filter(
        Customer.id == id,
        Customer.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not customer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")

    if "name" in payload and payload["name"]: customer.name = payload["name"].strip()
    if "contactName" in payload: customer.contact_name = payload["contactName"]
    if "email" in payload: customer.email = payload["email"]
    if "phone" in payload: customer.phone = payload["phone"]
    if "address" in payload: customer.address = payload["address"]
    if "taxId" in payload: customer.tax_id = payload["taxId"]
    if "creditTermsDays" in payload and payload["creditTermsDays"] is not None:
        customer.credit_terms_days = payload["creditTermsDays"]
    if "notes" in payload: customer.notes = payload["notes"]
    if "status" in payload: customer.status = payload["status"]

    customer.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(customer)
    return enrich_customer(customer, db)

@router.post("/{id}/archive")
def archive_customer(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),

    customer.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(customer)
    return enrich_customer(customer, db)

@router.post("/{id}/unarchive")
def unarchive_customer(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    customer = db.query(Customer).filter(
        Customer.id == id,
        Customer.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not customer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")

    customer.status = "active"
    customer.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(customer)
    return enrich_customer(customer, db)

@router.delete("/{id}")
def delete_customer(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    customer = db.query(Customer).filter(
        Customer.id == id,
        Customer.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not customer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Customer not found")

    has_orders = db.query(CustomerOrder).filter(CustomerOrder.customer_id == id).first()
    has_invoices = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.customer_id == id).first()
    enriched = enrich_customer(customer, db)

    if has_orders or has_invoices or enriched["calculatedOutstandingPaise"] > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Cannot delete customer with historical orders or open invoices. Archive instead."
        )

    db.delete(customer)
    db.commit()
    return {"success": True}

import json
from datetime import date, timedelta
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.api.deps import get_current_business
from app.models.business import Business
from app.models.invoice import Invoice
from app.models.product import Product
from app.models.inventory import InventoryItem
from app.models.cash_flow import CashFlowEvent
from app.models.supplier import Supplier
from app.models.payment import Payment
from app.models.order import PurchaseOrder, CustomerOrder
from app.models.settings import AppSettingsModel
from app.services.forecast import build_detailed_forecast
from app.services.financial import enrich_inventory_item, to_iso_date

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/dashboard", tags=["dashboard"])

@router.get("/summary")
def get_dashboard_summary(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    today = date.today()
    today_str = to_iso_date(today)

    # 1. Fetch business-isolated records
    invoices = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.business_id == business.id).all()
    products = db.query(Product).filter(Product.business_id == business.id).all()
    events = db.query(CashFlowEvent).filter(CashFlowEvent.business_id == business.id).all()
    suppliers = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.business_id == business.id).all()
    payments = db.query(Payment).filter(Payment.business_id == business.id).all()
    purchase_orders = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(PurchaseOrder.business_id == business.id).all()

    # 2. Derive Current Cash: Opening cash + actual cash inflows - actual cash outflows
    # Completed payments represent verified transactions
    completed_inflows = sum(
        p.amount_paise for p in payments if p.direction == "incoming" and p.status == "completed"
    )
    completed_outflows = sum(
        p.amount_paise for p in payments if p.direction == "outgoing" and p.status == "completed"
    )

    # Also capture non-invoice completed cash flow events (e.g. ad-hoc rent, payroll, tax)
    # avoiding double counting against payments
    handled_po_ids = {p.purchase_order_id for p in payments if p.purchase_order_id}
    handled_inv_ids = {p.invoice_id for p in payments if p.invoice_id}

    for ev in events:
        if ev.status == "completed" and not ev.is_projected and ev.date <= today_str:
            if ev.related_purchase_order_id and ev.related_purchase_order_id in handled_po_ids:
                continue
            if ev.related_invoice_id and ev.related_invoice_id in handled_inv_ids:
                continue
            if ev.direction == "incoming":
                completed_inflows += ev.amount_paise
            elif ev.direction == "outgoing":
                completed_outflows += ev.amount_paise

    opening_cash = business.opening_cash_paise if business.opening_cash_paise is not None else 0
    current_cash_paise = opening_cash + completed_inflows - completed_outflows

    # 3. Derive Receivables, Payables, Overdue Receivables, Open Invoices
    receivables = 0
    overdue_rec = 0
    open_invoices_count = 0
    payables = 0

    for inv in invoices:
        if inv.status in ("void", "cancelled"):
            continue
        rem = max(0, inv.amount_paise - inv.amount_paid_paise)
        if rem > 0:
            open_invoices_count += 1
            if inv.type == "receivable":
                receivables += rem
                if inv.due_date < today_str:
                    overdue_rec += rem
            elif inv.type == "payable":
                payables += rem

    # Include unbilled Purchase Orders in payables
    billed_po_ids = {inv.purchase_order_id for inv in invoices if inv.purchase_order_id and inv.type == "payable"}
    for po in purchase_orders:
        if po.id not in billed_po_ids and po.status in ("draft", "sent", "confirmed"):
            unbilled_amount = max(0, po.total_paise - (po.advance_paid_paise or 0))
            payables += unbilled_amount

    # 4. Inventory health and low stock
    low_stock_count = 0
    for p in products:
        enriched = enrich_inventory_item(p, db)
        if enriched["status"] in ("low_stock", "stockout_risk", "out_of_stock"):
            low_stock_count += 1

    # 5. 30-Day Cash Forecast starting from today's actual cash on hand
    safety_threshold = business.safety_threshold_paise or 500_000
    horizon_days = business.default_forecast_horizon_days or 30

    forecast_data = build_detailed_forecast(
        events=events,
        opening_cash_paise=current_cash_paise,
        days=horizon_days,
        safety_threshold_paise=safety_threshold,
    )

    # 6. Upcoming Cash Events (future events from today forward)
    upcoming_events = [
        {
            "id": e.id,
            "type": e.type,
            "label": e.label,
            "direction": e.direction,
            "amountPaise": e.amount_paise,
            "date": e.date,
            "relatedInvoiceId": e.related_invoice_id,
            "relatedPurchaseOrderId": e.related_purchase_order_id,
            "isProjected": e.is_projected,
            "counterpartyName": e.counterparty_name,
            "status": e.status,
            "riskNote": e.risk_note,
        }
        for e in sorted(events, key=lambda x: x.date)
        if e.date >= today_str
    ][:6]

    # 7. Notification Preferences & Filtered Alerts
    settings_record = db.query(AppSettingsModel).filter(AppSettingsModel.business_id == business.id).first()
    notifs = json.loads(settings_record.notification_preferences_json) if settings_record and settings_record.notification_preferences_json else {}

    alerts = []

    # A. Cash Shortfall Alert
    if notifs.get("lowCash", True) and forecast_data["daysBelowThreshold"] > 0:
        first_breach = forecast_data["breachDates"][0]
        alerts.append({
            "id": "alert_cash_shortfall",
            "severity": "critical",
            "title": f"Cash shortfall projected around {first_breach}",
            "description": f"Balance drops below safety threshold (₹{safety_threshold / 100:,.0f}). Action required.",
            "createdAt": today_str,
            "acknowledged": False,
        })

    # B. Overdue Customer Receivables Alert
    if notifs.get("overdueInvoices", True) and overdue_rec > 0:
        alerts.append({
            "id": "alert_overdue_rec",
            "severity": "warning",
            "title": f"Overdue customer receivables: ₹{overdue_rec / 100:,.0f}",
            "description": "Follow up on overdue customer collections to protect cash reserves.",
            "createdAt": today_str,
            "acknowledged": False,
        })

    # C. Supplier Delivery & Reliability Alerts
    if notifs.get("delayedDeliveries", True):
        for s in suppliers:
            if s.reliability_score is not None and s.reliability_score < 75:
                alerts.append({
                    "id": f"alert_sup_{s.id}",
                    "severity": "warning",
                    "title": f"At-risk supplier: {s.name}",
                    "description": f"Low reliability score ({s.reliability_score}%). Check order delivery tracking.",
                    "relatedEntityId": s.id,
                    "relatedEntityType": "supplier",
                    "createdAt": today_str,
                    "acknowledged": False,
                })

    # D. Low Stock Alert
    if low_stock_count > 0:
        alerts.append({
            "id": "alert_low_stock",
            "severity": "warning",
            "title": f"{low_stock_count} item{'s' if low_stock_count > 1 else ''} below reorder point",
            "description": "Replenish inventory to prevent production and sales fulfillment delays.",
            "createdAt": today_str,
            "acknowledged": False,
        })

    # 8. Dynamic Recommendations based on real conditions
    recommendations = []
    if forecast_data["daysBelowThreshold"] > 0:
        recommendations.append({
            "id": "rec_stagger_payables",
            "title": "Stagger supplier payments across pay cycles",
            "rationale": "Smoothing outgoing payables prevents dips below your safety threshold.",
            "impactPaise": 250_000,
            "priority": "high",
        })
    if overdue_rec > 0:
        recommendations.append({
            "id": "rec_early_discounts",
            "title": "Enable early payment discounts for key clients",
            "rationale": "Accelerates customer collections and reinforces working capital.",
            "impactPaise": min(overdue_rec, 500_000),
            "priority": "medium",
        })
    if low_stock_count > 0:
        recommendations.append({
            "id": "rec_reorder_stock",
            "title": "Issue purchase orders for low-stock inventory",
            "rationale": "Order replenishment stock now to avoid supply chain disruptions.",
            "impactPaise": 150_000,
            "priority": "low" if forecast_data["daysBelowThreshold"] == 0 else "medium",
        })

    return {
        "businessName": business.name,
        "currency": business.currency or "INR",
        "cashOnHandPaise": current_cash_paise,
        "receivablesPaise": receivables,
        "payablesPaise": payables,
        "overdueReceivablesPaise": overdue_rec,
        "lowStockCount": low_stock_count,
        "openInvoiceCount": open_invoices_count,
        "forecast": forecast_data["points"],
        "alerts": alerts,
        "recommendations": recommendations,
        "upcomingEvents": upcoming_events,
    }

@router.get("/recent-activity")
def get_dashboard_recent_activity(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Retrieve recent transactions and business activity for the authenticated business."""
    # Combine recent invoices, payments, and orders into a unified timeline
    invoices = (
        db.query(Invoice)
        .filter(Invoice.business_id == business.id)
        .order_by(Invoice.created_at.desc())
        .limit(10)
        .all()
    )
    payments = (
        db.query(Payment)
        .filter(Payment.business_id == business.id)
        .order_by(Payment.created_at.desc())
        .limit(10)
        .all()
    )

    activities = []
    for inv in invoices:
        activities.append({
            "id": f"act_inv_{inv.id}",
            "type": "invoice",
            "title": f"Invoice {inv.invoice_number} ({inv.type})",
            "amountPaise": inv.amount_paise,
            "status": inv.status,
            "date": inv.created_at or inv.issue_date,
        })
    for p in payments:
        activities.append({
            "id": f"act_pay_{p.id}",
            "type": "payment",
            "title": f"{'Received payment' if p.direction == 'incoming' else 'Paid supplier'}",
            "amountPaise": p.amount_paise,
            "status": p.status,
            "date": p.created_at or p.completed_date or p.scheduled_date,
        })

    activities.sort(key=lambda a: a.get("date") or "", reverse=True)
    return {"activities": activities[:10]}

<file path="backend/app/api/deps.py">
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status, Header
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.services.auth import decode_access_token
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.business import Business, BusinessMembership

security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)

def get_current_user(
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(security),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
) -> User:
    if not credentials:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Authentication token required",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    
    token = credentials.credentials
    payload = decode_access_token(token)
    if not payload or "sub" not in payload:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired authentication token",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    
    user_id = payload["sub"]
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="User not found",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
        )
    return user

def get_current_business(
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    x_business_id: str | None = Header(None, alias="x-business-id"),
    credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(security),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> Business:
    # First priority: explicit header
    target_business_id = x_business_id

    # Second priority: claim in JWT token
    if not target_business_id and credentials:
        payload = decode_access_token(credentials.credentials)
        if payload and payload.get("business_id"):
            target_business_id = payload.get("business_id")

    # If neither, default to the user's first membership business
    membership = None
    if target_business_id:
        membership = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(
            BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id,
            BusinessMembership.business_id == target_business_id
        ).first()
        if not membership:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="You do not have access to this business"
            )
    else:
        membership = db.query(BusinessMembership).filter(
            BusinessMembership.user_id == user.id
        ).first()

    if not membership:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="No business membership found for this user. Please register or join a business."
        )

    business = db.query(Business).filter(Business.id == membership.business_id).first()
    if not business:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Business not found"
        )
    return business

from datetime import date, timedelta
import uuid
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.api.deps import get_current_business
from app.models.business import Business
from app.models.product import Product
from app.models.inventory import InventoryItem, InventoryMovement
from app.models.supplier import Supplier
from app.models.order import PurchaseOrder, CustomerOrder
from app.models.customer import Customer
from app.services.financial import enrich_inventory_item, get_inventory_summary, to_iso_date

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/inventory", tags=["inventory"])

@router.get("")
def list_inventory(
    search: str | None = None,
    category: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    sortBy: str | None = None,
    sortDir: str | None = "asc",
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    pageSize: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100),
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(Product).filter(Product.business_id == business.id)

    if category and category != "all":
        query = query.filter(Product.category == category)

    if search:
        s = f"%{search.strip().lower()}%"
        query = query.filter(
            (Product.name.ilike(s)) |
            (Product.sku.ilike(s)) |
            (Product.category.ilike(s))
        )

    products = query.all()
    rows = [enrich_inventory_item(p, db) for p in products]

    if status and status != "all":
        rows = [r for r in rows if r["status"] == status]

    reverse = (sortDir == "desc")
    if sortBy == "name":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["product"]["name"].lower(), reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "available":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["availableStock"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "onHand":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["stockOnHand"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "cost":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["unitCostPaise"], reverse=reverse)
    elif sortBy == "status":
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["status"], reverse=reverse)
    else:
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["product"]["name"].lower())

    total = len(rows)
    start = (page - 1) * pageSize
    paged = rows[start : start + pageSize]

    return {
        "data": paged,
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "pageSize": pageSize,
    }

    return get_inventory_summary(business.id, db)

@router.get("/reorder-recommendations")
def reorder_recommendations(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    products = db.query(Product).filter(Product.business_id == business.id).all()
    recommendations = []

    for product in products:
        enriched = enrich_inventory_item(product, db)
        preferred_supplier = enriched["preferredSupplier"]

        cust_orders = db.query(CustomerOrder).filter(
            CustomerOrder.product_id == product.id,
            CustomerOrder.status == "confirmed"
        ).all()

        commitments_at_risk = []
        for co in cust_orders:
            cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == co.customer_id).first()
            commitments_at_risk.append(f"{cust.name if cust else 'Customer'} ({co.quantity} units due {co.delivery_date or 'soon'})")

        is_low = enriched["availableStock"] < product.reorder_point
        is_stockout_risk = enriched["status"] == "stockout_risk"
        is_out_of_stock = enriched["availableStock"] == 0

        if is_low or is_stockout_risk or is_out_of_stock:
            lead_days = preferred_supplier["paymentTermsDays"] if preferred_supplier else 15
            today = date.today()
            delivery_date = today + timedelta(days=lead_days)

            target_stock = max(product.reorder_point * 2, 20)
            current_deficit = target_stock - enriched["availableStock"] - enriched["incomingStock"]
            suggested_reorder_qty = max(10, current_deficit if current_deficit > 0 else 10)

            proposed_amount = suggested_reorder_qty * product.unit_cost_paise
            required_advance = round(proposed_amount * 0.15) if preferred_supplier else 0

            forecast_demand = max(5, sum(co.quantity for co in cust_orders))

            reason = ""
            if enriched["stockOnHand"] == 0 and enriched["incomingStock"] == 0:
                reason = "Zero stock on hand and no incoming purchase order."
            elif is_stockout_risk:
                reason = f"Committed orders ({sum(co.quantity for co in cust_orders)} units) exceed available stock ({enriched['availableStock']} units)."
            else:
                reason = f"Available stock ({enriched['availableStock']} units) is below reorder threshold ({product.reorder_point} units)."

            recommendations.append({
                "productId": product.id,
                "productName": product.name,
                "sku": product.sku,
                "category": product.category,
                "currentAvailableStock": enriched["availableStock"],
                "reorderPoint": product.reorder_point,
                "incomingQuantity": enriched["incomingStock"],
                "forecastDemand": forecast_demand,
                "estimatedStockoutDate": enriched["nextExpectedDelivery"],
                "suggestedReorderQuantity": suggested_reorder_qty,
                "preferredSupplierId": preferred_supplier["id"] if preferred_supplier else None,
                "preferredSupplierName": preferred_supplier["name"] if preferred_supplier else None,
                "preferredSupplierLeadDays": lead_days,
                "estimatedDeliveryDate": to_iso_date(delivery_date),
                "proposedPurchaseAmountPaise": proposed_amount,
                "requiredAdvancePaise": required_advance,
                "relatedCustomerOrderCount": len(cust_orders),
                "customerCommitmentsAtRisk": commitments_at_risk,
                "reason": reason,
                "hasSufficientData": True,
            })

    return recommendations

@router.get("/alerts")
def inventory_alerts(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    products = db.query(Product).filter(Product.business_id == business.id).all()
    alerts = []

    for product in products:
        enriched = enrich_inventory_item(product, db)
        if enriched["status"] == "stockout_risk":
            alerts.append({
                "id": f"alert_inv_{product.id}",
                "severity": "critical",
                "category": "projected_stockout",
                "title": f"Projected stockout: {product.name} ({product.sku})",
                "explanation": f"Only {enriched['availableStock']} units available. Committed orders exceed available stock.",
                "productId": product.id,
                "productName": product.name,
                "sku": product.sku,
                "financialImpactPaise": product.unit_price_paise * max(1, product.reorder_point),
                "actionType": "simulate",
            })
        elif enriched["status"] == "out_of_stock":
            alerts.append({
                "id": f"alert_inv_{product.id}",
                "severity": "critical",
                "category": "projected_stockout",
                "title": f"Out of stock: {product.name} ({product.sku})",
                "explanation": "Zero units on hand and reorder required to maintain catalog availability.",
                "productId": product.id,
                "productName": product.name,
                "sku": product.sku,
                "financialImpactPaise": product.unit_cost_paise * 10,
                "actionType": "view_product",
            })
        elif enriched["status"] == "low_stock":
            alerts.append({
                "id": f"alert_inv_{product.id}",
                "severity": "warning",
                "category": "delayed_supplier_delivery",
                "title": f"Low stock: {product.name} ({product.sku})",
                "explanation": f"Available stock ({enriched['availableStock']} units) is below reorder point ({product.reorder_point} units).",
                "productId": product.id,
                "productName": product.name,
                "sku": product.sku,
                "financialImpactPaise": product.unit_cost_paise * product.reorder_point,
                "actionType": "view_po",
            })

    return alerts

@router.get("/{productId}")
def get_product(
    productId: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    product = db.query(Product).filter(
        Product.id == productId,
        Product.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")

    enriched = enrich_inventory_item(product, db)
    movements = db.query(InventoryMovement).filter(InventoryMovement.product_id == productId).all()
    pos = db.query(PurchaseOrder).join(PurchaseOrder.line_items).filter(PurchaseOrder.line_items.any(product_id=productId)).all()
    cos = db.query(CustomerOrder).filter(CustomerOrder.product_id == productId).all()

    co_details = []
    for co in cos:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == co.customer_id).first()
        co_details.append({
            "id": co.id,
            "customerId": co.customer_id,
            "customerName": cust.name if cust else "Customer",
            "productId": co.product_id,
            "quantity": co.quantity,
            "totalPaise": co.total_paise,
            "status": co.status,
            "orderDate": co.order_date,
            "deliveryDate": co.delivery_date,
        })

    return {
        **enriched,
        "movements": [
            {
                "id": m.id,
                "businessId": m.business_id,
                "productId": m.product_id,
                "type": m.type,
                "quantity": m.quantity,
                "resultingBalance": m.resulting_balance,
                "date": m.date,
                "referenceType": m.reference_type,
                "referenceId": m.reference_id,
                "note": m.note,
                "createdAt": m.created_at,
            }
            for m in movements
        ],
        "purchaseOrders": [
            {
                "id": p.id,
                "poNumber": p.po_number,
                "supplierId": p.supplier_id,
                "totalPaise": p.total_paise,
                "status": p.status,
                "orderDate": p.order_date,
                "expectedDeliveryDate": p.expected_delivery_date,
            }
            for p in pos
        ],
        "customerOrders": co_details,
        "forecastDemand": max(10, sum(c["quantity"] for c in co_details)),
    }

@router.post("", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_product(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    sku = payload.get("sku", "").strip().upper()
    name = payload.get("name", "").strip()

    if not sku:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="SKU is required")
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Product name is required")

    existing = db.query(Product).filter(
        Product.business_id == business.id,
        Product.sku == sku
    ).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'SKU "{sku}" already exists.')

    prod_id = f"prod_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    product = Product(
        id=prod_id,
        business_id=business.id,
        sku=sku,
        name=name,
        category=payload.get("category", "General"),
        description=payload.get("description"),
        unit_of_measure=payload.get("unitOfMeasure", "units"),
        reorder_point=payload.get("reorderPoint", 10),
        preferred_supplier_id=payload.get("preferredSupplierId"),
        unit_cost_paise=payload.get("unitCostPaise", 0),
        unit_price_paise=round(payload.get("unitCostPaise", 0) * 1.5),
        currency=payload.get("currency", "INR"),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(product)
    db.flush()

    init_qty = payload.get("initialStockQuantity", 0)
    inv = InventoryItem(
        id=f"inv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        product_id=prod_id,
        quantity_on_hand=init_qty,
        quantity_reserved=0,
        quantity_on_order=0,
        updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(inv)

    if init_qty > 0:
        mov = InventoryMovement(
            id=f"mov_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            business_id=business.id,
            product_id=prod_id,
            type="adjustment",
            quantity=init_qty,
            resulting_balance=init_qty,
            date=to_iso_date(date.today()),
            note="Initial inventory setup",
            created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        )
        db.add(mov)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(product)
    return enrich_inventory_item(product, db)

@router.patch("/{productId}")
def update_product(
    productId: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    product = db.query(Product).filter(
        Product.id == productId,
        Product.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")

    if "sku" in payload and payload["sku"]:
        sku = payload["sku"].strip().upper()
        existing = db.query(Product).filter(
            Product.business_id == business.id,
            Product.sku == sku,
            Product.id != productId
        ).first()
        if existing:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f'SKU "{sku}" is already in use.')
        product.sku = sku

    if "name" in payload and payload["name"]: product.name = payload["name"].strip()
    if "category" in payload: product.category = payload["category"].strip()
    if "description" in payload: product.description = payload["description"].strip()
    if "unitOfMeasure" in payload: product.unit_of_measure = payload["unitOfMeasure"].strip()
    if "reorderPoint" in payload and payload["reorderPoint"] is not None:
        product.reorder_point = payload["reorderPoint"]
    if "preferredSupplierId" in payload:
        product.preferred_supplier_id = payload["preferredSupplierId"]
    if "unitCostPaise" in payload and payload["unitCostPaise"] is not None:
        product.unit_cost_paise = payload["unitCostPaise"]

    product.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(product)
    return {
        "id": product.id,
        "businessId": product.business_id,
        "sku": product.sku,
        "name": product.name,
        "unitCostPaise": product.unit_cost_paise,
        "unitPricePaise": product.unit_price_paise,
        "reorderPoint": product.reorder_point,
        "category": product.category,
        "description": product.description,
        "unitOfMeasure": product.unit_of_measure,
        "preferredSupplierId": product.preferred_supplier_id,
        "currency": product.currency,
    }

@router.post("/transactions")
def record_movement(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    prod_id = payload.get("productId")
    qty = payload.get("quantity", 0)
    mov_type = payload.get("type", "adjustment")

    if not prod_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Product ID is required")
    if qty <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Movement quantity must be greater than zero.")

    product = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == prod_id, Product.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not product:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Product not found")

    inv = db.query(InventoryItem).filter(InventoryItem.product_id == prod_id).first()
    if not inv:
        inv = InventoryItem(
            id=f"inv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            business_id=business.id,
            product_id=prod_id,
            quantity_on_hand=0,
            quantity_reserved=0,
            quantity_on_order=0,
            updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        )
        db.add(inv)
        db.flush()

    if mov_type == "receipt":
        inv.quantity_on_hand += qty
        inv.quantity_on_order = max(0, inv.quantity_on_order - qty)
    elif mov_type == "sale":
        inv.quantity_on_hand = max(0, inv.quantity_on_hand - qty)
        inv.quantity_reserved = max(0, inv.quantity_reserved - qty)
    elif mov_type == "reservation":
        inv.quantity_reserved += qty
    elif mov_type == "reservation_release":
        inv.quantity_reserved = max(0, inv.quantity_reserved - qty)
    elif mov_type == "adjustment":
        inv.quantity_on_hand += qty
    elif mov_type == "return":
        inv.quantity_on_hand += qty

    mov_date = payload.get("date") or to_iso_date(date.today())
    inv.updated_at = mov_date

    movement = InventoryMovement(
        id=f"mov_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        product_id=prod_id,
        type=mov_type,
        quantity=qty,
        resulting_balance=inv.quantity_on_hand,
        date=mov_date,
        reference_type=payload.get("referenceType"),
        reference_id=payload.get("referenceId"),
        note=payload.get("note"),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(movement)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(movement)

    return {
        "id": movement.id,
        "businessId": movement.business_id,
        "productId": movement.product_id,
        "type": movement.type,
        "quantity": movement.quantity,
        "resultingBalance": movement.resulting_balance,
        "date": movement.date,
        "referenceType": movement.reference_type,
        "referenceId": movement.reference_id,
        "note": movement.note,
        "createdAt": movement.created_at,
    }

from datetime import date
import uuid
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.api.deps import get_current_business
from app.models.business import Business
from app.models.invoice import Invoice
from app.models.customer import Customer
from app.models.supplier import Supplier
from app.models.order import CustomerOrder, PurchaseOrder
from app.models.payment import Payment
from app.models.cash_flow import CashFlowEvent
from app.services.financial import enrich_invoice, get_invoice_summary, to_iso_date

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/invoices", tags=["invoices"])

@router.get("")
def list_invoices(
    search: str | None = None,
    type: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    pageSize: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100),
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.business_id == business.id)

    if type and type != "all":
        query = query.filter(Invoice.type == type)

    today = date.today()
    invoices = query.all()
    enriched = [enrich_invoice(inv, db, today) for inv in invoices]

    if status and status != "all":
        if status == "unpaid":
            enriched = [i for i in enriched if i["status"] in ("sent", "draft") and i["amountPaidPaise"] == 0 and not i["isOverdue"]]
        elif status == "partially_paid":
            enriched = [i for i in enriched if i["status"] == "partially_paid"]
        elif status == "paid":
            enriched = [i for i in enriched if i["status"] == "paid"]
        elif status == "overdue":
            enriched = [i for i in enriched if i["isOverdue"]]
        else:
            enriched = [i for i in enriched if i["status"] == status]

    if search:
        s = search.strip().lower()
        enriched = [
            i for i in enriched
            if s in i["invoiceNumber"].lower()
            or s in i["counterpartyName"].lower()
            or (i["notes"] and s in i["notes"].lower())
        ]

    # Sort default by dueDate descending
    enriched.sort(key=lambda x: x["dueDate"], reverse=True)

    total = len(enriched)
    start = (page - 1) * pageSize
    paged = enriched[start : start + pageSize]

    return {
        "data": paged,
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "pageSize": pageSize,
    }

@router.get("/summary")
def invoice_summary(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    return get_invoice_summary(business.id, db)

@router.get("/{id}")
def get_invoice(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    inv = db.query(Invoice).filter(
        Invoice.id == id,
        Invoice.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not inv:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found")

    today = date.today()
    enriched = enrich_invoice(inv, db, today)
    customer = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == inv.customer_id).first() if inv.customer_id else None
    supplier = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == inv.supplier_id).first() if inv.supplier_id else None
    customer_order = db.query(CustomerOrder).filter(CustomerOrder.id == inv.customer_order_id).first() if inv.customer_order_id else None
    purchase_order = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(PurchaseOrder.id == inv.purchase_order_id).first() if inv.purchase_order_id else None
    payments = db.query(Payment).filter(Payment.invoice_id == id).all()

    return {
        "invoice": enriched,
        "customer": {
            "id": customer.id,
            "name": customer.name,
            "email": customer.email,
            "phone": customer.phone,
            "outstandingPaise": customer.outstanding_paise,
        } if customer else None,
        "supplier": {
            "id": supplier.id,
            "name": supplier.name,
            "email": supplier.email,
            "phone": supplier.phone,
            "outstandingPaise": supplier.outstanding_paise,
        } if supplier else None,
        "customerOrder": {
            "id": customer_order.id,
            "quantity": customer_order.quantity,
            "totalPaise": customer_order.total_paise,
            "status": customer_order.status,
        } if customer_order else None,
        "purchaseOrder": {
            "id": purchase_order.id,
            "poNumber": purchase_order.po_number,
            "totalPaise": purchase_order.total_paise,
            "status": purchase_order.status,
        } if purchase_order else None,
        "payments": [
            {
                "id": p.id,
                "direction": p.direction,
                "invoiceId": p.invoice_id,
                "amountPaise": p.amount_paise,
                "status": p.status,
                "scheduledDate": p.scheduled_date,
                "completedDate": p.completed_date,
                "method": p.method,
            }
            for p in payments
        ],
    }

@router.post("", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_invoice(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    inv_type = payload.get("type", "receivable")
    amount = payload.get("amountPaise", 0)
    customer_id = payload.get("customerId")
    supplier_id = payload.get("supplierId")

    if amount <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invoice amount must be greater than zero.")
    if inv_type == "receivable" and not customer_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="A customer must be selected for accounts receivable invoices.")
    if inv_type == "payable" and not supplier_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="A supplier must be selected for accounts payable vendor bills.")

    inv_id = f"invc_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    inv_number = payload.get("invoiceNumber") or (
        f"INV-2026-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4].upper()}" if inv_type == "receivable"
        else f"BILL-2026-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4].upper()}"
    )

    issue_date = payload.get("issueDate") or to_iso_date(date.today())
    due_date = payload.get("dueDate") or issue_date

    invoice = Invoice(
        id=inv_id,
        business_id=business.id,
        invoice_number=inv_number,
        type=inv_type,
        customer_id=customer_id,
        customer_order_id=payload.get("customerOrderId"),
        supplier_id=supplier_id,
        purchase_order_id=payload.get("purchaseOrderId"),
        amount_paise=amount,
        amount_paid_paise=0,
        status=payload.get("status", "sent"),
        issue_date=issue_date,
        due_date=due_date,
        notes=payload.get("notes"),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(invoice)

    # Update counterparty balance
    if inv_type == "receivable" and customer_id:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == customer_id).first()
        if cust:
            cust.outstanding_paise = (cust.outstanding_paise or 0) + amount
    elif inv_type == "payable" and supplier_id:
        supp = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == supplier_id).first()
        if supp:
            supp.outstanding_paise = (supp.outstanding_paise or 0) + amount

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(invoice)
    return enrich_invoice(invoice, db)

@router.patch("/{id}")
def update_invoice(
    id: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    inv = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.id == id, Invoice.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not inv:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found")

    if "notes" in payload: inv.notes = payload["notes"]
    if "dueDate" in payload: inv.due_date = payload["dueDate"]
    if "status" in payload: inv.status = payload["status"]

    inv.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inv)
    return enrich_invoice(inv, db)

@router.post("/{id}/payments")
def record_invoice_payment(
    id: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    inv = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.id == id, Invoice.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not inv:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found")

    if inv.status in ("void", "cancelled"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot record payment for a cancelled or void invoice.")

    amount = payload.get("amountPaise", 0)
    if amount <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Payment amount must be greater than zero.")

    remaining = max(0, inv.amount_paise - inv.amount_paid_paise)
    if amount > remaining:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Payment amount (₹{amount / 100:.2f}) exceeds remaining invoice balance (₹{remaining / 100:.2f})."
        )

    pay_date = payload.get("paymentDate") or to_iso_date(date.today())
    is_rec = (inv.type == "receivable")

    payment = Payment(
        id=f"pay_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        direction="incoming" if is_rec else "outgoing",
        invoice_id=inv.id,
        customer_id=inv.customer_id,
        supplier_id=inv.supplier_id,
        amount_paise=amount,
        status="completed",
        scheduled_date=pay_date,
        completed_date=pay_date,
        method=payload.get("method", "Bank Transfer"),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(payment)

    inv.amount_paid_paise += amount
    if inv.amount_paid_paise >= inv.amount_paise:
        inv.status = "paid"
    else:
        inv.status = "partially_paid"
    inv.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())

    # Update counterparty outstanding balance
    if is_rec and inv.customer_id:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == inv.customer_id).first()
        if cust:
            cust.outstanding_paise = max(0, (cust.outstanding_paise or 0) - amount)
    elif not is_rec and inv.supplier_id:
        supp = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == inv.supplier_id).first()
        if supp:
            supp.outstanding_paise = max(0, (supp.outstanding_paise or 0) - amount)

    # Cash movement: only recorded payments create real cash movement!
    cf_event = CashFlowEvent(
        id=f"evt_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        type="customer_payment" if is_rec else "supplier_payment",
        label=f"{'Receipt' if is_rec else 'Payment'} - {inv.invoice_number}",
        direction="incoming" if is_rec else "outgoing",
        amount_paise=amount,
        date=pay_date,
        related_invoice_id=inv.id,
        is_projected=False,
        status="completed",
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(cf_event)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(payment)

    return {
        "id": payment.id,
        "direction": payment.direction,
        "invoiceId": payment.invoice_id,
        "customerId": payment.customer_id,
        "supplierId": payment.supplier_id,
        "amountPaise": payment.amount_paise,
        "status": payment.status,
        "scheduledDate": payment.scheduled_date,
        "completedDate": payment.completed_date,
        "method": payment.method,
    }

@router.post("/{id}/cancel")
def cancel_invoice(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    inv = db.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.id == id, Invoice.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not inv:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invoice not found")

    if inv.amount_paid_paise >= inv.amount_paise and inv.amount_paise > 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot cancel a fully settled invoice.")

    remaining = max(0, inv.amount_paise - inv.amount_paid_paise)
    inv.status = "void"
    inv.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())

    # Decrement counterparty outstanding
    if inv.type == "receivable" and inv.customer_id:
        cust = db.query(Customer).filter(Customer.id == inv.customer_id).first()
        if cust:
            cust.outstanding_paise = max(0, (cust.outstanding_paise or 0) - remaining)
    elif inv.type == "payable" and inv.supplier_id:
        supp = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == inv.supplier_id).first()
        if supp:
            supp.outstanding_paise = max(0, (supp.outstanding_paise or 0) - remaining)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(inv)
    return enrich_invoice(inv, db)

<file path="backend/app/api/purchase_orders.py">
from datetime import date
import uuid
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.database import get_db
from app.api.deps import get_current_business
from app.models.business import Business
from app.models.supplier import Supplier
from app.models.order import PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLineItem
from app.models.product import Product
from app.models.inventory import InventoryItem, InventoryMovement
from app.models.invoice import Invoice
from app.models.payment import Payment
from app.models.cash_flow import CashFlowEvent
from app.services.financial import to_iso_date

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/purchase-orders", tags=["purchase-orders"])

def enrich_po(po: PurchaseOrder, db: Session) -> dict:
    supplier = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == po.supplier_id).first()
    line_items_data = []
    total_qty = 0

    for li in po.line_items:
        prod = db.query(Product).filter(Product.id == li.product_id).first()
        total_qty += li.quantity
        line_items_data.append({
            "id": li.id,
            "purchaseOrderId": li.purchase_order_id,
            "productId": li.product_id,
            "quantity": li.quantity,
            "unitPricePaise": li.unit_price_paise,
            "totalPaise": li.total_paise,
            "receivedQuantity": li.received_quantity,
            "product": {
                "id": prod.id,
                "sku": prod.sku,
                "name": prod.name,
                "unitCostPaise": prod.unit_cost_paise,
            } if prod else None,
        })

    received_units = po.received_quantity or sum(li.received_quantity for li in po.line_items)

    return {
        "id": po.id,
        "poNumber": po.po_number,
        "supplierId": po.supplier_id,
        "supplier": {
            "id": supplier.id,
            "name": supplier.name,
            "contactName": supplier.contact_name,
            "email": supplier.email,
            "paymentTermsDays": supplier.payment_terms_days,
            "reliabilityScore": supplier.reliability_score,
            "status": supplier.status,
        } if supplier else None,
        "quantity": total_qty,
        "orderedUnits": total_qty,
        "receivedUnits": received_units,
        "receivedQuantity": received_units,
        "lineItems": line_items_data,
        "lineItemsDetails": line_items_data,
        "totalPaise": po.total_paise,
        "advancePaidPaise": po.advance_paid_paise,
        "outstandingPaise": max(0, po.total_paise - po.advance_paid_paise),
        "status": po.status,
        "orderDate": po.order_date,
        "expectedDeliveryDate": po.expected_delivery_date,
        "paymentTermsDays": po.payment_terms_days,
        "paymentDueDate": po.payment_due_date,
        "notes": po.notes,
    }

@router.get("")
def list_purchase_orders(
    supplierId: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    search: str | None = None,
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    pageSize: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100),
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(PurchaseOrder.business_id == business.id)

    if supplierId:
        query = query.filter(PurchaseOrder.supplier_id == supplierId)
    if status and status != "all":
        query = query.filter(PurchaseOrder.status == status)
    if search:
        s = f"%{search.strip().lower()}%"
        query = query.filter(PurchaseOrder.po_number.ilike(s))

    pos = query.order_by(PurchaseOrder.order_date.desc()).all()
    enriched = [enrich_po(p, db) for p in pos]

    total = len(enriched)
    start = (page - 1) * pageSize
    paged = enriched[start : start + pageSize]

    return {
        "data": paged,
        "total": total,
        "page": page,
        "pageSize": pageSize,
    }

@router.get("/{id}")
def get_purchase_order(
    id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    po = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(
        (PurchaseOrder.id == id) | (PurchaseOrder.po_number == id),
        PurchaseOrder.business_id == business.id
    ).first()
    if not po:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Purchase order not found")
    return enrich_po(po, db)

@router.post("", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_purchase_order(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    supplier_id = payload.get("supplierId")
    line_items = payload.get("lineItems", [])

    if not supplier_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Supplier is required")
    if not line_items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="At least one line item is required")

    supplier = db.query(Supplier).filter(Supplier.id == supplier_id, Supplier.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not supplier:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Supplier not found")

    po_id = f"po_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    po_number = f"PO-2026-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4].upper()}"

    total_paise = sum(li.get("quantity", 0) * li.get("unitPricePaise", 0) for li in line_items)
    advance_amt = payload.get("advanceAmountPaise", 0)

    po = PurchaseOrder(
        id=po_id,
        business_id=business.id,
        po_number=po_number,
        supplier_id=supplier_id,
        total_paise=total_paise,
        advance_paid_paise=advance_amt,
        status="sent" if advance_amt > 0 else "draft",
        order_date=payload.get("orderDate") or to_iso_date(date.today()),
        expected_delivery_date=payload.get("expectedDeliveryDate"),
        payment_terms_days=payload.get("paymentTermsDays") or supplier.payment_terms_days,
        notes=payload.get("notes"),
        received_quantity=0,
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        updated_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(po)
    db.flush()

    for li in line_items:
        prod_id = li.get("productId")
        qty = li.get("quantity", 0)
        price = li.get("unitPricePaise", 0)
        tot = qty * price

        poli = PurchaseOrderLineItem(
            id=f"poli_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            purchase_order_id=po_id,
            product_id=prod_id,
            quantity=qty,
            unit_price_paise=price,
            total_paise=tot,
            received_quantity=0,
        )
        db.add(poli)

        # Update inventory quantityOnOrder
        inv = db.query(InventoryItem).filter(InventoryItem.product_id == prod_id).first()
        if inv:
            inv.quantity_on_order += qty
            inv.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())

    # If advance is recorded, update supplier balance, record payment and cash flow event
    if advance_amt > 0:
        pay_id = f"pay_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
        payment = Payment(
            id=pay_id,
            business_id=business.id,
            direction="outgoing",
            purchase_order_id=po_id,
            supplier_id=supplier_id,
            amount_paise=advance_amt,
            status="completed",
            scheduled_date=po.order_date,
            completed_date=po.order_date,
            method="Advance Transfer",
            created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        )
        db.add(payment)

        cf_event = CashFlowEvent(
            id=f"evt_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            business_id=business.id,
            type="supplier_payment",
            label=f"Advance - {po_number}",
            direction="outgoing",
            amount_paise=advance_amt,
            date=po.order_date,
            related_purchase_order_id=po_id,
            is_projected=False,
            counterparty_name=supplier.name,
            status="completed",
            created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
        )
        db.add(cf_event)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(po)
    return enrich_po(po, db)

@router.patch("/{id}/status")
def update_po_status(
    id: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    po = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(PurchaseOrder.id == id, PurchaseOrder.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not po:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Purchase order not found")

    new_status = payload.get("status")
    if new_status:
        po.status = new_status
        po.updated_at = to_iso_date(date.today())
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(po)

    return po

@router.post("/{id}/receive")
def record_po_receipt(
    id: str,
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    po = db.query(PurchaseOrder).filter(PurchaseOrder.id == id, PurchaseOrder.business_id == business.id).first()
    if not po:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Purchase order not found")

    receipts = payload.get("receipts", [])
    notes = payload.get("notes")
    receipt_date = to_iso_date(date.today())

    total_received_now = 0
    for rec in receipts:
        prod_id = rec.get("productId")
        qty = rec.get("quantity", 0)
        if qty <= 0:
            continue

        inv = db.query(InventoryItem).filter(InventoryItem.product_id == prod_id).first()
        if not inv:
            inv = InventoryItem(
                id=f"inv_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
                business_id=business.id,
                product_id=prod_id,
                quantity_on_hand=qty,
                quantity_reserved=0,
                quantity_on_order=0,
                updated_at=receipt_date,
            )
            db.add(inv)
        else:
            inv.quantity_on_hand += qty
            inv.quantity_on_order = max(0, inv.quantity_on_order - qty)
            inv.updated_at = receipt_date

        line_item = next((li for li in po.line_items if li.product_id == prod_id), None)
        if line_item:
            line_item.received_quantity += qty

        total_received_now += qty

        mov = InventoryMovement(
            id=f"mov_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
            business_id=business.id,
            product_id=prod_id,
            type="receipt",
            quantity=qty,
            resulting_balance=inv.quantity_on_hand,
            date=receipt_date,
            reference_type="purchase_order",
            reference_id=po.po_number or po.id,
            note=notes or f"Receipt against {po.po_number or po.id}",
            created_at=receipt_date,
        )
        db.add(mov)

    po.received_quantity = (po.received_quantity or 0) + total_received_now
    total_ordered = sum(li.quantity for li in po.line_items) if po.line_items else (po.quantity or 0)
    if po.received_quantity >= total_ordered:
        po.status = "received"
    else:
        po.status = "partially_received"

    po.updated_at = receipt_date
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(po)
    return enrich_po(po, db)
