<file path="src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx">
import * as React from "react";

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    };
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  return !!isMobile;
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/api/settingsApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, resetDbToSeed } from "@/mocks/store";
import type { AppSettings, UpdateSettingsInput } from "@/types";

/**
 * Settings API service.
 * Adapts to GET /settings, PATCH /settings, and POST /settings/reset-demo-data.
 */
export const settingsApi = {
  async getSettings(): Promise<AppSettings> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(150);
      return {
        business: { ...db.business },
        notifications: { ...db.notifications },
        app: { ...db.app },
        dataMode: DATA_MODE,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<AppSettings>("/settings");
  },

  async updateSettings(input: UpdateSettingsInput): Promise<AppSettings> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(200);

      if (input.business) {
        db.business = {
          ...db.business,
          ...input.business,
        };
      }

      if (input.notifications) {
        db.notifications = {
          ...db.notifications,
          ...input.notifications,
        };
      }

      if (input.app) {
        db.app = {
          ...db.app,
          ...input.app,
        };
      }

      return {
        business: { ...db.business },
        notifications: { ...db.notifications },
        app: { ...db.app },
        dataMode: DATA_MODE,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<AppSettings>("/settings", {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: input,
    });
  },

  async resetDemoData(): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(300);
      resetDbToSeed();
      return { success: true, message: "Demo data has been reset to its initial state." };
    }

    // In API mode, check safety / invoke the reset-demo-data endpoint if available
    return httpRequest<{ success: boolean; message: string }>("/settings/reset-demo-data", {
      method: "POST",
    });
  },
};

<file path="src/lib/error-capture.ts">
// Captures the original Error out-of-band so server.ts can recover the stack
// when h3 has already swallowed the throw into a generic 500 Response.

let lastCapturedError: { error: unknown; at: number } | undefined;
const TTL_MS = 5_000;

function record(error: unknown) {
  lastCapturedError = { error, at: Date.now() };
}

// h3's HTTPError serializes to {"status":500,"unhandled":true,"message":"HTTPError"} —
// no stack, no cause — so a plain console.error(error) reaches the log pipeline with
// the failure detail stripped. Expand Error-like args into a string that keeps the
// message, stack, and the full cause chain.
const CAUSE_DEPTH_LIMIT = 5;
const DESCRIPTION_LENGTH_LIMIT = 8_000;

export function describeError(error: unknown): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let current: unknown = error;
  for (let depth = 0; depth < CAUSE_DEPTH_LIMIT && current != null; depth++) {
    if (!(current instanceof Error)) {
      parts.push(typeof current === "string" ? current : safeStringify(current));
      break;
    }
    const label = depth === 0 ? "" : "caused by: ";
    const status = describeStatus(current);
    parts.push(`${label}${current.stack ?? `${current.name}: ${current.message}`}${status}`);
    current = current.cause;
  }
  return parts.join("\n").slice(0, DESCRIPTION_LENGTH_LIMIT);
}

function describeStatus(error: Error): string {
  const { status, statusCode } = error as { status?: unknown; statusCode?: unknown };
  const value = status ?? statusCode;
  return typeof value === "number" ? ` (status ${value})` : "";
}

function safeStringify(value: unknown): string {
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value);
  } catch {
    return String(value);
  }
}

function isErrorLike(value: unknown): value is Error {
  return value instanceof Error;
}

// Wrap console.error so errors logged by any layer — including h3's internal
// unhandled-error logging, which this file cannot hook directly — are both
// recorded for consumeLastCapturedError and expanded before serialization.
const originalConsoleError = console.error.bind(console);
console.error = (...args: unknown[]) => {
  const expanded = args.map((arg) => {
    if (!isErrorLike(arg)) return arg;
    record(arg);
    return describeError(arg);
  });
  originalConsoleError(...expanded);
};

if (typeof globalThis.addEventListener === "function") {
  globalThis.addEventListener("error", (event) => record((event as ErrorEvent).error ?? event));
  globalThis.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) =>
    record((event as PromiseRejectionEvent).reason),
  );
}

export function consumeLastCapturedError(): unknown {
  if (!lastCapturedError) return undefined;
  if (Date.now() - lastCapturedError.at > TTL_MS) {
    lastCapturedError = undefined;
    return undefined;
  }
  const { error } = lastCapturedError;
  lastCapturedError = undefined;
  return error;
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/errors.ts">
/**
 * Narrowing helpers for `catch` blocks.
 *
 * `catch (err)` gives `unknown`. Casting it to `any` (which the lint rules forbid)
 * silently accepts typos and wrong shapes. These helpers turn an unknown thrown
 * value into the small shape the API client actually guarantees (`ApiError`:
 * `status`, `code`, `message`), so error handling stays type-safe.
 */

export interface NormalizedApiError {
  code: string | undefined;
  status: number | undefined;
  message: string | undefined;
}

function pick(value: unknown, key: string): unknown {
  return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && key in value
    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
    : undefined;
}

export function toApiError(err: unknown): NormalizedApiError {
  const code = pick(err, "code");
  const status = pick(err, "status");
  const message = pick(err, "message");

  return {
    code: typeof code === "string" ? code : undefined,
    status: typeof status === "number" ? status : undefined,
    message: typeof message === "string" ? message : undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * True when the failure means "the backend could not be reached" — the offline
 * demo fallback keys off this, so it must stay in one place.
 */
export function isNetworkError(err: unknown): boolean {
  const { code, status } = toApiError(err);
  return code === "network_error" || status === 0;
}

const API_BASE = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models";

// Ordered priority list of Google AI Studio models with automatic fallback on 404/503
const CANDIDATE_MODELS = [
  "gemini-3.5-flash-lite",
  "gemini-3.5-flash",
  "gemini-3.8-flash",
  "gemini-2.5-flash",
];

export function getGeminiApiKey(): string {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const localKey = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (localKey && localKey.trim()) {
        return localKey.trim();
      }
    } catch {
      // LocalStorage access restricted
    }
  }

  // Fallback to environment variables
  const envKey =
    (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string> }).env?.["VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY"] ||
    (typeof process !== "undefined" && process?.env?.["NEXT_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY"]) ||
    "";

  return envKey.trim();
}

export function setGeminiApiKey(key: string): void {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      if (!key || !key.trim()) {
        localStorage.removeItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY, key.trim());
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
}

export function getGeminiApiKeySource(): "localStorage" | "env" | "none" {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const localKey = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (localKey && localKey.trim()) {
        return "localStorage";
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  const envKey =
    (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string> }).env?.["VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY"] ||
    (typeof process !== "undefined" && process?.env?.["NEXT_PUBLIC_GEMINI_API_KEY"]);

  if (envKey && envKey.trim()) {
    return "env";
  }

  return "none";
}

export interface ChatMessagePart {
  role: "user" | "bot" | "model";
  text: string;
}

export interface GeminiGenerateOptions {
  prompt: string;
  systemInstruction: string;
  history?: { role: "user" | "bot"; text: string }[];
  apiKeyOverride?: string;
  preferredModel?: string;
}

export interface GeminiResponse {
  text: string;
  model: string;
  promptTokens?: number;
  candidatesTokens?: number;
}

/**
 * Call the official Google AI Studio Gemini API endpoint with model failover.
 * Tries the available active models (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.8-flash).
 * Throws only if all models or network fail so callers seamlessly fall back to local deterministic generation.
 */
export async function callGeminiAPI(options: GeminiGenerateOptions): Promise<GeminiResponse> {
  const apiKey =
    options.apiKeyOverride !== undefined ? options.apiKeyOverride.trim() : getGeminiApiKey();

  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error("Missing Gemini API Key. Provide a key or use safe offline mode.");
  }

  // Convert conversation history to Gemini contents format
  const contents: Array<{ role: "user" | "model"; parts: Array<{ text: string }> }> = [];

  if (options.history && options.history.length > 0) {
    for (const msg of options.history) {
      contents.push({
        role: msg.role === "bot" ? "model" : "user",
        parts: [{ text: msg.text }],
      });
    }
  }

  // Append latest user message
  contents.push({
    role: "user",
    parts: [{ text: options.prompt }],
  });

  const payload = {
    contents,
    systemInstruction: {
      parts: [{ text: options.systemInstruction }],
    },
    generationConfig: {
      temperature: 0.35,
      maxOutputTokens: 1200,
      topP: 0.9,
    },
  };

  const modelsToTry = options.preferredModel
    ? [options.preferredModel, ...CANDIDATE_MODELS.filter((m) => m !== options.preferredModel)]
    : CANDIDATE_MODELS;

  let lastError: Error | null = null;

  for (const model of modelsToTry) {
    const url = `${API_BASE}/${model}:generateContent?key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey)}`;

    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        let errorDetail = "";
        try {
          const errJson = await response.json();
          errorDetail = errJson?.error?.message || response.statusText;
        } catch {
          errorDetail = response.statusText;
        }

        // If deprecated (404) or temporarily overloaded (503), try next model candidate
        if (response.status === 404 || response.status === 503) {
          console.warn(`Gemini model ${model} returned ${response.status} (${errorDetail}), trying fallback model...`);
          lastError = new Error(`Gemini API (${model} - ${response.status}): ${errorDetail}`);
          continue;
        }

        throw new Error(`Gemini API error (${model} - ${response.status}): ${errorDetail}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();
      const candidate = data?.candidates?.[0];
      const replyText = candidate?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text;

      if (!replyText) {
        throw new Error(`Gemini ${model} returned an empty response candidate.`);
      }

      return {
        text: replyText.trim(),
        model,
        promptTokens: data?.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount,
        candidatesTokens: data?.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount,
      };
    } catch (err) {
      lastError = err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err));
      // If it was a network failure (fetch TypeError), don't loop endlessly through all models
      if (err instanceof TypeError && err.message.includes("fetch")) {
        throw err;
      }
    }
  }

  throw lastError || new Error("All Gemini candidate models failed to generate content.");
}

<file path="src/lib/lovable-error-reporting.ts">
type LovableErrorOptions = {
  mechanism?: "manual" | "onerror" | "unhandledrejection" | "react_error_boundary";
  handled?: boolean;
  severity?: "error" | "warning" | "info";
};

type LovableEvents = {
  track?: (event: string, properties?: Record<string, unknown>) => string | null;
  captureException?: (
    error: unknown,
    context?: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: LovableErrorOptions,
  ) => void;
};

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __lovableEvents?: LovableEvents;
    __lovableReportRuntimeError?: (payload: {
      message: string;
      stack?: string;
      filename?: string;
    }) => void;
  }
}

export function reportLovableError(error: unknown, context: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.__lovableEvents?.captureException?.(
    error,
    {
      source: "react_error_boundary",
      route: window.location.pathname,
      ...context,
    },
    {
      mechanism: "react_error_boundary",
      handled: false,
      severity: "error",
    },
  );
  // Prod React does not rethrow boundary-caught errors to window.onerror, so the
  // editor's telemetry never sees them. Forward to lovable.js's reporting hook,
  // which is present only inside the editor preview.
  const stack = error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined;
  window.__lovableReportRuntimeError?.({
    message: describeThrown(error),
    ...(stack !== undefined && { stack }),
    filename: window.location.pathname,
  });
}

const MAX_SERIALIZED_LENGTH = 2000;

// Loaders and server fns throw raw Responses and plain objects (a Supabase
// `{ message, code, details }`), which String() reduces to "[object ...]".
function describeThrown(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Response) {
    return `Response ${error.status}${error.url ? ` at ${error.url}` : ""}`;
  }
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  const { message } = (error ?? {}) as { message?: unknown };
  if (typeof message === "string" && message.length > 0) return message;
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(error)?.slice(0, MAX_SERIALIZED_LENGTH) ?? String(error);
  } catch {
    return String(error);
  }
}

<file path="src/lib/simulatorStore.ts">
import type { SimulatorControls, SimulatorResult, ChaosStressTestResult } from "@/types";

export type SimulatorPreset = "baseline" | "flagship" | "chaos" | "custom_17d" | "custom";

export interface SharedSimulatorState {
  preset: SimulatorPreset;
  presetLabel: string;
  controls: SimulatorControls;
  result: SimulatorResult | null;
  chaosResult: ChaosStressTestResult | null;
  rescues: {
    autoPhaseApplied: boolean;
    autoPhaseTimestamp?: string;
    splitEscrowLocked: boolean;
    splitEscrowTimestamp?: string;
  };
}

export const DEFAULT_CONTROLS: SimulatorControls = {
  supplierDeliveryDelayDays: 0,
  customerPaymentDelayDays: 0,
  customerPaymentAmountPaise: null,
  supplierPaymentAmountPaise: null,
  orderQuantityMultiplier: 1.0,
  horizonDays: 30,
};

export const FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS: SimulatorControls = {
  supplierDeliveryDelayDays: 0,
  customerPaymentDelayDays: 16,
  customerPaymentAmountPaise: 50_000_000, // ₹5,00,000 Apex Corp
  supplierPaymentAmountPaise: 12_000_000, // ₹1,20,000 Kaveri Timber
  orderQuantityMultiplier: 1.0,
  horizonDays: 30,
};

export const CUSTOM_17D_CONTROLS: SimulatorControls = {
  supplierDeliveryDelayDays: 0,
  customerPaymentDelayDays: 17,
  customerPaymentAmountPaise: 50_000_000,
  supplierPaymentAmountPaise: 12_000_000,
  orderQuantityMultiplier: 1.0,
  horizonDays: 30,
};

const AUTH_BIZ_STORAGE_KEY = "ripple_auth_biz";

export function isCurrentBusinessDemo(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return true;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_BIZ_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return true;
    const biz = JSON.parse(raw);
    return !biz || biz.name === "Rupi Clothing" || biz.id === "biz_1";
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

export function getStorageKey(businessId?: string): string {
  if (businessId) return `ripple_simulator_state_${businessId}`;
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_BIZ_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const biz = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (biz?.id) return `ripple_simulator_state_${biz.id}`;
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
  return "rupi_simulator_shared_state";
}

function getInitialState(): SharedSimulatorState {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(getStorageKey());
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (parsed && parsed.controls) {
          return parsed;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // LocalStorage error or SSR
    }
  }

  // Demo accounts default to Apex Flagship (+16d), new user accounts default to Baseline
  const isDemo = isCurrentBusinessDemo();
  if (isDemo) {
    return {
      preset: "flagship",
      presetLabel: "Apex Flagship (+16d)",
      controls: { ...FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS },
      result: null,
      chaosResult: null,
      rescues: {
        autoPhaseApplied: false,
        splitEscrowLocked: false,
      },
    };
  }

  return {
    preset: "baseline",
    presetLabel: "Baseline",
    controls: { ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS },
    result: null,
    chaosResult: null,
    rescues: {
      autoPhaseApplied: false,
      splitEscrowLocked: false,
    },
  };
}

let currentState: SharedSimulatorState = getInitialState();
const listeners = new Set<(state: SharedSimulatorState) => void>();

function notify() {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(getStorageKey(), JSON.stringify(currentState));
    } catch {
      // Storage might be full or private browsing
    }
  }
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    try {
      listener(currentState);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error in simulator state listener:", err);
    }
  });
}

export function syncSimulatorStoreWithBusiness(businessId?: string, businessName?: string): void {
  const isDemo = !businessName || businessName === "Rupi Clothing" || businessId === "biz_1";
  const key = getStorageKey(businessId);

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (parsed && parsed.controls) {
          currentState = parsed;
          notify();
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }

  if (isDemo) {
    currentState = {
      preset: "flagship",
      presetLabel: "Apex Flagship (+16d)",
      controls: { ...FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS },
      result: null,
      chaosResult: null,
      rescues: {
        autoPhaseApplied: false,
        splitEscrowLocked: false,
      },
    };
  } else {
    currentState = {
      preset: "baseline",
      presetLabel: "Baseline",
      controls: { ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS },
      result: null,
      chaosResult: null,
      rescues: {
        autoPhaseApplied: false,
        splitEscrowLocked: false,
      },
    };
  }
  notify();
}

export const simulatorStore = {
  getState(): SharedSimulatorState {
    return currentState;
  },

  subscribe(listener: (state: SharedSimulatorState) => void): () => void {
    listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  },

  setControls(controls: SimulatorControls, preset: SimulatorPreset = "custom", presetLabel?: string) {
    let label = presetLabel;
    if (!label) {
      if (preset === "flagship") label = "Apex Flagship (+16d)";
      else if (preset === "baseline") label = "Baseline";
      else if (preset === "custom_17d") label = "Custom +17d Delay";
      else if (preset === "chaos") label = "Chaos Stress-Test (+5d)";
      else label = `Custom (${controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}d payment / ${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}d delivery)`;
    }

    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      preset,
      presetLabel: label,
      controls: { ...controls },
    };
    notify();
  },

  setResult(result: SimulatorResult | null) {
    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      result,
    };
    notify();
  },

  setChaosResult(chaosResult: ChaosStressTestResult | null) {
    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      chaosResult,
      preset: chaosResult ? "chaos" : currentState.preset === "chaos" ? "baseline" : currentState.preset,
      presetLabel: chaosResult ? "Chaos Stress-Test (+5d)" : currentState.presetLabel,
    };
    notify();
  },

  applyAutoPhase() {
    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      rescues: {
        ...currentState.rescues,
        autoPhaseApplied: true,
        autoPhaseTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    };
    notify();
  },

  applySplitEscrow() {
    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      rescues: {
        ...currentState.rescues,
        splitEscrowLocked: true,
        splitEscrowTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
    };
    notify();
  },

  revertRescues() {
    currentState = {
      ...currentState,
      rescues: {
        autoPhaseApplied: false,
        splitEscrowLocked: false,
      },
    };
    notify();
  },

  loadPreset(preset: "flagship" | "baseline" | "custom_17d" | "chaos") {
    if (preset === "flagship") {
      currentState = {
        ...currentState,
        preset: "flagship",
        presetLabel: "Apex Flagship (+16d)",
        controls: { ...FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS },
        chaosResult: null,
      };
    } else if (preset === "baseline") {
      currentState = {
        ...currentState,
        preset: "baseline",
        presetLabel: "Baseline",
        controls: { ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS },
        chaosResult: null,
      };
    } else if (preset === "custom_17d") {
      currentState = {
        ...currentState,
        preset: "custom_17d",
        presetLabel: "Custom +17d Delay",
        controls: { ...CUSTOM_17D_CONTROLS },
        chaosResult: null,
      };
    }
    notify();
  },
};

describe("Cash Flow Forecasting Engine", () => {
  it("generates forecast for 7, 14, 30, 60, and 90 days with correct lengths", async () => {
    const f7 = await forecastApi.getForecast(7);
    expect(f7.length).toBe(7);
    expect(f7.dailyLedger.length).toBe(7);

    const f14 = await forecastApi.getForecast(14);
    expect(f14.length).toBe(14);
    expect(f14.dailyLedger.length).toBe(14);

    const f30 = await forecastApi.getForecast(30);
    expect(f30.length).toBe(30);
    expect(f30.dailyLedger.length).toBe(30);

    const f60 = await forecastApi.getForecast(60);
    expect(f60.length).toBe(60);
    expect(f60.dailyLedger.length).toBe(60);

    const f90 = await forecastApi.getForecast(90);
    expect(f90.length).toBe(90);
    expect(f90.dailyLedger.length).toBe(90);
  });

  it("maintains strict mathematical consistency across opening, flows, and closing balance", async () => {
    const forecast = await forecastApi.getForecast(30);
    expect(
      forecast.openingBalancePaise + forecast.totalInflowsPaise - forecast.totalOutflowsPaise,
    ).toBe(forecast.closingBalancePaise);
    expect(forecast.totalInflowsPaise - forecast.totalOutflowsPaise).toBe(
      forecast.netMovementPaise,
    );

    // Each daily ledger row must balance
    for (const row of forecast.dailyLedger) {
      expect(row.openingBalancePaise + row.netMovementPaise).toBe(row.closingBalancePaise);
      expect(row.totalInflowsPaise).toBe(row.expectedIncomingPaise + row.otherInflowsPaise);
      expect(row.totalOutflowsPaise).toBe(
        row.supplierPaymentsPaise + row.operatingExpensesPaise + row.otherOutflowsPaise,
      );
    }
  });

    expect(forecast.minBalanceDate).toBeDefined();
    expect(typeof forecast.minBalancePaise).toBe("number");
    expect(forecast.safetyThresholdPaise).toBe(500_000);
    expect(Array.isArray(forecast.breachDates)).toBe(true);

    if (forecast.daysBelowThreshold > 0) {
      expect(forecast.breachDates.length).toBe(forecast.daysBelowThreshold);
    }
  });

  it("evaluates simulation scenarios and calculates liquidity impact", async () => {
    const scenarios = await forecastApi.getScenarios();
    expect(scenarios.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const shreeScenario = scenarios.find((s) => s.id === "sim_shree_delay");
    expect(shreeScenario).toBeDefined();

    // In a 7-day horizon, delaying Shree Textiles from Day 4 to Day 11 prevents the Day 5 shortfall
    const baseline7 = await forecastApi.getForecast({ days: 7 });
    const withScenario7 = await forecastApi.getForecast({
      days: 7,
      scenarioId: "sim_shree_delay",
    });

    expect(withScenario7.scenario).toBeDefined();
    expect(withScenario7.scenario?.scenarioId).toBe("sim_shree_delay");
    expect(withScenario7.scenario?.scenarioMinBalancePaise).toBeGreaterThan(
      baseline7.minBalancePaise,

    expect(withScenario7.scenario?.minBalanceDifferencePaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Urban Threads discount acceleration scenario
    const withUrbanScenario = await forecastApi.getForecast({
      days: 30,
      scenarioId: "sim_urban_discount",
    });
    expect(withUrbanScenario.scenario?.scenarioId).toBe("sim_urban_discount");
    expect(withUrbanScenario.scenario?.targetEventId).toBe("cfe_3");
  });

  it("updates safety threshold in store", async () => {
    const res = await forecastApi.updateSafetyThreshold(1_000_000);
    expect(res.success).toBe(true);
    expect(res.safetyThresholdPaise).toBe(1_000_000);

    const forecast = await forecastApi.getForecast(30);
    expect(forecast.safetyThresholdPaise).toBe(1_000_000);

    await forecastApi.updateSafetyThreshold(500_000);
  });

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { customerApi } from "@/lib/api/customerApi";
import { db } from "@/mocks/store";
import type { CreateCustomerInput } from "@/types";

describe("Customer API & Data Integrity", () => {
  it("1. Loads seeded customers and calculates summary metrics correctly", async () => {
    const metrics = await customerApi.getSummaryMetrics();

    expect(metrics.totalCustomers).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
    expect(metrics.activeCustomers).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(metrics.archivedCustomers).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(metrics.totalOutstandingPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("2. Lists customers with search, status filtering and sorting", async () => {
    // List all
    const all = await customerApi.list({ status: "all" });
    expect(all.total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);

    // List active
    const active = await customerApi.list({ status: "active" });
    expect(active.data.every((c) => c.status === "active")).toBe(true);

    // List archived
    const archived = await customerApi.list({ status: "archived" });
    expect(archived.data.every((c) => c.status === "archived")).toBe(true);
    expect(archived.data.some((c) => c.name.includes("Aarav"))).toBe(true);

    // Search by name
    const searchName = await customerApi.list({ search: "Urban Threads" });
    expect(searchName.data.length).toBe(1);
    expect(searchName.data[0]?.name).toBe("Urban Threads Boutique");

    // Search by GSTIN / Tax ID
    const searchTax = await customerApi.list({ search: "29AABCU9603R1Z7" });
    expect(searchTax.data.length).toBe(1);
    expect(searchTax.data[0]?.id).toBe("cus_1");

    // Sort by name
    const sorted = await customerApi.list({ sortBy: "name", sortDir: "asc" });
    const names = sorted.data.map((c) => c.name);
    const expected = [...names].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    expect(names).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it("3. Enriches customers with dynamic outstanding, overdue amount, and payment reliability ratings", async () => {
    const list = await customerApi.list({ status: "all" });

    // Urban Threads (cus_1) — has open invoices and overdue amount
    const cus1 = list.data.find((c) => c.id === "cus_1");
    expect(cus1).toBeDefined();
    expect(cus1?.calculatedOutstandingPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(cus1?.reliability).toBeDefined();

    // Style Mart (cus_2) — has overdue invoice
    const cus2 = list.data.find((c) => c.id === "cus_2");
    expect(cus2).toBeDefined();
    expect(cus2?.overdueInvoicesCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(cus2?.overdueAmountPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Kala Niketan Emporium (cus_4) — 2 on-time settled invoices
    const cus4 = list.data.find((c) => c.id === "cus_4");
    expect(cus4).toBeDefined();
    expect(cus4?.reliability.hasSufficientHistory).toBe(true);
    expect(cus4?.reliability.score).toBe(100);
    expect(cus4?.reliability.category).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(cus4?.reliability.transactionCount).toBe(2);
  });

  it("4. Creates a new customer with validation and credit terms", async () => {
    const input: CreateCustomerInput = {
      name: "Chic Avenue Delhi",
      contactName: "Pooja Malhotra",
      email: "pooja@chicavenue.in",
      phone: "+91 99112 88776",
      creditTermsDays: 25,
      taxId: "07AABCC9988D1Z4",
      address: "South Extension Part II, New Delhi",
    };

    const created = await customerApi.create(input);
    expect(created.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(created.name).toBe(input.name);
    expect(created.creditTermsDays).toBe(25);
    expect(created.status).toBe("active");

    // Duplicate name prevention
    await expect(customerApi.create(input)).rejects.toThrow(/already exists/i);
  });

  it("5. Updates an existing customer with validation", async () => {
    const target = db.customers.find((c) => c.name === "Chic Avenue Delhi");
    expect(target).toBeDefined();

    const updated = await customerApi.update(target!.id, {
      creditTermsDays: 45,
      contactName: "Pooja M. Malhotra",
    });

    expect(updated.creditTermsDays).toBe(45);
    expect(updated.contactName).toBe("Pooja M. Malhotra");
  });

  it("6. Preserves historical records upon archiving and unarchiving", async () => {
    const cus1 = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === "cus_1");
    expect(cus1).toBeDefined();

    // Count existing related records
    const ordersBefore = db.customerOrders.filter((co) => co.customerId === "cus_1").length;
    const invoicesBefore = db.invoices.filter((i) => i.customerId === "cus_1").length;
    expect(ordersBefore).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(invoicesBefore).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Archive customer
    const archived = await customerApi.archive("cus_1");
    expect(archived.status).toBe("archived");

    // Historical records must be preserved
    const ordersAfter = db.customerOrders.filter((co) => co.customerId === "cus_1").length;
    const invoicesAfter = db.invoices.filter((i) => i.customerId === "cus_1").length;
    expect(ordersAfter).toBe(ordersBefore);
    expect(invoicesAfter).toBe(invoicesBefore);

    // Unarchive customer
    const unarchived = await customerApi.unarchive("cus_1");
    expect(unarchived.status).toBe("active");
  });

  it("7. Protects customers with historical financial records from deletion", async () => {
    // cus_1 has invoices and orders
    await expect(customerApi.remove("cus_1")).rejects.toThrow(/Cannot permanently delete/i);
  });

  it("8. Retrieves detailed customer profile with all sub-ledgers and metrics", async () => {
    const details = await customerApi.getDetails("cus_1");

    expect(details.customer.id).toBe("cus_1");
    expect(details.metrics.outstandingPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(details.orders.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(details.invoices.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(details.metrics.reliability).toBeDefined();
  });
});

      expect(reply.text).toContain("Shree Textiles (PO-1)");
      expect(reply.text).toContain("Kaveri Timber");
      expect(reply.text).toContain("-₹1,20,000");
      expect(reply.text).toContain("1.4x Ripple Risk Multiplier");
      expect(reply.text).toContain("Batch 1 (₹1,00,000)");
      expect(reply.text).toContain("Batch 2 (₹20,000)");
    });
  });

  describe("4. Autonomous Rescues State Tracking", () => {
    it("tracks Auto-Phase execution in shared simulator store", () => {
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.autoPhaseApplied).toBe(false);

      simulatorStore.applyAutoPhase();
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.autoPhaseApplied).toBe(true);

      const state = getLiveCrossPageState();
      expect(state.simulator.activeRescues.autoPhaseApplied).toBe(true);
      expect(state.systemPromptString).toContain("Auto-Phase Inventory: ACTIVE");
    });

    it("tracks Tri-Party Split-Escrow execution in shared simulator store", () => {
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.splitEscrowLocked).toBe(false);

      simulatorStore.applySplitEscrow();
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.splitEscrowLocked).toBe(true);

      const state = getLiveCrossPageState();
      expect(state.simulator.activeRescues.splitEscrowLocked).toBe(true);
      expect(state.systemPromptString).toContain("Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow: LOCKED");
    });

    it("reverts rescues cleanly", () => {
      simulatorStore.applyAutoPhase();
      simulatorStore.applySplitEscrow();
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.autoPhaseApplied).toBe(true);

      simulatorStore.revertRescues();
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.autoPhaseApplied).toBe(false);
      expect(simulatorStore.getState().rescues.splitEscrowLocked).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});

<file path="src/test/inventory.test.tsx">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { inventoryApi } from "@/lib/api/inventoryApi";
import { purchaseOrderApi } from "@/lib/api/purchaseOrderApi";
import { dashboardApi } from "@/lib/api/dashboardApi";
import { buildRelationshipGraph } from "@/lib/api/relationshipsApi";
import { db } from "@/mocks/store";

describe("Feature 5: Inventory & Procurement Lifecycle", () => {
  it("1. Loads seeded products and calculates available stock and valuation", async () => {
    const listRes = await inventoryApi.list();
    expect(listRes.total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);

    const kurti = listRes.data.find((item) => item.product.sku === "KUR-COT-001");
    expect(kurti).toBeDefined();
    if (!kurti) return;

    // Available stock = on-hand - reserved
    expect(kurti.stockOnHand).toBe(12);
    expect(kurti.reservedStock).toBe(10);
    expect(kurti.availableStock).toBe(2);
    expect(kurti.incomingStock).toBe(100);
    expect(kurti.reorderThreshold).toBe(25);
    expect(kurti.status).toBe("low_stock");
    expect(kurti.inventoryValuationPaise).toBe(12 * 35_000); // 420,000 paise (₹4,200)
  });

  it("2. Returns accurate summary metrics without fabricating values", async () => {
    const metrics = await inventoryApi.getSummary();
    expect(metrics.totalProducts).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
    expect(metrics.totalAvailableUnits).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(metrics.lowStockCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(metrics.incomingUnits).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(100);
    expect(typeof metrics.estimatedValuationPaise).toBe("number");
  });

  it("3. Creates a new product with unique SKU and zero or initial stock", async () => {
    const newSku = `TEST-TSHIRT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
    const created = await inventoryApi.create({
      name: "Organic Bamboo Tee",
      sku: newSku,
      category: "Linen & Casual",
      description: "Super soft eco-friendly bamboo knit tee.",
      unitOfMeasure: "pieces",
      initialStockQuantity: 15,
      reorderPoint: 10,
      preferredSupplierId: "sup_1",
      unitCostPaise: 25_000, // ₹250
      currency: "INR",
    });

    expect(created.product.name).toBe("Organic Bamboo Tee");
    expect(created.product.sku).toBe(newSku);
    expect(created.stockOnHand).toBe(15);
    expect(created.availableStock).toBe(15);
    expect(created.status).toBe("healthy");

    // Prevents duplicate SKU
    await expect(
      inventoryApi.create({
        name: "Duplicate Tee",
        sku: newSku,
        category: "Linen & Casual",
        unitOfMeasure: "pieces",
        reorderPoint: 5,
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/already in use/i);
  });

  it("4. Records stock receipt and updates available quantity and balance", async () => {
    const kurti = db.products.find((p) => p.sku === "KUR-COT-001");
    expect(kurti).toBeDefined();
    if (!kurti) return;

    const initialInv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === kurti.id);
    const prevOnHand = initialInv?.quantityOnHand ?? 0;

    const movement = await inventoryApi.recordMovement({
      productId: kurti.id,
      type: "receipt",
      quantity: 8,
      referenceType: "manual",
      note: "Batch replenishment delivery",
    });

    expect(movement.type).toBe("receipt");
    expect(movement.quantity).toBe(8);
    expect(movement.resultingBalance).toBe(prevOnHand + 8);

    const updatedDetail = await inventoryApi.getById(kurti.id);
    expect(updatedDetail.stockOnHand).toBe(prevOnHand + 8);
    expect(updatedDetail.availableStock).toBe(prevOnHand + 8 - updatedDetail.reservedStock);
  });

  it("5. Triggers low-stock and stockout-risk statuses deterministically", async () => {
    const denim = db.products.find((p) => p.sku === "JKT-DEN-002");
    expect(denim).toBeDefined();
    if (!denim) return;

    const detail = await inventoryApi.getById(denim.id);
    // On hand 8, reserved 6, available 2, reorder point 10
    expect(detail.availableStock).toBe(2);
    expect(detail.status).toBe("stockout_risk");
    expect(detail.statusLabel).toBe("Stockout risk");
  });

  it("6. Generates reorder recommendations with suggested quantities and supplier lead times", async () => {
    const recommendations = await inventoryApi.getReorderRecommendations();
    expect(recommendations.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    const denimRec = recommendations.find((r) => r.sku === "JKT-DEN-002");
    expect(denimRec).toBeDefined();
    if (!denimRec) return;

    expect(denimRec.currentAvailableStock).toBeLessThan(denimRec.reorderPoint);
    expect(denimRec.suggestedReorderQuantity).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(denimRec.preferredSupplierName).toBe("Mehta Fabrics");
    expect(denimRec.customerCommitmentsAtRisk.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(denimRec.proposedPurchaseAmountPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("7. Creates purchase order linked to a supplier with line items and financial terms", async () => {
    const supplier = db.suppliers[0];
    const product = db.products[0];
    expect(supplier).toBeDefined();
    expect(product).toBeDefined();
    if (!supplier || !product) return;

    const initialOnOrder =
      db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === product.id)?.quantityOnOrder ?? 0;

    const po = await purchaseOrderApi.create({
      supplierId: supplier.id,
      orderDate: "2026-10-15",
      expectedDeliveryDate: "2026-10-22",
      paymentTermsDays: 30,
      advanceAmountPaise: 100_000, // ₹1,000
      notes: "Urgent festival season delivery",
      lineItems: [
        {
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: 25,
          unitPricePaise: product.unitCostPaise,
        },
      ],
    });

    expect(po.supplierId).toBe(supplier.id);
    expect(po.status).toBe("confirmed"); // Confirmed due to advance
    expect(po.advancePaidPaise).toBe(100_000);
    expect(po.totalPaise).toBe(25 * product.unitCostPaise);
    expect(po.lineItems?.length).toBe(1);

    // Quantity on order updated
    const updatedInv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === product.id);
    expect(updatedInv?.quantityOnOrder).toBe(initialOnOrder + 25);

    // Scheduled payment recorded in mock store
    const scheduledPay = db.payments.find((p) => p.purchaseOrderId === po.id);
    expect(scheduledPay).toBeDefined();
    expect(scheduledPay?.direction).toBe("outgoing");
  });

  it("8. Records stock receipt against a purchase order and updates order status", async () => {
    const supplier = db.suppliers[1];
    const product = db.products[1];
    if (!supplier || !product) return;

    const po = await purchaseOrderApi.create({
      supplierId: supplier.id,
      orderDate: "2026-10-15",
      expectedDeliveryDate: "2026-10-20",
      lineItems: [
        {
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: 10,
          unitPricePaise: product.unitCostPaise,
        },
      ],
    });

    // Receive partial batch (4 units)
    const partialUpdated = await purchaseOrderApi.recordReceipt(
      po.id,
      [{ productId: product.id, quantity: 4 }],
      "Received first shipment carton",
    );
    expect(partialUpdated.receivedUnits).toBe(4);
    expect(partialUpdated.status).toBe("partially_received");

    // Receive remaining 6 units
    const fullyReceived = await purchaseOrderApi.recordReceipt(
      po.id,
      [{ productId: product.id, quantity: 6 }],
      "Received second shipment carton",
    );
    expect(fullyReceived.receivedUnits).toBe(10);
    expect(fullyReceived.status).toBe("received");
  });

  it("9. Reflects updated records across the dashboard and relationship graph", async () => {
    const summary = await dashboardApi.getSummary();
    expect(summary.lowStockCount).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);

    const graph = buildRelationshipGraph();
    expect(graph.nodes.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(graph.edges.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Verify PO nodes exist in graph
    const poNode = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.type === "purchase_order");
    expect(poNode).toBeDefined();

    // Verify delivery nodes exist
    const deliveryNode = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.type === "inventory_delivery");
    expect(deliveryNode).toBeDefined();
  });

  it("10. Generates deterministic risk alerts with financial exposure", async () => {
    const alerts = await inventoryApi.getRiskAlerts();
    expect(alerts.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

    const stockoutAlert = alerts.find((a) => a.category === "projected_stockout");
    expect(stockoutAlert).toBeDefined();
    expect(stockoutAlert?.severity).toBe("critical");
    expect(stockoutAlert?.financialImpactPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

import React from "react";
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

vi.mock("@tanstack/react-router", async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import("@tanstack/react-router")>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    Link: ({
      children,
      to,
      ...props
    }: {
      children?: React.ReactNode;
      to?: string;
      [key: string]: unknown;
    }) => {
      const href = typeof to === "string" ? to : "/";
      return (
        <a href={href} {...props}>
          {children}
        </a>
      );
    },
  };
});

import { InvoiceDetailView } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-detail-view";
import { invoiceApi } from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";

/**
 * Regression coverage for the invoice detail page.
 *
 * This component previously crashed for every invoice with an outstanding
 * balance (`ReferenceError: Button is not defined` — a missing import), which
 * the route error boundary surfaced as "Could not load invoice". Nothing
 * rendered this component, so the defect shipped. These tests exist to make
 * sure it cannot happen again silently.
 */
describe("InvoiceDetailView", () => {
  it("renders an outstanding receivable and fires the Record Payment handler", async () => {
    const list = await invoiceApi.list({ status: "overdue" });
    const target = list.data.find(
      (i) => (i.type === "receivable" || !i.type) && i.outstandingPaise > 0,
    );
    expect(target).toBeDefined();

    const data = await invoiceApi.getById(target!.id);
    const onRecordPayment = vi.fn();

    render(<InvoiceDetailView data={data} onRecordPayment={onRecordPayment} />);

    const button = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /record payment/i });
    fireEvent.click(button);
    expect(onRecordPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    // Metric summary must render values, not blanks.
    expect(screen.getByText("Total Amount")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Outstanding Balance")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("renders a supplier-side bill with supplier context", async () => {
    const list = await invoiceApi.list({ type: "payable" });
    const target = list.data.find((i) => i.outstandingPaise > 0) ?? list.data[0];
    expect(target).toBeDefined();

    const data = await invoiceApi.getById(target!.id);
    render(<InvoiceDetailView data={data} onRecordPayment={() => {}} />);

    expect(screen.getByText("Supplier Information")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Settlement & Payment Ledger")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("hides Record Payment once the balance is fully settled", async () => {
    const list = await invoiceApi.list({ status: "paid" });
    const target = list.data.find((i) => i.outstandingPaise === 0);
    expect(target).toBeDefined();

    const data = await invoiceApi.getById(target!.id);
    render(<InvoiceDetailView data={data} onRecordPayment={() => {}} />);

    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: /record payment/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("renders the customer counterparty link when the invoice has a customer", async () => {
    const list = await invoiceApi.list({ type: "receivable" });
    const withCustomer = list.data.find((i) => i.customerId);
    expect(withCustomer).toBeDefined();

    const data = await invoiceApi.getById(withCustomer!.id);
    render(<InvoiceDetailView data={data} onRecordPayment={() => {}} />);

    expect(screen.getByText("Customer Information")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

<file path="src/test/reliability.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  calculatePaymentReliability,
  calculateCustomerPaymentReliability,
  calculateSupplierPaymentReliability,
  getReliabilityCategory,
  evaluateObligation,
} from "@/lib/reliability";
import type { Invoice, Payment, Customer, Supplier } from "@/types";

describe("Payment Reliability Rating Engine", () => {
  const mockCustomer: Customer = {
    id: "cus_test",
    businessId: "biz_1",
    name: "Acme Retail",
    creditTermsDays: 15,
    outstandingPaise: 0,
  };

  const mockSupplier: Supplier = {
    id: "sup_test",
    businessId: "biz_1",
    name: "TexCo Mills",
    paymentTermsDays: 30,
    outstandingPaise: 0,
    reliabilityScore: 85,
  };

  it("classifies scores into correct categories", () => {
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(100)).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(90)).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(89)).toBe("Good");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(75)).toBe("Good");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(74)).toBe("Fair");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(60)).toBe("Fair");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(59)).toBe("Poor");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(40)).toBe("Poor");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(39)).toBe("Very poor");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(0)).toBe("Very poor");
    expect(getReliabilityCategory(null)).toBe("Insufficient payment history");
  });

  it("returns Insufficient payment history when no transactions exist", () => {
    const result = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(mockCustomer, [], []);
    expect(result.hasSufficientHistory).toBe(false);
    expect(result.score).toBeNull();
    expect(result.category).toBe("Insufficient payment history");
    expect(result.transactionCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it("returns 100 (Excellent) when all obligations were paid on or before due date", () => {
    const invoice: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_1",
      invoiceNumber: "INV-001",
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_test",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 100_000,
      status: "paid",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-15",
    };
    const payment: Payment = {
      id: "pay_1",
      direction: "incoming",
      invoiceId: "inv_1",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      status: "completed",
      scheduledDate: "2026-01-10",
      completedDate: "2026-01-10",
    };

    const result = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(mockCustomer, [invoice], [payment]);
    expect(result.hasSufficientHistory).toBe(true);
    expect(result.score).toBe(100);
    expect(result.category).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(result.transactionCount).toBe(1);
    expect(result.onTimeCount).toBe(1);
    expect(result.lateCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it("applies lateness penalties and caps them at 60 points per obligation", () => {
    // 40 days late: with penalty 2 pts/day, raw penalty is 80, but must be capped at 60
    const invoice: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_late",
      invoiceNumber: "INV-LATE",
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_test",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 100_000,
      status: "paid",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-15",
    };
    const payment: Payment = {
      id: "pay_late",
      direction: "incoming",
      invoiceId: "inv_late",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      status: "completed",
      scheduledDate: "2026-02-24", // 40 days after Jan 15
      completedDate: "2026-02-24",
    };

    const result = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(mockCustomer, [invoice], [payment]);
    expect(result.obligations[0]?.penalty).toBe(60); // Capped at 60
    expect(result.score).toBe(40); // 100 - 60 = 40
    expect(result.category).toBe("Poor");
  });

  it("handles partial payments and settlement dates accurately", () => {
    // Invoice 200,000 paise due 2026-01-10.
    // Half paid on time (2026-01-10, 0 days late).
    // Half paid 10 days late (2026-01-20).
    // Weighted days late: (100k*0 + 100k*10) / 200k = 5 days.
    // Penalty: 5 * 2 = 10 pts. Score: 100 - 10 = 90 (Excellent).
    // Settlement date must be the final payment date: 2026-01-20.
    const invoice: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_part",
      invoiceNumber: "INV-PART",
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_test",
      amountPaise: 200_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 200_000,
      status: "paid",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-10",
    };
    const pay1: Payment = {
      id: "pay_p1",
      direction: "incoming",
      invoiceId: "inv_part",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      status: "completed",
      completedDate: "2026-01-10",
      scheduledDate: "2026-01-10",
    };
    const pay2: Payment = {
      id: "pay_p2",
      direction: "incoming",
      invoiceId: "inv_part",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      status: "completed",
      completedDate: "2026-01-20",
      scheduledDate: "2026-01-20",
    };

    const result = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(mockCustomer, [invoice], [pay1, pay2]);
    expect(result.score).toBe(90);
    expect(result.category).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(result.obligations[0]?.settlementDate).toBe("2026-01-20");
    expect(result.obligations[0]?.weightedDaysLate).toBe(5);
  });

  it("applies lateness for active overdue unpaid balance", () => {
    const invoice: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_overdue",
      invoiceNumber: "INV-OD",
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_test",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 0,
      status: "overdue",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-10",
    };

    // Evaluated as of 2026-01-20 (10 days overdue)
    const result = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(mockCustomer, [invoice], [], {
      asOfDate: "2026-01-20",
    });
    expect(result.score).toBe(80); // 100 - (10 * 2) = 80
    expect(result.category).toBe("Good");
    expect(result.obligations[0]?.isOverdue).toBe(true);
  });

  it("only rates qualifying amounts owed by suppliers to Ripple, never Ripple's outgoing payments", () => {
    // Payable bills where Ripple pays the supplier
    const payableBill: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_bill",
      invoiceNumber: "BILL-001",
      type: "payable",
      supplierId: "sup_test",
      amountPaise: 500_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 500_000,
      status: "paid",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-15",
    };
    const outgoingPayment: Payment = {
      id: "pay_out",
      direction: "outgoing",
      invoiceId: "inv_bill",
      supplierId: "sup_test",
      amountPaise: 500_000,
      status: "completed",
      completedDate: "2026-02-01", // Late outgoing payment made by Ripple
      scheduledDate: "2026-02-01",
    };

    // calculateSupplierPaymentReliability should ignore payable bills and outgoing payments
    const supplierResult = calculateSupplierPaymentReliability(
      mockSupplier,
      [payableBill],
      [outgoingPayment],
    );
    expect(supplierResult.hasSufficientHistory).toBe(false);
    expect(supplierResult.score).toBeNull();
    expect(supplierResult.category).toBe("Insufficient payment history");

    // But if supplier has a qualifying receivable invoice (e.g. refund/credit owed to Ripple)
    const supplierReceivable: Invoice = {
      id: "inv_sup_rec",
      invoiceNumber: "REC-SUP-01",
      type: "receivable",
      supplierId: "sup_test",
      amountPaise: 50_000,
      amountPaidPaise: 50_000,
      status: "paid",
      issueDate: "2026-01-01",
      dueDate: "2026-01-10",
    };
    const incomingRefund: Payment = {
      id: "pay_in",
      direction: "incoming",
      invoiceId: "inv_sup_rec",
      supplierId: "sup_test",
      amountPaise: 50_000,
      status: "completed",
      completedDate: "2026-01-09",
      scheduledDate: "2026-01-09",
    };

    const qualifyingResult = calculateSupplierPaymentReliability(
      mockSupplier,
      [payableBill, supplierReceivable],
      [outgoingPayment, incomingRefund],
    );
    expect(qualifyingResult.hasSufficientHistory).toBe(true);
    expect(qualifyingResult.score).toBe(100);
    expect(qualifyingResult.category).toBe("Excellent");
    expect(qualifyingResult.transactionCount).toBe(1);
  });
});

    expect(handleConfirm).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

    // Archive supplier
    const archived = await supplierApi.archive(supplierId);
    expect(archived.status).toBe("archived");

    const posAfterArchive = db.purchaseOrders.filter((po) => po.supplierId === supplierId);

    // All payable invoices must link to suppliers, not customer receivables
    const payableInvoices = db.invoices.filter((i) => i.type === "payable");
    expect(payableInvoices.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

      expect(inv.supplierId).toBeDefined();
      expect(inv.type).toBe("payable");

    // Customer invoices must have type receivable
    const receivableInvoices = db.invoices.filter((i) => i.type === "receivable");
    expect(receivableInvoices.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    for (const inv of receivableInvoices) {
      expect(inv.customerId).toBeDefined();
      expect(inv.type).toBe("receivable");
    }
  });

<file path="src/server.ts">
import "./lib/error-capture";

import { consumeLastCapturedError } from "./lib/error-capture";
import { renderErrorPage } from "./lib/error-page";

type ServerEntry = {
  fetch: (request: Request, env: unknown, ctx: unknown) => Promise<Response> | Response;
};

let serverEntryPromise: Promise<ServerEntry> | undefined;

async function getServerEntry(): Promise<ServerEntry> {
  if (!serverEntryPromise) {
    serverEntryPromise = import("@tanstack/react-start/server-entry").then(
      (m) => (m.default ?? m) as ServerEntry,
    );
  }
  return serverEntryPromise;
}

// h3 swallows in-handler throws into a normal 500 Response with body
// {"unhandled":true,"message":"HTTPError"} — try/catch alone never fires for those.
async function normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse(response: Response): Promise<Response> {
  if (response.status < 500) return response;
  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
  if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) return response;

  const body = await response.clone().text();
  if (!isH3SwallowedErrorBody(body)) return response;

  console.error(consumeLastCapturedError() ?? new Error(`h3 swallowed SSR error: ${body}`));
  return new Response(renderErrorPage(), {
    status: 500,
    headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" },
  });
}

function isH3SwallowedErrorBody(body: string): boolean {
  try {
    const payload = JSON.parse(body) as { unhandled?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    return payload.unhandled === true && payload.message === "HTTPError";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request, env: unknown, ctx: unknown) {
    try {
      const handler = await getServerEntry();
      const response = await handler.fetch(request, env, ctx);
      return await normalizeCatastrophicSsrResponse(response);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      return new Response(renderErrorPage(), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" },
      });
    }
  },
};
</file>

<file path="src/start.ts">
import { createStart, createCsrfMiddleware, createMiddleware } from "@tanstack/react-start";

import { renderErrorPage } from "./lib/error-page";

const errorMiddleware = createMiddleware().server(async ({ next }) => {
  try {
    return await next();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error != null && typeof error === "object" && "statusCode" in error) {
      throw error;
    }
    console.error(error);
    return new Response(renderErrorPage(), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" },
    });
  }
});

// Start installs this automatically when src/start.ts is absent; defining the
// file opts out, so re-add it explicitly to keep server functions protected
// from cross-site requests.
const csrfMiddleware = createCsrfMiddleware({
  filter: (ctx) => ctx.handlerType === "serverFn",
});

export const startInstance = createStart(() => ({
  requestMiddleware: [errorMiddleware, csrfMiddleware],
}));
</file>

# RIPPLE — GLOBAL ENGINEERING RULES

You are the lead engineer responsible for maintaining and improving the existing Ripple application. These rules apply to every task, prompt, feature, refactor, and bug fix.

## 1. Inspect Before Changing

- Inspect the relevant existing code, dependencies, routes, components, API contracts, database models, and data flow before editing.
- Understand the root cause before fixing a bug.
- Reuse existing architecture and components.
- Never rewrite, delete, or replace working code unnecessarily.
- Never create duplicate components, API clients, routes, database models, or state systems when an existing implementation can be extended.

## 2. Functional Completeness

- Every visible button, link, input, dropdown, form, filter, tab, modal, chart interaction, and navigation item must behave as expected.
- No decorative controls pretending to be functional.
- No empty event handlers, placeholder actions, dead links, fake success messages, or unfinished TODOs in user-facing functionality.
- Every form must validate input, display useful errors, prevent invalid submissions, handle loading, and show a clear success or failure result.
- Every data-changing action must persist correctly when persistence is expected.
- Prevent duplicate submissions and handle network failures safely.

## 3. UI Visibility and Visual Quality

- Ensure all content is visible, readable, accessible, and correctly positioned.
- Fix clipped text, hidden content, overlapping elements, incorrect stacking, broken dialogs, dropdowns appearing behind overlays, and scroll containers that prevent access to content.
- Fix text/background contrast, inconsistent spacing, misaligned elements, oversized components, broken icons, and inconsistent typography.
- Ensure all pages work on desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
- Avoid horizontal overflow unless the specific component intentionally supports it.
- Preserve Ripple's established visual identity and design system.
- Do not solve visibility problems by hiding content or removing functionality.

## 4. Frontend Engineering

- Preserve the existing framework, routing, state management, styling system, and component conventions.
- Follow React and TypeScript best practices.
- Fix React warnings, invalid state updates, stale state, incorrect keys, uncontrolled/controlled input conflicts, and avoidable rendering problems.
- Ensure loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and hover/focus states are intentional.
- Ensure keyboard navigation and accessible labels work.
- Do not suppress errors or warnings instead of fixing their cause.

## 5. Backend and Data Integrity

- Follow the existing typed API layer and backend architecture.
- Validate user input on both client and server.
- Handle loading, timeouts, network errors, and invalid responses.
- Ensure authenticated requests work correctly and authorization is enforced server-side.
- Preserve business-level data isolation.
- Use the database as the source of truth in live mode.
- Do not silently substitute mock data when live API calls fail.
- Use safe database transactions and preserve referential integrity.
- Never expose credentials, tokens, passwords, or sensitive information in logs or API responses.

## 6. Bug-Fixing Standard

- Reproduce the problem or establish a clear technical explanation.
- Identify the root cause and all affected code paths.
- Implement the smallest reliable fix.
- Check nearby components and dependent functionality for regressions.
- Run relevant tests, type checks, linting, and build commands when available.
- Never claim that something passed a test that was not actually run.
- Report environmental limitations honestly.

## 7. Implementation Discipline

- Make changes directly in the existing project.
- Do not rebuild the application from scratch.
- Do not make unrelated changes during a focused task.
- Do not add unnecessary dependencies or infrastructure.
- Do not hardcode data that should come from the database.
- Do not use arbitrary CSS patches when the real issue is in layout, state, or component structure.
- Keep code maintainable, consistent, and production-minded.

## 8. Definition of Done

A task is complete only when the requested behavior is implemented, relevant UI states are handled, affected workflows are verified, and no known related regression remains unaddressed.

Prioritize correctness, functional completeness, visual clarity, accessibility, data integrity, and stability over unnecessary code volume.

## RIPPLE SIMULATION INTEGRITY RULE

For all Ripple Simulator and supply-chain risk features:

- The existing timeline and dependency graph are the canonical scenario representation. Extend them; never create a competing simulator.
- All cash-flow, fragility, contagion-cost, margin, and rescue calculations must use one consistent financial engine.
- Clearly distinguish actual transactions, forecast events, simulated events, and hypothetical stress-test results.
- Never treat an expected customer receipt as actual available cash.
- Never mutate real invoices, payments, inventory, or financial records merely by previewing or applying a simulation action.
- Preview every financial rescue before confirmation. Persist scenario actions separately from actual financial transactions.
- Model split-escrow as a simulated funding and settlement arrangement unless a real, authorized provider integration exists.
- Prevent duplicate supplier payments, duplicated dependency exposure, repeated receivable allocations, and double-counted penalties.
- Derive results from scenario inputs, event dates, configured rates, and dependency relationships. Never hardcode desired financial outcomes.
- Recalculate affected results after scenario edits, stress tests, rescues, reversals, and backend data changes.
- Every applied rescue must have a clear status, audit trail, validation rules, and safe reversal behavior.
- Verify both the financial calculations and the complete frontend-to-backend workflow before declaring a feature complete.
</file>

@router.get("/api/forecast")
@router.get("/api/cash-flow/forecast")
def get_forecast(
    days: int = Query(30, ge=7, le=180),
    scenario_id: str | None = None,
    safety_threshold: int | None = None,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    events = db.query(CashFlowEvent).filter(CashFlowEvent.business_id == business.id).all()
    threshold = safety_threshold or business.safety_threshold_paise or 500_000
    opening_cash = business.opening_cash_paise or 1_000_000

    forecast = build_detailed_forecast(
        events=events,
        opening_cash_paise=opening_cash,
        days=days,
        safety_threshold_paise=threshold,
        scenario_id=scenario_id,
    )
    return forecast

@router.patch("/api/business/safety-threshold")

    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    threshold = payload.get("safetyThresholdPaise")
    if threshold is None or threshold < 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid safety threshold amount")

    business.safety_threshold_paise = threshold
    db.commit()
    return {"success": True, "safetyThresholdPaise": threshold}

@router.post("/api/scenarios")
def save_scenario(
    payload: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    name = payload.get("name", "New Scenario")
    controls = payload.get("controls", {})
    result = payload.get("result", {})

    scenario_id = f"scn_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
    scenario = SimulationScenario(
        id=scenario_id,
        business_id=business.id,
        name=name,
        controls_json=json.dumps(controls),
        result_json=json.dumps(result),
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(scenario)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(scenario)

    return {
        "id": scenario.id,
        "name": scenario.name,
        "controls": controls,
        "result": result,
        "createdAt": scenario.created_at,
    }

@router.get("/api/scenarios")
def list_scenarios(
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    scenarios = db.query(SimulationScenario).filter(SimulationScenario.business_id == business.id).all()
    result = []
    for s in scenarios:
        controls = json.loads(s.controls_json) if s.controls_json else {}
        res = json.loads(s.result_json) if s.result_json else {}
        result.append({
            "id": s.id,
            "name": s.name,
            "controls": controls,
            "result": res,
            "createdAt": s.created_at,
        })
    return result

router = APIRouter(tags=["simulator"])

def _get_active_rescues(business_id: str, db: Session) -> list[dict]:
    records = db.query(ScenarioRescue).filter(
        ScenarioRescue.business_id == business_id,
        ScenarioRescue.status == "active",
    ).all()
    return [
        {
            "id": r.id,
            "rescue_type": r.rescue_type,
            "status": r.status,
            "target_supplier_id": r.target_supplier_id,
            "target_customer_id": r.target_customer_id,
            "parent_order_id": r.parent_order_id,
            "batch1_amount_paise": r.batch1_amount_paise,
            "batch1_date": r.batch1_date,
            "batch2_amount_paise": r.batch2_amount_paise,
            "batch2_date": r.batch2_date,
            "float_fee_paise": r.float_fee_paise,
            "net_proceeds_paise": r.net_proceeds_paise,
        }
        for r in records
    ]

@router.post("/api/simulator/simulate")
@router.post("/api/simulate")
def simulate(
    controls: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """
    Authoritative simulation endpoint evaluating controls and active rescues.
    """
    events = db.query(CashFlowEvent).filter(CashFlowEvent.business_id == business.id).all()
    opening_cash = business.opening_cash_paise or 15_000_000 # default ₹1,50,000 for scenario
    rescues = _get_active_rescues(business.id, db)
    return run_simulation(events, opening_cash, controls, rescues=rescues, business=business)

@router.post("/api/simulator/chaos-test")
def chaos_stress_test(
    controls: dict,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    """
    Chaos Stress-Test: Applies isolated +5-day delay to evaluate resilience,
    identifying the most fragile single point of failure under stress.
    """
    events = db.query(CashFlowEvent).filter(CashFlowEvent.business_id == business.id).all()
    opening_cash = business.opening_cash_paise or 15_000_000
    rescues = _get_active_rescues(business.id, db)
    stress_result = run_chaos_stress_test(events, opening_cash, controls, rescues=rescues, business=business)

    # Persist the stress test run audit
    stress_record = ScenarioStressTest(
        id=f"stress_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}",
        business_id=business.id,
        baseline_min_paise=stress_result["baselineMinCashPaise"],
        stressed_min_paise=stress_result["stressedMinCashPaise"],
        additional_shortfall_paise=stress_result["additionalShortfallPaise"],
        most_fragile_node_id=stress_result["mostFragileNodeAfter"],
        most_fragile_multiplier=stress_result["mostFragileMultiplier"],
        created_at=to_iso_date(date.today()),
    )
    db.add(stress_record)
    db.commit()

    return stress_result

@router.post("/api/simulator/rescues/{rescue_id}/revert")
def revert_rescue(
    rescue_id: str,
    business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    rescue = db.query(ScenarioRescue).filter(
        ScenarioRescue.id == rescue_id,
        ScenarioRescue.business_id == business.id,
    ).first()

    if not rescue:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Scenario rescue not found.")

    rescue.status = "reverted"
    db.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "rescueId": rescue_id,
        "message": "Scenario rescue successfully reverted.",
    }

):

        ScenarioRescue.status == "active",
    ).all()

    for r in rescues:
        r.status = "reverted"

    db.commit()

import uuid
from sqlalchemy import Column, String, Float, Text, ForeignKey, Integer
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from app.database import Base

class SimulationScenario(Base):
    __tablename__ = "simulation_scenarios"

    id = Column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f"scn_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}")
    business_id = Column(String(64), ForeignKey("businesses.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    target_event_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    change_type = Column(String(50), nullable=True) # "delay_payment" | "advance_payment" | "cancel_order" | "price_change"
    change_magnitude = Column(Float, nullable=True)
    controls_json = Column(Text, nullable=True) # JSON string of SimulatorControls
    result_json = Column(Text, nullable=True)   # JSON string of SimulatorResult
    created_at = Column(String(50), nullable=True)

    business = relationship("Business", back_populates="simulation_scenarios")

class DependencyEdge(Base):
    __tablename__ = "dependency_edges"

    id = Column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f"dep_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}")
    business_id = Column(String(64), ForeignKey("businesses.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    source_id = Column(String(64), nullable=False)
    source_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    target_id = Column(String(64), nullable=False)
    target_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    label = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    lag_days = Column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)

class ScenarioRescue(Base):
    __tablename__ = "simulation_rescues"

    id = Column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f"res_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}")
    business_id = Column(String(64), ForeignKey("businesses.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    scenario_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    rescue_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False) # "auto_phase" | "split_escrow"
    status = Column(String(20), default="active", nullable=False) # "active" | "reverted"
    target_supplier_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    target_customer_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    parent_order_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    batch1_amount_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    batch1_date = Column(String(50), nullable=True)
    batch2_amount_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    batch2_date = Column(String(50), nullable=True)
    float_fee_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    net_proceeds_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=True)
    metadata_json = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(String(50), nullable=True)

class ScenarioStressTest(Base):
    __tablename__ = "simulation_stress_tests"

    id = Column(String(64), primary_key=True, default=lambda: f"stress_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}")
    business_id = Column(String(64), ForeignKey("businesses.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True)
    scenario_id = Column(String(64), nullable=True)
    baseline_min_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    stressed_min_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    additional_shortfall_paise = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    most_fragile_node_id = Column(String(64), nullable=False)
    most_fragile_multiplier = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(String(50), nullable=True)

<file path="backend/app/services/auth.py">
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import bcrypt
import jwt
from app.config import settings

def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    pwd_bytes = password.encode("utf-8")
    salt = bcrypt.gensalt()
    return bcrypt.hashpw(pwd_bytes, salt).decode("utf-8")

def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(plain_password.encode("utf-8"), hashed_password.encode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        return False

def create_access_token(user_id: str, business_id: str | None = None, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) -> str:
    if expires_delta:
        expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + expires_delta
    else:
        expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    
    payload = {
        "sub": user_id,
        "business_id": business_id,
        "exp": expire,
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.JWT_SECRET, algorithm=settings.JWT_ALGORITHM)

def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict | None:
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.JWT_SECRET, algorithms=[settings.JWT_ALGORITHM])
        return payload
    except Exception:
        return None
</file>
