import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { DailyLedgerEntry, CashFlowEvent, CashFlowEventType } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowLedgerViewProps {
  ledger: DailyLedgerEntry[];
  safetyThresholdPaise: number;
}

export function CashFlowLedgerView({ ledger, safetyThresholdPaise }: CashFlowLedgerViewProps) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [eventTypeFilter, setEventTypeFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [sortDir, setSortDir] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");
  const [expandedDates, setExpandedDates] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const toggleExpand = (date: string) => {
    setExpandedDates((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(date)) {
        next.delete(date);
      } else {
        next.add(date);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const expandAll = () => {
    setExpandedDates(new Set(ledger.map((e) => e.date)));
  };

  const collapseAll = () => {
    setExpandedDates(new Set());
  };

  // Filter and sort ledger entries
  const filteredLedger = useMemo(() => {
    let result = [...ledger];

    // Search query filter (matches date, event label, counterparty, invoice ID, PO ID)
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      result = result.filter((entry) => {
        if (entry.date.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return true;
        return entry.events.some(
          (e) =>
            e.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            e.counterpartyName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            e.relatedInvoiceId?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            e.relatedPurchaseOrderId?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            e.type.toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      });
    }

    // Status filter
    if (statusFilter === "deficit") {
      result = result.filter((entry) => entry.closingBalancePaise < 0);
    } else if (statusFilter === "warning") {
      result = result.filter(
        (entry) =>
          entry.closingBalancePaise < safetyThresholdPaise && entry.closingBalancePaise >= 0,
      );
    } else if (statusFilter === "breach_or_deficit") {
      result = result.filter((entry) => entry.closingBalancePaise < safetyThresholdPaise);
    } else if (statusFilter === "has_activity") {
      result = result.filter((entry) => entry.events.length > 0);
    }

    // Event type filter
    if (eventTypeFilter !== "all") {
      result = result.filter((entry) => entry.events.some((e) => e.type === eventTypeFilter));
    }

    // Sorting by date
    result.sort((a, b) => {
      const cmp = a.date.localeCompare(b.date);
      return sortDir === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
    });

    return result;
  }, [ledger, searchQuery, statusFilter, eventTypeFilter, sortDir, safetyThresholdPaise]);

  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearchQuery("");
    setStatusFilter("all");
    setEventTypeFilter("all");
    setSortDir("asc");
  };

  const hasActiveFilters =
    searchQuery !== "" || statusFilter !== "all" || eventTypeFilter !== "all";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Controls Bar: Search, Filters, Sort, Expand/Collapse */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 shadow-xs lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
          {/* Search box */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
            <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              type="search"
              placeholder="Search events, counterparties, invoices..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="h-8 pl-8 text-xs"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Status filter */}
          <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
            <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs w-[170px]">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Filter by status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className="text-xs">
              <SelectItem value="all">All Days</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="breach_or_deficit">Below Buffer or Deficit</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="deficit">Deficit Only (&lt; ₹0)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="warning">Below Buffer Only</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="has_activity">Days With Transactions</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Event type filter */}
          <Select value={eventTypeFilter} onValueChange={setEventTypeFilter}>
            <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs w-[170px]">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Event type" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent className="text-xs">
              <SelectItem value="all">All Event Types</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="customer_payment">Customer Payments</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="supplier_payment">Supplier Payments</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="rent">Rent</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="payroll">Payroll</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="tax">Taxes / GST</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="other">Other Inflows/Outflows</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>

        {/* Right side actions: Sort, Expand/Collapse, Reset */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={clearFilters}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Reset</span>
            </Button>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSortDir(sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc")}
            className="h-8 gap-1 text-xs"
          >
            <ArrowUpDown className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>{sortDir === "asc" ? "Date: Earliest" : "Date: Latest"}</span>
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={expandedDates.size > 0 ? collapseAll : expandAll}
            className="h-8 text-xs"
          >
            {expandedDates.size > 0 ? "Collapse all" : "Expand all"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Daily Ledger Table */}
      {filteredLedger.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Search}
          title="No ledger days match your criteria"
          description="Try broadening your search term or resetting the status and event type filters."
          actionLabel="Clear all filters"
          onAction={clearFilters}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow className="bg-muted/40 text-xs">
                  <TableHead className="w-10 px-2"></TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="min-w-[130px]">Date</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[125px]">Opening Cash</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[135px] text-success">
                    Expected Inflows
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[115px] text-success">
                    Other Inflows
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[140px] text-destructive">
                    Supplier Payments
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[125px] text-destructive">
                    Operating Exp.
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[120px] text-destructive">
                    Other Outflows
                  </TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[135px] font-bold">Closing Cash</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-center min-w-[110px]">Status</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>

              <TableBody>
                {filteredLedger.map((entry) => {
                  const isExpanded = expandedDates.has(entry.date);
                  const isToday = entry.date === todayIso;
                  const hasEvents = entry.events.length > 0;
                  const isShortfall = entry.closingBalancePaise < 0;
                  const isBelowThreshold =
                    entry.closingBalancePaise < safetyThresholdPaise && !isShortfall;

                  return (
                    <DailyLedgerRow
                      key={entry.date}
                      entry={entry}
                      isExpanded={isExpanded}
                      isToday={isToday}
                      hasEvents={hasEvents}
                      isShortfall={isShortfall}
                      isBelowThreshold={isBelowThreshold}
                      onToggleExpand={() => toggleExpand(entry.date)}
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface DailyLedgerRowProps {
  entry: DailyLedgerEntry;
  isExpanded: boolean;
  isToday: boolean;
  hasEvents: boolean;
  isShortfall: boolean;
  isBelowThreshold: boolean;
  onToggleExpand: () => void;
}

function DailyLedgerRow({
  entry,
  isExpanded,
  isToday,
  hasEvents,
  isShortfall,
  isBelowThreshold,
  onToggleExpand,
}: DailyLedgerRowProps) {
  return (
    <>
      <TableRow
        className={`text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/40 ${
          isShortfall
            ? "bg-destructive/5 hover:bg-destructive/10"
            : isBelowThreshold
              ? "bg-warning/5 hover:bg-warning/10"
              : isToday
                ? "bg-primary/5 font-medium"
                : ""
        }`}
        onClick={onToggleExpand}
      >
        {/* Expand toggle */}
        <TableCell className="w-10 px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            aria-label={isExpanded ? "Collapse day" : "Expand day"}
          >
            {isExpanded ? (
              <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            )}
          </button>
        </TableCell>

        {/* Date */}
        <TableCell className="font-medium whitespace-nowrap py-2.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span>{formatDate(entry.date, "d MMM yyyy")}</span>
            {isToday && (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 text-primary text-[10px] py-0 px-1"
              >
                Today
              </Badge>
            )}
            {hasEvents && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">({entry.events.length})</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </TableCell>

        {/* Opening cash */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums text-muted-foreground py-2.5">
          {formatMoney(entry.openingBalancePaise)}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Expected incoming payments */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5">
          {entry.expectedIncomingPaise > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-success font-medium">
              +{formatMoney(entry.expectedIncomingPaise)}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Other cash inflows */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5">
          {entry.otherInflowsPaise > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-success">+{formatMoney(entry.otherInflowsPaise)}</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Supplier payments */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5">
          {entry.supplierPaymentsPaise > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-destructive font-medium">
              −{formatMoney(entry.supplierPaymentsPaise)}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Operating expenses */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5">
          {entry.operatingExpensesPaise > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-destructive">−{formatMoney(entry.operatingExpensesPaise)}</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Other outgoing payments */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5">
          {entry.otherOutflowsPaise > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-destructive">−{formatMoney(entry.otherOutflowsPaise)}</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">—</span>
          )}
        </TableCell>

        {/* Closing cash */}
        <TableCell className="text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums py-2.5 font-bold">
          <span
            className={
              isShortfall
                ? "text-destructive"
                : isBelowThreshold
                  ? "text-warning-foreground"
                  : "text-foreground"
            }
          >
            {entry.closingBalancePaise < 0 ? "−" : ""}
            {formatMoney(Math.abs(entry.closingBalancePaise))}
          </span>
        </TableCell>

        {/* Status */}
        <TableCell className="text-center py-2.5">
          {isShortfall ? (
            <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-2 font-medium">
              Deficit
            </Badge>
          ) : isBelowThreshold ? (
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="border-warning/40 bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground text-[10px] py-0 px-2 font-medium"
            >
              Below Buffer
            </Badge>
          ) : (
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="border-success/30 bg-success/10 text-success text-[10px] py-0 px-2 font-medium"
            >
              Healthy
            </Badge>
          )}
        </TableCell>
      </TableRow>

      {/* Expanded Underlying Events Row */}
      {isExpanded && (
        <TableRow className="bg-muted/20 hover:bg-muted/20">
          <TableCell colSpan={10} className="p-3 pl-10 pr-6">
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 shadow-2xs space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                  Transactions & Obligations for {formatDate(entry.date, "EEEE, d MMMM yyyy")}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  Day net:{" "}
                  <span
                    className={`font-semibold ${
                      entry.netMovementPaise >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {entry.netMovementPaise >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}
                    {formatMoney(Math.abs(entry.netMovementPaise))}
                  </span>
                </span>
              </div>

              {entry.events.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2 italic">
                  No discrete transactions scheduled for this date. Opening balance carried forward.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div className="divide-y">
                  {entry.events.map((event) => (
                    <DailyEventItem key={event.id} event={event} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </TableCell>
        </TableRow>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function DailyEventItem({ event }: { event: CashFlowEvent }) {
  const isIncoming = event.direction === "incoming";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 py-2 text-xs">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0">
        <span
          className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md ${
            isIncoming ? "bg-success/10 text-success" : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
          }`}
        >
          {isIncoming ? (
            <ArrowDownLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          ) : (
            <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          )}
        </span>

        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground truncate">{event.label}</span>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 capitalize">
              {event.type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
            </Badge>
            {event.status && (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={`text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 ${
                  event.status === "completed"
                    ? "text-success border-success/30"
                    : event.status === "overdue"
                      ? "text-destructive border-destructive/30"
                      : "text-muted-foreground"
                }`}
              >
                {event.status}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">
            {event.counterpartyName && <span>Party: {event.counterpartyName}</span>}
            {event.riskNote && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-destructive font-medium">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
                {event.riskNote}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Amount and Linked Source Records */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-center">
        <span
          className={`font-bold tabular-nums text-sm ${
            isIncoming ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
          }`}
        >
          {isIncoming ? "+" : "−"}
          {formatMoney(event.amountPaise)}
        </span>

        {/* Source Record Links */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          {event.relatedInvoiceId && (
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild className="h-6 text-[10px] px-2 gap-1">
              <Link to="/invoices" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                <FileText className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                <span>{event.relatedInvoiceId.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              </Link>
            </Button>
          )}

          {event.relatedPurchaseOrderId && (
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild className="h-6 text-[10px] px-2 gap-1">
              <Link to="/suppliers" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                <Truck className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                <span>{event.relatedPurchaseOrderId.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              </Link>
            </Button>
          )}

          {/* Quick link to Ripple Simulator */}
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild className="h-6 text-[10px] px-1.5 text-primary">
            <Link
              to="/simulator"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              search={{
                eventId: event.id,
                eventName: event.label,
              }}
              title="Simulate delay/advance in Ripple Simulator"
            >
              <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3" />
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-summary-cards.tsx">
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Wallet,
  ArrowDownToLine,
  ArrowUpFromLine,
  TrendingUp,
  TrendingDown,
  ShieldAlert,
  Calendar,
  AlertTriangle,
  FlaskConical,
  ArrowRight,
  Info,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { formatMoney, formatDate, formatRelative } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { ForecastResponse, CashFlowEvent } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowSummaryCardsProps {
  forecast: ForecastResponse;
}

export function CashFlowSummaryCards({ forecast }: CashFlowSummaryCardsProps) {
  const isDeficit = forecast.minBalancePaise < 0;
  const isBreached = forecast.daysBelowThreshold > 0;
  const netPositive = forecast.netMovementPaise >= 0;

  // Identify events contributing to the minimum cash point / shortage
  const criticalEvents = forecast.events
    .filter(
      (e) =>
        e.direction === "outgoing" &&
        e.date <= forecast.minBalanceDate &&
        (e.type === "supplier_payment" || e.type === "rent" || e.amountPaise >= 500_000),
    )
    .sort((a, b) => b.amountPaise - a.amountPaise)
    .slice(0, 3);

  const topShortfallEvent: CashFlowEvent | undefined = criticalEvents[0];
  const firstBreachDate = forecast.breachDates[0];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* 7 Core Financial Summary Metrics */}
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-7">
        {/* 1. Current available cash */}
        <Card className="shadow-xs bg-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Available Cash
              </span>
              <Wallet className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">
              {formatMoney(forecast.openingBalancePaise)}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Reconciled starting balance</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 2. Total projected inflows */}
        <Card className="shadow-xs bg-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-success">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Total Inflows
              </span>
              <ArrowDownToLine className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-success">
              +{formatMoney(forecast.totalInflowsPaise)}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Expected collections</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 3. Total projected outflows */}
        <Card className="shadow-xs bg-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-destructive">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Total Outflows
              </span>
              <ArrowUpFromLine className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-destructive">
              −{formatMoney(forecast.totalOutflowsPaise)}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Committed expenses & POs</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 4. Net projected cash movement */}
        <Card className="shadow-xs bg-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Net Movement
              </span>
              {netPositive ? (
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-success" />
              ) : (
                <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive" />
              )}
            </div>
            <div
              className={`mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums ${
                netPositive ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
              }`}
            >
              {netPositive ? "+" : "−"}
              {formatMoney(Math.abs(forecast.netMovementPaise))}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {netPositive ? "Net cash expansion" : "Working capital contraction"}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 5. Minimum projected closing balance */}
        <Card
          className={`shadow-xs ${
            isDeficit
              ? "border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5"
              : isBreached
                ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/5"
                : "bg-card"
          }`}
        >
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Minimum Cash
              </span>
              <AlertTriangle
                className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                  isDeficit
                    ? "text-destructive"
                    : isBreached
                      ? "text-warning"
                      : "text-muted-foreground"
                }`}
              />
            </div>
            <div
              className={`mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums ${
                isDeficit
                  ? "text-destructive"
                  : isBreached
                    ? "text-warning-foreground"
                    : "text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              {forecast.minBalancePaise < 0 ? "−" : ""}
              {formatMoney(Math.abs(forecast.minBalancePaise))}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {isDeficit
                ? "Deficit warning"
                : isBreached
                  ? "Below safety buffer"
                  : "Comfortable liquidity"}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 6. Date of the minimum balance */}
        <Card className="shadow-xs bg-card">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Date of Min Balance
              </span>
              <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1.5 text-base font-bold text-foreground truncate">
              {formatDate(forecast.minBalanceDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              {formatRelative(forecast.minBalanceDate)}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 7. Days below safety threshold */}
        <Card
          className={`shadow-xs ${
            forecast.daysBelowThreshold > 0
              ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/5"
              : "border-success/30 bg-success/5"
          }`}
        >
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Days Below Buffer
              </span>
              <ShieldAlert
                className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                  forecast.daysBelowThreshold > 0 ? "text-warning" : "text-success"
                }`}
              />
            </div>
            <div
              className={`mt-1.5 text-xl font-bold tabular-nums ${
                forecast.daysBelowThreshold > 0 ? "text-warning-foreground" : "text-success"
              }`}
            >
              {forecast.daysBelowThreshold} {forecast.daysBelowThreshold === 1 ? "day" : "days"}
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              Threshold: {formatMoney(forecast.safetyThresholdPaise)}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Cash Safety Warning / Shortfall Banner when threshold is breached */}
      {isBreached && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                  {isDeficit ? "Cash Shortfall Detected" : "Below Safety Buffer"}
                </Badge>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                  Lowest cash point: {formatMoney(forecast.minBalancePaise)} on{" "}
                  {formatDate(forecast.minBalanceDate)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Cash drops below your {formatMoney(forecast.safetyThresholdPaise)} safety buffer
                across{" "}
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                  {forecast.daysBelowThreshold} days
                </span>
                {firstBreachDate && (
                  <span>
                    {" "}
                    (first breach on{" "}
                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                      {formatDate(firstBreachDate)}
                    </span>
                    )
                  </span>
                )}
                .
                {criticalEvents.length > 0 && (
                  <span>
                    {" "}
                    Contributing commitments:{" "}
                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                      {criticalEvents
                        .map((e) => `${e.label} (${formatMoney(e.amountPaise)})`)
                        .join(", ")}
                    </span>
                    .
                  </span>
                )}
              </p>
            </div>

            {topShortfallEvent && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="default"
                asChild
                className="shrink-0 gap-1.5 bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs text-xs font-medium"
              >
                <Link
                  to="/simulator"
                  search={{
                    eventId: topShortfallEvent.id,
                    eventName: topShortfallEvent.label,
                  }}
                >
                  <FlaskConical className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Simulate in Ripple</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                </Link>
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from "recharts";
import { format, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { formatMoneyCompact, formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { ForecastPoint } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowChartProps {
  data: ForecastPoint[];
}

function ChartTooltip({
  active,
  payload,
}: {
  active?: boolean;
  payload?: Array<{ payload: ForecastPoint }>;
}) {
  const point = payload?.[0]?.payload;
  if (!active || !point) return null;
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border bg-card px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-md">
      <div className="font-medium text-foreground">
        {format(parseISO(point.date), "d MMM yyyy")}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 space-y-0.5 tabular-nums">
        <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Balance</span>
          <span
            className={
              point.isShortfall ? "font-medium text-destructive" : "font-medium text-foreground"
            }
          >
            {formatMoney(point.projectedBalancePaise)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">In</span>
          <span className="text-success">{formatMoney(point.inflowsPaise)}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between gap-4">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Out</span>
          <span className="text-destructive">{formatMoney(point.outflowsPaise)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CashFlowChart({ data }: CashFlowChartProps) {
  const chartData = data.map((p) => ({
    ...p,
    balance: p.projectedBalancePaise / 100,
  }));

  return (
    <div
      className="h-72 w-full"
      role="img"
      aria-label="Projected cash balance over the next 30 days"
    >
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
        <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}>
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id="balanceFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.25} />
              <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.02} />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="var(--color-border)" vertical={false} />
          <XAxis
            dataKey="date"
            tickFormatter={(iso: string) => format(parseISO(iso), "d MMM")}
            tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
            tickLine={false}
            axisLine={false}
            minTickGap={32}
          />
          <YAxis
            tickFormatter={(v: number) => formatMoneyCompact(v * 100)}
            tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
            tickLine={false}
            axisLine={false}
            width={56}
          />
          <Tooltip content={<ChartTooltip />} />
          <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="var(--color-destructive)" strokeDasharray="4 4" />
          <Area
            type="monotone"
            dataKey="balance"
            stroke="var(--color-primary)"
            strokeWidth={2}
            fill="url(#balanceFill)"
          />
        </AreaChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/customers/customer-archive-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Archive, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { EnrichedCustomer } from "@/types";

interface CustomerArchiveDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  customer: EnrichedCustomer | null;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
}

export function CustomerArchiveDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  customer,
  onConfirm,
}: CustomerArchiveDialogProps) {
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  if (!customer) return null;

  const isArchived = customer.status === "archived";

  const handleAction = async () => {
    try {
      setIsProcessing(true);
      await onConfirm();
      toast.success(
        isArchived
          ? `Customer "${customer.name}" reactivated successfully.`
          : `Customer "${customer.name}" archived. Historical records preserved.`,
      );
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Action failed";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isArchived ? (
              <RotateCcw className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            ) : (
              <Archive className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
            )}
            <AlertDialogTitle>
              {isArchived ? `Reactivate "${customer.name}"?` : `Archive "${customer.name}"?`}
            </AlertDialogTitle>
          </div>
          <AlertDialogDescription className="space-y-2 pt-2">
            {isArchived ? (
              <p>
                Reactivating will restore this customer to active lists and enable creating new
                invoices and orders.
              </p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <p>Archiving hides this customer from active ordering and new invoice creation.</p>
                <div className="rounded-md border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs text-amber-900 dark:border-amber-900/50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300">
                  <strong>Preserved Historical Data:</strong> All existing customer orders (
                  {customer.orderCount}), invoices ({customer.invoiceCount}), and payment records (
                  {customer.paymentCount}) remain permanently preserved in your ledger.
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel disabled={isProcessing}>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              void handleAction();
            }}
            disabled={isProcessing}
            className={
              isArchived
                ? "bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90"
                : "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white"
            }
          >
            {isProcessing
              ? "Processing..."
              : isArchived
                ? "Reactivate Customer"
                : "Archive Customer"}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}

              </div>

                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Standard Credit Terms</span>

              <CardDescription>Primary account representative and operational memo</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>

                </p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  );

<file path="src/components/customers/customer-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { Customer, CreateCustomerInput, UpdateCustomerInput } from "@/types";

interface CustomerDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  customer?: Customer | null | undefined;
  onSubmit: (data: CreateCustomerInput | UpdateCustomerInput) => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Field-level validation messages. A precise shape beats `Record<string, string>`:
 * it keeps dot access legal under `noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature` and turns
 * a mistyped field key into a compile error instead of a silently ignored message.
 */
interface CustomerFormErrors {
  name?: string;
  email?: string;
  creditTermsDays?: string;
}

export function CustomerDialog({ open, onOpenChange, customer, onSubmit }: CustomerDialogProps) {
  const isEdit = !!customer;

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [contactName, setContactName] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");
  const [taxId, setTaxId] = useState("");
  const [creditTermsDays, setCreditTermsDays] = useState(15);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<CustomerFormErrors>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (customer) {
      setName(customer.name);
      setContactName(customer.contactName || "");
      setEmail(customer.email || "");
      setPhone(customer.phone || "");
      setAddress(customer.address || "");
      setTaxId(customer.taxId || "");
      setCreditTermsDays(customer.creditTermsDays ?? 15);
      setNotes(customer.notes || "");
    } else {
      setName("");
      setContactName("");
      setEmail("");
      setPhone("");
      setAddress("");
      setTaxId("");
      setCreditTermsDays(15);
      setNotes("");
    }
    setErrors({});
  }, [customer, open]);

  const validate = () => {
    const newErrors: CustomerFormErrors = {};
    if (!name.trim() || name.trim().length < 2) {
      newErrors.name = "Customer name must be at least 2 characters.";
    }
    if (email.trim() && !email.includes("@")) {
      newErrors.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
    }
    if (Number.isNaN(creditTermsDays) || creditTermsDays < 0) {
      newErrors.creditTermsDays = "Credit terms must be 0 or more days.";
    }
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return Object.keys(newErrors).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await onSubmit({
        name: name.trim(),
        contactName: contactName.trim() || undefined,
        email: email.trim() || undefined,
        phone: phone.trim() || undefined,
        address: address.trim() || undefined,
        taxId: taxId.trim() || undefined,
        creditTermsDays: Number(creditTermsDays),
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
      });
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save customer";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{isEdit ? "Edit Customer" : "New Customer"}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {isEdit
                ? `Update counterparty profile and credit terms for ${customer.name}.`
                : "Add a new customer account, credit payment terms, and billing details."}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="grid gap-4 py-4">
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="customer-name">
                Business Name <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="customer-name"
                placeholder="e.g. Urban Threads Boutique"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
              {errors.name && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.name}</p>}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="contact-name">Contact Person</Label>
                <Input
                  id="contact-name"
                  placeholder="e.g. Riya Kapoor"
                  value={contactName}
                  onChange={(e) => setContactName(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="credit-terms">Credit Terms (Days)</Label>
                <Input
                  id="credit-terms"
                  type="number"
                  min="0"
                  max="180"
                  value={creditTermsDays}
                  onChange={(e) => setCreditTermsDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                {errors.creditTermsDays && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.creditTermsDays}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="customer-email">Email Address</Label>
                <Input
                  id="customer-email"
                  type="email"
                  placeholder="accounts@boutique.in"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                {errors.email && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.email}</p>}
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="customer-phone">Phone Number</Label>
                <Input
                  id="customer-phone"
                  placeholder="+91 98200 12345"
                  value={phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="customer-taxid">GSTIN / Tax ID</Label>
              <Input
                id="customer-taxid"
                placeholder="29AABCU9603R1Z7"
                value={taxId}
                onChange={(e) => setTaxId(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="customer-address">Billing Address</Label>
              <Input
                id="customer-address"
                placeholder="Street address, city, state, pin"
                value={address}
                onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="customer-notes">Internal Notes</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="customer-notes"
                placeholder="Notes on ordering behavior, special agreements, payment preferences..."
                rows={2}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? "Saving..." : isEdit ? "Update Customer" : "Create Customer"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/customers/customer-summary-cards.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Users, AlertTriangle, Wallet, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { MetricCard } from "@/components/shared/metric-card";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { CustomerSummaryMetrics } from "@/types";

interface CustomerSummaryCardsProps {
  metrics: CustomerSummaryMetrics;
}

export function CustomerSummaryCards({ metrics }: CustomerSummaryCardsProps) {
  const avgScore = metrics.averageReliabilityScore;
  const scoreLabel = avgScore !== null ? `${avgScore}/100 avg rating` : "Insufficient history";

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
      <MetricCard
        label="Total Customers"
        value={metrics.totalCustomers.toString()}
        subtext={`${metrics.activeCustomers} active · ${metrics.archivedCustomers} archived`}
        icon={Users}
      />
      <MetricCard
        label="Outstanding Receivables"
        value={formatMoney(metrics.totalOutstandingPaise)}
        subtext="Total unpaid customer balances"
        icon={Wallet}
        intent="info"
      />
      <MetricCard
        label="Overdue Invoices"
        value={formatMoney(metrics.totalOverduePaise)}
        subtext={`${metrics.overdueCustomersCount} counterparty accounts overdue`}
        icon={AlertTriangle}
        intent={metrics.totalOverduePaise > 0 ? "danger" : "default"}
      />
      <MetricCard
        label="Average Payment Reliability"
        value={avgScore !== null ? `${avgScore}%` : "N/A"}
        subtext={scoreLabel}
        icon={ShieldCheck}
        intent={
          avgScore !== null && avgScore >= 75
            ? "success"
            : avgScore !== null && avgScore >= 60
              ? "warning"
              : "default"
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}

                    <Button

                  )}

                  {alert.purchaseOrderId && onSelectPurchaseOrder && (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"

                      </Link>
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Movement Audit Log
                    </span>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => onRecordMovement(data.product.id)}
                      className="h-7 text-xs"
                    >
                      Record Movement
                    </Button>
                  </div>

                  {data.movements.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      No stock movements recorded yet for this product.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                      {data.movements.map((mov) => {
                        const isPositive = mov.type === "receipt" || mov.type === "return";
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={mov.id}
                            className="flex items-start justify-between p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card text-xs"
                          >
                            <div className="space-y-0.5">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <Badge
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className={`text-[10px] capitalize ${
                                    isPositive
                                      ? "border-success/30 text-success bg-success/5"
                                      : "border-warning/30 text-warning-foreground bg-warning/5"
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {mov.type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                                </Badge>
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                  {formatDate(mov.date, "d MMM yyyy")}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              {mov.note && (
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-foreground mt-1">{mov.note}</p>
                              )}
                              {mov.referenceId && (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block font-mono">
                                  Ref: {mov.referenceId}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>

                            <div className="text-right">
                              <span
                                className={`font-bold text-sm ${
                                  isPositive ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {isPositive ? `+${mov.quantity}` : `-${mov.quantity}`}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">
                                Balance: {mov.resultingBalance}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>

                {/* 3. PURCHASE ORDERS TAB */}
                <TabsContent value="orders" className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Related Purchase Orders
                    </span>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => onCreatePurchaseOrder(data.product.id)}
                      className="h-7 text-xs"
                    >
                      New Purchase Order
                    </Button>
                  </div>

                  {data.purchaseOrders.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      No purchase orders recorded for this product.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {data.purchaseOrders.map((po) => {
                        const supplier = data.preferredSupplier;
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={po.id}
                            className="p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card text-xs space-y-1.5"
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">
                                  {po.poNumber || po.id}
                                </span>
                                <StatusBadge status={po.status} />
                              </div>
                              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground font-mono">
                                {formatMoney(po.totalPaise)}
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">
                              <span>Ordered: {formatDate(po.orderDate, "d MMM yyyy")}</span>
                              <span>
                                Expected: {formatDate(po.expectedDeliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
                              </span>
                              <span>Units: {po.quantity || 0}</span>
                            </div>

                            {onViewPoDetails && (
                              <div className="pt-1 flex justify-end">
                                <Button
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="sm"
                                  onClick={() => onViewPoDetails(po.id)}
                                  className="h-6 text-[11px] p-0 text-primary hover:underline"
                                >
                                  View PO Details →
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>

                {/* 4. CUSTOMER COMMITMENTS TAB */}
                <TabsContent value="commitments" className="space-y-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">
                    Committed Customer Orders
                  </span>

                  {data.customerOrders.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      No customer orders currently reserving this product.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {data.customerOrders.map((co) => (
                        <div
                          key={co.id}
                          className="p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card text-xs space-y-1"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{co.customerName}</span>
                            <StatusBadge status={co.status} />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">
                            <span>Quantity: {co.quantity} units</span>
                            <span>Order Total: {formatMoney(co.totalPaise)}</span>
                            <span>
                              Delivery:{" "}
                              {co.deliveryDate
                                ? formatDate(co.deliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")
                                : "Scheduled"}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>

                {/* 5. RISK ANALYSIS TAB */}
                <TabsContent value="risk" className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border p-4 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertTriangle
                        className={`h-4 w-4 ${
                          data.status === "stockout_risk" || data.status === "out_of_stock"
                            ? "text-destructive"
                            : data.status === "low_stock"
                              ? "text-warning-foreground"
                              : "text-success"
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">
                        Operational Risk Assessment
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-2 leading-relaxed">
                      {data.status === "stockout_risk" ? (
                        <p className="text-destructive font-medium">
                          Critical Alert: Open customer order commitments exceed available warehouse
                          stock. Immediate procurement action required to avoid delivery delay
                          penalties.
                        </p>
                      ) : data.status === "low_stock" ? (
                        <p className="text-warning-foreground font-medium">
                          Warning: Available stock ({data.availableStock}) is below reorder
                          threshold ({data.reorderThreshold}). Place a purchase order before
                          supplier lead time window closes.
                        </p>
                      ) : data.status === "out_of_stock" ? (
                        <p className="text-destructive font-medium">
                          Critical Alert: Zero units available on hand. Product cannot fulfill new
                          customer orders.
                        </p>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-success font-medium">
                          Healthy: Available stock buffer adequately covers projected demand and
                          current order commitments.
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="border-t pt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">
                          Forecast Demand
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                          ~{data.forecastDemand} units / week
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">
                          Lead Time Buffer
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                          {data.preferredSupplier
                            ? `${data.preferredSupplier.paymentTermsDays} days supplier lead time`
                            : "Standard 15 days"}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
</file>

import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
  SheetDescription,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

import {
  Truck,
  Calendar,
  Building2,
  Boxes,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  Network,
  FlaskConical,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ExternalLink,
} from "lucide-react";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { EnrichedPurchaseOrder } from "@/lib/api/purchaseOrderApi";

interface PurchaseOrderDetailSheetProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  order?: EnrichedPurchaseOrder | null | undefined;
  onReceiveStock: (poId: string) => void;
}

export function PurchaseOrderDetailSheet({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  order,
  onReceiveStock,
}: PurchaseOrderDetailSheetProps) {
  if (!open || !order) return null;

  const isFullyReceived = order.status === "received";

  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent className="w-full sm:max-w-xl overflow-y-auto p-0">
        <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-6 pb-4 border-b bg-card">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                  {order.poNumber || order.id}
                </span>
                <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {!isFullyReceived && (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => onReceiveStock(order.id)}
                    className="h-8 text-xs gap-1.5 text-primary"
                  >
                    <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Receive Items
                  </Button>
                )}

                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" asChild className="h-8 text-xs gap-1.5">
                  <Link to="/relationships" search={{ selectedId: `node_${order.id}` }}>
                    <Network className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                    <span>Graph</span>
                  </Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-foreground font-medium">
                <Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                {order.supplier?.name || "Supplier"}
              </span>
              <span>Ordered: {formatDate(order.orderDate, "d MMM yyyy")}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-6 space-y-5 flex-1">
            {/* Delivery Milestones */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Truck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                Delivery Timeline & Status
              </span>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center text-xs">
                <div className="rounded bg-muted/30 p-2 border">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">Order Date</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {formatDate(order.orderDate, "d MMM")}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded bg-primary/5 p-2 border border-primary/20">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-primary block">Expected Delivery</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {formatDate(order.expectedDeliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded bg-muted/30 p-2 border">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">Receipt Status</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {order.receivedUnits} / {order.orderedUnits} units
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Line Items Table */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground block">Line Items</span>
              <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card overflow-hidden">
                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                  <thead className="bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground border-b">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="text-left p-2.5">Item</th>
                      <th className="text-right p-2.5">Qty</th>
                      <th className="text-right p-2.5">Received</th>
                      <th className="text-right p-2.5">Unit Price</th>
                      <th className="text-right p-2.5 pr-3">Total</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y">
                    {order.lineItemsDetails?.map((li) => (
                      <tr key={li.id}>
                        <td className="p-2.5">
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground block">
                            {li.product?.name || "Product"}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                            {li.product?.sku}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="text-right p-2.5 text-foreground">{li.quantity}</td>
                        <td className="text-right p-2.5">
                          <span
                            className={
                              (li.receivedQuantity ?? 0) >= li.quantity
                                ? "text-success font-semibold"
                                : "text-muted-foreground"
                            }
                          >
                            {li.receivedQuantity ?? 0}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="text-right p-2.5 font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                          {formatMoney(li.unitPricePaise)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="text-right p-2.5 pr-3 font-semibold text-foreground font-mono">
                          {formatMoney(li.totalPaise)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Payment Commitments Breakdown */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 space-y-2.5 text-xs">
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground block">Financial Commitments</span>
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Order Total:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(order.totalPaise)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Advance Paid / Scheduled:</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground font-mono">
                  {order.advancePaidPaise > 0 ? formatMoney(order.advancePaidPaise) : "₹0"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1 border-b">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Balance Outstanding:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-foreground font-mono">
                  {formatMoney(order.outstandingPaise)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between py-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Payment Due Date:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                  {order.paymentDueDate
                    ? formatDate(order.paymentDueDate, "d MMM yyyy")
                    : "Net payment terms"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Simulation Link */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground block">
                  Ripple What-If Simulation
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  Simulate supplier delivery delay on this purchase order.
                </span>
              </div>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" asChild className="h-7 text-xs gap-1">
                <Link
                  to="/simulator"
                  search={{
                    eventId: `node_${order.id}`,
                    eventName: `${order.poNumber || order.id} Delivery`,
                  }}
                >
                  <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3" /> Test Delay
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}

import React from "react";

  Clock,
