import type { ReorderRecommendation } from "@/types";

interface ReorderRecommendationsPanelProps {
  recommendations: ReorderRecommendation[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  onSelectProduct: (productId: string) => void;
  onCreatePurchaseOrder: (productId: string, supplierId?: string) => void;
}

export function ReorderRecommendationsPanel({
  recommendations,
  isLoading,
  onSelectProduct,
  onCreatePurchaseOrder,
}: ReorderRecommendationsPanelProps) {
  if (recommendations.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-8 text-center shadow-xs">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-success/10 text-success">
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">All Stock Levels Healthy</h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
          No replenishment orders are currently required. Warehouse stock buffers and incoming
          deliveries comfortably exceed reorder thresholds and committed customer orders.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Informational Guidance Banner */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-3.5 text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-foreground">
          <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          Algorithmic Procurement & Lead-Time Sizing
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          Recommendations synthesize current available stock, open customer reservations, supplier
          lead times, and minimum reorder thresholds.{" "}
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
            Confirmed facts are clearly separated from proposed purchase suggestions.
          </span>
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4">
        {recommendations.map((rec) => (
          <Card key={rec.productId} className="shadow-xs border-l-4 border-l-warning">
            <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                      {rec.productName}
                    </CardTitle>
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase">
                      {rec.sku}
                    </span>
                    {rec.category && (
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
                        {rec.category}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1 text-warning-foreground font-medium">
                    {rec.reason}
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() => onSelectProduct(rec.productId)}
                    className="h-8 text-xs gap-1"
                  >
                    <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> View Product
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => onCreatePurchaseOrder(rec.productId, rec.preferredSupplierId)}
                    className="h-8 text-xs gap-1.5 shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <ShoppingCart className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Create Purchase Order
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="p-4 pt-2 space-y-3">
              {/* Confirmed Facts vs Proposed Order Comparison */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs">
                {/* Fact: Current Available */}
                <div className="rounded border bg-muted/20 p-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block font-medium">
                    Confirmed Available
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                    {rec.currentAvailableStock}{" "}
                    <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                      / {rec.reorderPoint} threshold
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Fact: Incoming Quantity */}
                <div className="rounded border bg-muted/20 p-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block font-medium">
                    Incoming Deliveries
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-primary">
                    {rec.incomingQuantity > 0 ? `+${rec.incomingQuantity}` : "0"} units
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Proposed: Suggested Reorder Quantity */}
                <div className="rounded border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-primary block font-semibold">
                    Suggested Reorder
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                    {rec.suggestedReorderQuantity} units
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Proposed: Purchase Amount */}
                <div className="rounded border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 p-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-primary block font-semibold">
                    Proposed Outlay
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-base font-bold text-foreground font-mono">
                    {rec.proposedPurchaseAmountPaise
                      ? formatMoney(rec.proposedPurchaseAmountPaise)
                      : "—"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Timing, Supplier & Customer Risk Details */}
              <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs space-y-2">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">
                      Preferred Supplier
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                      {rec.preferredSupplierName ? (
                        <Link to="/suppliers" className="text-primary hover:underline">
                          {rec.preferredSupplierName} ({rec.preferredSupplierLeadDays || 15}d lead)
                        </Link>
                      ) : (
                        "No preferred supplier assigned"
                      )}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">
                      Estimated Delivery Date
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                      {rec.estimatedDeliveryDate
                        ? formatDate(rec.estimatedDeliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")
                        : "Depends on supplier order date"}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">
                      Required Upfront Advance
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-foreground font-mono">
                      {rec.requiredAdvancePaise ? formatMoney(rec.requiredAdvancePaise) : "₹0"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Customer commitments at risk */}
                {rec.customerCommitmentsAtRisk.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="pt-2 border-t border-muted">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive block">
                      Customer Commitments at Risk:
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-1">
                      {rec.customerCommitmentsAtRisk.map((c, i) => (
                        <Badge
                          key={i}
                          variant="outline"
                          className="border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive text-[11px]"
                        >
                          {c}
                        </Badge>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Ripple Simulator Link */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  Simulate procurement cash outlays against future receivable collections:
                </span>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  asChild
                  className="h-6 text-[11px] gap-1 text-primary"
                >
                  <Link
                    to="/simulator"
                    search={{
                      eventId: `node_stock_1`,
                      eventName: `${rec.productName} Reorder`,
                    }}
                  >
                    <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3" /> Explore in Simulator
                  </Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/invoices/invoice-detail-header.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { ArrowLeft, CreditCard, Bell, Ban, ArrowDownLeft, ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import type { EnrichedInvoice } from "@/types";

interface InvoiceDetailHeaderProps {
  invoice: EnrichedInvoice;
  onRecordPayment: () => void;
  onSendReminder: () => void;
  onCancelInvoice: () => void;
}

export function InvoiceDetailHeader({
  invoice,
  onRecordPayment,
  onSendReminder,
  onCancelInvoice,
}: InvoiceDetailHeaderProps) {
  const isReceivable = invoice.type === "receivable" || !invoice.type;
  const isOverdue = invoice.isOverdue;
  const isCancellable = invoice.status !== "void" && invoice.status !== "paid";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 pb-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild className="gap-1.5 -ml-2 text-muted-foreground">
          <Link to="/invoices">
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            Back to Invoices
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
              {invoice.invoiceNumber}
            </h1>

            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className={`text-xs gap-1 font-medium ${
                isReceivable
                  ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300"
                  : "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950/50 dark:text-purple-300"
              }`}
            >
              {isReceivable ? (
                <>
                  <ArrowDownLeft className="h-3 w-3" />
                  Receivable (Customer)
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                  Payable (Vendor)
                </>
              )}
            </Badge>

            <StatusBadge status={invoice.status} />

            {isOverdue && (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-xs"
              >
                {invoice.daysOverdue} days overdue
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>

          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Counterparty:{" "}
            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{invoice.counterpartyName}</span>
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {isOverdue && isReceivable && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onSendReminder}
              className="text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400"
            >
              <Bell className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Overdue Reminder
            </Button>
          )}

          {invoice.outstandingPaise > 0 && invoice.status !== "void" && (
            <Button size="sm" onClick={onRecordPayment}>
              <CreditCard className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Record Payment
            </Button>
          )}

          {isCancellable && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onCancelInvoice}
              className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
            >
              <Ban className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Cancel Invoice
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { MetricCard } from "@/components/shared/metric-card";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import {
  Wallet,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Calendar,
  Building,
  CreditCard,
  Package,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { InvoiceDetailData } from "@/types";
import { calculateCustomerPaymentReliability } from "@/lib/reliability";

interface InvoiceDetailViewProps {
  data: InvoiceDetailData;
  onRecordPayment: () => void;
}

export function InvoiceDetailView({ data, onRecordPayment }: InvoiceDetailViewProps) {
  const { invoice, customer, supplier, customerOrder, purchaseOrder, payments } = data;
  const isReceivable = invoice.type === "receivable" || !invoice.type;

  // Calculate customer reliability rating if customer exists
  const customerReliability = customer
    ? calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(customer, db.invoices, db.payments)
    : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Metric Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <MetricCard
          label="Total Amount"
          value={formatMoney(invoice.amountPaise)}
          subtext={`Issued on ${formatDate(invoice.issueDate)}`}
          icon={Wallet}
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Amount Paid"
          value={formatMoney(invoice.amountPaidPaise || 0)}
          subtext={`${payments.length} settlement transaction(s)`}
          icon={CheckCircle2}
          intent="success"
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Outstanding Balance"
          value={formatMoney(invoice.outstandingPaise)}
          subtext={
            invoice.outstandingPaise === 0
              ? "Fully settled"
              : invoice.isOverdue
                ? `${invoice.daysOverdue} days past due`
                : "Payment pending"
          }
          icon={AlertTriangle}
          intent={
            invoice.outstandingPaise > 0 ? (invoice.isOverdue ? "danger" : "info") : "success"
          }
        />

        <MetricCard
          label="Payment Due Date"
          value={formatDate(invoice.dueDate)}
          subtext={
            invoice.isOverdue ? `Overdue by ${invoice.daysOverdue} days` : "Net terms active"
          }
          icon={Calendar}
          intent={invoice.isOverdue ? "danger" : "default"}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Counterparty Information Card */}
        <Card className="md:col-span-1">
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Building className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <CardTitle className="text-base">
                {isReceivable ? "Customer Information" : "Supplier Information"}
              </CardTitle>
            </div>
            <CardDescription>Commercial relationship profile and credit rating</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 text-sm">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Counterparty Name</span>
              {isReceivable && customer ? (
                <Link
                  to="/customers/$customerId"
                  params={{ customerId: customer.id }}
                  className="font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary hover:underline"
                >
                  {customer.name}
                </Link>
              ) : !isReceivable && supplier ? (
                <Link
                  to="/suppliers/$supplierId"
                  params={{ supplierId: supplier.id }}
                  className="font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary hover:underline"
                >
                  {supplier.name}
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <span className="font-semibold">{invoice.counterpartyName}</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {customer && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Primary Contact</span>
                  <span>{customer.contactName || "None assigned"}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Email & Phone</span>
                  <span>
                    {customer.email || "No email"} · {customer.phone || "No phone"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Credit Terms</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Net {customer.creditTermsDays} days</span>
                </div>
                {customerReliability && (
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                      Payment Reliability
                    </span>
                    <PaymentReliabilityBadge reliability={customerReliability} size="sm" />
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}

            {supplier && (
              <>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Primary Contact</span>
                  <span>{supplier.contactName || "None assigned"}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Payment Terms</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">Net {supplier.paymentTermsDays} days</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Delivery Reliability</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{supplier.reliabilityScore}%</span>
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            {invoice.notes && (
              <div className="pt-2 border-t">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">Invoice Notes</span>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic mt-0.5">{invoice.notes}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* Payments Ledger Card */}
        <Card className="md:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CreditCard className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                <CardTitle className="text-base">Settlement & Payment Ledger</CardTitle>
              </div>
              <CardDescription>
                Chronological record of settlements applied against this invoice
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
            {invoice.outstandingPaise > 0 && invoice.status !== "void" && (
              <Button size="sm" onClick={onRecordPayment}>
                Record Payment
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {payments.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState
                title="No payments recorded"
                description="This invoice has no settlement records yet."
                icon={CreditCard}
              />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Payment ID</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Method</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {payments.map((p) => (
                    <TableRow key={p.id}>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.id}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {p.completedDate
                          ? formatDate(p.completedDate)
                          : p.scheduledDate
                            ? formatDate(p.scheduledDate)
                            : "—"}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{p.method || "Bank Transfer"}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right font-medium text-success">
                        {formatMoney(p.amountPaise)}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <StatusBadge status={p.status} />
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}

            {/* Linked Order Info if any */}
            {(customerOrder || purchaseOrder) && (
              <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Linked Commercial Order
                </h4>
                {customerOrder && (
                  <div className="rounded-md border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        Customer Order #{customerOrder.id}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">
                        Ordered on {formatDate(customerOrder.orderDate)} · {customerOrder.quantity}{" "}
                        units
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="font-semibold">{formatMoney(customerOrder.totalPaise)}</span>
                      <div>
                        <StatusBadge status={customerOrder.status} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {purchaseOrder && (
                  <div className="rounded-md border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                        Purchase Order {purchaseOrder.poNumber || purchaseOrder.id}

                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">

                        {formatDate(purchaseOrder.expectedDeliveryDate)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="font-semibold">{formatMoney(purchaseOrder.totalPaise)}</span>
                      <div>
                        <StatusBadge status={purchaseOrder.status} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/invoices/invoice-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { addDays, format, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { CreateInvoiceInput, InvoiceType, Customer, Supplier } from "@/types";

interface InvoiceDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  customers: Customer[];
  suppliers: Supplier[];
  initialType?: InvoiceType | undefined;
  preselectedCustomerId?: string | undefined;
  preselectedSupplierId?: string | undefined;
  onSubmit: (data: CreateInvoiceInput) => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Field-level validation messages. A precise shape beats `Record<string, string>`:
 * it keeps dot access legal under `noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature` and turns
 * a mistyped field key into a compile error instead of a silently ignored message.
 */
interface InvoiceFormErrors {
  amount?: string;
  counterparty?: string;
  issueDate?: string;
  dueDate?: string;
}

export function InvoiceDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  customers,
  suppliers,
  initialType = "receivable",
  preselectedCustomerId,
  preselectedSupplierId,
  onSubmit,
}: InvoiceDialogProps) {
  const [type, setType] = useState<InvoiceType>(initialType);
  const [customerId, setCustomerId] = useState<string>("");
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState<string>("");
  const [invoiceNumber, setInvoiceNumber] = useState<string>("");
  const [amountRupees, setAmountRupees] = useState<string>("");
  const [issueDate, setIssueDate] = useState<string>("");
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState<string>("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<InvoiceFormErrors>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    setIssueDate(today);
    setDueDate(format(addDays(new Date(), 15), "yyyy-MM-dd"));
    setType(initialType);
    setCustomerId(preselectedCustomerId || (customers[0]?.id ?? ""));
    setSupplierId(preselectedSupplierId || (suppliers[0]?.id ?? ""));
    setInvoiceNumber("");
    setAmountRupees("");
    setNotes("");
    setErrors({});
  }, [open, initialType, preselectedCustomerId, preselectedSupplierId, customers, suppliers]);

  // Auto-calculate due date when customer/supplier changes
  const handleCustomerChange = (id: string) => {
    setCustomerId(id);
    const selected = customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
    if (selected && issueDate) {
      const days = selected.creditTermsDays ?? 15;
      setDueDate(format(addDays(parseISO(issueDate), days), "yyyy-MM-dd"));
    }
  };

  const handleSupplierChange = (id: string) => {
    setSupplierId(id);
    const selected = suppliers.find((s) => s.id === id);
    if (selected && issueDate) {
      const days = selected.paymentTermsDays ?? 30;
      setDueDate(format(addDays(parseISO(issueDate), days), "yyyy-MM-dd"));
    }
  };

  const validate = () => {
    const errs: InvoiceFormErrors = {};
    const parsedAmt = parseFloat(amountRupees);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsedAmt) || parsedAmt <= 0) {
      errs.amount = "Invoice amount must be greater than ₹0.";
    }
    if (type === "receivable" && !customerId) {
      errs.counterparty = "Please select a customer.";
    }
    if (type === "payable" && !supplierId) {
      errs.counterparty = "Please select a supplier.";
    }
    if (!issueDate) {
      errs.issueDate = "Issue date is required.";
    }
    if (!dueDate) {
      errs.dueDate = "Due date is required.";
    }
    setErrors(errs);
    return Object.keys(errs).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      const paise = Math.round(parseFloat(amountRupees) * 100);
      await onSubmit({
        type,
        customerId: type === "receivable" ? customerId : undefined,
        supplierId: type === "payable" ? supplierId : undefined,
        invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber.trim() || undefined,
        amountPaise: paise,
        issueDate,
        dueDate,
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(
        `${type === "receivable" ? "Customer invoice" : "Vendor bill"} created successfully.`,
      );
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create invoice";
      toast.error(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {type === "receivable" ? "Create Customer Invoice" : "Record Vendor Bill"}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Issue an accounts receivable invoice to a customer or record an accounts payable
              vendor bill.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="grid gap-4 py-4">
            {/* Invoice Type Selector */}
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label>Invoice Classification</Label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant={type === "receivable" ? "default" : "outline"}
                  onClick={() => setType("receivable")}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="w-full text-xs"
                >
                  Receivable (Customer Invoice)
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant={type === "payable" ? "default" : "outline"}
                  onClick={() => setType("payable")}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  className="w-full text-xs"
                >
                  Payable (Vendor Bill)
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Counterparty Selection */}
            {type === "receivable" ? (
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-customer">Customer</Label>
                <Select
                  value={customerId}
                  onValueChange={handleCustomerChange}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="inv-customer">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select customer" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {customers
                      .filter((c) => c.status !== "archived")
                      .map((c) => (
                        <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                          {c.name} (Net {c.creditTermsDays}d)
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                {errors.counterparty && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.counterparty}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-supplier">Supplier</Label>
                <Select
                  value={supplierId}
                  onValueChange={handleSupplierChange}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="inv-supplier">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select supplier" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {suppliers
                      .filter((s) => s.status !== "archived")
                      .map((s) => (
                        <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                          {s.name} (Net {s.paymentTermsDays}d)
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                {errors.counterparty && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.counterparty}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Invoice Number & Amount */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-num">Invoice / Bill # (Optional)</Label>
                <Input
                  id="inv-num"
                  placeholder={type === "receivable" ? "INV-2026-XXXX" : "BILL-2026-XXXX"}
                  value={invoiceNumber}
                  onChange={(e) => setInvoiceNumber(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-amount">
                  Total Amount (₹) <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="inv-amount"
                  type="number"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0.01"
                  placeholder="e.g. 25000"
                  value={amountRupees}
                  onChange={(e) => setAmountRupees(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                {errors.amount && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.amount}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Issue Date & Due Date */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-issue">Issue Date</Label>
                <Input
                  id="inv-issue"
                  type="date"
                  value={issueDate}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setIssueDate(e.target.value);
                    if (type === "receivable") {
                      const c = customers.find((cust) => cust.id === customerId);
                      if (c && e.target.value) {
                        setDueDate(
                          format(
                            addDays(parseISO(e.target.value), c.creditTermsDays ?? 15),
                            "yyyy-MM-dd",
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                    } else {
                      const s = suppliers.find((supp) => supp.id === supplierId);
                      if (s && e.target.value) {
                        setDueDate(
                          format(
                            addDays(parseISO(e.target.value), s.paymentTermsDays ?? 30),
                            "yyyy-MM-dd",
                          ),
                        );
                      }
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                {errors.issueDate && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.issueDate}</p>}
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-due">Payment Due Date</Label>
                <Input
                  id="inv-due"
                  type="date"
                  value={dueDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setDueDate(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
                {errors.dueDate && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors.dueDate}</p>}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Notes */}
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="inv-notes">Notes / Itemization Description</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="inv-notes"
                placeholder="Product order reference, lot number, delivery terms..."
                rows={2}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? "Creating..." : "Create Invoice"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/invoices/overdue-reminder-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Copy, Check, Bell, Mail } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { OverdueReminderPayload } from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";

interface OverdueReminderDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  reminderData: OverdueReminderPayload | null;
}

export function OverdueReminderDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  reminderData,
}: OverdueReminderDialogProps) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [editedBody, setEditedBody] = useState("");

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (reminderData) {
      setEditedBody(reminderData.body);
      setCopied(false);
    }
  }, [reminderData, open]);

  if (!reminderData) return null;

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    try {
      const fullText = `Subject: ${reminderData.subject}\n\n${editedBody}`;
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullText);
      setCopied(true);
      toast.success("Reminder message copied to clipboard!");
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to copy reminder to clipboard.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Bell className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
            <DialogTitle>Overdue Payment Reminder Preview</DialogTitle>
          </div>
          <DialogDescription>
            Preview and copy a formalized payment notice for invoice {reminderData.invoiceNumber} (
            {reminderData.daysOverdue} days overdue).
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="grid gap-3.5 py-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">To</Label>
              <Input
                value={`${reminderData.recipientName} <${reminderData.recipientEmail}>`}
                readOnly
                className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs bg-muted/40 font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Due Date</Label>
              <Input
                value={`${reminderData.dueDate} (${reminderData.daysOverdue}d overdue)`}
                readOnly
                className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs bg-muted/40 font-semibold text-destructive"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Subject Line</Label>
            <Input
              value={reminderData.subject}
              readOnly
              className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs bg-muted/40 font-medium"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <Label htmlFor="reminder-body" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Message Body (Editable)
            </Label>
            <Textarea
              id="reminder-body"
              value={editedBody}
              onChange={(e) => setEditedBody(e.target.value)}
              rows={10}
              className="mt-1 text-xs font-mono leading-relaxed resize-y"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="flex-row justify-between sm:justify-between items-center gap-2">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            Close
          </Button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" asChild>
              <a
                href={`mailto:${reminderData.recipientEmail}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(
                  reminderData.subject,
                )}&body=${encodeURIComponent(editedBody)}`}
              >
                <Mail className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Open Email Client
              </a>
            </Button>
            <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={handleCopy}>
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                  Copied!
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Copy Reminder
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/invoices/record-payment-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { Invoice, RecordPaymentInput } from "@/types";

interface RecordPaymentDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  invoice: Invoice | null;
  onSubmit: (invoiceId: string, data: RecordPaymentInput) => Promise<void>;
}

export function RecordPaymentDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  invoice,
  onSubmit,
}: RecordPaymentDialogProps) {
  const [amountRupees, setAmountRupees] = useState<string>("");
  const [paymentDate, setPaymentDate] = useState<string>("");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<string>("Bank Transfer");
  const [note, setNote] = useState<string>("");
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const remainingPaise = invoice
    ? Math.max(0, invoice.amountPaise - (invoice.amountPaidPaise || 0))
    : 0;
  const remainingRupees = remainingPaise / 100;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (invoice) {
      const rem = Math.max(0, invoice.amountPaise - (invoice.amountPaidPaise || 0));
      setAmountRupees((rem / 100).toString());
      setPaymentDate(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      setMethod("Bank Transfer");
      setNote("");
      setError(null);
    }
  }, [invoice, open]);

  if (!invoice) return null;

  const isReceivable = invoice.type === "receivable" || !invoice.type;

  const handleQuickAmount = (ratio: number) => {
    const amt = Math.round(remainingRupees * ratio);
    setAmountRupees(amt.toString());
    setError(null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsedRupees = parseFloat(amountRupees);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsedRupees) || parsedRupees <= 0) {
      setError("Please enter a valid payment amount greater than ₹0.");
      return;
    }

    const inputPaise = Math.round(parsedRupees * 100);
    if (inputPaise > remainingPaise) {
      setError(`Amount cannot exceed remaining balance of ${formatMoney(remainingPaise)}.`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsSubmitting(true);
      await onSubmit(invoice.id, {
        amountPaise: inputPaise,
        paymentDate: paymentDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        method,
        note: note.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(
        `Payment of ${formatMoney(inputPaise)} recorded successfully for ${invoice.invoiceNumber}.`,
      );
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to record payment";
      toast.error(msg);
      setError(msg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {isReceivable ? "Record Customer Payment" : "Record Supplier Settlement"}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Record full or partial settlement against {invoice.invoiceNumber}.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="grid gap-4 py-4">
            {/* Invoice Summary Card */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-sm space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                <span>Invoice Total:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                  {formatMoney(invoice.amountPaise)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                <span>Already Paid:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  {formatMoney(invoice.amountPaidPaise || 0)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between pt-1 border-t font-semibold">
                <span>Remaining Balance:</span>
                <span className="text-primary">{formatMoney(remainingPaise)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Amount input & quick buttons */}
            <div className="grid gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label htmlFor="payment-amount">Payment Amount (₹)</Label>
                <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    onClick={() => handleQuickAmount(0.5)}
                  >
                    50%
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    onClick={() => handleQuickAmount(1)}
                  >
                    Full
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Input
                id="payment-amount"
                type="number"
                step="0.01"
                min="0.01"
                max={remainingRupees}
                value={amountRupees}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setAmountRupees(e.target.value);
                  setError(null);
                }}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="font-medium text-base"
              />
              {error && <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{error}</p>}
            </div>

            {/* Payment Date & Method */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="payment-date">Settlement Date</Label>
                <Input
                  id="payment-date"
                  type="date"
                  value={paymentDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentDate(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="payment-method">Payment Mode</Label>
                <Select value={method} onValueChange={setMethod} disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  <SelectTrigger id="payment-method">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="UPI">UPI</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="NEFT">NEFT</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="RTGS">RTGS</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="Bank Transfer">Bank Transfer</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="Cheque">Cheque</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="Cash">Cash</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Note / Transaction Reference */}
            <div className="grid gap-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="payment-note">Transaction Reference / Note</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="payment-note"
                placeholder="e.g. UTR / Ref number or bank confirmation memo"
                rows={2}
                value={note}
                onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? "Recording..." : "Record Payment"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/relationships/relationship-edge.tsx">
import React, { memo } from "react";
import {
  BaseEdge,
  EdgeLabelRenderer,
  getSmoothStepPath,
  type Edge,
  type EdgeProps,
} from "@xyflow/react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Declared as a `type` alias rather than an `interface` on purpose: only object
 * type aliases receive an implicit index signature, which is what lets this
 * satisfy React Flow's `Edge<T extends Record<string, unknown>>` constraint.
 */
export type CustomEdgeData = {
  description?: string | undefined;
  isHighlighted?: boolean | undefined;
  isAtRisk?: boolean | undefined;
  isDelayed?: boolean | undefined;
  isDimmed?: boolean | undefined;
  status?: string | undefined;
};

export type RelationshipEdge = Edge<CustomEdgeData>;

export const RelationshipCustomEdge = memo(
  ({
    id,
    sourceX,
    sourceY,
    targetX,
    targetY,
    sourcePosition,
    targetPosition,
    style = {},
    markerEnd,
    data,
  }: EdgeProps<RelationshipEdge>) => {
    const [edgePath, labelX, labelY] = getSmoothStepPath({
      sourceX,
      sourceY,
      sourcePosition,
      targetX,
      targetY,
      targetPosition,
      borderRadius: 6,
    });

    const edgeData = data;
    const isHighlighted = edgeData?.isHighlighted;
    const isAtRisk = edgeData?.isAtRisk;
    const isDelayed = edgeData?.isDelayed;
    const isDimmed = edgeData?.isDimmed;
    const description = edgeData?.description;

    const shouldShowLabel = Boolean(description) && (isHighlighted || isAtRisk || isDelayed);

    return (
      <>
        <BaseEdge
          id={id}
          path={edgePath}
          // React Flow types this as `markerEnd?: string`, which under
          // `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` rejects an explicit `undefined`.
          {...(markerEnd ? { markerEnd } : {})}
          style={{
            ...style,
            strokeWidth: isHighlighted ? 2.5 : isAtRisk || isDelayed ? 2 : 1.5,
            stroke: isHighlighted
              ? "var(--primary)"
              : isAtRisk
                ? "var(--warning)"
                : isDelayed
                  ? "var(--destructive)"
                  : "var(--muted-foreground)",
            opacity: isDimmed ? 0.3 : isHighlighted ? 1 : 0.75,
            strokeDasharray: isAtRisk ? "5,5" : isDelayed ? "4,4" : undefined,
            transition: "all 0.2s ease",
          }}
        />
        {shouldShowLabel && (
          <EdgeLabelRenderer>
            <div
              style={{
                position: "absolute",
                transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${labelX}px,${labelY}px)`,
                pointerEvents: "all",
                zIndex: 1000,
              }}
              className={cn(
                "rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold shadow-xs select-none backdrop-blur-md whitespace-nowrap",
                isHighlighted
                  ? "bg-card/98 text-foreground border-primary ring-2 ring-primary/30 shadow-md font-bold"
                  : isAtRisk
                    ? "bg-warning/20 text-warning-foreground border-warning ring-1 ring-warning/40 shadow-xs"
                    : isDelayed
                      ? "bg-destructive/20 text-destructive border-destructive ring-1 ring-destructive/40 shadow-xs"
                      : "bg-card/95 text-muted-foreground border-border",
              )}
            >
              {description}
            </div>
          </EdgeLabelRenderer>
        )}
      </>
    );
  },
);

RelationshipCustomEdge.displayName = "RelationshipCustomEdge";
</file>

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Building2, Save, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,

} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

} from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { Business, CurrencyCode } from "@/types";

interface BusinessProfileSectionProps {
  business: Business;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Business>) => Promise<void>;
  isSaving: boolean;
}

export function BusinessProfileSection({
  business,
  onSave,
  isSaving,
}: BusinessProfileSectionProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(business.name ?? "");
  const [ownerName, setOwnerName] = useState(business.ownerName ?? "");
  const [ownerEmail, setOwnerEmail] = useState(business.ownerEmail ?? "");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(business.phone ?? "");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState(business.address ?? "");
  const [industry, setIndustry] = useState(business.industry ?? "");
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState<CurrencyCode>(business.currency ?? "INR");
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    setName(business.name ?? "");
    setOwnerName(business.ownerName ?? "");
    setOwnerEmail(business.ownerEmail ?? "");
    setPhone(business.phone ?? "");
    setAddress(business.address ?? "");
    setIndustry(business.industry ?? "");
    setCurrency(business.currency ?? "INR");
    setErrors({});
  }, [business]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setName(business.name ?? "");
    setOwnerName(business.ownerName ?? "");
    setOwnerEmail(business.ownerEmail ?? "");
    setPhone(business.phone ?? "");
    setAddress(business.address ?? "");
    setIndustry(business.industry ?? "");
    setCurrency(business.currency ?? "INR");
    setErrors({});
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};

    if (!name.trim()) {
      newErrors["name"] = "Business name is required";
    }
    if (ownerEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(ownerEmail)) {
      newErrors["ownerEmail"] = "Invalid email format";
    }

    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});

    await onSave({
      name: name.trim(),
      ownerName: ownerName.trim(),
      ownerEmail: ownerEmail.trim(),
      phone: phone.trim(),
      address: address.trim(),
      industry: industry.trim(),
      currency,
    });
  };

  const hasChanges =
    name !== (business.name ?? "") ||
    ownerName !== (business.ownerName ?? "") ||
    ownerEmail !== (business.ownerEmail ?? "") ||
    phone !== (business.phone ?? "") ||
    address !== (business.address ?? "") ||
    industry !== (business.industry ?? "") ||
    currency !== (business.currency ?? "INR");

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Building2 className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">Business Profile</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Company registration details, primary point of contact, and default operating
                currency.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-name">Business Name *</Label>
              <Input
                id="biz-name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Rupi Clothing"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["name"] ? <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["name"]}</p> : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-owner">Owner / Contact Name</Label>
              <Input
                id="biz-owner"
                value={ownerName}
                onChange={(e) => setOwnerName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Demo Owner"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-email">Email Address</Label>
              <Input
                id="biz-email"
                type="email"
                value={ownerEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setOwnerEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. owner@rupiclothing.in"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["ownerEmail"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["ownerEmail"]}</p>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-phone">Phone Number</Label>
              <Input
                id="biz-phone"
                value={phone}
                onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. +91 98200 54321"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-industry">Industry</Label>
              <Input
                id="biz-industry"
                value={industry}
                onChange={(e) => setIndustry(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Apparel retail"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="biz-currency">Operating Currency</Label>
              <Select
                value={currency}
                onValueChange={(val) => setCurrency(val as CurrencyCode)}
                disabled={isSaving}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="biz-currency" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select currency" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="INR">INR (₹ - Indian Rupee)</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="USD">USD ($ - US Dollar)</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="EUR">EUR (€ - Euro)</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="biz-address">Business Address</Label>
            <Input
              id="biz-address"
              value={address}
              onChange={(e) => setAddress(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Shop 14, Linking Road, Bandra West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400050"
              disabled={isSaving}
            />
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex items-center justify-between border-t px-6 py-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {hasChanges ? "Unsaved changes" : "All changes up to date"}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleReset}
              disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}
            >
              <Undo2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}>
              <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Profile"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/settings/financial-preferences-section.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Coins, Save, Undo2, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { Business } from "@/types";

interface FinancialPreferencesSectionProps {
  business: Business;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Business>) => Promise<void>;
  isSaving: boolean;
}

export function FinancialPreferencesSection({
  business,
  onSave,
  isSaving,
}: FinancialPreferencesSectionProps) {
  // Financial amounts are in rupees in the form for user-friendliness, converted to paise on submit
  const [openingCashRupees, setOpeningCashRupees] = useState<string>(
    String((business.openingCashPaise ?? 0) / 100),
  );
  const [safetyThresholdRupees, setSafetyThresholdRupees] = useState<string>(
    String((business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000) / 100),
  );
  const [supplierTermsDays, setSupplierTermsDays] = useState<string>(
    String(business.defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays ?? 30),
  );
  const [customerTermsDays, setCustomerTermsDays] = useState<string>(
    String(business.defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays ?? 15),
  );
  const [forecastHorizon, setForecastHorizon] = useState<"7" | "14" | "30">(
    String(business.defaultForecastHorizonDays ?? 30) as "7" | "14" | "30",
  );
  const [taxRatePercent, setTaxRatePercent] = useState<string>(
    String(business.taxRatePercent ?? 18),
  );
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    setOpeningCashRupees(String((business.openingCashPaise ?? 0) / 100));
    setSafetyThresholdRupees(String((business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000) / 100));
    setSupplierTermsDays(String(business.defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays ?? 30));
    setCustomerTermsDays(String(business.defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays ?? 15));
    setForecastHorizon(String(business.defaultForecastHorizonDays ?? 30) as "7" | "14" | "30");
    setTaxRatePercent(String(business.taxRatePercent ?? 18));
    setErrors({});
  }, [business]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    setOpeningCashRupees(String((business.openingCashPaise ?? 0) / 100));
    setSafetyThresholdRupees(String((business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000) / 100));
    setSupplierTermsDays(String(business.defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays ?? 30));
    setCustomerTermsDays(String(business.defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays ?? 15));
    setForecastHorizon(String(business.defaultForecastHorizonDays ?? 30) as "7" | "14" | "30");
    setTaxRatePercent(String(business.taxRatePercent ?? 18));
    setErrors({});
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const newErrors: Record<string, string> = {};

    const openingVal = Number(openingCashRupees);
    if (isNaN(openingVal) || openingVal < 0) {
      newErrors["openingCash"] = "Opening cash must be a non-negative number";
    }

    const safetyVal = Number(safetyThresholdRupees);
    if (isNaN(safetyVal) || safetyVal < 0) {
      newErrors["safetyThreshold"] = "Threshold must be a non-negative number";
    }

    const supplierDays = Number(supplierTermsDays);
    if (isNaN(supplierDays) || supplierDays < 0 || !Number.isInteger(supplierDays)) {
      newErrors["supplierTerms"] = "Supplier terms must be a non-negative integer";
    }

    const customerDays = Number(customerTermsDays);
    if (isNaN(customerDays) || customerDays < 0 || !Number.isInteger(customerDays)) {
      newErrors["customerTerms"] = "Customer terms must be a non-negative integer";
    }

    const taxVal = Number(taxRatePercent);
    if (isNaN(taxVal) || taxVal < 0 || taxVal > 100) {
      newErrors["taxRate"] = "Tax rate must be between 0% and 100%";
    }

    if (Object.keys(newErrors).length > 0) {
      setErrors(newErrors);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});

    await onSave({
      openingCashPaise: Math.round(openingVal * 100),
      safetyThresholdPaise: Math.round(safetyVal * 100),
      defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays: supplierDays,
      defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays: customerDays,
      defaultForecastHorizonDays: Number(forecastHorizon) as 7 | 14 | 30,
      taxRatePercent: taxVal,
    });
  };

  const hasChanges =
    openingCashRupees !== String((business.openingCashPaise ?? 0) / 100) ||
    safetyThresholdRupees !== String((business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000) / 100) ||
    supplierTermsDays !== String(business.defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays ?? 30) ||
    customerTermsDays !== String(business.defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays ?? 15) ||
    forecastHorizon !== String(business.defaultForecastHorizonDays ?? 30) ||
    taxRatePercent !== String(business.taxRatePercent ?? 18);

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground">
              <Coins className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">Financial Preferences</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Configure baseline cash reserves, payment terms, forecast horizon, and risk alert
                thresholds.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="opening-cash">Opening Cash Balance (₹)</Label>
              <Input
                id="opening-cash"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="1"
                value={openingCashRupees}
                onChange={(e) => setOpeningCashRupees(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="10000"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["openingCash"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["openingCash"]}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Starting cash for rolling ledger forecasts
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="safety-threshold">Low-Cash Alert Threshold (₹)</Label>
              <Input
                id="safety-threshold"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="1"
                value={safetyThresholdRupees}
                onChange={(e) => setSafetyThresholdRupees(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="5000"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["safetyThreshold"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["safetyThreshold"]}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Triggers liquidity warnings when balance dips below this
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="supplier-terms">Default Supplier Payment Terms (days)</Label>
              <Input
                id="supplier-terms"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="1"
                value={supplierTermsDays}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplierTermsDays(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="30"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["supplierTerms"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["supplierTerms"]}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Standard vendor credit period</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="customer-terms">Default Customer Payment Terms (days)</Label>
              <Input
                id="customer-terms"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="1"
                value={customerTermsDays}
                onChange={(e) => setCustomerTermsDays(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="15"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["customerTerms"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["customerTerms"]}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Net receivables collection expectation
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="forecast-horizon">Default Forecast Horizon</Label>
              <Select
                value={forecastHorizon}
                onValueChange={(val) => setForecastHorizon(val as "7" | "14" | "30")}
                disabled={isSaving}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="forecast-horizon" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select horizon" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="7">7 Days (Short-term operational cash)</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="14">14 Days (Bi-weekly cycle)</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="30">30 Days (Full monthly projection)</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Default window on the cash flow dashboard
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="tax-rate">Default Tax Rate (% GST)</Label>
              <Input
                id="tax-rate"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                step="0.5"
                value={taxRatePercent}
                onChange={(e) => setTaxRatePercent(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="18"
                disabled={isSaving}
              />
              {errors["taxRate"] ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-destructive">{errors["taxRate"]}</p>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Standard tax applied to new invoices & orders
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-md border border-muted bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
            <span>
              Changes to the low-cash threshold and default forecast horizon immediately update the
              cash flow projections, shortfall calculations, and active liquidity alerts across
              Ripple.
            </span>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex items-center justify-between border-t px-6 py-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {hasChanges ? "Unsaved changes" : "All changes up to date"}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleReset}
              disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}
            >
              <Undo2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}>
              <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Preferences"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}
