<file path="src/components/settings/notifications-section.tsx">
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  Bell,
  Save,
  Undo2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  FileWarning,
  Wallet,
  Truck,
  Network,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { NotificationPreferences } from "@/types";

interface NotificationsSectionProps {
  notifications: NotificationPreferences;
  onSave: (data: NotificationPreferences) => Promise<void>;
  isSaving: boolean;
}

interface NotificationItemConfig {
  key: keyof NotificationPreferences;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: typeof Bell;
}

const NOTIFICATION_ITEMS: NotificationItemConfig[] = [
  {
    key: "overduePayments",
    label: "Overdue Payments",
    description:
      "Alert when scheduled outgoing payments or vendor disbursements exceed payment terms.",
    icon: AlertTriangle,
  },
  {
    key: "upcomingSupplierPayments",
    label: "Upcoming Supplier Payments",
    description: "Reminders for vendor bills and purchase order balances due within 7 days.",
    icon: Clock,
  },
  {
    key: "overdueInvoices",
    label: "Overdue Customer Invoices",
    description: "Immediate notifications when customer receivable invoices pass their due date.",
    icon: FileWarning,
  },
  {
    key: "lowCash",
    label: "Low Cash & Shortfalls",
    description: "Warning when projected cash falls below your configured safety threshold.",
    icon: Wallet,
  },
  {
    key: "delayedDeliveries",
    label: "Delayed Deliveries & Stockout Risks",
    description:
      "Notifications when vendor shipments run late or inventory threatens customer fulfillment.",
    icon: Truck,
  },
  {
    key: "highRippleImpact",
    label: "High Ripple Impact Score",
    description:
      "Alert when a single change triggers cascading disruptions across downstream orders and cash.",
    icon: Network,
  },
];

export function NotificationsSection({
  notifications,
  onSave,
  isSaving,
}: NotificationsSectionProps) {
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState<NotificationPreferences>({ ...notifications });

  useEffect(() => {
    setPreferences({ ...notifications });
  }, [notifications]);

  const handleToggle = (key: keyof NotificationPreferences, checked: boolean) => {
    setPreferences((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: checked,
    }));
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setPreferences({ ...notifications });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await onSave(preferences);
  };

  const hasChanges = (Object.keys(preferences) as (keyof NotificationPreferences)[]).some(
    (k) => preferences[k] !== notifications[k],
  );

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Bell className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">Notifications & Risk Alerts</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Choose which events and operational risks surface banners and activity alerts across
                Ripple.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="divide-y">
          {NOTIFICATION_ITEMS.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            const isChecked = !!preferences[item.key];

            return (
              <div
                key={item.key}
                className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 py-4 first:pt-0 last:pb-0"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                    <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label
                      htmlFor={`notif-${item.key}`}
                      className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-foreground"
                    >
                      {item.label}
                    </Label>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.description}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Switch
                  id={`notif-${item.key}`}
                  checked={isChecked}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => handleToggle(item.key, checked)}
                  disabled={isSaving}
                  aria-label={item.label}
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex items-center justify-between border-t px-6 py-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {hasChanges ? "Unsaved notification changes" : "Notification settings current"}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleReset}
              disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}
            >
              <Undo2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}>
              <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save Notifications"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface ErrorStateProps {
  title?: string | undefined;
  message?: string | undefined;
  onRetry?: (() => void) | undefined;
}

export function ErrorState({
  title = "Something went wrong",
  message = "We couldn't load this data. Please try again.",
  onRetry,
}: ErrorStateProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 px-6 py-12 text-center">
      <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-destructive" aria-hidden />
      <h3 className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">{message}</p>
      {onRetry ? (
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-4" onClick={onRetry}>
          Try again
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/shared/feature-placeholder.tsx">
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

interface FeaturePlaceholderProps {

<file path="src/components/shared/payment-reliability-badge.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PaymentReliabilityCategory, PaymentReliabilityResult } from "@/types";
import { ShieldCheck, ShieldAlert, ShieldX, HelpCircle, Shield } from "lucide-react";

interface PaymentReliabilityBadgeProps {
  reliability?: PaymentReliabilityResult | undefined;
  score?: number | null | undefined;
  category?: PaymentReliabilityCategory | undefined;
  transactionCount?: number | undefined;
  showCount?: boolean | undefined;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | undefined;
  className?: string | undefined;
}

export function PaymentReliabilityBadge({
  reliability,
  score: propScore,
  category: propCategory,
  transactionCount: propCount,
  showCount = true,
  size = "md",
  className,
}: PaymentReliabilityBadgeProps) {
  const score = reliability?.score ?? propScore;
  const category: PaymentReliabilityCategory =
    reliability?.category ??
    propCategory ??
    (score !== null && score !== undefined ? "Fair" : "Insufficient payment history");
  const count = reliability?.transactionCount ?? propCount;

  // Visual tones
  let colorClass = "border-muted-foreground/30 bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground";
  let Icon = HelpCircle;

  switch (category) {
    case "Excellent":
      colorClass =
        "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300";
      Icon = ShieldCheck;
      break;
    case "Good":
      colorClass =
        "border-blue-500/30 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:text-blue-300";
      Icon = Shield;
      break;
    case "Fair":
      colorClass =
        "border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300";
      Icon = Shield;
      break;
    case "Poor":
      colorClass =
        "border-orange-500/30 bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-950/40 dark:text-orange-300";
      Icon = ShieldAlert;
      break;
    case "Very poor":
      colorClass =
        "border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300";
      Icon = ShieldX;
      break;
    case "Insufficient payment history":
    default:
      colorClass =
        "border-slate-300 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400";
      Icon = HelpCircle;
      break;
  }

  const isInsufficient =
    category === "Insufficient payment history" || score === null || score === undefined;

  return (
    <div className={cn("inline-flex items-center gap-1.5", className)}>
      <Badge
        variant="outline"
        className={cn(
          "font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5",
          colorClass,
          size === "sm" && "text-xs px-1.5 py-0",
          size === "lg" && "text-sm px-2.5 py-1",
        )}
      >
        <Icon
          className={cn(
            "h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0",
            size === "sm" && "h-3 w-3",
            size === "lg" && "h-4 w-4",
          )}
        />
        {isInsufficient ? (
          <span>Insufficient payment history</span>
        ) : (
          <span>
            {category} ({score}/100)
          </span>
        )}
      </Badge>
      {showCount && count !== undefined && count > 0 && (
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          ({count} {count === 1 ? "txn" : "txns"})
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Info } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { RiskSeverity } from "@/types";

const config: Record<RiskSeverity, { icon: typeof Info; classes: string; label: string }> = {
  critical: {
    icon: AlertCircle,
    classes: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
    label: "Critical",
  },
  warning: {
    icon: AlertTriangle,
    classes: "bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground",
    label: "Warning",
  },
  info: {
    icon: Info,
    classes: "bg-primary/10 text-primary",
    label: "Info",
  },
};

export function RiskIndicator({ severity }: { severity: RiskSeverity }) {
  const item = config[severity] ?? config.info;
  const { icon: Icon, classes, label } = item;
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium",
        classes,
      )}
    >
      <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

interface NodeInspectionDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  node: SimulatorTimelineNode | null;
  onTriggerAutoPhase?: () => void;
  onTriggerSplitEscrow?: () => void;
}

export function NodeInspectionDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  node,
  onTriggerAutoPhase,
  onTriggerSplitEscrow,
}: NodeInspectionDialogProps) {
  const [showCalculation, setShowCalculation] = useState(false);
  if (!node) return null;

  const fragility = node.fragility;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs font-mono">
              {node.dayLabel} · {node.date}
            </Badge>
            {fragility && (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={
                  fragility.isKeystone
                    ? "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20 font-semibold"
                    : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                }
              >
                {fragility.badgeText}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          <DialogTitle className="text-base font-semibold pt-1">{node.label}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-xs">
            Counterparty: {node.counterparty} · Amount: {formatMoney(node.amountPaise)}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4 py-2 text-xs">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{node.description}</p>

          {/* Fragility Multiplier Explanation */}
          {fragility && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-warning" />
                  Fragility Multiplier
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {fragility.multiplier}x Multiplier
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Plain Language Explanation */}
              <p className="text-xs text-foreground font-medium leading-snug">
                How much other business revenue is exposed if this customer pays late?
              </p>

              {/* Progressive Disclosure: View calculation */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowCalculation((v) => !v)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-primary hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>View calculation</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px]">{showCalculation ? "▲ Hide" : "▼ Expand"}</span>
                </button>

                <div
                  className={cn(
                    "mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-muted-foreground pt-1.5 border-t border-dashed",
                    !showCalculation && "hidden",
                  )}
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Tranche / Node Amount:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-foreground">
                      {formatMoney(fragility.invoiceAmountPaise)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span>Downstream Order Value at Risk:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-medium text-destructive">
                      {formatMoney(fragility.downstreamValueAtRiskPaise)}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {fragility.exposedOrders.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t">
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground mb-1">
                        Exposed Downstream Commitments:
                      </p>
                      <ul className="list-disc pl-4 space-y-0.5 text-muted-foreground">
                        {fragility.exposedOrders.map((order, idx) => (
                          <li key={idx}>{order}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Rescue triggers */}
          {(node.isEligibleForAutoPhase || node.isEligibleForSplitEscrow) && (
            <div className="space-y-2 pt-1 border-t">
              <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">Available Cash-Flow Rescues:</p>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">

                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={onTriggerAutoPhase}
                    className="w-full justify-start gap-2 border-primary/30 text-primary hover:bg-primary/5"
                  >
                    <Layers className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Auto-Phase Inventory (Split into 2 Batches)</span>
                  </Button>
                )}
                {node.isEligibleForSplitEscrow && onTriggerSplitEscrow && (
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={onTriggerSplitEscrow}
                    className="w-full justify-start gap-2 border-primary/30 text-primary hover:bg-primary/5"
                  >
                    <Lock className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow (Funded via Receivable)</span>
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {

import type { SupplierDetailData } from "@/types";

interface SupplierDetailHeaderProps {
  data: SupplierDetailData;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onArchiveToggle: () => void;

export function SupplierDetailHeader({ data, onEdit, onArchiveToggle }: SupplierDetailHeaderProps) {
  const { supplier, metrics } = data;
  const isArchived = supplier.status === "archived";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Breadcrumb / Back Link */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">

          <Link to="/suppliers">
            <ArrowLeft className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Back to Suppliers
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Header Row */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">{supplier.name}</h1>
            <StatusBadge status={supplier.status ?? "active"} />
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className={
                metrics.reliabilityScore >= 85
                  ? "border-success/30 bg-success/10 text-success"
                  : metrics.reliabilityScore >= 75
                    ? "border-warning/30 bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground"
                    : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
              }
            >
              {metrics.reliabilityScore}% Reliability
            </Badge>
            {metrics.riskLevel === "high" && (
              <Badge variant="destructive" className="gap-1">
                <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3" />
                At Risk
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {supplier.taxId && (
              <span>
                GSTIN: <strong className="font-medium text-foreground">{supplier.taxId}</strong>
              </span>
            )}
            <span>Net {supplier.paymentTermsDays} Days</span>
            {supplier.leadTimeDays && <span>{supplier.leadTimeDays}-day delivery lead</span>}
            {supplier.contactName && <span>Contact: {supplier.contactName}</span>}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild>
            <Link
              to="/relationships"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              search={{ selectedId: `node_${supplier.id}` }}
            >
              <Network className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              View Dependency
            </Link>
          </Button>

          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={onEdit}>
            <Edit2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Edit
          </Button>

          <Button variant={isArchived ? "default" : "outline"} size="sm" onClick={onArchiveToggle}>
            {isArchived ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Reactivate
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Archive className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Archive
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx">
import * as React from "react";
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority";
import { PanelLeft } from "lucide-react";

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state";
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7;
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem";
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem";
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem";
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b";

type SidebarContextProps = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed";
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openMobile: boolean;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
};

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContextProps | null>(null);

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.");
  }

  return context;
}

const SidebarProvider = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    open?: boolean;
    onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  }
>(
  (
    {
      defaultOpen = false,
      open: openProp,
      onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
      className,
      style,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const isMobile = useIsMobile();
    const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);

    // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
    // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
    const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
    const open = openProp ?? _open;
    const setOpen = React.useCallback(
      (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
        const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value;
        if (setOpenProp) {
          setOpenProp(openState);
        } else {
          _setOpen(openState);
        }

        // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
        document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`;
      },
      [setOpenProp, open],
    );

    // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
    const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
      return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open);
    }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile]);

    // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
    React.useEffect(() => {
      const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          toggleSidebar();
        }
      };

      window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
      return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    }, [toggleSidebar]);

    // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
    // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
    const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed";

    const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
      () => ({
        state,
        open,
        setOpen,
        isMobile,
        openMobile,
        setOpenMobile,
        toggleSidebar,
      }),
      [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar],
    );

    return (
      <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
        <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
          <div
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
                "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
                ...style,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            className={cn(
              "group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full has-[[data-variant=inset]]:bg-sidebar",
              className,
            )}
            ref={ref}
            {...props}
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </TooltipProvider>
      </SidebarContext.Provider>
    );
  },
);
SidebarProvider.displayName = "SidebarProvider";

const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    side?: "left" | "right";
    variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset";
    collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none";
  }
>(
  (
    {
      side = "left",
      variant = "sidebar",
      collapsible = "offcanvas",
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();

    if (collapsible === "none") {
      return (
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex h-full w-(--sidebar-width) flex-col bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground",
            className,
          )}
          ref={ref}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (isMobile) {
      return (
        <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
          <SheetContent
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            data-mobile="true"
            className="w-(--sidebar-width) bg-sidebar p-0 text-sidebar-foreground [&>button]:hidden"
            style={
              {
                "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
              } as React.CSSProperties
            }
            side={side}
          >
            <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
              <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className="group peer hidden text-sidebar-foreground md:block"
        data-state={state}
        data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-side={side}
      >
        {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
        <div
          className={cn(
            "relative w-(--sidebar-width) bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
            "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
            "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
              ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4))]"
              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)",
          )}
        />
        <div
          className={cn(
            "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-(--sidebar-width) transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear md:flex",
            side === "left"
              ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
              : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
            // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
            variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
              ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)_+_theme(spacing.4)_+2px)]"
              : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon) group-data-[side=left]:border-r group-data-[side=right]:border-l",
            className,
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          <div
            data-sidebar="sidebar"
            className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow"
          >
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  },
);
Sidebar.displayName = "Sidebar";

const SidebarTrigger = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Button>,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
>(({ className, onClick, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      data-sidebar="trigger"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className={cn("h-7 w-7", className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event);
        toggleSidebar();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeft />
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle Sidebar</span>
    </Button>
  );
});
SidebarTrigger.displayName = "SidebarTrigger";

const SidebarRail = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, React.ComponentProps<"button">>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();

    return (
      <button
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="rail"
        aria-label="Toggle Sidebar"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onClick={toggleSidebar}
        title="Toggle Sidebar"
        className={cn(
          "absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 -translate-x-1/2 transition-all ease-linear after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-[2px] hover:after:bg-sidebar-border group-data-[side=left]:-right-4 group-data-[side=right]:left-0 sm:flex",
          "[[data-side=left]_&]:cursor-w-resize [[data-side=right]_&]:cursor-e-resize",
          "[[data-side=left][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-e-resize [[data-side=right][data-state=collapsed]_&]:cursor-w-resize",
          "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:translate-x-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:after:left-full group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:hover:bg-sidebar",
          "[[data-side=left][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-right-2",
          "[[data-side=right][data-collapsible=offcanvas]_&]:-left-2",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
SidebarRail.displayName = "SidebarRail";

const SidebarInset = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.ComponentProps<"main">>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <main
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "relative flex w-full flex-1 flex-col bg-background",
          "md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:m-2 md:peer-data-[state=collapsed]:peer-data-[variant=inset]:ml-2 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:ml-0 md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:rounded-xl md:peer-data-[variant=inset]:shadow",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  },
);
SidebarInset.displayName = "SidebarInset";

const SidebarInput = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Input>,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Input>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
  return (
    <Input
      ref={ref}
      data-sidebar="input"

        "h-8 w-full bg-background shadow-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sidebar-ring",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}

SidebarInput.displayName = "SidebarInput";

const SidebarHeader = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, React.ComponentProps<"div">>(
  ({ className, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="header"
        className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2 p-2", className)}

const SidebarMenuButton = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
    asChild?: boolean;
    isActive?: boolean;
    tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>;
  } & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>
>(
  (
    {
      asChild = false,
      isActive = false,
      variant = "default",
      size = "default",
      tooltip,
      className,
      ...props
    },
    ref,
  ) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button";
    const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar();

    const button = (
      <Comp
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="menu-button"
        data-size={size}
        data-active={isActive}
        className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
        {...props}
      />
    );

    if (!tooltip) {
      return button;
    }

    if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
      tooltip = {
        children: tooltip,
      };
    }

    return (
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent
          side="right"
          align="center"
          hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
          {...tooltip}
        />
      </Tooltip>
    );
  },
);

<file path="src/lib/api/customerApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, nextId } from "@/mocks/store";
import { calculateCustomerPaymentReliability } from "@/lib/reliability";
import type {
  Customer,
  CreateCustomerInput,
  UpdateCustomerInput,
  EnrichedCustomer,
  CustomerSummaryMetrics,
  CustomerDetailData,
  ApiListResponse,
  ListParams,
} from "@/types";

export interface CustomerListFilterParams extends ListParams {
  status?: "all" | "active" | "archived" | undefined;
  overdueStatus?: "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy" | undefined;
  sortBy?: "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

export function enrichCustomer(c: Customer): EnrichedCustomer {
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // Customer Orders
  const orders = db.customerOrders.filter((co) => co.customerId === c.id);

  // Customer Invoices (receivable)
  const invoices = db.invoices.filter(
    (i) => i.customerId === c.id && (i.type === "receivable" || !i.type),
  );

  const openInvoices = invoices.filter(
    (i) => i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void" && i.status !== "cancelled",
  );

  // Overdue Invoices
  const overdueInvoices = openInvoices.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.status === "overdue" ||
      (i.dueDate < todayStr && Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise) > 0),
  );

  const overdueAmountPaise = overdueInvoices.reduce(
    (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
    0,
  );

  // Total invoiced and paid
  const totalInvoicedPaise = invoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountPaise, 0);
  const totalPaidPaise = invoices.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountPaidPaise, 0);

  // Outstanding calculation
  let calculatedOutstandingPaise = openInvoices.reduce(
    (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
    0,
  );
  if (calculatedOutstandingPaise === 0 && c.outstandingPaise > 0 && invoices.length === 0) {
    calculatedOutstandingPaise = c.outstandingPaise;
  }

  // Linked payments
  const payments = db.payments.filter(
    (p) => p.customerId === c.id || invoices.some((inv) => inv.id === p.invoiceId),
  );

  // Reliability rating
  const reliability = calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(c, invoices, payments);

  return {
    ...c,
    status: c.status ?? "active",
    calculatedOutstandingPaise,
    overdueInvoicesCount: overdueInvoices.length,
    overdueAmountPaise,
    totalInvoicedPaise,
    totalPaidPaise,
    orderCount: orders.length,
    invoiceCount: invoices.length,
    paymentCount: payments.length,
    reliability,
  };
}

export const customerApi = {
  async list(params: CustomerListFilterParams = {}): Promise<ApiListResponse<EnrichedCustomer>> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      let customers = db.customers.map(enrichCustomer);

      // Status filter
      if (params.status && params.status !== "all") {
        customers = customers.filter((c) => c.status === params.status);
      }

      // Overdue status filter
      if (params.overdueStatus === "has_overdue") {
        customers = customers.filter((c) => c.overdueAmountPaise > 0);
      } else if (params.overdueStatus === "healthy") {
        customers = customers.filter((c) => c.overdueAmountPaise === 0);
      }

      // Search filter
      if (params.search && params.search.trim() !== "") {
        const q = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        customers = customers.filter(
          (c) =>
            c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            c.contactName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            c.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            c.phone?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            c.taxId?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            c.address?.toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      }

      // Sorting
      const dir = params.sortDir === "desc" ? -1 : 1;
      if (params.sortBy === "name") {
        customers.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "outstanding") {
        customers.sort(
          (a, b) => (a.calculatedOutstandingPaise - b.calculatedOutstandingPaise) * dir,
        );
      } else if (params.sortBy === "reliability") {
        customers.sort((a, b) => {
          const scoreA = a.reliability.score ?? -1;
          const scoreB = b.reliability.score ?? -1;
          return (scoreA - scoreB) * dir;
        });
      }

      return {
        data: customers,
        total: customers.length,
        page: 1,
        pageSize: customers.length,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ApiListResponse<EnrichedCustomer>>("/api/customers", {
      query: {
        page: params.page,
        pageSize: params.pageSize,
        search: params.search,
        status: params.status,
      },
    });
  },

  async getSummaryMetrics(): Promise<CustomerSummaryMetrics> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const enriched = db.customers.map(enrichCustomer);

      const active = enriched.filter((c) => c.status === "active");
      const archived = enriched.filter((c) => c.status === "archived");

      const totalOutstandingPaise = enriched.reduce(
        (sum, c) => sum + c.calculatedOutstandingPaise,
        0,
      );
      const totalOverduePaise = enriched.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.overdueAmountPaise, 0);
      const overdueCustomersCount = enriched.filter((c) => c.overdueAmountPaise > 0).length;

      const scoredCustomers = enriched.filter((c) => c.reliability.score !== null);
      const averageReliabilityScore =
        scoredCustomers.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              scoredCustomers.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (c.reliability.score ?? 0), 0) /
                scoredCustomers.length,
            )
          : null;

      return {
        totalCustomers: enriched.length,
        activeCustomers: active.length,
        archivedCustomers: archived.length,
        totalOutstandingPaise,
        totalOverduePaise,
        overdueCustomersCount,
        averageReliabilityScore,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<CustomerSummaryMetrics>("/api/customers/summary");
  },

  async getById(id: string): Promise<Customer> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const found = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`Customer ${id} not found`);
      return found;
    }
    return httpRequest<Customer>(`/api/customers/${id}`);
  },

  async getDetails(id: string): Promise<CustomerDetailData> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const customer = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
      if (!customer) throw new Error(`Customer ${id} not found`);

      const enriched = enrichCustomer(customer);
      const orders = db.customerOrders.filter((co) => co.customerId === id);
      const invoices = db.invoices.filter((i) => i.customerId === id);
      const payments = db.payments.filter(
        (p) => p.customerId === id || invoices.some((inv) => inv.id === p.invoiceId),
      );

      const totalOrdersPaise = orders.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.totalPaise, 0);

      return {
        customer: {
          ...customer,
          status: customer.status ?? "active",
        },
        metrics: {
          totalOrdersPaise,
          totalInvoicedPaise: enriched.totalInvoicedPaise,
          totalPaidPaise: enriched.totalPaidPaise,
          outstandingPaise: enriched.calculatedOutstandingPaise,
          overdueBalancePaise: enriched.overdueAmountPaise,
          openInvoicesCount: invoices.filter(
            (i) => i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void" && i.status !== "cancelled",
          ).length,
          overdueInvoicesCount: enriched.overdueInvoicesCount,
          totalOrdersCount: orders.length,
          reliability: enriched.reliability,
        },
        orders,
        invoices,
        payments,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<CustomerDetailData>(`/api/customers/${id}/details`);
  },

  async create(input: CreateCustomerInput): Promise<Customer> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const name = input.name.trim();
      if (!name || name.length < 2) {
        throw new Error("Customer name must be at least 2 characters.");
      }

      const duplicate = db.customers.find(
        (c) => c.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase() && c.status !== "archived",
      );
      if (duplicate) {
        throw new Error(`An active customer named "${name}" already exists.`);
      }

      const customer: Customer = {
        id: nextId("cus"),
        businessId: db.business.id,
        name,
        contactName: input.contactName?.trim() || undefined,
        email: input.email?.trim() || undefined,
        phone: input.phone?.trim() || undefined,
        address: input.address?.trim() || undefined,
        taxId: input.taxId?.trim() || undefined,
        creditTermsDays: Math.max(0, input.creditTermsDays ?? 15),
        outstandingPaise: 0,
        status: input.status ?? "active",
        notes: input.notes?.trim() || undefined,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      };

      db.customers.push(customer);
      return customer;
    }

    return httpRequest<Customer>("/api/customers", { method: "POST", body: input });
  },

  async update(id: string, patch: UpdateCustomerInput): Promise<Customer> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const existing = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
      if (!existing) throw new Error(`Customer ${id} not found`);

      if (patch.name !== undefined) {
        const nameTrimmed = patch.name.trim();
        if (nameTrimmed.length < 2) {
          throw new Error("Customer name must be at least 2 characters.");
        }
        const duplicate = db.customers.find(
          (c) =>
            c.id !== id &&
            c.name.toLowerCase() === nameTrimmed.toLowerCase() &&
            c.status !== "archived",
        );
        if (duplicate) {
          throw new Error(`An active customer named "${nameTrimmed}" already exists.`);
        }
      }

      const updated: Customer = {
        ...existing,
        ...patch,
        id,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      };

      db.customers = db.customers.map((c) => (c.id === id ? updated : c));
      return updated;
    }

    return httpRequest<Customer>(`/api/customers/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: patch });
  },

  async archive(id: string): Promise<Customer> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const customer = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
      if (!customer) throw new Error(`Customer ${id} not found`);

      customer.status = "archived";
      customer.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return { ...customer };
    }
    return httpRequest<Customer>(`/api/customers/${id}/archive`, { method: "POST" });
  },

  async unarchive(id: string): Promise<Customer> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const customer = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === id);
      if (!customer) throw new Error(`Customer ${id} not found`);

      customer.status = "active";
      customer.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      return { ...customer };
    }
    return httpRequest<Customer>(`/api/customers/${id}/unarchive`, { method: "POST" });
  },

  async remove(id: string): Promise<void> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const hasOrders = db.customerOrders.some((co) => co.customerId === id);
      const hasInvoices = db.invoices.some((inv) => inv.customerId === id);
      const hasPayments = db.payments.some((p) => p.customerId === id);

      if (hasOrders || hasInvoices || hasPayments) {
        throw new Error(
          "Cannot permanently delete a customer with historical orders, invoices, or payments. Please archive the customer to preserve records.",
        );
      }

      db.customers = db.customers.filter((c) => c.id !== id);
      return;
    }
    return httpRequest<void>(`/api/customers/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
  },
};

<file path="src/lib/api/purchaseOrderApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, nextId } from "@/mocks/store";
import type {
  PurchaseOrder,
  PurchaseOrderLineItem,
  PurchaseOrderStatus,
  CreatePurchaseOrderInput,
  ApiListResponse,
  Supplier,
  Product,
  InventoryMovement,
  Payment,
  CashFlowEvent,
} from "@/types";

export interface EnrichedPurchaseOrder extends PurchaseOrder {
  supplier?: Supplier | undefined;
  lineItemsDetails?: (PurchaseOrderLineItem & { product?: Product | undefined })[] | undefined;
  orderedUnits: number;
  receivedUnits: number;
  outstandingPaise: number;
}

export interface PurchaseOrderListParams {
  supplierId?: string | undefined;
  status?: PurchaseOrderStatus | "all" | undefined;
  search?: string | undefined;
}

function enrichPurchaseOrder(po: PurchaseOrder): EnrichedPurchaseOrder {
  const supplier = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === po.supplierId);

  // Line items
  const lineItems = po.lineItems ?? [
    {
      id: nextId("poli"),
      purchaseOrderId: po.id,
      productId: po.productId ?? "",
      quantity: po.quantity ?? 0,
      unitPricePaise: Math.round(po.totalPaise / Math.max(1, po.quantity ?? 1)),
      totalPaise: po.totalPaise,
      receivedQuantity: po.receivedQuantity ?? 0,
    },
  ];

  const lineItemsDetails = lineItems.map((li) => {
    const product = db.products.find((p) => p.id === li.productId);
    return {
      ...li,
      product,
    };
  });

  const orderedUnits = lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + li.quantity, 0);
  const receivedUnits =
    po.receivedQuantity ?? lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + (li.receivedQuantity ?? 0), 0);
  const outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, po.totalPaise - po.advancePaidPaise);

  return {
    ...po,
    supplier,
    lineItemsDetails,
    orderedUnits,
    receivedUnits,
    outstandingPaise,
  };
}

export const purchaseOrderApi = {
  async list(
    params: PurchaseOrderListParams = {},
  ): Promise<ApiListResponse<EnrichedPurchaseOrder>> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      let pos = db.purchaseOrders.map(enrichPurchaseOrder);

      if (params.supplierId && params.supplierId !== "all") {
        pos = pos.filter((po) => po.supplierId === params.supplierId);
      }

      if (params.status && params.status !== "all") {
        pos = pos.filter((po) => po.status === params.status);
      }

      if (params.search && params.search.trim() !== "") {
        const q = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        pos = pos.filter(
          (po) =>
            po.poNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            po.supplier?.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            po.lineItemsDetails?.some((li) => li.product?.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
        );
      }

      pos.sort((a, b) => b.orderDate.localeCompare(a.orderDate));

      return {
        data: pos,
        total: pos.length,
        page: 1,
        pageSize: pos.length,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ApiListResponse<EnrichedPurchaseOrder>>("/api/purchase-orders", {
      query: {
        supplierId: params.supplierId,
        status: params.status,
        search: params.search,
      },
    });
  },

  async getById(id: string): Promise<EnrichedPurchaseOrder> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const po = db.purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === id || p.poNumber === id);
      if (!po) throw new Error(`Purchase order ${id} not found`);
      return enrichPurchaseOrder(po);
    }

    return httpRequest<EnrichedPurchaseOrder>(`/api/purchase-orders/${id}`);
  },

  async create(input: CreatePurchaseOrderInput): Promise<EnrichedPurchaseOrder> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      if (!input.supplierId) {
        throw new Error("Please select a supplier for this purchase order.");
      }
      if (!input.lineItems || input.lineItems.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("Purchase order must have at least one product line item.");
      }

      const supplier = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === input.supplierId);
      if (!supplier) throw new Error(`Supplier ${input.supplierId} not found`);

      const poId = nextId("po");
      const poCount = db.purchaseOrders.length + 1;
      const poNumber = `PO-2026-${String(poCount).padStart(3, "0")}`;

      const lineItems: PurchaseOrderLineItem[] = input.lineItems.map((item, idx) => ({
        id: `poli_${poId}_${idx + 1}`,
        purchaseOrderId: poId,
        productId: item.productId,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        unitPricePaise: item.unitPricePaise,
        totalPaise: item.quantity * item.unitPricePaise,
        receivedQuantity: 0,
      }));

      const totalPaise = lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + li.totalPaise, 0);
      const advancePaidPaise = Math.min(totalPaise, Math.max(0, input.advanceAmountPaise ?? 0));
      const paymentTermsDays = input.paymentTermsDays ?? supplier.paymentTermsDays ?? 30;

      // Delivery date
      const deliveryDate = new Date(input.expectedDeliveryDate);
      const paymentDueDateObj = new Date(deliveryDate);
      paymentDueDateObj.setDate(deliveryDate.getDate() + paymentTermsDays);
      const paymentDueDate = paymentDueDateObj.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      const status: PurchaseOrderStatus = advancePaidPaise > 0 ? "confirmed" : "sent";

      const primaryLineItem = lineItems[0];
      const purchaseOrder: PurchaseOrder = {
        id: poId,
        poNumber,
        supplierId: input.supplierId,
        productId: primaryLineItem?.productId,
        quantity: lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + li.quantity, 0),
        lineItems,
        totalPaise,
        advancePaidPaise,
        status,
        orderDate: input.orderDate,
        expectedDeliveryDate: input.expectedDeliveryDate,
        paymentTermsDays,
        paymentDueDate,
        notes: input.notes,
        receivedQuantity: 0,
      };

      db.purchaseOrders.push(purchaseOrder);

      // Financial Integration: Schedule advance payment if specified
      if (advancePaidPaise > 0) {
        const advPayment: Payment = {
          id: nextId("pay"),
          direction: "outgoing",
          purchaseOrderId: poId,
          amountPaise: advancePaidPaise,
          status: "scheduled",
          scheduledDate: input.orderDate,
          method: "Bank Transfer",
        };
        db.payments.push(advPayment);

        const advCfe: CashFlowEvent = {
          id: nextId("cfe"),
          type: "supplier_payment",
          label: `Advance payment for ${poNumber} (${supplier.name})`,
          counterpartyName: supplier.name,
          direction: "outgoing",
          amountPaise: advancePaidPaise,
          date: input.orderDate,
          relatedPurchaseOrderId: poId,
          isProjected: true,
          status: "scheduled",
        };
        db.cashFlowEvents.push(advCfe);
      }

      // Schedule balance payment on delivery
      const balancePaise = totalPaise - advancePaidPaise;
      if (balancePaise > 0) {
        const balPayment: Payment = {
          id: nextId("pay"),
          direction: "outgoing",
          purchaseOrderId: poId,
          amountPaise: balancePaise,
          status: "scheduled",
          scheduledDate: paymentDueDate,
          method: "Bank Transfer",
        };
        db.payments.push(balPayment);

        const balCfe: CashFlowEvent = {
          id: nextId("cfe"),
          type: "supplier_payment",
          label: `Balance payment for ${poNumber} (${supplier.name})`,
          counterpartyName: supplier.name,
          direction: "outgoing",
          amountPaise: balancePaise,
          date: paymentDueDate,
          relatedPurchaseOrderId: poId,
          isProjected: true,
          status: "scheduled",
        };
        db.cashFlowEvents.push(balCfe);
      }

      // Inventory Integration: Update quantityOnOrder for ordered products
      for (const li of lineItems) {
        let inv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === li.productId);
        if (!inv) {
          inv = {
            id: nextId("inv"),
            productId: li.productId,
            quantityOnHand: 0,
            quantityReserved: 0,
            quantityOnOrder: li.quantity,
            expectedRestockDate: input.expectedDeliveryDate,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          };
          db.inventory.push(inv);
        } else {
          inv.quantityOnOrder += li.quantity;
          if (!inv.expectedRestockDate || input.expectedDeliveryDate < inv.expectedRestockDate) {
            inv.expectedRestockDate = input.expectedDeliveryDate;
          }
          inv.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        }
      }

      return enrichPurchaseOrder(purchaseOrder);
    }

    return httpRequest<EnrichedPurchaseOrder>("/api/purchase-orders", {
      method: "POST",
      body: input,
    });
  },

  async updateStatus(id: string, status: PurchaseOrderStatus): Promise<PurchaseOrder> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const po = db.purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (!po) throw new Error(`Purchase order ${id} not found`);
      po.status = status;
      return po;
    }

    return httpRequest<PurchaseOrder>(`/api/purchase-orders/${id}/status`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: { status },
    });
  },

  async recordReceipt(
    poId: string,
    receipts: { productId: string; quantity: number }[],
    notes?: string,
  ): Promise<EnrichedPurchaseOrder> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const po = db.purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === poId);
      if (!po) throw new Error(`Purchase order ${poId} not found`);

      const receiptDate = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      let totalReceivedThisBatch = 0;

      for (const rec of receipts) {
        if (rec.quantity <= 0) continue;

        let inv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === rec.productId);
        if (!inv) {
          inv = {
            id: nextId("inv"),
            productId: rec.productId,
            quantityOnHand: rec.quantity,
            quantityReserved: 0,
            quantityOnOrder: 0,
            updatedAt: receiptDate,
          };
          db.inventory.push(inv);
        } else {
          inv.quantityOnHand += rec.quantity;
          inv.quantityOnOrder = Math.max(0, inv.quantityOnOrder - rec.quantity);
          inv.updatedAt = receiptDate;
        }

        // Update line item receivedQuantity
        const lineItem = po.lineItems?.find((li) => li.productId === rec.productId);
        if (lineItem) {
          lineItem.receivedQuantity = (lineItem.receivedQuantity ?? 0) + rec.quantity;
        }

        totalReceivedThisBatch += rec.quantity;

        // Record stock movement
        const movement: InventoryMovement = {
          id: nextId("mov"),
          businessId: db.business.id,
          productId: rec.productId,
          type: "receipt",
          quantity: rec.quantity,
          resultingBalance: inv.quantityOnHand,
          date: receiptDate,
          referenceType: "purchase_order",
          referenceId: po.poNumber ?? po.id,
          note: notes || `Receipt against ${po.poNumber ?? po.id}`,
          createdAt: receiptDate,
        };
        db.inventoryMovements.push(movement);
      }

      po.receivedQuantity = (po.receivedQuantity ?? 0) + totalReceivedThisBatch;
      const totalOrdered = po.quantity ?? po.lineItems?.reduce((s, li) => s + li.quantity, 0) ?? 0;
      if (po.receivedQuantity >= totalOrdered) {
        po.status = "received";
      } else {
        po.status = "partially_received";
      }

      return enrichPurchaseOrder(po);
    }

    return httpRequest<EnrichedPurchaseOrder>(`/api/purchase-orders/${poId}/receive`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: { receipts, notes },
    });
  },
};
</file>

  const atRiskCount = nodes.filter((n) => n.status === "at_risk" || n.status === "delayed").length;

    .filter((n) => n.status === "at_risk" || n.status === "delayed")
    .reduce((sum, n) => sum + (n.amountPaise ?? 0), 0);

  return {

    },

/**
 * Calculates causal ripple chain and business impact when an event changes or is delayed.
 */
export function calculateRippleImpact(
  nodeId: string,
  graph: RelationshipGraphData,
): RippleImpactPreview {
  const selected = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId);
  if (!selected) {
    return {
      selectedNodeId: nodeId,
      selectedLabel: "Unknown Event",
      primaryMilestone: "No downstream milestone found.",
      cashFlowRisk: { hasRisk: false },
      chain: [],
      businessImpactSummary: "Select a node in the graph to preview its ripple effect.",
    };
  }

  // BFS to build downstream chain
  const chain: RippleMilestone[] = [];
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const queue: { id: string; depth: number }[] = [{ id: nodeId, depth: 0 }];

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const current = queue.shift()!;
    if (visited.has(current.id)) continue;
    visited.add(current.id);

    const outgoing = graph.edges.filter((e) => e.source === current.id);
    for (const edge of outgoing) {
      if (!visited.has(edge.target)) {
        const targetNode = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === edge.target);
        if (targetNode) {
          queue.push({ id: targetNode.id, depth: current.depth + 1 });
          if (!chain.some((m) => m.nodeId === targetNode.id)) {
            chain.push({
              nodeId: targetNode.id,
              label: targetNode.label,
              type: targetNode.type,
              date: targetNode.date,
              daysFromSelected: (current.depth + 1) * 2, // approximated delta
              status: targetNode.status,
              amountPaise: targetNode.amountPaise,
              consequence: edge.description,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Specific causal summaries based on business logic
  let businessImpactSummary = "";
  const hasRisk = chain.some((m) => m.type === "cash_flow_risk") || selected.status === "at_risk";

  if (nodeId === "node_delivery_1") {
    businessImpactSummary =
      "If inventory delivery slips past Day 4: Cotton Kurti stock remains at 12 units (below 25 safety threshold), customer order #CO-1 cannot be fulfilled on Day 6, invoice INV-2001 is delayed, and the expected ₹8,000 receipt shifts past Day 21 — widening the Day 5 cash shortfall.";
  } else if (nodeId === "node_pay_3") {
    businessImpactSummary =
      "Executing this ₹30,000 balance payment on Day 4 creates an immediate ₹30,000 liquidity outflow that, paired with Day 5 rent, depletes reserves before customer collections arrive on Day 21.";
  } else if (nodeId === "node_inv_2001" || nodeId === "node_rec_2001") {
    businessImpactSummary =
      "This ₹8,000 inflow closes the operating cycle. Accelerating payment (e.g., offering a 2% early discount) from Day 21 to Day 10 helps offset Day 4–5 outflows.";
  } else if (nodeId === "node_inv_1999") {
    businessImpactSummary =
      "INV-1999 is already 5 days overdue from Style Mart. Every week of delay directly ties up ₹1,300 of working capital.";
  } else if (chain.length > 0) {
    businessImpactSummary = `A delay here ripples to ${chain.length} downstream business event${
      chain.length > 1 ? "s" : ""
    }, shifting projected execution dates and potentially deferring cash receipts.`;
  } else {
    businessImpactSummary =
      "This is a terminal node in the current operating cycle. It does not cascade further into other active events.";
  }

  return {
    selectedNodeId: nodeId,
    selectedLabel: selected.label,
    primaryMilestone: selected.metadata.nextMilestone || "Next operating milestone",
    cashFlowRisk: {
      hasRisk,
      description: selected.metadata.riskDescription,
      severity: selected.metadata.riskSeverity,
      shortfallPaise: hasRisk ? 3_000_000 : undefined,
    },
    chain,
    businessImpactSummary,
  };
}

export const relationshipsApi = {
  async getGraph(params: RelationshipFilterParams = {}): Promise<RelationshipGraphData> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(250);
      const graph = buildRelationshipGraph();

      let filteredNodes = graph.nodes;
      let filteredEdges = graph.edges;

      // Apply search filter
      if (params.search?.trim()) {
        const query = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        filteredNodes = filteredNodes.filter(
          (n) =>
            n.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            n.type.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            n.metadata.referenceNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            n.metadata.partnerName?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            n.metadata.productName?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            n.metadata.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(query),
        );
      }

      // Apply node type filter
      if (params.nodeTypes && params.nodeTypes.length > 0) {
        filteredNodes = filteredNodes.filter((n) => params.nodeTypes!.includes(n.type));
      }

      // Apply status filter
      if (params.statuses && params.statuses.length > 0) {
        filteredNodes = filteredNodes.filter((n) => params.statuses!.includes(n.status));
      }

      // Apply partner filter
      if (params.partnerId) {
        filteredNodes = filteredNodes.filter(
          (n) =>
            n.entityId === params.partnerId ||
            n.metadata.partnerName?.toLowerCase().includes(params.partnerId!.toLowerCase()),
        );
      }

      // Apply risk only filter
      if (params.riskOnly) {
        filteredNodes = filteredNodes.filter(
          (n) => n.status === "at_risk" || n.status === "delayed" || n.type === "cash_flow_risk",
        );
      }

      // Retain only edges connecting retained nodes
      const nodeIds = new Set(filteredNodes.map((n) => n.id));
      filteredEdges = filteredEdges.filter((e) => nodeIds.has(e.source) && nodeIds.has(e.target));

      return {
        nodes: filteredNodes,
        edges: filteredEdges,
        summary: graph.summary,
        updatedAt: graph.updatedAt,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<RelationshipGraphData>("/api/v1/relationships", {
      query: {
        search: params.search,
        riskOnly: params.riskOnly ? "true" : undefined,
        partnerId: params.partnerId,
      },
    });
  },

  async getNodeDetails(id: string): Promise<RelationshipGraphNode | undefined> {
    const graph = await this.getGraph();
    return graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id);
  },

  async getRipplePreview(nodeId: string): Promise<RippleImpactPreview> {
    const graph = await this.getGraph();
    return calculateRippleImpact(nodeId, graph);
  },
};

<file path="src/lib/reliability.ts">
import { differenceInCalendarDays, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import type {
  Invoice,
  Payment,
  PaymentReliabilityCategory,
  PaymentReliabilityResult,
  Customer,
  Supplier,
} from "@/types";

export interface ReliabilityScoringOptions {
  /** Penalty points per day of lateness. Defaults to 2. */
  penaltyPerDay?: number;
  /** Maximum penalty points per obligation. Defaults to 60. */
  maxPenaltyPerObligation?: number;
  /** Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current ISO date. */
  asOfDate?: string;
}

export interface RatedObligation {
  invoiceId: string;
  invoiceNumber: string;
  totalAmountPaise: number;
  paidAmountPaise: number;
  dueDate: string;
  isFullyPaid: boolean;
  isOverdue: boolean;
  settlementDate?: string | undefined;
  weightedDaysLate: number;
  penalty: number;
}

export function getReliabilityCategory(score: number | null): PaymentReliabilityCategory {
  if (score === null || score === undefined || Number.isNaN(score)) {
    return "Insufficient payment history";
  }
  if (score >= 90) return "Excellent";
  if (score >= 75) return "Good";
  if (score >= 60) return "Fair";
  if (score >= 40) return "Poor";
  return "Very poor";
}

/**
 * Evaluates an individual payment obligation (receivable invoice).
 */
export function evaluateObligation(
  invoice: Invoice,
  invoicePayments: Payment[],
  options: ReliabilityScoringOptions = {},
): RatedObligation | null {
  // Ignore cancelled or void invoices
  if (invoice.status === "void" || invoice.status === "cancelled") {
    return null;
  }

  const penaltyPerDay = options.penaltyPerDay ?? 2;
  const maxPenalty = options.maxPenaltyPerObligation ?? 60;
  const asOfDateStr = options.asOfDate ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const asOfDate = parseISO(asOfDateStr);
  const dueDate = parseISO(invoice.dueDate);

  const completedPayments = invoicePayments.filter(
    (p) => p.status === "completed" || (p.completedDate && p.status !== "cancelled"),
  );

  const paidAmountPaise = Math.min(
    invoice.amountPaise,
    invoice.amountPaidPaise || completedPayments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.amountPaise || 0), 0),
  );
  const isFullyPaid = paidAmountPaise >= invoice.amountPaise;
  const isOverdue =
    !isFullyPaid &&
    (invoice.status === "overdue" || differenceInCalendarDays(asOfDate, dueDate) > 0);

  // If neither paid nor overdue (i.e. upcoming un-matured invoice with no payments yet),
  // this obligation does not qualify as historical transaction data yet.
  if (paidAmountPaise === 0 && !isOverdue) {
    return null;
  }

  // Calculate weighted lateness across all payments and remaining balance
  let weightedDaysSum = 0;
  let latestPaymentDate: string | undefined = undefined;

  // Track payments
  for (const pay of completedPayments) {
    const payDateStr = pay.completedDate || pay.scheduledDate;
    if (!payDateStr) continue;
    if (!latestPaymentDate || payDateStr > latestPaymentDate) {
      latestPaymentDate = payDateStr;
    }
    const payDate = parseISO(payDateStr);
    const daysLate = Math.max(0, differenceInCalendarDays(payDate, dueDate));
    weightedDaysSum += daysLate * (pay.amountPaise || 0);
  }

  // If there is an unpaid balance that is currently overdue
  const remainingPaise = Math.max(0, invoice.amountPaise - paidAmountPaise);
  if (remainingPaise > 0 && isOverdue) {
    const overdueDays = Math.max(0, differenceInCalendarDays(asOfDate, dueDate));
    weightedDaysSum += overdueDays * remainingPaise;
  }

  const totalAmount = Math.max(1, invoice.amountPaise);
  const weightedDaysLate = Math.round((weightedDaysSum / totalAmount) * 10) / 10;

  // Lateness penalty calculation:
  // Starts at lateness * penaltyPerDay, capped at maxPenalty (60)
  const penalty = Math.min(maxPenalty, Math.max(0, Math.round(weightedDaysLate * penaltyPerDay)));

  return {
    invoiceId: invoice.id,
    invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,
    totalAmountPaise: invoice.amountPaise,
    paidAmountPaise,
    dueDate: invoice.dueDate,
    isFullyPaid,
    isOverdue,
    settlementDate: isFullyPaid ? latestPaymentDate : undefined,
    weightedDaysLate,
    penalty,
  };
}

/**
 * Calculates the centralized 0-100 payment reliability rating for a set of obligations.
 */
export function calculatePaymentReliability(
  qualifyingInvoices: Invoice[],
  allPayments: Payment[],
  options: ReliabilityScoringOptions = {},
): PaymentReliabilityResult & { obligations: RatedObligation[] } {
  const obligations: RatedObligation[] = [];

  for (const inv of qualifyingInvoices) {
    const invPayments = allPayments.filter((p) => p.invoiceId === inv.id);
    const evaluated = evaluateObligation(inv, invPayments, options);
    if (evaluated) {
      obligations.push(evaluated);
    }
  }

  // Check for insufficient payment history
  if (obligations.length === 0) {
    return {
      score: null,
      category: "Insufficient payment history",
      transactionCount: 0,
      onTimeCount: 0,
      lateCount: 0,
      averageLatenessDays: 0,
      hasSufficientHistory: false,
      obligations: [],
      notes: "No qualifying settlement or overdue transaction history found.",
    };
  }

  let totalPenalty = 0;
  let totalLatenessDays = 0;
  let onTimeCount = 0;
  let lateCount = 0;

  for (const ob of obligations) {
    totalPenalty += ob.penalty;
    totalLatenessDays += ob.weightedDaysLate;
    if (ob.penalty === 0) {
      onTimeCount += 1;
    } else {
      lateCount += 1;
    }
  }

  const averagePenalty = totalPenalty / obligations.length;
  // Starting score is 100, deducting average penalty, clamped to 0–100
  const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(100 - averagePenalty)));
  const category = getReliabilityCategory(score);
  const averageLatenessDays = Math.round((totalLatenessDays / obligations.length) * 10) / 10;

  return {
    score,
    category,
    transactionCount: obligations.length,
    onTimeCount,
    lateCount,
    averageLatenessDays,
    hasSufficientHistory: true,
    obligations,
  };
}

/**
 * Computes customer payment reliability from customer receivable invoices.
 */
export function calculateCustomerPaymentReliability(
  customer: Customer,
  allInvoices: Invoice[],
  allPayments: Payment[],
  options: ReliabilityScoringOptions = {},
): PaymentReliabilityResult & { obligations: RatedObligation[] } {
  // Only customer receivable invoices where money is owed to Ripple
  const customerInvoices = allInvoices.filter(
    (i) => i.customerId === customer.id && (i.type === "receivable" || !i.type),
  );

  return calculatePaymentReliability(customerInvoices, allPayments, options);
}

/**
 * Computes supplier payment reliability.
 * Rule: Only rate qualifying amounts owed by suppliers to Ripple (receivables / refunds).
 * NEVER rate Ripple's outgoing payments!
 */
export function calculateSupplierPaymentReliability(
  supplier: Supplier,
  allInvoices: Invoice[],
  allPayments: Payment[],
  options: ReliabilityScoringOptions = {},
): PaymentReliabilityResult & { obligations: RatedObligation[] } {
  // Only qualifying amounts owed by suppliers to Ripple
  const supplierReceivableInvoices = allInvoices.filter(
    (i) => i.supplierId === supplier.id && i.type === "receivable",
  );

  return calculatePaymentReliability(supplierReceivableInvoices, allPayments, options);
}
</file>

<file path="src/lib/theme.ts">
/**
 * Theme & UI display helpers.
 * Handles applying light, dark, and system theme class to document.documentElement
 * and compact-table layout mode.
 */

export type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark" | "system";

export const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = "ripple_theme";

export function getStoredTheme(): ThemeMode {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "system";
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark" || stored === "system") {
      return stored;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage access restrictions
  }
  return "system";
}

export function applyTheme(theme: ThemeMode): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, theme);
  } catch {
    // Ignore localStorage access restrictions
  }

  const root = document.documentElement;
  const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  const isDark = theme === "dark" || (theme === "system" && prefersDark);

  if (isDark) {
    root.classList.add("dark");
  } else {
    root.classList.remove("dark");
  }
}

export function applyCompactTables(compact: boolean): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  if (compact) {
    root.classList.add("compact-tables");
  } else {
    root.classList.remove("compact-tables");
  }
}

function LoginPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email || !password) {
      toast.error("Please enter both email and password.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const session = await authApi.login(email, password);
      toast.success(`Welcome back, ${session.user.fullName}!`);
      navigate({ to: "/dashboard" });
    } catch (err) {
      const { message } = toApiError(err);
      if (isNetworkError(err)) {
        toast.error(
          `${message ?? "Could not reach the server."} You can also click "Switch to Offline Demo Mode" below.`,
          { duration: 6000 },
        );
      } else {
        toast.error(message || "Failed to sign in. Please verify your credentials.");
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDemoLogin = async () => {
    setEmail("owner@rupiclothing.in");
    setPassword("password123");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const session = await authApi.login("owner@rupiclothing.in", "password123");
      toast.success(`Signed in as ${session.user.fullName} (Rupi Clothing)`);
      navigate({ to: "/dashboard" });

      // If live backend is unreachable, gracefully fall back to local mock demo

        toast.info("Live backend unreachable — switching to Offline Demo Mode for Rupi Clothing.");
        setDataMode("mock");
        return;
      }
      toast.error(toApiError(err).message || "Demo login failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md space-y-8">
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
          <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary shadow-md shadow-primary/20">
            <Waves className="h-6 w-6 text-primary-foreground" aria-hidden />
          </div>
          <h1 className="mt-4 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground sm:text-3xl">
            Sign in to Ripple
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Small business cash-flow intelligence & coordination
          </p>
        </div>

        <Card className="border shadow-lg">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-1 pb-4">
            <CardTitle className="text-xl">Account Credentials</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Enter your email and password to access your business workspace
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>

          <CardContent>
            {/* Mode Switcher Banner */}
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-muted/40 p-2.5 text-xs">

                  <Database className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600" />

                <div>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                    {DATA_MODE === "api" ? "Live API Mode" : "Offline Demo Mode"}

                <RefreshCw className="mr-1 h-3 w-3" />

                  placeholder="name@company.com"

                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={loading}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
                </div>
                <Input
                  id="password"
                  type="password"
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  required
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                  disabled={loading}

          </CardFooter>
        </Card>
      </div>

<file path="src/routes/README.md">
# Routes

TanStack Start uses **file-based routing**. Every `.tsx` file in this directory
defines a route. Do **not** create `src/pages/`, `src/routes/_app/index.tsx`, or
`app/layout.tsx` — those are Next.js / Remix conventions. The only root layout
is `src/routes/__root.tsx`.

## Conventions

| File                     | URL                                                     |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `index.tsx`              | `/`                                                     |
| `about.tsx`              | `/about`                                                |
| `users/index.tsx`        | `/users`                                                |
| `users/$id.tsx`          | `/users/:id` (dynamic — bare `$`, no curly braces)      |
| `posts/{-$category}.tsx` | `/posts/:category?` (optional segment)                  |
| `files/$.tsx`            | `/files/*` (splat — read via `_splat` param, never `*`) |
| `_layout.tsx`            | layout route (renders children via `<Outlet />`)        |
| `__root.tsx`             | app shell — wraps every page; preserve `<Outlet />`     |

`routeTree.gen.ts` is auto-generated. Don't edit it by hand.
</file>
