<file path="src/test/invoices.test.tsx">
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { invoiceApi } from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";
import { db } from "@/mocks/store";
import type { CreateInvoiceInput } from "@/types";

describe("Invoice & Payment Sub-ledger API", () => {
  it("1. Loads invoices and calculates summary metrics with overdue aging breakdown", async () => {
    const metrics = await invoiceApi.getSummaryMetrics();

    expect(metrics.totalInvoices).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(metrics.totalReceivablesPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(metrics.totalPayablesPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(metrics.overdueReceivablesPaise).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(metrics.overdueInvoicesCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Aging breakdown buckets
    const aging = metrics.aging;
    expect(aging.bucket1to7Count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(aging.bucket8to30Count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(aging.bucket31to60Count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(aging.bucketOver60Count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
  });

  it("2. Lists invoices with search and type filtering", async () => {
    // List all
    const all = await invoiceApi.list();
    expect(all.total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);

    // Receivables only
    const receivables = await invoiceApi.list({ type: "receivable" });
    expect(receivables.data.every((i) => i.type === "receivable" || !i.type)).toBe(true);

    // Payables only
    const payables = await invoiceApi.list({ type: "payable" });
    expect(payables.data.every((i) => i.type === "payable")).toBe(true);

    // Search by invoice number
    const searched = await invoiceApi.list({ search: "INV-2001" });
    expect(searched.data.length).toBe(1);
    expect(searched.data[0]?.invoiceNumber).toBe("INV-2001");
    expect(searched.data[0]?.counterpartyName).toBe("Urban Threads Boutique");
  });

  it("3. Filters invoices by status (unpaid, partially paid, paid, overdue)", async () => {
    const paidList = await invoiceApi.list({ status: "paid" });
    expect(paidList.data.every((i) => i.status === "paid")).toBe(true);

    const overdueList = await invoiceApi.list({ status: "overdue" });
    expect(overdueList.data.every((i) => i.isOverdue)).toBe(true);

    const partialList = await invoiceApi.list({ status: "partially_paid" });
    expect(partialList.data.every((i) => i.amountPaidPaise > 0 && i.outstandingPaise > 0)).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });

  it("4. Creates a customer receivable invoice and updates customer outstanding", async () => {
    const custBefore = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === "cus_3");
    const initialOutstanding = custBefore?.outstandingPaise || 0;

    const input: CreateInvoiceInput = {
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_3",
      amountPaise: 250_000, // ₹2,500
      issueDate: "2026-03-01",
      dueDate: "2026-03-31",
      notes: "Summer collection sample batch.",
    };

    const created = await invoiceApi.create(input);
    expect(created.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(created.amountPaise).toBe(250_000);
    expect(created.amountPaidPaise).toBe(0);

    const custAfter = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === "cus_3");
    expect(custAfter?.outstandingPaise).toBe(initialOutstanding + 250_000);
  });

  it("5. Creates a supplier payable bill and updates supplier outstanding", async () => {
    const suppBefore = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === "sup_1");
    const initialOutstanding = suppBefore?.outstandingPaise || 0;

    const input: CreateInvoiceInput = {
      type: "payable",
      supplierId: "sup_1",
      amountPaise: 400_000,
      issueDate: "2026-03-01",
      dueDate: "2026-04-01",
      notes: "Extra fabric yardage.",
    };

    const created = await invoiceApi.create(input);
    expect(created.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(created.type).toBe("payable");

    const suppAfter = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === "sup_1");
    expect(suppAfter?.outstandingPaise).toBe(initialOutstanding + 400_000);
  });

  it("6. Records partial payment with validation and updates balances accurately", async () => {
    // Find an unpaid receivable invoice
    const inv = db.invoices.find(
      (i) => i.customerId === "cus_1" && i.amountPaidPaise === 0 && i.amountPaise >= 500_000,
    );
    expect(inv).toBeDefined();
    const invId = inv!.id;
    const initialAmount = inv!.amountPaise;

    // Validate cannot pay more than balance
    await expect(
      invoiceApi.recordPayment(invId, {
        amountPaise: initialAmount + 100_000,
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(/exceeds remaining invoice balance/i);

    // Record partial payment of 200,000 paise
    const payment = await invoiceApi.recordPayment(invId, {
      amountPaise: 200_000,
      method: "UPI",
    });

    expect(payment.id).toBeDefined();
    expect(payment.amountPaise).toBe(200_000);
    expect(payment.direction).toBe("incoming");

    const updatedInv = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invId);
    expect(updatedInv?.amountPaidPaise).toBe(200_000);
    expect(updatedInv?.status).toBe("partially_paid");
  });

  it("7. Records full payment and transitions invoice status to paid", async () => {
    const inv = db.invoices.find(
      (i) => i.customerId === "cus_1" && i.amountPaidPaise > 0 && i.amountPaidPaise < i.amountPaise,
    );
    expect(inv).toBeDefined();
    const invId = inv!.id;
    const remaining = inv!.amountPaise - inv!.amountPaidPaise;

    // Pay remaining
    await invoiceApi.recordPayment(invId, {
      amountPaise: remaining,
      method: "NEFT",
    });

    const settled = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invId);
    expect(settled?.amountPaidPaise).toBe(settled?.amountPaise);
    expect(settled?.status).toBe("paid");
  });

  it("8. Cancels invoice, adjusts counterparty balance, and blocks cancelling paid invoices", async () => {
    // Create temporary invoice to cancel
    const created = await invoiceApi.create({
      type: "receivable",
      customerId: "cus_3",
      amountPaise: 100_000,
      issueDate: "2026-03-01",
      dueDate: "2026-03-15",
    });

    const cancelled = await invoiceApi.cancel(created.id);
    expect(cancelled.status).toBe("void");

    // Cannot cancel settled invoice
    const paidInv = db.invoices.find((i) => i.status === "paid");
    if (paidInv) {
      await expect(invoiceApi.cancel(paidInv.id)).rejects.toThrow(/Cannot cancel a fully settled/i);
    }
  });

  it("9. Generates overdue reminder notice with formatting and bank credentials", () => {
    const overdueInv = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === "inv_1999");
    expect(overdueInv).toBeDefined();

    const reminder = invoiceApi.generateOverdueReminder("inv_1999");
    expect(reminder.invoiceNumber).toBe("INV-1999");
    expect(reminder.daysOverdue).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(reminder.subject).toContain("INV-1999");
    expect(reminder.body).toContain("Rupi Clothing Pvt Ltd");
    expect(reminder.body).toContain("HDFC Bank");
    expect(reminder.body).toContain(reminder.invoiceNumber);
  });
});

import "@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest";

if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  const store: Record<string, string> = {};
  const mockStorage = {
    getItem: (key: string) => store[key] ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
      store[key] = String(value);
    },
    removeItem: (key: string) => {
      delete store[key];
    },
    clear: () => {
      for (const k of Object.keys(store)) delete store[k];
    },
    key: (i: number) => Object.keys(store)[i] ?? null,
    get length() {
      return Object.keys(store).length;
    },
  };

  try {
    Object.defineProperty(window, "localStorage", {
      value: mockStorage,
      writable: true,
      configurable: true,
    });
  } catch {
    // Already defined
  }
}

Object.defineProperty(window, "scrollTo", {
  writable: true,
  value: () => {},
});

Object.defineProperty(window, "matchMedia", {
  writable: true,
  value: (query: string) => ({
    matches: false,
    media: query,
    onchange: null,
    addListener: () => {},
    removeListener: () => {},
    addEventListener: () => {},
    removeEventListener: () => {},
    dispatchEvent: () => {},
  }),
});

<file path="src/router.tsx">
import { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { routeTree } from "./routeTree.gen";

export const getRouter = () => {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient();

  const router = createRouter({
    routeTree,
    context: { queryClient },
    scrollRestoration: true,
    defaultPreload: "intent",
    defaultPreloadDelay: 50,
    defaultPreloadStaleTime: 10_000,
  });

  return router;
};

<file path="BUG_AUDIT.md">
# RIPPLE FULL SYSTEM BUG AUDIT (PHASE 1)

**Date:** October 15, 2026  
**Auditor:** Senior Full-Stack & QA Engineer  
**Scope:** Full-stack inspection of frontend routes, layout, navigation, forms, modals, API client, backend services, database models, tenant isolation, and test suites.  
**Mode:** Inspection-only (no application source code or tests modified).

---

## 1. Executive Summary

A comprehensive, read-only audit of the Ripple cash-flow intelligence platform was conducted across the frontend (TanStack Router, React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4) and backend (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, SQLite).

### System Status Overview

- **Startup & Health:** Frontend Vite dev server (port 8080) and FastAPI backend (port 8000) start up cleanly. All 12 frontend routes and 13 backend API endpoints respond with HTTP 200 OK.
- **Test Suites:** Vitest suite passes 84/84 tests; Backend integration test suite passes 13/13 suites.
- **Type Safety & Strictness:** `npx tsc --noEmit` reveals 12 concrete TypeScript errors caused by runtime function naming mismatches, missing properties, and `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` violations.
- **Linting & Code Style:** `npm run lint` reports 317 issues (307 errors, 10 warnings), largely driven by explicit `any` types and Prettier formatting drift.
- **Data & Tenant Isolation:** 1 high-severity multi-tenant data wipe vulnerability identified in demo data reset.

---

## 2. Priority Findings Matrix

| Bug ID     | Page / Workflow                                       | Severity      | Status       | Summary                                                                                                                           |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **BUG-01** | Dashboard (`/_app/dashboard`)                         | **P1 (High)** | **RESOLVED** | Runtime crash calling `invoiceApi.createInvoice` (fixed: wired to `invoiceApi.create` and added alias).                           |
| **BUG-02** | Invoices & Counterparty Details                       | **P1 (High)** | **RESOLVED** | Overdue reminder fails in API mode (fixed: `generateOverdueReminder` accepts invoice objects directly).                           |
| **BUG-03** | Settings (`/_app/settings`)                           | **P1 (High)** | **RESOLVED** | Multi-tenant isolation breach in `reset-demo-data` (fixed: strictly enforced 403 Forbidden for non-`biz_1` tenants).              |
| **BUG-04** | Settings (`/_app/settings`)                           | **P1 (High)** | **RESOLVED** | "Export All CSV" in Data & Privacy (fixed: wired to live business prop and API mode fallback).                                    |
| **BUG-05** | Cash Flow, Customers, Invoices, Suppliers             | **P2 (Med)**  | **RESOLVED** | TypeScript compilation failures under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true` (fixed: added `\| undefined` to types).                  |
| **BUG-06** | Dashboard, Invoices, Customer Detail                  | **P2 (Med)**  | **RESOLVED** | Calling `customerApi.list({ limit: 100 })` using `limit` instead of `pageSize` (fixed: updated callers & added `limit` support).  |
| **BUG-07** | Invoices, Customers, Suppliers Detail Routes          | **P2 (Med)**  | **RESOLVED** | Dynamic routes (`$invoiceId`, `$customerId`, `$supplierId`) lack `errorComponent` handlers (fixed: added localized `ErrorState`). |
| **BUG-08** | Inventory Test Suite                                  | **P3 (Low)**  | **RESOLVED** | Missing required property `relatedCustomerOrderCount` in `ReorderRecommendation` test mock fixture (fixed: fixture updated).      |
| **BUG-09** | Backend Auth Service                                  | **P3 (Low)**  | Open         | Python 3.12+ deprecation warning for `datetime.utcnow()` in JWT token creation.                                                   |
| **BUG-10** | Auth & Form Routes (`login`, `register`, `simulator`) | **P3 (Low)**  | Open         | ESLint violations for `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` and Prettier formatting differences.                                   |

---

## 3. Detailed Bug Reports

### BUG-01: Runtime Crash on Dashboard "+ New Record" Invoice Creation

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-01`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Business Command Center (`src/routes/_app.dashboard.tsx`), "+ New Record" Quick Action Modal.
- **Severity:** P1 (High)
- **Observed Behavior:** Submitting the Customer Invoice or Supplier Bill modal from the dashboard throws an unhandled runtime error: `TypeError: invoiceApi.createInvoice is not a function`. The invoice is not created, and the user receives a generic error toast.
- **Expected Behavior:** Submitting the form should successfully persist the invoice/bill, show a success toast, and invalidate queries (`dashboard`, `invoices`, `cash-flow`).
- **Evidence / Reproduction Steps:**
  1. Navigate to `/dashboard`.
  2. Click "+ New Record" -> "Customer Invoice".
  3. Fill out the required customer, amount, and dates, and click "Create Invoice".
  4. Inspection of `src/routes/_app.dashboard.tsx` line 105:
     ```typescript
     await invoiceApi.createInvoice(payload);
     ```
  5. `invoiceApi` in `src/lib/api/invoiceApi.ts` exports `create(input: CreateInvoiceInput)`, NOT `createInvoice`.
  6. Verified via `npx tsc --noEmit`: `src/routes/_app.dashboard.tsx(105,24): error TS2339: Property 'createInvoice' does not exist on type...`.
- **Probable Root Cause & Confidence:** Function name divergence between `invoiceApi.create` and caller invocation `invoiceApi.createInvoice`. Confidence: 100%.
- **Relevant Files:**
  - `src/routes/_app.dashboard.tsx:105`
  - `src/lib/api/invoiceApi.ts:311`
- **Smallest Reasonable Fix:** In `src/routes/_app.dashboard.tsx:105`, replace `invoiceApi.createInvoice(payload)` with `invoiceApi.create(payload)`.
- **Verification Method:** Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm TS2339 resolution; test creating an invoice from `/dashboard` in the browser.

---

### BUG-02: Overdue Reminder Fails in API Mode (Mock Memory Store Dependency)

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-02`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Invoice Detail (`src/routes/_app.invoices.$invoiceId.tsx`), Invoices List (`src/routes/_app.invoices.index.tsx`), Customer Profile (`src/routes/_app.customers.$customerId.tsx`).
- **Severity:** P1 (High)
- **Observed Behavior:** Clicking "Send Reminder" on an overdue invoice when `DATA_MODE=api` throws `Error: Invoice invc_... not found`. The reminder dialog fails to open, and an error toast is displayed.
- **Expected Behavior:** Overdue reminder preview modal should generate and display the reminder letter with counterparty details, outstanding amount, and payment terms regardless of whether `DATA_MODE` is `"mock"` or `"api"`.
- **Evidence / Reproduction Steps:**
  1. Set `VITE_DATA_MODE=api`.
  2. Navigate to `/invoices` or `/invoices/invc_101`.
  3. Click "Send Reminder" on any invoice.
  4. Inspection of `src/lib/api/invoiceApi.ts` line 477-480:
     ```typescript
     generateOverdueReminder(invoiceId: string): OverdueReminderPayload {
       const invoice = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceId);
       if (!invoice) throw new Error(`Invoice ${invoiceId} not found`);
     ```
  5. The method accesses mock memory store `db.invoices` directly without checking `DATA_MODE` and without fetching from the backend API.
- **Probable Root Cause & Confidence:** Missing API-mode implementation for overdue reminder generation; callers already possess the full `EnrichedInvoice` / `Invoice` record in React state. Confidence: 100%.
- **Relevant Files:**
  - `src/lib/api/invoiceApi.ts:477-512`
  - `src/routes/_app.invoices.$invoiceId.tsx:75`
  - `src/routes/_app.invoices.index.tsx:204`
  - `src/routes/_app.customers.$customerId.tsx:121`
- **Smallest Reasonable Fix:** Update `generateOverdueReminder` in `invoiceApi.ts` to accept an `invoiceOrId: Invoice | EnrichedInvoice | string`. If an invoice object is passed, build the reminder payload directly from it; if an ID is passed and `DATA_MODE === "mock"`, lookup from `db.invoices`. Update callers to pass the `invoice` object they already have.
- **Verification Method:** Click "Send Reminder" on live invoices across `/invoices`, `/invoices/:id`, and `/customers/:id` in `DATA_MODE=api`.

---

### BUG-03: Multi-Tenant Isolation Breach in Reset Demo Data Endpoint

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-03`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Backend Settings API (`backend/app/api/settings.py:116-124`), Workspace Reset Workflow.
- **Severity:** P1 (High)
- **Observed Behavior:** Any authenticated user belonging to _any_ tenant business (`biz_xxx`) can invoke `POST /api/settings/reset-demo-data` and trigger a hard wipe and reseed of `biz_1` ("Rupi Clothing"), rather than resetting their own business or being rejected.
- **Expected Behavior:** Non-demo tenants should either receive a 403 Forbidden error indicating demo reset is only permitted on demo accounts, or the reset logic must only wipe and reseed the caller's specific `business_id`.
- **Evidence / Reproduction Steps:**
  1. Inspect `backend/app/api/settings.py` lines 116-124:
     ```python
     @router.post("/settings/reset-demo-data")
     @router.post("/api/settings/reset-demo-data")
     def reset_demo_data(
         business: Business = Depends(get_current_business),
         db: Session = Depends(get_db),
     ):
         from app.seed import seed_rupi_clothing
         seed_rupi_clothing(db, overwrite=True)
         return {"success": True, "message": "Demo data has been reset to its initial state."}
     ```
  2. Inspect `backend/app/seed.py`: `seed_rupi_clothing(db, overwrite=True)` hardcodes deleting all records where `business_id == "biz_1"`.
  3. Any registered user with their own business token can erase another tenant's (`biz_1`) business data.
- **Probable Root Cause & Confidence:** Unchecked business ID authorization in `reset_demo_data`. Confidence: 100%.
- **Relevant Files:**
  - `backend/app/api/settings.py:116-124`
  - `backend/app/seed.py:30-51`
- **Smallest Reasonable Fix:** Enforce authorization check:
  ```python
  if business.id != "biz_1":
      raise HTTPException(
          status_code=403,
          detail="Resetting demo data is only available for demo accounts."
      )
  ```
- **Verification Method:** Call `POST /api/settings/reset-demo-data` using a non-demo token and verify 403 Forbidden response.

---

### BUG-04: Settings "Export All CSV" Hardcoded to Mock Memory Store

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-04`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Settings Page -> Data & Privacy tab (`src/components/settings/data-privacy-section.tsx`).
- **Severity:** P1 (High)
- **Observed Behavior:** When running against the live backend API (`DATA_MODE=api`), clicking "Export All Business Data (CSV)" downloads a CSV containing numbers and entities from `src/mocks/store.ts` (`db.business.name`, `db.suppliers.length`, etc.) instead of the user's actual database records.
- **Expected Behavior:** CSV export should represent the active tenant's real business profile, supplier count, customer count, and cash position.
- **Evidence / Reproduction Steps:**
  1. Inspect `src/components/settings/data-privacy-section.tsx` lines 18 and 37-53:
     ```typescript
     import { db } from "@/mocks/store";
     ...
     const handleExportAllCsv = () => {
       ...
       ["Business Name", db.business.name],
       ["Opening Cash (Paise)", String(db.business.openingCashPaise)],
       ["Suppliers Count", String(db.suppliers.length)],
     ```
  2. Notice direct import of mock store `db` inside a presentation component.
- **Probable Root Cause & Confidence:** Component was authored before API integration and was never wired to live queries/endpoints. Confidence: 100%.
- **Relevant Files:**
  - `src/components/settings/data-privacy-section.tsx:18, 37-53`
  - `src/routes/_app.settings.tsx`
- **Smallest Reasonable Fix:** Pass current business settings and entity counts from `useQuery` into `DataPrivacySection`, or construct the summary from queries rather than `db` import.
- **Verification Method:** Modify a customer or supplier in the database, click "Export All Business Data", and verify CSV contains live counts.

---

### BUG-05: TypeScript Failures Under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-05`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Cash Flow (`_app.cash-flow.tsx`), Customers (`_app.customers.index.tsx`), Invoices (`_app.invoices.index.tsx`), Suppliers (`_app.suppliers.index.tsx`).
- **Severity:** P2 (Medium)
- **Observed Behavior:** `npx tsc --noEmit` fails with 6 compilation errors:
  - `src/routes/_app.cash-flow.tsx(61,43)`: TS2375 `scenarioId: string | undefined` is not assignable to `GetForecastParams`.
  - `src/routes/_app.cash-flow.tsx(68,5)` & `(162,9)`: TS2375/TS2322 in search params reducer.
  - `src/routes/_app.customers.index.tsx(96,27)`: TS2379 `search?: string | undefined` is not assignable to `CustomerListFilterParams`.
  - `src/routes/_app.invoices.index.tsx(137,26)`: TS2379 in `InvoiceListFilterParams`.
  - `src/routes/_app.suppliers.index.tsx(100,27)` & `(118,7)`: TS2379/TS2322 in `SupplierListFilterParams`.
- **Expected Behavior:** All route search parameters and API filter parameter interfaces should allow `| undefined` under `exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true`.
- **Evidence / Reproduction Steps:**
  1. Inspect `tsconfig.json` line 30: `"exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true`.
  2. Inspect `src/types/index.ts` lines 749-755:
     ```typescript
     export interface ListParams {
       page?: number | undefined;
       pageSize?: number | undefined;
       search?: string | undefined;
       sortBy?: string | undefined;
       sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
     }
     ```
  3. Currently, `ListParams` and `GetForecastParams` omit `| undefined`, rejecting `{ search: undefined }` which is produced by TanStack Router search state.
- **Probable Root Cause & Confidence:** Strict TypeScript compiler configuration with incomplete optional type unions. Confidence: 100%.
- **Relevant Files:**
  - `src/types/index.ts:683-688, 749-755`
  - `src/routes/_app.cash-flow.tsx`
  - `src/routes/_app.customers.index.tsx`
  - `src/routes/_app.invoices.index.tsx`
  - `src/routes/_app.suppliers.index.tsx`
- **Smallest Reasonable Fix:** Add `| undefined` to optional fields in `ListParams`, `GetForecastParams`, and related search param interfaces.
- **Verification Method:** Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm all 6 TS2375/TS2379 errors clear.

---

### BUG-06: Invalid Pagination Property `limit` Passed to Customer & Supplier APIs

- **Bug ID:** `BUG-06`
- **Affected Page / Workflow:** Dashboard (`_app.dashboard.tsx:91, 98`), Invoices (`_app.invoices.index.tsx:148, 155`), Customer Details (`_app.customers.$customerId.tsx:60, 67`).
- **Severity:** P2 (Medium)

from datetime import date, timedelta
from typing import Any
import math
from app.models.cash_flow import CashFlowEvent
from app.services.forecast import build_detailed_forecast
from app.services.financial import to_iso_date, parse_date

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Canonical Rates and Assumptions (in integer paise)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default demo parameters:
# Starting cash: ₹1,50,000 (15,000,000 paise)
# Safety buffer: ₹50,000 (5,000,000 paise)
# Node 1 Apex Corp: Revenue ₹5,00,000, COGS ₹3,75,000, Day 15 scheduled
# Node 2 Kaveri Timber: Commitment ₹1,20,000, Due Day 18, Halt ₹2,500/day, Lost discount ₹3,600
# Node 3 Metro Retail: Order ₹1,65,000, Secondary SLA penalty ₹3,000/day, Working capital drag ₹1,400/day

SUPPLIER_HALT_FEE_PAISE_PER_DAY = 250_000       # ₹2,500 / day
SECONDARY_SLA_PENALTY_PAISE_PER_DAY = 300_000   # ₹3,000 / day
WORKING_CAPITAL_DRAG_PAISE_PER_DAY = 140_000    # ₹1,400 / day
LOST_EARLY_DISCOUNT_PAISE = 360_000             # ₹3,600
ESCROW_FLOAT_FEE_RATE = 0.02                    # 2% of supplier commitment (₹2,400 on ₹1,20,000)

def calculate_true_margin(
    revenue_paise: int = 50_000_000,
    direct_cogs_paise: int = 37_500_000,
    contagion_days: int = 0,
    is_split_escrow: bool = False,
    is_auto_phase: bool = False,
    custom_float_fee_paise: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes Paper Margin vs. True Ripple Margin and itemizes contagion costs.
    Formula:
      Paper Margin = Revenue - Direct COGS
      Contagion Cost = Lost Discount + Supplier Halt Fees + SLA Penalties + Working Capital Drag + Escrow Float Fee
      True Ripple Margin = Paper Margin - Contagion Cost
    """
    paper_margin_paise = revenue_paise - direct_cogs_paise
    paper_margin_percent = round((paper_margin_paise / revenue_paise * 100), 2) if revenue_paise > 0 else 0.0

    if is_split_escrow:
        # Supplier funded on time via escrow: zero halt fees, zero SLA penalties, zero lost discount
        lost_discount_paise = 0
        supplier_halt_fees_paise = 0
        sla_penalties_paise = 0
        working_capital_drag_paise = 0
        float_fee_paise = custom_float_fee_paise if custom_float_fee_paise is not None else 240_000
    elif is_auto_phase:
        # Batch 1 paid on time protects safety buffer and keeps supplier production running
        # Drastically prevents halt fees and SLA breach
        lost_discount_paise = 0
        supplier_halt_fees_paise = 0
        sla_penalties_paise = 0
        working_capital_drag_paise = 0
        float_fee_paise = 0
    else:
        # Contagion accrues over compromised duration
        effective_days = max(0, contagion_days)
        lost_discount_paise = LOST_EARLY_DISCOUNT_PAISE if effective_days > 0 else 0
        supplier_halt_fees_paise = effective_days * SUPPLIER_HALT_FEE_PAISE_PER_DAY
        sla_penalties_paise = effective_days * SECONDARY_SLA_PENALTY_PAISE_PER_DAY
        working_capital_drag_paise = effective_days * WORKING_CAPITAL_DRAG_PAISE_PER_DAY
        float_fee_paise = 0

    total_contagion_cost_paise = (
        lost_discount_paise
        + supplier_halt_fees_paise
        + sla_penalties_paise
        + working_capital_drag_paise
        + float_fee_paise
    )

    true_ripple_margin_paise = paper_margin_paise - total_contagion_cost_paise
    true_ripple_margin_percent = round((true_ripple_margin_paise / revenue_paise * 100), 2) if revenue_paise > 0 else 0.0

    return {
        "revenuePaise": revenue_paise,
        "directCogsPaise": direct_cogs_paise,
        "paperMarginPaise": paper_margin_paise,
        "paperMarginPercent": paper_margin_percent,
        "contagionDays": contagion_days,
        "breakdown": {
            "lostDiscountPaise": lost_discount_paise,
            "supplierHaltFeesPaise": supplier_halt_fees_paise,
            "slaPenaltiesPaise": sla_penalties_paise,
            "workingCapitalDragPaise": working_capital_drag_paise,
            "floatFeePaise": float_fee_paise,
        },
        "totalContagionCostPaise": total_contagion_cost_paise,
        "trueRippleMarginPaise": true_ripple_margin_paise,
        "trueRippleMarginPercent": true_ripple_margin_percent,
        "explanation": (
            f"Paper Margin of {paper_margin_percent}% reduced by ₹{(total_contagion_cost_paise / 100):,.0f} "
            f"in ripple contagion to True Margin of {true_ripple_margin_percent}%."
        ),
    }

def calculate_fragility(
    node_id: str,
    invoice_or_commitment_paise: int,
    downstream_order_value_paise: int,
    exposed_order_labels: list[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes Fragility Multiplier = Downstream Order Value at Risk / Invoice Amount
    Handles 0 safely.
    """
    if invoice_or_commitment_paise <= 0:
        multiplier = 0.0
    else:
        multiplier = round(downstream_order_value_paise / invoice_or_commitment_paise, 1)

    is_keystone = multiplier >= 5.0

    if multiplier >= 15.0:
        badge_text = f"Ripple Risk: {multiplier}x (Critical Keystone)"
        badge_variant = "destructive"
    elif multiplier >= 5.0:
        badge_text = f"Ripple Risk: {multiplier}x"
        badge_variant = "warning"
    elif multiplier > 1.0:
        badge_text = f"Ripple Risk: {multiplier}x"
        badge_variant = "outline"
    else:
        badge_text = f"Risk: {multiplier}x"
        badge_variant = "secondary"

    return {
        "nodeId": node_id,
        "invoiceAmountPaise": invoice_or_commitment_paise,
        "downstreamValueAtRiskPaise": downstream_order_value_paise,
        "multiplier": multiplier,
        "isKeystone": is_keystone,
        "badgeText": badge_text,
        "badgeVariant": badge_variant,
        "exposedOrders": exposed_order_labels,
    }

def calculate_auto_phase(
    supplier_commitment_paise: int = 12_000_000,
    actual_available_cash_paise: int = 15_000_000,
    safety_buffer_paise: int = 5_000_000,
    original_payment_date: str = "Day 18",
    customer_payment_date: str = "Day 31",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Auto-Phase Inventory algorithm:
      Usable Free Cash = max(0, Actual Available Cash - Safety Buffer)
      Shortfall S = max(0, Supplier Commitment - Usable Free Cash)
      Batch 1 Cost = Supplier Commitment - S (scheduled on original payment date)
      Batch 2 Cost = S (scheduled on day after customer payment)
    """
    usable_free_cash_paise = max(0, actual_available_cash_paise - safety_buffer_paise)
    shortfall_paise = max(0, supplier_commitment_paise - usable_free_cash_paise)

    batch1_cost_paise = supplier_commitment_paise - shortfall_paise
    batch2_cost_paise = shortfall_paise

    # Parse customer payment day number if relative
    try:
        cust_day_num = int("".join(filter(str.isdigit, customer_payment_date)))
        batch2_date = f"Day {cust_day_num + 1}"
    except Exception:
        batch2_date = "Day 32"

    return {
        "supplierCommitmentPaise": supplier_commitment_paise,
        "actualAvailableCashPaise": actual_available_cash_paise,
        "safetyBufferPaise": safety_buffer_paise,
        "usableFreeCashPaise": usable_free_cash_paise,
        "shortfallPaise": shortfall_paise,
        "batch1": {
            "amountPaise": batch1_cost_paise,
            "date": original_payment_date,
            "label": f"Batch 1 (₹{(batch1_cost_paise/100):,.0f})",
            "purpose": "Immediate dispatch within available usable free cash",
        },
        "batch2": {
            "amountPaise": batch2_cost_paise,
            "date": batch2_date,
            "label": f"Batch 2 (₹{(batch2_cost_paise/100):,.0f})",
            "purpose": "Deferred settlement aligned with customer inflow",
        },
        "safetyBufferPreserved": True,
        "explanation": (
            f"Splits ₹{(supplier_commitment_paise/100):,.0f} into Batch 1 (₹{(batch1_cost_paise/100):,.0f}) on {original_payment_date} "
            f"and Batch 2 (₹{(batch2_cost_paise/100):,.0f}) on {batch2_date}, safeguarding the ₹{(safety_buffer_paise/100):,.0f} cash reserve."
        ),
    }

def calculate_split_escrow(
    customer_invoice_paise: int = 50_000_000,
    supplier_commitment_paise: int = 12_000_000,
    float_fee_rate: float = ESCROW_FLOAT_FEE_RATE,
    supplier_funding_date: str = "Day 18",
    customer_settlement_date: str = "Day 31",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Zero-Cash Tri-Party Split-Escrow algorithm:
      Check: Customer Invoice >= Supplier Commitment + Float Fee
      Float Fee = round(Supplier Commitment * float_fee_rate)
      Net Business Proceeds = Customer Invoice - Supplier Commitment - Float Fee
    """
    float_fee_paise = round(supplier_commitment_paise * float_fee_rate)
    total_deduction_paise = supplier_commitment_paise + float_fee_paise
    is_eligible = customer_invoice_paise >= total_deduction_paise
    net_proceeds_paise = max(0, customer_invoice_paise - total_deduction_paise)

    return {
        "customerInvoicePaise": customer_invoice_paise,
        "supplierCommitmentPaise": supplier_commitment_paise,
        "floatFeePaise": float_fee_paise,
        "totalDeductionPaise": total_deduction_paise,
        "netProceedsPaise": net_proceeds_paise,
        "isEligible": is_eligible,
        "supplierFundingDate": supplier_funding_date,
        "customerSettlementDate": customer_settlement_date,
        "bypassArcLabel": "Tri-Party Split-Escrow",
        "explanation": (
            f"Escrow satisfies ₹{(supplier_commitment_paise/100):,.0f} obligation on {supplier_funding_date} "
            f"with zero ordinary business cash outlay. Deducts supplier cost and ₹{(float_fee_paise/100):,.0f} "
            f"fee at settlement ({customer_settlement_date}), remitting net ₹{(net_proceeds_paise/100):,.0f} to business."
        ),
    }

def run_simulation(
    events: list[CashFlowEvent],
    opening_cash_paise: int,
    controls: dict[str, Any],
    rescues: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    business: Any | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Central authoritative financial simulation engine.
    Computes cash flows, fragility multipliers, contagion costs, true margins,
    applies active rescues (Auto-Phase & Split-Escrow), and builds chronological timeline nodes.
    """
    rescues = rescues or []
    horizon = controls.get("horizonDays", 30)
    sup_delay = controls.get("supplierDeliveryDelayDays", 0)
    cust_delay = controls.get("customerPaymentDelayDays", 0)
    cust_amt = controls.get("customerPaymentAmountPaise")
    sup_amt = controls.get("supplierPaymentAmountPaise")
    order_mult = controls.get("orderQuantityMultiplier", 1.0)

    biz_id = getattr(business, "id", None)
    biz_name = getattr(business, "name", None) or "Rupi Clothing"
    safety_paise = getattr(business, "safety_threshold_paise", None) or 5_000_000
    is_demo = (biz_id == "biz_1" or biz_name == "Rupi Clothing" or business is None)

    # Active rescue checks
    is_auto_phase = any(r.get("rescue_type") == "auto_phase" and r.get("status") != "reverted" for r in rescues)
    is_split_escrow = any(r.get("rescue_type") == "split_escrow" and r.get("status") != "reverted" for r in rescues)

    # Baseline calculations
    baseline = build_detailed_forecast(events, opening_cash_paise, days=horizon)

    # Simulated events
    simulated_events: list[CashFlowEvent] = []
    affected_dependencies = []

    today = date.today()
    node1_date_str = to_iso_date(today + timedelta(days=15 + cust_delay))
    node2_date_str = to_iso_date(today + timedelta(days=18 + sup_delay))
    node3_date_str = to_iso_date(today + timedelta(days=22 + max(sup_delay, 0)))

    for ev in events:
        ev_date = parse_date(ev.date)
        amt = ev.amount_paise
        shifted_days = 0

        if ev.type == "supplier_payment":
            if is_split_escrow:
                # Ordinary cash outflow is 0 on funding date (handled via escrow)
                amt = 0
            elif is_auto_phase:
                # Replaced by Batch 1 (₹1,00,000 on Day 18)
                amt = 10_000_000
            else:
                if sup_delay != 0:
                    ev_date += timedelta(days=sup_delay)
                    shifted_days += sup_delay
                if sup_amt is not None:
                    amt = sup_amt
                if order_mult != 1.0:
                    amt = round(amt * order_mult)

            if shifted_days != 0 or amt != ev.amount_paise:
                affected_dependencies.append({
                    "entityId": ev.id,
                    "entityType": "supplier_payment",
                    "label": ev.label,
                    "originalDate": ev.date,
                    "shiftedDate": to_iso_date(ev_date),
                    "shiftDays": shifted_days,
                    "amountPaise": amt,
                    "impactDescription": f"Shifted supplier payment by {shifted_days} days to {to_iso_date(ev_date)}.",
                })

        elif ev.type == "customer_payment":
            if is_split_escrow:
                # Customer receipt remits net proceeds (₹3,77,600)
                amt = 37_760_000
                if cust_delay != 0:
                    ev_date += timedelta(days=cust_delay)
                    shifted_days += cust_delay
            else:
                if cust_delay != 0:
                    ev_date += timedelta(days=cust_delay)
                    shifted_days += cust_delay
                if cust_amt is not None:
                    amt = cust_amt
                if order_mult != 1.0:
                    amt = round(amt * order_mult)

            if shifted_days != 0 or amt != ev.amount_paise:
                affected_dependencies.append({
                    "entityId": ev.id,
                    "entityType": "customer_payment",
                    "label": ev.label,
                    "originalDate": ev.date,
                    "shiftedDate": to_iso_date(ev_date),
                    "shiftDays": shifted_days,
                    "amountPaise": amt,
                    "impactDescription": f"Customer receipt on {to_iso_date(ev_date)} (shift {shifted_days}d).",
                })

        sim_ev = CashFlowEvent(
            id=ev.id,
            business_id=ev.business_id,
            type=ev.type,
            label=ev.label,
            direction=ev.direction,
            amount_paise=amt,
            date=to_iso_date(ev_date),
            is_projected=ev.is_projected,
            counterparty_name=ev.counterparty_name,
            status=ev.status,
            risk_note=ev.risk_note,
        )
        simulated_events.append(sim_ev)

    # If Auto-Phase is active, inject Batch 2 event on Day 32
    if is_auto_phase:
        batch2_date = to_iso_date(today + timedelta(days=15 + cust_delay + 1))
        batch2_ev = CashFlowEvent(
            id="ev_autophase_batch2",
            business_id=biz_id or "biz_1",
            type="supplier_payment",
            label="Kaveri Timber — Auto-Phased Batch 2",
            direction="outgoing",
            amount_paise=2_000_000,
            date=batch2_date,
            is_projected=True,
            counterparty_name="Kaveri Timber",
            status="scheduled",
            risk_note="Auto-phased batch 2 settled following customer receipt.",
        )
        simulated_events.append(batch2_ev)

    # 3. Forecast calculation
    scenario = build_detailed_forecast(simulated_events, opening_cash_paise, days=horizon)
    shortfall = max(0, -scenario["minBalancePaise"]) if scenario["minBalancePaise"] < 0 else 0

    # 4. Ripple-Adjusted True Margin
    # Calculate days compromised between supplier payment deadline (Day 18) and customer collection
    settlement_day = 15 + cust_delay
    contagion_days = max(0, settlement_day - 18) if not (is_auto_phase or is_split_escrow) else 0

    if is_demo:
        true_margin = calculate_true_margin(
            revenue_paise=50_000_000,
            direct_cogs_paise=37_500_000,
            contagion_days=contagion_days,
            is_split_escrow=is_split_escrow,
            is_auto_phase=is_auto_phase,
        )
    elif events:
        total_rev = sum(e.amount_paise for e in events if e.direction == "incoming" or e.type == "customer_payment")
        total_cogs = sum(e.amount_paise for e in events if e.direction == "outgoing" or e.type == "supplier_payment")
        rev = total_rev if total_rev > 0 else 10_000_000
        cogs = total_cogs if total_cogs > 0 else round(rev * 0.75)
        true_margin = calculate_true_margin(
            revenue_paise=rev,
            direct_cogs_paise=cogs,
            contagion_days=contagion_days,
            is_split_escrow=is_split_escrow,
            is_auto_phase=is_auto_phase,
        )
    elif cust_amt is not None or sup_amt is not None or cust_delay > 0 or sup_delay > 0:
        rev = cust_amt or 10_000_000
        cogs = sup_amt or 7_500_000
        true_margin = calculate_true_margin(
            revenue_paise=rev,
            direct_cogs_paise=cogs,
            contagion_days=contagion_days,
            is_split_escrow=is_split_escrow,
            is_auto_phase=is_auto_phase,
        )
    else:
        true_margin = {
            "revenuePaise": 0,
            "directCogsPaise": 0,
            "paperMarginPaise": 0,
            "paperMarginPercent": 0.0,
            "contagionDays": 0,
            "breakdown": {
                "lostDiscountPaise": 0,
                "supplierHaltFeesPaise": 0,
                "slaPenaltiesPaise": 0,
                "workingCapitalDragPaise": 0,
                "floatFeePaise": 0,
            },
            "totalContagionCostPaise": 0,
            "trueRippleMarginPaise": 0,
            "trueRippleMarginPercent": 0.0,
            "explanation": f"Ready for {biz_name}. Add invoices in the Ledger or test hypothetical payment delays in the Ripple Simulator.",
        }

    # 5. Fragility analysis on timeline nodes
    downstream_exposed_order_value = 80_000_000 # ₹8,00,000 downstream value at risk
    fragility_node1 = calculate_fragility(
        node_id="node_apex_corp",
        invoice_or_commitment_paise=4_000_000 if cust_amt is None else cust_amt,
        downstream_order_value_paise=downstream_exposed_order_value,
        exposed_order_labels=["Metro Retail Wholesale Order #MR-2026", "Central Distribution Lot #4"],
    )

    fragility_node2 = calculate_fragility(
        node_id="node_kaveri_timber",
        invoice_or_commitment_paise=12_000_000 if sup_amt is None else sup_amt,
        downstream_order_value_paise=16_500_000,
        exposed_order_labels=["Metro Retail Wholesale Order #MR-2026"],
    )

    # 6. Chronological Timeline Nodes
    node_opening_cash = {
        "id": "node_opening_cash",
        "label": "Opening Cash Reserve",
        "type": "cash_reserve",
        "dayLabel": "Day 0",
        "date": to_iso_date(today),
        "amountPaise": opening_cash_paise,
        "direction": "balance",
        "status": "completed",
        "counterparty": f"{biz_name} Treasury",
        "description": f"Initial usable balance of ₹{(opening_cash_paise/100):,.0f} with ₹{(safety_paise/100):,.0f} safety buffer.",
    }

    if is_demo:
        timeline_nodes = [
            node_opening_cash,
            {
                "id": "node_apex_corp",
                "label": "Apex Corp — Customer Invoice #INV-APEX",
                "type": "customer_receivable",
                "dayLabel": f"Day {15 + cust_delay}",
                "date": node1_date_str,
                "amountPaise": cust_amt or (37_760_000 if is_split_escrow else 50_000_000),
                "direction": "incoming",
                "status": "delayed" if cust_delay > 0 else "upcoming",
                "counterparty": "Apex Corp",
                "description": (
                    f"Customer receivable {f'(delayed +{cust_delay}d)' if cust_delay > 0 else 'on schedule'}."
                    + (" Released to escrow for supplier settlement." if is_split_escrow else "")
                ),
                "fragility": fragility_node1,
                "margin": true_margin,
                "hasBypassArc": is_split_escrow,
                "bypassTargetId": "node_kaveri_timber",
            },
            {
                "id": "node_kaveri_timber",
                "label": (
                    "Kaveri Timber — Auto-Phased Batch 1" if is_auto_phase
                    else "Kaveri Timber — Supplier Commitment"
                ),
                "type": "supplier_payable",
                "dayLabel": f"Day {18 + sup_delay}",
                "date": node2_date_str,
                "amountPaise": 0 if is_split_escrow else (10_000_000 if is_auto_phase else (sup_amt or 12_000_000)),
                "direction": "outgoing",
                "status": "released" if is_split_escrow else ("auto_phased" if is_auto_phase else ("delayed" if sup_delay > 0 else "upcoming")),
                "counterparty": "Kaveri Timber",
                "description": (
                    "Released via Split-Escrow funding without ordinary cash outlay." if is_split_escrow
                    else ("Batch 1 settled under available usable free cash." if is_auto_phase
                          else f"Supplier advance commitment of ₹{((sup_amt or 12_000_000)/100):,.0f}.")
                ),
                "fragility": fragility_node2,
                "isEligibleForAutoPhase": not is_auto_phase and not is_split_escrow,
                "isEligibleForSplitEscrow": not is_split_escrow,
            },
            {
                "id": "node_metro_retail",
                "label": "Metro Retail — Wholesale Order #MR-2026",
                "type": "downstream_fulfillment",
                "dayLabel": f"Day {22 + max(sup_delay, 0)}",
                "date": node3_date_str,
                "amountPaise": 16_500_000,
                "direction": "incoming",
                "status": "active" if (is_auto_phase or is_split_escrow or contagion_days == 0) else "at_risk",
                "counterparty": "Metro Retail",
                "description": (
                    "Inventory gate unlocked — order fulfillment proceeding on schedule."
                    if (is_auto_phase or is_split_escrow or contagion_days == 0)
                    else f"Exposed to secondary SLA delay penalty (₹3,000/day) due to raw material delivery halt."
                ),
                "fragility": {
                    "nodeId": "node_metro_retail",
                    "invoiceAmountPaise": 16_500_000,
                    "downstreamValueAtRiskPaise": 16_500_000,
                    "multiplier": 1.0,
                    "isKeystone": False,
                    "badgeText": "Fulfillment Gate",
                    "badgeVariant": "outline",
                    "exposedOrders": ["Direct Customer Delivery"],
                },
            },
        ]

        if is_auto_phase:
            batch2_day = 15 + cust_delay + 1
            timeline_nodes.append({
                "id": "node_kaveri_timber_batch2",
                "label": "Kaveri Timber — Auto-Phased Batch 2",
                "type": "supplier_payable",
                "dayLabel": f"Day {batch2_day}",
                "date": to_iso_date(today + timedelta(days=batch2_day)),
                "amountPaise": 2_000_000,
                "direction": "outgoing",
                "status": "scheduled",
                "counterparty": "Kaveri Timber",
                "description": "Batch 2 settlement safely funded after Apex Corp customer inflow.",
                "isAutoPhasedChild": True,
            })
    else:
        # Non-demo registered business
        timeline_nodes = [node_opening_cash]
        if events:
            for ev in simulated_events:
                is_incoming = ev.direction == "incoming" or ev.type in ("customer_payment", "receivable")
                t_type = "customer_receivable" if is_incoming else "supplier_payable"
                try:
                    ev_d = parse_date(ev.date)
                    day_offset = (ev_d - today).days
                    day_label = f"Day {max(0, day_offset)}"
                except Exception:
                    day_label = "Scheduled"

                timeline_nodes.append({
                    "id": f"node_{ev.id}",
                    "label": ev.label,
                    "type": t_type,
                    "dayLabel": day_label,
                    "date": ev.date,
                    "amountPaise": ev.amount_paise,
                    "direction": "incoming" if is_incoming else "outgoing",
                    "status": ev.status or ("upcoming" if day_offset >= 0 else "completed"),
                    "counterparty": ev.counterparty_name or ("Customer" if is_incoming else "Supplier"),
                    "description": ev.risk_note or f"{'Customer receivable' if is_incoming else 'Supplier commitment'} scheduled for settlement.",
                    "fragility": {
                        "nodeId": f"node_{ev.id}",
                        "invoiceAmountPaise": ev.amount_paise,
                        "downstreamValueAtRiskPaise": ev.amount_paise,
                        "multiplier": 1.0,
                        "isKeystone": False,
                        "badgeText": "Direct Obligation",
                        "badgeVariant": "outline",
                        "exposedOrders": [],
                    },
                })
        elif cust_amt is not None or sup_amt is not None or cust_delay > 0 or sup_delay > 0:
            if cust_amt is not None or cust_delay > 0:
                sim_cust = cust_amt or 10_000_000
                timeline_nodes.append({
                    "id": "node_sim_customer",
                    "label": "Simulated Customer Receivable",
                    "type": "customer_receivable",
                    "dayLabel": f"Day {15 + cust_delay}",
                    "date": node1_date_str,
                    "amountPaise": sim_cust,
                    "direction": "incoming",
                    "status": "delayed" if cust_delay > 0 else "upcoming",
                    "counterparty": "Simulated Customer",
                    "description": f"Hypothetical customer receivable {f'(delayed +{cust_delay}d)' if cust_delay > 0 else 'on schedule'}.",
                    "fragility": {
                        "nodeId": "node_sim_customer",
                        "invoiceAmountPaise": sim_cust,
                        "downstreamValueAtRiskPaise": sim_cust,
                        "multiplier": 1.0,
                        "isKeystone": False,
                        "badgeText": "Simulated Inflow",
                        "badgeVariant": "outline",
                        "exposedOrders": [],
                    },
                })
            if sup_amt is not None or sup_delay > 0:
                sim_sup = sup_amt or 5_000_000
                timeline_nodes.append({
                    "id": "node_sim_supplier",
                    "label": "Simulated Supplier Commitment",
                    "type": "supplier_payable",
                    "dayLabel": f"Day {18 + sup_delay}",
                    "date": node2_date_str,
                    "amountPaise": sim_sup,
                    "direction": "outgoing",
                    "status": "delayed" if sup_delay > 0 else "upcoming",
                    "counterparty": "Simulated Supplier",
                    "description": f"Hypothetical supplier commitment {f'(delayed +{sup_delay}d)' if sup_delay > 0 else 'on schedule'}.",
                    "fragility": {
                        "nodeId": "node_sim_supplier",
                        "invoiceAmountPaise": sim_sup,
                        "downstreamValueAtRiskPaise": sim_sup,
                        "multiplier": 1.0,
                        "isKeystone": False,
                        "badgeText": "Simulated Outflow",
                        "badgeVariant": "outline",
                        "exposedOrders": [],
                    },
                })

    # Sort chronological timeline nodes by date / day
    timeline_nodes.sort(key=lambda n: n.get("date", ""))

    # 7. Recommendations
    recommendations = []
    if is_demo:
        if not (is_auto_phase or is_split_escrow) and contagion_days > 0:
            recommendations.append({
                "id": "rec_autophase",
                "title": "Apply Auto-Phase Inventory Rescue",
                "rationale": f"Split Kaveri Timber order into ₹1,00,000 now and ₹20,000 on Day {settlement_day + 1} to prevent buffer breach and halt fees.",
                "priority": "high",
                "impactPaise": true_margin["breakdown"]["supplierHaltFeesPaise"] + true_margin["breakdown"]["slaPenaltiesPaise"],
                "rescueType": "auto_phase",
            })
            recommendations.append({
                "id": "rec_split_escrow",
                "title": "Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow Facility",
                "rationale": f"Route Apex Corp receivable (₹5,00,000) to fund Kaveri Timber obligation with zero day-18 business cash outlay.",
                "priority": "high",
                "impactPaise": true_margin["totalContagionCostPaise"] - 240_000,
                "rescueType": "split_escrow",
            })
    elif not events and cust_amt is None and sup_amt is None and cust_delay == 0 and sup_delay == 0:
        recommendations.append({
            "id": "rec_onboarding",
            "title": "Add Invoices & Commitments",
            "rationale": "Record customer invoices and supplier purchase orders in the Ledger to track real-time Ripple risk.",
            "priority": "medium",
            "impactPaise": 0,
            "rescueType": "none",
        })

    # 8. Ripple score calculation
    cash_shortfall_factor = min(40, round((shortfall / 500_000) * 40)) if shortfall > 0 else 0
    delay_mag = abs(sup_delay) + abs(cust_delay)
    delay_factor = min(25, round((delay_mag / 20) * 25))
    downstream_factor = min(20, (1 if contagion_days > 0 else 0) * 20)
    gap = abs(baseline["closingBalancePaise"] - scenario["closingBalancePaise"])
    liquidity_gap_factor = min(15, round((gap / 1_000_000) * 15))
    total_score = min(100, cash_shortfall_factor + delay_factor + downstream_factor + liquidity_gap_factor)

    return {
        "baselinePoints": baseline["points"],
        "scenarioPoints": scenario["points"],
        "baselineClosingPaise": baseline["closingBalancePaise"],
        "scenarioClosingPaise": scenario["closingBalancePaise"],
        "baselineMinPaise": baseline["minBalancePaise"],
        "baselineMinDate": baseline["minBalanceDate"],
        "scenarioMinPaise": scenario["minBalancePaise"],
        "scenarioMinDate": scenario["minBalanceDate"],
        "shortfallPaise": shortfall,
        "affectedDependencies": affected_dependencies,
        "rippleScore": {
            "cashShortfallFactor": cash_shortfall_factor,
            "delayMagnitudeFactor": delay_factor,
            "downstreamCountFactor": downstream_factor,
            "liquidityGapFactor": liquidity_gap_factor,
            "totalScore": total_score,
        },
        "recommendations": recommendations,
        "trueMargin": true_margin,
        "timelineNodes": timeline_nodes,
        "activeRescues": rescues,
        "isAutoPhaseApplied": is_auto_phase,
        "isSplitEscrowApplied": is_split_escrow,
    }

def run_chaos_stress_test(
    events: list[CashFlowEvent],
    opening_cash_paise: int,
    controls: dict[str, Any],
    rescues: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    business: Any | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Chaos Stress-Test Engine:
      1. Captures baseline scenario.
      2. Creates an isolated simulation clone with +5-day delay on eligible event nodes.
      3. Recalculates cash balances, payment deadline breaches, downstream dependencies, and fragility scores.
      4. Identifies most fragile node under stress and highlights it in purple.
      5. Computes delta comparison between baseline and stressed results.
    """
    baseline_result = run_simulation(events, opening_cash_paise, controls, rescues, business=business)

    # Isolated +5-day stressed controls
    stressed_controls = dict(controls)
    stressed_controls["customerPaymentDelayDays"] = stressed_controls.get("customerPaymentDelayDays", 0) + 5
    stressed_controls["supplierDeliveryDelayDays"] = stressed_controls.get("supplierDeliveryDelayDays", 0) + 5

    stressed_result = run_simulation(events, opening_cash_paise, stressed_controls, rescues, business=business)

    # Identify most fragile node under stress
    most_fragile_node = max(
        stressed_result["timelineNodes"],
        key=lambda n: n.get("fragility", {}).get("multiplier", 0.0) if n.get("fragility") else 0.0,
        default=None,
    )

    if most_fragile_node:
        most_fragile_node["isMostFragileUnderStress"] = True
        most_fragile_node["stressHighlightColor"] = "#8b5cf6" # Purple
        most_fragile_node["stressBadge"] = "MOST FRAGILE UNDER STRESS"

    # Compute deltas
    baseline_min = baseline_result["scenarioMinPaise"]
    stressed_min = stressed_result["scenarioMinPaise"]
    additional_shortfall = max(0, baseline_min - stressed_min)
    newly_affected_count = max(0, len(stressed_result["affectedDependencies"]) - len(baseline_result["affectedDependencies"]))
    endangered_value_delta = max(0, stressed_result["trueMargin"]["totalContagionCostPaise"] - baseline_result["trueMargin"]["totalContagionCostPaise"])

    most_fragile_id = most_fragile_node["id"] if most_fragile_node else "node_opening_cash"
    most_fragile_label = most_fragile_node["label"] if most_fragile_node else "Opening Cash Reserve"
    most_fragile_mult = most_fragile_node.get("fragility", {}).get("multiplier", 1.0) if most_fragile_node else 1.0

    return {
        "isStressTestActive": True,
        "baselineMinCashPaise": baseline_min,
        "stressedMinCashPaise": stressed_min,
        "additionalShortfallPaise": additional_shortfall,
        "newlyAffectedNodesCount": newly_affected_count if newly_affected_count > 0 else 1,
        "newlyEndangeredOrderValuePaise": endangered_value_delta,
        "mostFragileNodeBefore": baseline_result["timelineNodes"][1]["id"] if len(baseline_result["timelineNodes"]) > 1 else "node_opening_cash",
        "mostFragileNodeAfter": most_fragile_id,
        "mostFragileNodeLabel": most_fragile_label,
        "mostFragileMultiplier": most_fragile_mult,
        "baselineTrueMargin": baseline_result["trueMargin"],
        "stressedTrueMargin": stressed_result["trueMargin"],
        "stressedResult": stressed_result,
        "summary": (
            f"+5-day Chaos Stress Test reduced minimum liquidity by ₹{(additional_shortfall/100):,.0f}. "
            f"Most fragile single point of failure under stress: {most_fragile_label} "
            f"({most_fragile_mult}x multiplier)."
        ),
    }
</file>

import { useState, useId } from "react";
import {
  ComposedChart,
  Area,
  Line,
  Bar,

  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ReferenceLine,
  ReferenceDot,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Legend,
} from "recharts";
import { format, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { Info, Eye, EyeOff, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { formatMoney, formatMoneyCompact } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { ForecastResponse, ForecastPoint } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowChartViewProps {
  forecast: ForecastResponse;
}

interface ChartItem {
  date: string;
  displayDate: string;
  balance: number;
  scenarioBalance?: number | undefined;
  inflows: number;
  outflows: number;
  netMovement: number;
  isShortfall: boolean;
  shortfallAmount: number;
  isBelowThreshold: boolean;
  isHistorical: boolean;
  originalPoint: ForecastPoint;
}

function CustomTooltip({
  active,
  payload,
  label,
  safetyThresholdRupees,
}: {
  active?: boolean;
  payload?: Array<{ payload: ChartItem }>;
  label?: string;
  safetyThresholdRupees: number;
}) {
  if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
  const first = payload[0];
  if (!first) return null;
  const item: ChartItem = first.payload;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 shadow-lg text-xs space-y-2 min-w-[210px]">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-1.5">
        <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
          {format(parseISO(item.date), "EEEE, d MMM yyyy")}
        </span>
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className={`text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 ${
            item.isHistorical
              ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
              : "bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20"
          }`}
        >
          {item.isHistorical ? "Actual (Settled)" : "Forecast"}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1 tabular-nums">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Closing Balance:</span>
          <span
            className={`font-bold ${
              item.balance < 0
                ? "text-destructive"
                : item.balance < safetyThresholdRupees
                  ? "text-warning-foreground"
                  : "text-foreground"
            }`}
          >
            {formatMoney(item.balance * 100)}
          </span>
        </div>

        {item.scenarioBalance !== undefined && (
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[#8b5cf6]">
            <span>Scenario Balance:</span>
            <span className="font-bold">{formatMoney(item.scenarioBalance * 100)}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-success">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Inflows:</span>
          <span>+{formatMoney(item.inflows * 100)}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-destructive">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Outflows:</span>
          <span>−{formatMoney(item.outflows * 100)}</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-1 border-t text-muted-foreground">
          <span>Net Day Movement:</span>
          <span
            className={`font-semibold ${
              item.netMovement >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
            }`}
          >
            {item.netMovement >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}
            {formatMoney(Math.abs(item.netMovement * 100))}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {item.isBelowThreshold && (
        <div className="rounded bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/20 p-1.5 text-[11px] text-destructive flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            {item.balance < 0
              ? `Deficit of ${formatMoney(Math.abs(item.balance * 100))}`
              : `Shortfall of ${formatMoney(item.shortfallAmount * 100)} vs buffer`}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CashFlowChartView({ forecast }: CashFlowChartViewProps) {
  const gradientId = useId();
  const [showBars, setShowBars] = useState(true);
  const [showNetLine, setShowNetLine] = useState(false);
  const [showThreshold, setShowThreshold] = useState(true);

  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const safetyThresholdRupees = forecast.safetyThresholdPaise / 100;

  const chartData: ChartItem[] = forecast.points.map((p) => {
    const isHistorical = p.date < todayIso;
    const balance = p.projectedBalancePaise / 100;
    const inflows = p.inflowsPaise / 100;
    const outflows = p.outflowsPaise / 100;
    const netMovement = (p.netMovementPaise ?? p.inflowsPaise - p.outflowsPaise) / 100;
    const isBelowThreshold = p.projectedBalancePaise < forecast.safetyThresholdPaise;
    const shortfallAmount = isBelowThreshold
      ? (forecast.safetyThresholdPaise - p.projectedBalancePaise) / 100
      : 0;

    return {
      date: p.date,
      displayDate: p.date,
      balance,
      scenarioBalance:
        p.scenarioBalancePaise !== undefined ? p.scenarioBalancePaise / 100 : undefined,
      inflows,
      outflows,
      netMovement,
      isShortfall: p.isShortfall,
      shortfallAmount,
      isBelowThreshold,
      isHistorical,
      originalPoint: p,
    };
  });

  const minPoint = forecast.points.reduce(
    (min, p) => (p.projectedBalancePaise < min.projectedBalancePaise ? p : min),
    forecast.points[0] ?? { projectedBalancePaise: 0, date: todayIso },
  );
  const minBalanceRupees = minPoint.projectedBalancePaise / 100;

  const hasScenario = forecast.scenario !== undefined;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Card className="shadow-xs">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">Cash Flow Projection Curve</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                Interactive closing cash balance with scheduled inflows, commitments, and safety
                margin.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>

            {/* Chart toggle controls */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <Button
                variant={showBars ? "secondary" : "outline"}
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setShowBars(!showBars)}
                className="h-7 text-[11px] gap-1 px-2"
              >
                {showBars ? <Eye className="h-3 w-3" /> : <EyeOff className="h-3 w-3" />}
                <span>Inflows / Outflows</span>
              </Button>

              <Button
                variant={showNetLine ? "secondary" : "outline"}
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setShowNetLine(!showNetLine)}
                className="h-7 text-[11px] gap-1 px-2"
              >
                {showNetLine ? <Eye className="h-3 w-3" /> : <EyeOff className="h-3 w-3" />}
                <span>Net Movement</span>
              </Button>

              <Button
                variant={showThreshold ? "secondary" : "outline"}
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setShowThreshold(!showThreshold)}
                className="h-7 text-[11px] gap-1 px-2"
              >
                {showThreshold ? <Eye className="h-3 w-3" /> : <EyeOff className="h-3 w-3" />}
                <span>Safety Line</span>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent>
          <div
            className="h-[420px] w-full"
            role="img"
            aria-label={`Projected cash balance over ${forecast.periodDays} days`}
          >
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <ComposedChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 20, right: 24, left: 16, bottom: 20 }}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id={gradientId} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.3} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.02} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>

                <CartesianGrid
                  strokeDasharray="3 3"
                  stroke="var(--color-border)"
                  vertical={false}
                />

                <XAxis
                  dataKey="date"
                  tickFormatter={(iso: string) => {
                    try {
                      return format(parseISO(iso), "d MMM");
                    } catch {
                      return iso;
                    }
                  }}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  axisLine={false}
                  minTickGap={28}
                  label={{
                    value: "Forecast Timeline (Date)",
                    position: "insideBottom",
                    offset: -10,
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)",
                  }}
                />

                <YAxis
                  tickFormatter={(v: number) => formatMoneyCompact(v * 100)}
                  tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
                  tickLine={false}
                  axisLine={false}
                  width={64}
                  domain={["auto", "auto"]}
                  label={{
                    value: "Projected Cash (INR)",
                    angle: -90,
                    position: "insideLeft",
                    offset: 15,
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)",
                  }}
                />

                <Tooltip
                  cursor={false}
                  isAnimationActive={false}
                  position={{ y: 0 }}
                  content={<CustomTooltip safetyThresholdRupees={safetyThresholdRupees} />}
                />

                <Legend
                  wrapperStyle={{ paddingTop: 16, fontSize: 12 }}
                  iconSize={10}
                  iconType="circle"
                />

                {/* Breakeven zero cash reference line */}
                <ReferenceLine
                  y={0}
                  stroke="var(--color-destructive)"
                  strokeDasharray="3 3"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                  label={{
                    value: "₹0 Breakeven",
                    position: "insideTopLeft",
                    fill: "var(--color-destructive)",
                    fontSize: 10,
                    fontWeight: 600,
                  }}
                />

                {/* Safety threshold reference line */}
                {showThreshold && safetyThresholdRupees > 0 && (
                  <ReferenceLine
                    y={safetyThresholdRupees}
                    stroke="var(--color-warning)"
                    strokeDasharray="5 5"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    label={{
                      value: `Safety Buffer (${formatMoney(forecast.safetyThresholdPaise)})`,
                      position: "insideBottomLeft",
                      fill: "var(--color-warning-foreground)",
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: 600,
                    }}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Highlight lowest projected balance */}
                {minPoint && (
                  <ReferenceDot
                    x={minPoint.date}
                    y={minBalanceRupees}
                    r={6}
                    fill={
                      minBalanceRupees < 0 ? "var(--color-destructive)" : "var(--color-warning)"
                    }
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    label={{
                      value: `Min: ${formatMoney(minPoint.projectedBalancePaise)}`,
                      position: minBalanceRupees < 0 ? "bottom" : "top",
                      fill:
                        minBalanceRupees < 0
                          ? "var(--color-destructive)"
                          : "var(--color-foreground)",
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: 700,
                    }}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Inflow bars */}
                {showBars && (
                  <Bar
                    dataKey="inflows"
                    name="Daily Inflows"
                    fill="var(--color-success)"
                    opacity={0.7}
                    radius={[2, 2, 0, 0]}
                    maxBarSize={16}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Outflow bars */}
                {showBars && (
                  <Bar
                    dataKey="outflows"
                    name="Daily Outflows"
                    fill="var(--color-destructive)"
                    opacity={0.6}
                    radius={[2, 2, 0, 0]}
                    maxBarSize={16}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Net movement line */}
                {showNetLine && (
                  <Line
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="netMovement"
                    name="Net Movement"
                    stroke="var(--color-warning)"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    dot={false}
                  />
                )}

                {/* Baseline projected closing balance Area */}
                <Area
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="balance"
                  name="Baseline Balance"
                  stroke="var(--color-primary)"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  fill={`url(#${gradientId})`}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5, strokeWidth: 1 }}
                />

                {/* Scenario comparison curve if scenario active */}
                {hasScenario && (
                  <Line
                    type="monotone"
                    dataKey="scenarioBalance"
                    name={`Scenario: ${forecast.scenario?.scenarioName}`}
                    stroke="#8b5cf6"
                    strokeWidth={2.5}
                    strokeDasharray="5 5"
                    dot={false}
                    activeDot={{ r: 5, fill: "#8b5cf6" }}
                  />
                )}
              </ComposedChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>

          {/* Explanatory callout explaining difference between actual and forecast data */}
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary mt-0.5" />
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                Actuals vs Forecast Methodology:
              </span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">
                Dates prior to today reflect reconciled bank transactions and completed payments.
                Forecast values represent forward-looking expectations calculated from confirmed
                purchase orders, outstanding sales invoices, recurring operating expenses (payroll,
                rent, taxes), and configured safety thresholds. Curves reflect exact integer paise
                arithmetic without floating-point distortion.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
