<file path="src/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-timeline-view.tsx">
import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Calendar,
  Building2,
  FileText,
  Truck,
  FlaskConical,
  AlertTriangle,
  ExternalLink,
  Clock,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { formatMoney, formatDate, formatRelative } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { CashFlowEvent } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowTimelineViewProps {
  events: CashFlowEvent[];
  safetyThresholdPaise: number;
}

export function CashFlowTimelineView({ events, safetyThresholdPaise }: CashFlowTimelineViewProps) {
  const [filterMode, setFilterMode] = useState<"all" | "incoming" | "outgoing" | "risks">("all");

  const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // Filter events
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    let list = [...events];
    if (filterMode === "incoming") {
      list = list.filter((e) => e.direction === "incoming");
    } else if (filterMode === "outgoing") {
      list = list.filter((e) => e.direction === "outgoing");
    } else if (filterMode === "risks") {
      list = list.filter((e) => Boolean(e.riskNote) || e.status === "overdue");
    }
    return list.sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  }, [events, filterMode]);

  // Group events by date
  const groupedByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<string, CashFlowEvent[]> = {};
    for (const e of filteredEvents) {
      const bucket = groups[e.date] ?? (groups[e.date] = []);
      bucket.push(e);
    }
    return groups;
  }, [filteredEvents]);

  const dates = Object.keys(groupedByDate).sort();

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Controls Bar: Filter pills */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 shadow-xs sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mr-1">Filter events:</span>
          <div className="inline-flex rounded-md bg-muted p-0.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterMode("all")}
              className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                filterMode === "all"
                  ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-xs"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              All Events ({events.length})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterMode("incoming")}
              className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                filterMode === "incoming"
                  ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-xs"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              Incoming Only
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterMode("outgoing")}
              className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                filterMode === "outgoing"
                  ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-xs"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              Outgoing Only
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilterMode("risks")}
              className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                filterMode === "risks"
                  ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-xs"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              Risk Items Only
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Showing {filteredEvents.length} transactions across {dates.length} scheduled dates
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Stream */}
      {dates.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Calendar}
          title="No timeline events match the filter"
          description="Adjust your timeline filter to inspect all planned incoming and outgoing transactions."
          actionLabel="Show all events"
          onAction={() => setFilterMode("all")}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {dates.map((date) => {
            const dayEvents = groupedByDate[date] ?? [];
            const isToday = date === todayIso;
            const isPast = date < todayIso;

            const dayInflows = dayEvents
              .filter((e) => e.direction === "incoming")
              .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);
            const dayOutflows = dayEvents
              .filter((e) => e.direction === "outgoing")
              .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);
            const netFlow = dayInflows - dayOutflows;

            return (
              <div key={date} className="relative pl-6 sm:pl-8 border-l-2 border-border/80">
                {/* Node icon milestone */}
                <div
                  className={`absolute -left-[9px] top-1 h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 bg-card ${
                    isToday
                      ? "border-primary ring-4 ring-primary/20"
                      : isPast
                        ? "border-muted-foreground/40 bg-muted"
                        : "border-primary/60"
                  }`}
                />

                {/* Date Group Header */}
                <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                      {formatDate(date, "EEEE, d MMMM yyyy")}
                    </span>
                    {isToday ? (
                      <Badge className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5">
                        Today
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        ({formatRelative(date)})
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Day net badge */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Day Net:</span>
                    <span
                      className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${
                        netFlow >= 0 ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {netFlow >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}
                      {formatMoney(Math.abs(netFlow))}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Events Cards Grid */}
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {dayEvents.map((event) => (
                    <TimelineEventCard key={event.id} event={event} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function TimelineEventCard({ event }: { event: CashFlowEvent }) {
  const isIncoming = event.direction === "incoming";

  return (
    <Card
      className={`shadow-xs transition-shadow hover:shadow-sm ${
        isIncoming
          ? "border-success/30 bg-success/[0.02]"
          : "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/[0.02]"
      }`}
    >
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        {/* Header: Direction, Category, and Amount */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <span
              className={`flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${
                isIncoming ? "bg-success/10 text-success" : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
              }`}
            >
              {isIncoming ? (
                <ArrowDownLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              ) : (
                <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
              )}
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <span className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                {isIncoming ? "Cash Inflow" : "Cash Outflow"} · {event.type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
              </span>
              <span className="block font-semibold text-foreground text-sm truncate">
                {event.label}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            className={`text-right font-bold tabular-nums text-base shrink-0 ${
              isIncoming ? "text-success" : "text-destructive"
            }`}
          >
            {isIncoming ? "+" : "−"}
            {formatMoney(event.amountPaise)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Counterparty & Status */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t pt-2 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground truncate">
            <Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">
              {event.counterpartyName ?? (isIncoming ? "Customer" : "Supplier / Payee")}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            {event.status === "completed" ? (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="gap-1 border-success/30 bg-success/10 text-success text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                Actual (Paid)
              </Badge>
            ) : event.status === "overdue" ? (
              <Badge variant="destructive" className="gap-1 text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5">
                <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                Overdue
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="gap-1 border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 text-primary text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5"
              >
                <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                {event.isProjected ? "Projected" : "Scheduled"}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Risk Indicators & Simulator Link */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 text-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            {event.relatedInvoiceId && (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                asChild
                className="h-6 text-[10px] px-2 gap-1 text-primary border-primary/30"
              >
                <Link to="/invoices" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <FileText className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>{event.relatedInvoiceId.toUpperCase()}</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                </Link>
              </Button>
            )}

            {event.relatedPurchaseOrderId && (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                asChild
                className="h-6 text-[10px] px-2 gap-1 text-primary border-primary/30"
              >
                <Link to="/suppliers" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  <Truck className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>{event.relatedPurchaseOrderId.toUpperCase()}</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                </Link>
              </Button>
            )}

            {event.riskNote && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded bg-destructive/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-destructive">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                <span>{event.riskNote}</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Action: Simulate in Ripple Simulator */}
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            asChild
            className="h-6 text-[11px] px-2 font-medium text-primary hover:text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 gap-1 ml-auto"
          >
            <Link
              to="/simulator"
              target="_blank"
              rel="noreferrer"
              search={{
                eventId: event.id,
                eventName: event.label,
              }}
            >
              <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Simulate</span>
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

  statusFilter: "all" | "active" | "archived";
  onStatusFilterChange: (val: "all" | "active" | "archived") => void;
  overdueFilter: "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy";
  onOverdueFilterChange: (val: "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy") => void;
  sortBy: "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability";
  onSortByChange: (val: "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability") => void;

  onArchiveToggle: (customer: EnrichedCustomer) => void;

export function CustomerTable({
  customers,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  statusFilter,
  onStatusFilterChange,
  overdueFilter,
  onOverdueFilterChange,
  sortBy,
  onSortByChange,
  onEdit,
  onArchiveToggle,
}: CustomerTableProps) {
  const [localSearch, setLocalSearch] = React.useState(search);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setLocalSearch(search);
  }, [search]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      if (localSearch !== search) {
        onSearchChange(localSearch);
      }
    }, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [localSearch, search, onSearchChange]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Filters Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search customers, contacts, tax ID..."
            value={localSearch}
            onChange={(e) => setLocalSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Status Filter */}
          <Select
            value={statusFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onStatusFilterChange(val as "all" | "active" | "archived")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[130px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="active">Active</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="archived">Archived</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Overdue Filter */}
          <Select
            value={overdueFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onOverdueFilterChange(val as "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[145px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Overdue" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Balances</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="has_overdue">Has Overdue</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="healthy">No Overdue</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Sort By */}
          <Select
            value={sortBy}
            onValueChange={(val) => onSortByChange(val as "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[155px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Sort by" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="name">Name (A-Z)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="outstanding">Outstanding (High)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="reliability">Reliability Score</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card">
        {customers.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No customers found"
            description="Try adjusting your search criteria or filter options."

              search || statusFilter !== "all" || overdueFilter !== "all" ? (
                <Button

                  onClick={() => {
                    onSearchChange("");

                    onOverdueFilterChange("all");

                >
                  Reset filters
                </Button>
              ) : undefined
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Customer</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Credit Terms</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Outstanding</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Overdue Balance</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Payment Reliability</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[70px] text-right">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {customers.map((customer) => (
                <TableRow key={customer.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <Link
                        to="/customers/$customerId"
                        params={{ customerId: customer.id }}
                        className="font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary hover:underline"

                        {customer.name}

                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell>
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">Net {customer.creditTermsDays}</span>
                  </TableCell>

                  <TableCell className="text-right font-medium">
                    {formatMoney(customer.calculatedOutstandingPaise)}

                  <TableCell className="text-right">

<file path="src/components/inventory/purchase-order-list.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { LoadingSkeleton } from "@/components/shared/loading-skeleton";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { Search, ShoppingCart, Eye, ArrowLeftRight, Truck, Plus, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { Supplier, PurchaseOrderStatus } from "@/types";
import type { EnrichedPurchaseOrder } from "@/lib/api/purchaseOrderApi";

interface PurchaseOrderListProps {
  orders: EnrichedPurchaseOrder[];
  suppliers: Supplier[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error?: Error | null | undefined;
  onRetry?: () => void;
  onSelectPo: (poId: string) => void;
  onCreatePo: () => void;
  onReceiveItems: (poId: string) => void;
}

export function PurchaseOrderList({
  orders,
  suppliers,
  isLoading,
  error,
  onRetry,
  onSelectPo,
  onCreatePo,
  onReceiveItems,
}: PurchaseOrderListProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [supplierFilter, setSupplierFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<PurchaseOrderStatus | "all">("all");

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-6 shadow-xs">
        <LoadingSkeleton count={5} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-6 shadow-xs">
        <ErrorState message="Could not load purchase orders." onRetry={onRetry} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Filter
  const filteredOrders = orders.filter((po) => {
    if (search.trim()) {
      const q = search.toLowerCase();
      const matchesNum = po.poNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || po.id.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesSup = po.supplier?.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesItem = po.lineItemsDetails?.some((li) =>
        li.product?.name.toLowerCase().includes(q),
      );
      if (!matchesNum && !matchesSup && !matchesItem) return false;
    }

    if (supplierFilter !== "all" && po.supplierId !== supplierFilter) {
      return false;
    }

    if (statusFilter !== "all" && po.status !== statusFilter) {
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Controls Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2 w-full">
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="Search by PO number, supplier, or item..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-9 h-9 bg-card"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="w-44">
            <Select value={supplierFilter} onValueChange={setSupplierFilter}>
              <SelectTrigger className="h-9 bg-card text-xs">
                <SelectValue placeholder="All suppliers" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All Suppliers</SelectItem>
                {suppliers.map((s) => (
                  <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id} className="text-xs">
                    {s.name}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="w-40">
            <Select
              value={statusFilter}
              onValueChange={(val) => setStatusFilter(val as PurchaseOrderStatus | "all")}
            >
              <SelectTrigger className="h-9 bg-card text-xs">
                <SelectValue placeholder="All statuses" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="draft">Draft</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="sent">Sent</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="confirmed">Confirmed</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="partially_received">Partially received</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="received">Received</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="delayed">Delayed</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="cancelled">Cancelled</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Button size="sm" onClick={onCreatePo} className="gap-1.5 shadow-xs whitespace-nowrap">
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Create Purchase Order
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* PO Table */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader className="bg-muted/40">
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[130px]">PO Number</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[150px]">Supplier</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[110px]">Order Date</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[120px]">Expected Delivery</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[90px]">Ordered</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[90px]">Received</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[110px]">Order Total</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[100px]">Paid</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[100px]">Outstanding</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[120px]">Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right min-w-[100px] pr-4">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell
                    colSpan={11}
                    className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground"
                  >
                    No purchase orders found matching your search.
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ) : (
                filteredOrders.map((po) => (
                  <TableRow
                    key={po.id}
                    className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                    onClick={() => onSelectPo(po.id)}
                  >
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                      {po.poNumber || po.id}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                      {po.supplier?.name || "Supplier"}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {formatDate(po.orderDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                      {formatDate(po.expectedDeliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-foreground font-medium">
                      {po.orderedUnits}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs">
                      <span
                        className={
                          po.receivedUnits >= po.orderedUnits
                            ? "text-success font-semibold"
                            : po.receivedUnits > 0
                              ? "text-warning-foreground font-semibold"
                              : "text-muted-foreground"
                        }
                      >
                        {po.receivedUnits} / {po.orderedUnits}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-foreground font-mono">
                      {formatMoney(po.totalPaise)}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                      {po.advancePaidPaise > 0 ? formatMoney(po.advancePaidPaise) : "₹0"}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right text-xs font-medium text-foreground font-mono">
                      {formatMoney(po.outstandingPaise)}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell>
                      <StatusBadge status={po.status} />
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="text-right pr-4" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        {po.status !== "received" && po.status !== "cancelled" && (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => onReceiveItems(po.id)}
                            className="h-7 text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary"
                          >
                            Receive
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          onClick={() => onSelectPo(po.id)}
                          className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                        >
                          <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/invoices/invoice-table.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import {
  Search,
  MoreHorizontal,
  Eye,
  CreditCard,
  Bell,
  Ban,
  FileText,
  ArrowDownLeft,
  ArrowUpRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { EnrichedInvoice, AgingBucket } from "@/types";

interface InvoiceTableProps {
  invoices: EnrichedInvoice[];
  search: string;
  onSearchChange: (val: string) => void;
  typeFilter: "all" | "receivable" | "payable";
  onTypeFilterChange: (val: "all" | "receivable" | "payable") => void;
  statusFilter: "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled";
  onStatusFilterChange: (
    val: "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled",
  ) => void;
  agingFilter: "all" | AgingBucket;
  onAgingFilterChange: (val: "all" | AgingBucket) => void;
  sortBy: "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue";
  onSortByChange: (val: "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue") => void;
  onRecordPayment: (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => void;
  onSendReminder: (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => void;
  onCancelInvoice: (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => void;
}

export function InvoiceTable({
  invoices,
  search,
  onSearchChange,
  typeFilter,
  onTypeFilterChange,
  statusFilter,
  onStatusFilterChange,
  agingFilter,
  onAgingFilterChange,
  sortBy,
  onSortByChange,
  onRecordPayment,
  onSendReminder,
  onCancelInvoice,
}: InvoiceTableProps) {
  const [localSearch, setLocalSearch] = React.useState(search);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setLocalSearch(search);
  }, [search]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      if (localSearch !== search) {
        onSearchChange(localSearch);
      }
    }, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [localSearch, search, onSearchChange]);

  const getAgingBadge = (bucket: AgingBucket, days: number) => {
    switch (bucket) {
      case "1_7":
        return (
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 text-[10px] dark:border-amber-900/50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300"
          >
            1–7d overdue ({days}d)
          </Badge>
        );
      case "8_30":
        return (
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="border-orange-300 bg-orange-50 text-orange-800 text-[10px] dark:border-orange-900/50 dark:bg-orange-950/40 dark:text-orange-300"
          >
            8–30d overdue ({days}d)
          </Badge>
        );
      case "31_60":
        return (
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 text-[10px] dark:border-rose-900/50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:text-rose-300"
          >
            31–60d overdue ({days}d)
          </Badge>
        );
      case "over_60":
        return (
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="border-rose-400 bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 font-bold text-[10px] dark:border-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-900/60 dark:text-rose-200"
          >
            60+d overdue ({days}d)
          </Badge>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Search and Filters */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-sm">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search by invoice #, counterparty..."
            value={localSearch}
            onChange={(e) => setLocalSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Type Filter */}
          <Select
            value={typeFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onTypeFilterChange(val as "all" | "receivable" | "payable")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Type" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Invoices</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="receivable">Receivables</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="payable">Payables</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Status Filter */}
          <Select
            value={statusFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) =>
              onStatusFilterChange(
                val as "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled",
              )
            }
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="unpaid">Unpaid</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="partially_paid">Partially Paid</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="paid">Paid</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="overdue">Overdue</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="cancelled">Cancelled</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Aging Filter */}
          <Select
            value={agingFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onAgingFilterChange(val as "all" | AgingBucket)}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Aging" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Aging</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="1_7">1–7 Days</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="8_30">8–30 Days</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="31_60">31–60 Days</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="over_60">Over 60 Days</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Sort By */}
          <Select
            value={sortBy}
            onValueChange={(val) =>
              onSortByChange(val as "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue")
            }
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[145px] h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Sort by" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="dueDate">Due Date</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="amount">Amount</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="overdue">Days Overdue</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="status">Status</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="invoiceNumber">Invoice #</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card">
        {invoices.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            title="No invoices found"
            description="No invoices match your current search and filter parameters."
            icon={FileText}
            action={
              search || typeFilter !== "all" || statusFilter !== "all" || agingFilter !== "all" ? (
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onSearchChange("");
                    onTypeFilterChange("all");
                    onStatusFilterChange("all");
                    onAgingFilterChange("all");
                  }}
                >
                  Reset filters
                </Button>
              ) : undefined
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Invoice #</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Counterparty</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Due Date</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Total</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Paid</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Outstanding</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[120px] text-right">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {invoices.map((inv) => {
                const isReceivable = inv.type === "receivable" || !inv.type;

                return (
                  <TableRow key={inv.id}>
                    {/* Invoice Number */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <Link
                        to="/invoices/$invoiceId"
                        params={{ invoiceId: inv.id }}
                        className="font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary hover:underline"
                      >
                        {inv.invoiceNumber}
                      </Link>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Type Badge */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge
                        variant="secondary"
                        className={`text-[11px] gap-1 font-medium ${
                          isReceivable
                            ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300"
                            : "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-950/50 dark:text-purple-300"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isReceivable ? (
                          <>
                            <ArrowDownLeft className="h-3 w-3" />
                            Receivable
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <ArrowUpRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                            Payable
                          </>
                        )}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Counterparty */}
                    <TableCell>
                      {isReceivable && inv.customerId ? (
                        <Link
                          to="/customers/$customerId"
                          params={{ customerId: inv.customerId }}
                          className="font-medium text-foreground hover:underline"
                        >
                          {inv.counterpartyName}
                        </Link>
                      ) : !isReceivable && inv.supplierId ? (
                        <Link
                          to="/suppliers/$supplierId"
                          params={{ supplierId: inv.supplierId }}
                          className="font-medium text-foreground hover:underline"
                        >
                          {inv.counterpartyName}
                        </Link>
                      ) : (
                        <span>{inv.counterpartyName}</span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Due Date & Aging */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                        <span
                          className={`text-sm ${
                            inv.isOverdue
                              ? "font-semibold text-destructive"
                              : "text-muted-foreground"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {formatDate(inv.dueDate)}
                        </span>
                        {inv.isOverdue && getAgingBadge(inv.agingBucket, inv.daysOverdue)}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Total Amount */}
                    <TableCell className="text-right font-medium">
                      {formatMoney(inv.amountPaise)}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Paid Amount */}
                    <TableCell className="text-right text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      {formatMoney(inv.amountPaidPaise || 0)}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Outstanding Balance */}
                    <TableCell
                      className={`text-right font-bold ${
                        inv.isOverdue ? "text-destructive" : "text-foreground"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {formatMoney(inv.outstandingPaise)}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Status */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <StatusBadge status={inv.status} />
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Actions */}
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        {inv.isOverdue && isReceivable && (
                          <Button
                            variant="outline"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-2 text-xs text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400"
                            onClick={() => onSendReminder(inv)}
                            title="Preview Overdue Reminder"
                          >
                            <Bell className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        )}

                        {inv.outstandingPaise > 0 && inv.status !== "void" && (
                          <Button
                            variant="default"
                            size="sm"
                            className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs"
                            onClick={() => onRecordPayment(inv)}
                          >
                            Pay
                          </Button>
                        )}

                        <DropdownMenu>
                          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8">
                              <MoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                              <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                            </Button>
                          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                          <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
                            <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                              <Link
                                to="/invoices/$invoiceId"
                                params={{ invoiceId: inv.id }}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noreferrer"
                                className="cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Eye className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                                View Details
                              </Link>
                            </DropdownMenuItem>

                            {inv.outstandingPaise > 0 && inv.status !== "void" && (
                              <DropdownMenuItem
                                onClick={() => onRecordPayment(inv)}
                                className="cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <CreditCard className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                                Record Payment
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                            )}

                            {inv.isOverdue && (
                              <DropdownMenuItem
                                onClick={() => onSendReminder(inv)}
                                className="cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                <Bell className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-amber-600" />
                                Reminder Notice
                              </DropdownMenuItem>
                            )}

                            {inv.status !== "void" && inv.status !== "paid" && (
                              <>
                                <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                                <DropdownMenuItem
                                  onClick={() => onCancelInvoice(inv)}
                                  className="cursor-pointer text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
                                >
                                  <Ban className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                                  Cancel Invoice
                                </DropdownMenuItem>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </DropdownMenuContent>
                        </DropdownMenu>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/relationships/relationship-details-panel.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  X,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Calendar,
  AlertTriangle,
  FlaskConical,
  ExternalLink,
  Info,
  Layers,
  ArrowUpRight,
  ShieldAlert,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { MoneyAmount } from "@/components/shared/money-amount";
import { DateLabel } from "@/components/shared/date-label";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type {
  RelationshipGraphNode,
  RelationshipGraphEdge,
  RelationshipGraphData,
  RippleImpactPreview,
} from "@/types";
import { calculateRippleImpact } from "@/lib/api/relationshipsApi";

interface RelationshipDetailsPanelProps {
  nodeId: string | null;
  graph: RelationshipGraphData;
  onSelectNode: (nodeId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function RelationshipDetailsPanel({
  nodeId,
  graph,
  onSelectNode,
  onClose,
}: RelationshipDetailsPanelProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (!nodeId) return null;

  const node = graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId);
  if (!node) return null;

  // Immediate Upstream Dependencies (incoming edges)
  const incomingEdges = graph.edges.filter((e) => e.target === nodeId);
  const upstreamNodes = incomingEdges
    .map((e) => ({
      edge: e,
      node: graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.source),
    }))
    .filter((item): item is { edge: RelationshipGraphEdge; node: RelationshipGraphNode } =>
      Boolean(item.node),
    );

  // Immediate Downstream Dependencies (outgoing edges)
  const outgoingEdges = graph.edges.filter((e) => e.source === nodeId);
  const downstreamNodes = outgoingEdges
    .map((e) => ({
      edge: e,
      node: graph.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.target),
    }))
    .filter((item): item is { edge: RelationshipGraphEdge; node: RelationshipGraphNode } =>
      Boolean(item.node),
    );

  // Calculate ripple impact preview
  const ripplePreview: RippleImpactPreview = calculateRippleImpact(nodeId, graph);

  const handleSimulateDelay = () => {
    window.open(
      `/simulator?eventId=${encodeURIComponent(node.id)}&eventName=${encodeURIComponent(node.label)}`,
      "_blank",
      "noopener,noreferrer",
    );
  };

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col h-full border-border/80 shadow-md overflow-hidden bg-card text-card-foreground">
      {/* Panel Header */}
      <CardHeader className="pb-3 px-4 pt-4 border-b border-border/60 bg-muted/20">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider"
              >
                {node.type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
              </Badge>
              <StatusBadge status={node.status} />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-foreground leading-snug truncate">
              {node.label}
            </CardTitle>
            {node.metadata.partnerName && (
              <CardDescription className="text-xs truncate font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                Partner: {node.metadata.partnerName}
              </CardDescription>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close details"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
        {/* Key Attributes Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 rounded-lg border bg-background p-3 text-xs">
          {node.metadata.referenceNumber && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Reference
              </span>
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{node.metadata.referenceNumber}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {node.date && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Scheduled / Due
              </span>
              <DateLabel iso={node.date} className="font-medium text-foreground" />
            </div>
          )}

          {node.metadata.actualDate && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Actual Date
              </span>
              <DateLabel iso={node.metadata.actualDate} className="font-medium text-foreground" />
            </div>
          )}

          {node.amountPaise !== undefined && node.amountPaise > 0 && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Amount
              </span>
              <MoneyAmount paise={node.amountPaise} className="font-bold text-foreground" />
            </div>
          )}

          {node.metadata.quantity !== undefined && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Quantity
              </span>
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                {node.metadata.quantity} units {node.metadata.sku ? `(${node.metadata.sku})` : ""}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {node.metadata.expectedDate && !node.date && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                Timeline / Terms
              </span>
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{node.metadata.expectedDate}</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Why this node matters */}
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-primary mb-1">
            <Info className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Workflow Significance</span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {node.metadata.workflowSignificance}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Cash-Flow Impact & Risk Note */}
        {(node.metadata.cashImpactPaise !== undefined || node.metadata.riskDescription) && (
          <div
            className={`rounded-lg border p-3 ${
              node.metadata.riskSeverity === "critical"
                ? "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive"
                : "border-warning/30 bg-warning/5 text-warning-foreground"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold mb-1">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Cash-Flow Assessment</span>
            </div>
            {node.metadata.cashImpactPaise !== undefined && (
              <p className="text-xs font-medium mb-1">
                Net liquidity delta:{" "}
                <span className="font-bold">{formatMoney(node.metadata.cashImpactPaise)}</span> (
                {node.metadata.cashDirection === "outgoing" ? "cash outflow" : "cash inflow"})
              </p>
            )}
            {node.metadata.riskDescription && (
              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
                {node.metadata.riskDescription}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Upstream Dependencies */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
              Must Happen First ({upstreamNodes.length})
            </span>
          </div>
          {upstreamNodes.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic rounded-md border border-dashed p-2">
              Initial initiating entity — no preceding business dependencies.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {upstreamNodes.map(({ edge, node: upstreamNode }) => (
                <button
                  key={upstreamNode.id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectNode(upstreamNode.id)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:border-primary/40 text-left transition-colors group"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate font-medium text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                      {upstreamNode.label}
                    </p>
                    <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{edge.description}</p>
                  </div>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary shrink-0" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Downstream Consequences */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-warning" />
              Downstream Events Affected ({downstreamNodes.length})
            </span>
          </div>
          {downstreamNodes.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground italic rounded-md border border-dashed p-2">
              Terminal event — does not trigger further active events.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {downstreamNodes.map(({ edge, node: downstreamNode }) => (
                <button
                  key={downstreamNode.id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectNode(downstreamNode.id)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:border-primary/40 text-left transition-colors group"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate font-medium text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                      {downstreamNode.label}
                    </p>
                    <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{edge.description}</p>
                  </div>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary shrink-0" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <Separator />

        {/* Ripple Impact Preview */}
        <div className="rounded-xl border bg-muted/30 p-3.5 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h5 className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FlaskConical className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
              Potential Ripple Effect
            </h5>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Causal Chain</span>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">
            {ripplePreview.businessImpactSummary}
          </p>

          {/* Chain visualization */}
          {ripplePreview.chain.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              {ripplePreview.chain.slice(0, 4).map((milestone, i) => (
                <div
                  key={milestone.nodeId}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs py-1 px-2 rounded-md bg-card border border-border/70"
                >
                  <span className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-[10px] font-bold text-primary">
                    {i + 1}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground truncate block">
                      {milestone.label}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block truncate">
                      {milestone.consequence}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {milestone.date && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground tabular-nums shrink-0">
                      {milestone.date.slice(5)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Action to simulate delay */}
          <Button
            onClick={handleSimulateDelay}
            className="w-full gap-2 mt-2 h-9 text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs"
          >
            <FlaskConical className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Simulate a Delay in Ripple</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
</file>

import React, { memo } from "react";
import { Handle, Position, type NodeProps } from "@xyflow/react";
import {
  Truck,
  CreditCard,
  Package,
  Boxes,

export interface CustomNodeData extends Record<string, unknown> {
  node: RelationshipGraphNode;
  isSelected?: boolean | undefined;
  isUpstream?: boolean | undefined;
  isDownstream?: boolean | undefined;
  isDimmed?: boolean | undefined;
}

const typeConfig: Record<
  RelationshipNodeType,
  {
    label: string;

  }

  },
};

export const RelationshipCustomNode = memo(({ data }: NodeProps) => {
  const customData = data as unknown as CustomNodeData;
  const node = customData?.node;

  if (!node) return null;

  const config = typeConfig[node.type] || typeConfig.supplier;
  const Icon = config.icon;
  const isSelected = customData.isSelected;
  const isUpstream = customData.isUpstream;
  const isDownstream = customData.isDownstream;
  const isDimmed = customData.isDimmed;

  const isCompleted = node.status === "completed";
  const isDelayed = node.status === "delayed";
  const isAtRisk = node.status === "at_risk";
  const isUpcoming = node.status === "upcoming";

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "group relative flex w-[270px] flex-col rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-xs transition-all duration-200 select-none cursor-pointer overflow-visible",
        isSelected
          ? "border-primary ring-2 ring-primary/60 shadow-lg -translate-y-0.5 bg-card ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background"
          : isUpstream
            ? "border-primary/80 ring-2 ring-primary/25 shadow-sm bg-primary/[0.02]"
            : isDownstream
              ? "border-warning/90 ring-2 ring-warning/30 shadow-sm bg-warning/[0.02]"
              : isAtRisk
                ? "border-warning/60 hover:border-warning shadow-xs"
                : isDelayed
                  ? "border-destructive/60 hover:border-destructive shadow-xs"
                  : "border-border hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-0.5",
        isDimmed && "opacity-60",
      )}
    >
      {/* React Flow ER Multi-Handles */}
      {/* Left Input Handles */}
      <Handle
        id="left"
        type="target"
        position={Position.Left}
        style={{ top: "50%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2.5 !w-2.5 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/60 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-3 !w-3",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-3 !w-3",
        )}
      />
      <Handle
        id="left-upper"
        type="target"
        position={Position.Left}
        style={{ top: "30%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2 !w-2 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/50 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
        )}
      />
      <Handle
        id="left-lower"
        type="target"
        position={Position.Left}
        style={{ top: "70%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2 !w-2 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/50 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
        )}
      />

      {/* Right Output Handles */}
      <Handle
        id="right"
        type="source"
        position={Position.Right}
        style={{ top: "50%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2.5 !w-2.5 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/60 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-3 !w-3",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-3 !w-3",
        )}
      />
      <Handle
        id="right-upper"
        type="source"
        position={Position.Right}
        style={{ top: "30%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2 !w-2 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/50 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
        )}
      />
      <Handle
        id="right-lower"
        type="source"
        position={Position.Right}
        style={{ top: "70%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2 !w-2 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/50 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-2.5 !w-2.5",
        )}
      />

      {/* Top Input Handle */}
      <Handle
        id="top"
        type="target"
        position={Position.Top}
        style={{ left: "50%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2.5 !w-2.5 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/60 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-3 !w-3",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-3 !w-3",
        )}
      />

      {/* Bottom Output Handle */}
      <Handle
        id="bottom"
        type="source"
        position={Position.Bottom}
        style={{ left: "50%" }}
        className={cn(
          "!h-2.5 !w-2.5 !border-2 !border-background !bg-muted-foreground/60 transition-all hover:!scale-125",
          (isSelected || isUpstream) && "!bg-primary !h-3 !w-3",
          isDownstream && "!bg-warning !h-3 !w-3",
        )}
      />

      {/* Dependency role pill if active */}
      {isUpstream && (
        <span className="absolute -top-3 left-4 rounded-full bg-primary px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-primary-foreground shadow-xs tracking-wide uppercase">
          Upstream
        </span>
      )}
      {isDownstream && (
        <span className="absolute -top-3 right-4 rounded-full bg-warning px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-warning-foreground shadow-xs tracking-wide uppercase">
          Downstream
        </span>
      )}

      {/* ER Card Header Banner */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border/80 bg-muted/40 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-t-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <span
            className={cn(
              "flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md",
              config.badgeBg,
            )}
          >
            <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
          </span>
          <span className="truncate text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-mono">
            {config.label}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Status Pill or Reference ID */}
        <div className="flex items-center shrink-0">
          {isCompleted && (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-success/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-success"
              title="Event completed"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              Done
            </span>
          )}
          {isUpcoming && (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary"
              title="Upcoming event"
            >
              <Clock className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              Upcoming
            </span>
          )}
          {isDelayed && (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-destructive/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-destructive"
              title="Delayed event"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              Delayed
            </span>
          )}
          {isAtRisk && (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-warning/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-warning-foreground"
              title="Potential cash-flow risk"
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
              At Risk
            </span>
          )}
          {node.status === "active" && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-foreground">
              Active
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ER Entity Body */}
      <div className="px-3.5 py-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <h4 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
            {node.label}
          </h4>
        </div>
        {node.metadata.partnerName && (
          <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            {node.metadata.partnerName}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ER Attributes Row (Date / Financial Amount / Quantity) */}
      <div className="border-t border-border/60 bg-muted/15 px-3.5 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs rounded-b-xl">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          {node.date ? (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium font-mono text-[11px]">
              {formatDate(node.date, "d MMM yyyy")}
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-mono text-[11px]">
              {node.metadata.expectedDate || "Standard"}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {node.amountPaise !== undefined && node.amountPaise > 0 ? (
          <span
            className={cn(
              "font-semibold tabular-nums font-mono text-xs",
              node.metadata.cashDirection === "incoming"
                ? "text-success"
                : node.metadata.cashDirection === "outgoing"
                  ? "text-destructive"
                  : "text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {node.metadata.cashDirection === "outgoing" ? "−" : ""}
            {formatMoneyCompact(node.amountPaise)}
          </span>
        ) : node.metadata.quantity !== undefined ? (
          <span className="font-semibold text-muted-foreground tabular-nums font-mono text-xs">
            {node.metadata.quantity} units
          </span>
        ) : node.metadata.referenceNumber ? (
          <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {node.metadata.referenceNumber}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">Entity</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

RelationshipCustomNode.displayName = "RelationshipCustomNode";

        <span className="text-muted-foreground/40 font-light">|</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">{lane.subtitle}</span>
      </div>
      <span
        className={cn(

            : lane.badgeVariant === "warning"
              ? "bg-warning/20 text-warning-foreground"
              : "bg-primary/10 text-primary",

      >
        {lane.badge}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});
