} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { AppPreferences } from "@/types";
import { applyTheme, applyCompactTables, type ThemeMode } from "@/lib/theme";
import {
  getGeminiApiKey,
  setGeminiApiKey,
  getGeminiApiKeySource,
  callGeminiAPI,
} from "@/lib/gemini";

interface AppSettingsSectionProps {
  appPreferences: AppPreferences;
  onSave: (data: Partial<AppPreferences>) => Promise<void>;
  isSaving: boolean;
}

export function AppSettingsSection({ appPreferences, onSave, isSaving }: AppSettingsSectionProps) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<ThemeMode>(appPreferences.theme ?? "system");
  const [compactTables, setCompactTables] = useState<boolean>(
    appPreferences.compactTables ?? false,
  );

  // Gemini API Key State
  const [geminiKeyInput, setGeminiKeyInput] = useState<string>("");
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isTestingKey, setIsTestingKey] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [keySource, setKeySource] = useState<"localStorage" | "env" | "none">("none");

  useEffect(() => {
    setTheme(appPreferences.theme ?? "system");
    setCompactTables(appPreferences.compactTables ?? false);

    // Load active Gemini key & source
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem("rupi_gemini_api_key") || "";
      setGeminiKeyInput(stored);
      setKeySource(getGeminiApiKeySource());
    }
  }, [appPreferences]);

  const handleThemeChange = (newTheme: ThemeMode) => {
    setTheme(newTheme);
    // Instant live preview
    applyTheme(newTheme);
  };

  const handleCompactChange = (checked: boolean) => {
    setCompactTables(checked);
    // Instant live preview
    applyCompactTables(checked);
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setTheme(appPreferences.theme ?? "system");
    setCompactTables(appPreferences.compactTables ?? false);
    applyTheme(appPreferences.theme ?? "system");
    applyCompactTables(appPreferences.compactTables ?? false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await onSave({
      theme,
      compactTables,
      version: appPreferences.version ?? "1.0.0",
    });
  };

  const handleSaveGeminiKey = () => {
    setGeminiApiKey(geminiKeyInput.trim());
    setKeySource(getGeminiApiKeySource());
    if (geminiKeyInput.trim()) {
      toast.success("Gemini API key saved to localStorage", {
        description: "Active override will be used for all Insights & AI queries.",
      });
    } else {
      toast.info("Gemini API key cleared from localStorage", {
        description: "Insights & AI will fall back to environment variable or safety net.",
      });
    }
  };

  const handleClearGeminiKey = () => {
    setGeminiKeyInput("");
    setGeminiApiKey("");
    setKeySource(getGeminiApiKeySource());
    toast.info("Custom API key cleared");
  };

  const handleTestGeminiKey = async () => {
    const keyToTest = geminiKeyInput.trim() || getGeminiApiKey();
    if (!keyToTest) {
      toast.error("Please enter a Gemini API Key to test.", {
        description: "Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey",
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsTestingKey(true);
    try {
      const res = await callGeminiAPI({
        prompt: "Respond with exactly: Connection successful.",
        systemInstruction: "You are a test agent. Keep responses to 2 words.",
        apiKeyOverride: keyToTest,
      });
      toast.success("Google AI Studio Connected Successfully!", {
        description: `Model: ${res.model} responded: "${res.text}"`,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Connection failed";
      toast.error("Gemini Connection Test Failed", {
        description: msg,
      });
    } finally {
      setIsTestingKey(false);
    }
  };

  const hasChanges =
    theme !== (appPreferences.theme ?? "system") ||
    compactTables !== (appPreferences.compactTables ?? false);

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Sliders className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">App Settings & Appearance</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                Customize theme styling, table density, AI integrations, and inspect the platform version.
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          {/* Google AI Studio (Gemini API) Integration */}
          <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                    Google AI Studio (Gemini 2.5 Flash)
                  </Label>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Connects Insights & AI to Gemini with automatic Hackathon Safety Net fallback.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                {keySource === "localStorage" && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs gap-1">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                    Custom Override Active
                  </Badge>
                )}
                {keySource === "env" && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-blue-500/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 text-xs gap-1">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                    Env Key Active
                  </Badge>
                )}
                {keySource === "none" && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs gap-1">
                    <Wifi className="h-3 w-3" />
                    Safety Net Ready
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              <Label htmlFor="gemini-key" className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <KeyRound className="h-3 w-3" />
                Gemini API Key (<code className="text-[11px] font-mono">rupi_gemini_api_key</code>)
              </Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Input
                    id="gemini-key"
                    type={showKey ? "text" : "password"}
                    placeholder="AQ... or AIzaSy... (Paste Google AI Studio API key)"
                    value={geminiKeyInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setGeminiKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                    className="pr-10 text-xs font-mono"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)}
                    className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    title={showKey ? "Hide key" : "Show key"}
                  >
                    {showKey ? <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                  </button>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleTestGeminiKey}
                  disabled={isTestingKey}
                  className="text-xs h-9"
                >
                  {isTestingKey ? "Testing…" : "Test Key"}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleSaveGeminiKey}
                  className="text-xs h-9 font-medium"
                >
                  Save Key
                </Button>
                {geminiKeyInput && (
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={handleClearGeminiKey}
                    className="text-xs h-9 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                  >
                    Clear
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Get an API key free at{" "}
                <a
                  href="https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="text-primary underline hover:opacity-80"
                >
                  Google AI Studio
                </a>
                . If offline or no key is set, the copilot will automatically generate deterministic responses using live data.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          {/* Theme Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Theme Preference</Label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleThemeChange("light")}
                className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                  theme === "light"
                    ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary"
                    : "border-input bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
                }`}
              >
                <Sun className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Light</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleThemeChange("dark")}
                className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                  theme === "dark"
                    ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary"
                    : "border-input bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
                }`}
              >
                <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Dark</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleThemeChange("system")}
                className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                  theme === "system"
                    ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 text-primary"
                    : "border-input bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
                }`}
              >
                <Laptop className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>System</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Compact Tables Mode */}
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                <LayoutGrid className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <Label
                  htmlFor="compact-tables"
                  className="cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-foreground"
                >
                  Compact Table Mode
                </Label>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Reduces row padding across suppliers, customers, invoices, and cash flow ledgers
                  to view more data on screen.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Switch
              id="compact-tables"
              checked={compactTables}
              onCheckedChange={handleCompactChange}
              disabled={isSaving}
              aria-label="Compact tables"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Version Info */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border p-4 bg-muted/20">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">Platform Release</span>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-xs">
              Ripple v{appPreferences.version ?? "1.0.0"}
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex items-center justify-between border-t px-6 py-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {hasChanges ? "Unsaved appearance changes" : "Appearance preferences current"}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleReset}
              disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}
            >
              <Undo2 className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={!hasChanges || isSaving}>
              <Save className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              {isSaving ? "Saving..." : "Save App Settings"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </form>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/settings/data-privacy-section.tsx">
import { useState } from "react";
import { Database, Download, RotateCcw, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { db } from "@/mocks/store";
import type { Business } from "@/types";

interface DataPrivacySectionProps {
  business?: Business;
  dataMode: "mock" | "api";
  onResetDemoData: () => Promise<void>;
  isResetting: boolean;
}

export function DataPrivacySection({
  business,
  dataMode,
  onResetDemoData,
  isResetting,
}: DataPrivacySectionProps) {
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);

  const handleExportAllCsv = () => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const bName = business?.name ?? (dataMode === "mock" ? db.business.name : "Active Business");
      const bCurr = business?.currency ?? (dataMode === "mock" ? db.business.currency : "INR");
      const bOpenCash =
        business?.openingCashPaise ?? (dataMode === "mock" ? db.business.openingCashPaise : 0);
      const bSafety =
        business?.safetyThresholdPaise ??
        (dataMode === "mock" ? (db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 0) : 0);

      // Export cohesive business summary CSV
      const rows = [
        ["Data Export", "Ripple Business Summary"],
        ["Export Date", new Date().toISOString()],
        ["Mode", dataMode],
        [],
        ["Entity", "Count / Value"],
        ["Business Name", bName],
        ["Currency", bCurr],
        ["Opening Cash (Paise)", String(bOpenCash)],
        ["Safety Threshold (Paise)", String(bSafety)],
        ["Suppliers Count", String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.suppliers.length : "N/A (API Mode)")],
        ["Customers Count", String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.customers.length : "N/A (API Mode)")],
        ["Products Count", String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.products.length : "N/A (API Mode)")],
        ["Invoices Count", String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.invoices.length : "N/A (API Mode)")],
        [
          "Purchase Orders Count",
          String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.purchaseOrders.length : "N/A (API Mode)"),
        ],
        [
          "Cash Flow Events Count",
          String(dataMode === "mock" ? db.cashFlowEvents.length : "N/A (API Mode)"),
        ],
      ];

      const csvContent = rows
        .map((row) => row.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(","))
        .join("\n");

      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      const filename = `ripple-data-export-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

      link.setAttribute("href", url);
      link.setAttribute("download", filename);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      toast.success("Business data export downloaded as CSV.");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to export data to CSV.");
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const isMockMode = dataMode === "mock";

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Database className="h-4 w-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">Data & Privacy</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Inspect workspace environment mode, backup records as CSV, or reset demo data.
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-6">
        {/* Current Environment Mode */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Current Operating Mode</span>
              <Badge variant={isMockMode ? "secondary" : "default"} className="capitalize">
                {dataMode} Mode
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {isMockMode
                ? "Running with in-memory local demo data. Safe to simulate, edit, and experiment without touching live servers."
                : "Connected to live FastAPI backend. Real transactions and bank ledgers are active."}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-success">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Environment Protected</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CSV Export */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Export Workspace Data</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Download your current counterparties, products, invoices, and financial preferences in
              CSV format.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleExportAllCsv}
            disabled={isExporting}
            className="shrink-0"
          >
            <Download className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {isExporting ? "Exporting..." : "Export to CSV"}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Reset Demo Data */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-destructive">Reset Demo Data</h4>
              {!isMockMode ? (
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className="border-destructive/30 text-destructive text-[10px]"
                >
                  Disabled in Live API Mode
                </Badge>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {isMockMode
                ? "Reverts all modified suppliers, customers, inventory balances, and invoices back to the initial 'Rupi Clothing' demo seed."
                : "Live production data cannot be reset from this interface to preserve audit trails and integrity."}
            </p>
          </div>

          {isMockMode ? (
            <AlertDialog>
              <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="destructive"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={isResetting}
                  className="shrink-0"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {isResetting ? "Resetting..." : "Reset Demo Data"}
                </Button>
              </AlertDialogTrigger>
              <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />
                    <AlertDialogTitle>Reset demo data to initial seed?</AlertDialogTitle>
                  </div>
                  <AlertDialogDescription>
                    This will restore all mock counterparties, invoices, payments, inventory, and
                    business settings to the default Rupi Clothing seed dataset. Any unsaved edits
                    will be discarded.
                  </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                  <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
                  <AlertDialogAction
                    onClick={onResetDemoData}
                    className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
                  >
                    Confirm Reset
                  </AlertDialogAction>
                </AlertDialogFooter>
              </AlertDialogContent>
            </AlertDialog>
          ) : (
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" disabled className="shrink-0">
              Live Mode Protected
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter className="border-t px-6 py-3">
        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          Never expose sensitive credentials or API keys. Ripple enforces strict environment
          segregation.
        </p>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/shared/empty-state.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Inbox, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
  action?: React.ReactNode | { label: string; onClick?: () => void };
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon: Icon = Inbox,
  title,
  description,
  actionLabel,
  onAction,
  action,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  const renderedAction = action ? (
    React.isValidElement(action) ? (
      action
    ) : typeof action === "object" && "label" in action ? (
      <Button size="sm" onClick={(action as { onClick?: () => void }).onClick}>
        {(action as { label: string }).label}
      </Button>
    ) : null
  ) : actionLabel && onAction ? (
    <Button size="sm" onClick={onAction}>
      {actionLabel}
    </Button>
  ) : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-dashed bg-card px-6 py-16 text-center">
      {Icon && (
        <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted">
          <Icon className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
        </div>
      )}
      <h3 className="mt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">{title}</h3>
      {description ? (
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-sm text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      ) : null}
      {renderedAction ? <div className="mt-4">{renderedAction}</div> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/shared/metric-card.tsx">
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus } from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** Semantic tone for a metric. Drives the icon chip, and the value for risk tones. */
export type MetricIntent = "default" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info";

interface MetricCardProps {
  label: string;
  /** Usually a formatted money/date string; accepts a node so badges can be used as the value. */
  value: ReactNode;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /**
   * Short caption under the value (e.g. "6 open invoices").
   * `hint` is the legacy alias — `subtext` wins when both are supplied.
   */
  subtext?: string;
  hint?: string;
  intent?: MetricIntent;
  trend?: {
    direction: "up" | "down" | "flat";
    label: string;
    sentiment?: "good" | "bad" | "neutral";
  };
}

const chipByIntent: Record<MetricIntent, string> = {
  default: "bg-primary/10 text-primary",
  info: "bg-primary/10 text-primary",
  success: "bg-success/10 text-success",
  warning: "bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground",
  danger: "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
};

/**
 * Only risk tones colour the headline number. A red or amber figure is a
 * financial convention that reads as "look at this"; a green or indigo
 * headline number is just noise, so those stay in foreground ink.
 */
const valueByIntent: Record<MetricIntent, string> = {
  default: "text-foreground",
  info: "text-foreground",
  success: "text-foreground",
  warning: "text-warning-foreground",
  danger: "text-destructive",
};

export function MetricCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon: Icon,
  subtext,
  hint,
  intent = "default",
  trend,
}: MetricCardProps) {
  const TrendIcon =
    trend?.direction === "up" ? TrendingUp : trend?.direction === "down" ? TrendingDown : Minus;

  const caption = subtext ?? hint;

  const trendTone = cn(
    trend?.sentiment === "good" && "text-success",
    trend?.sentiment === "bad" && "text-destructive",
    (!trend?.sentiment || trend?.sentiment === "neutral") && "text-muted-foreground",
  );

  return (
    <Card className="group hover:shadow-elevated">
      <CardContent className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <span className="pt-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-[0.08em] text-muted-foreground uppercase">
            {label}
          </span>
          <span
            className={cn(
              "flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg",
              chipByIntent[intent],
            )}
            aria-hidden
          >
            <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
          </span>
        </div>
        <div
          className={cn(
            "mt-3 text-[1.6rem] leading-none font-semibold tracking-[-0.02em] tabular-nums",
            valueByIntent[intent],
          )}
        >
          {value}
        </div>
        {trend ? (
          <div className={cn("mt-2.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium", trendTone)}>
            <TrendIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" aria-hidden />
            <span>{trend.label}</span>
          </div>
        ) : caption ? (
          <p className="mt-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground">{caption}</p>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/shared/money-amount.tsx">
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CurrencyCode } from "@/types";

interface MoneyAmountProps {
  paise?: number;
  amountPaise?: number;
  currency?: CurrencyCode;
  /** Show +/− sign and color-code direction. */
  signed?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function MoneyAmount({
  paise,
  amountPaise,
  currency = "INR",
  signed,
  className,
}: MoneyAmountProps) {
  const valuePaise =
    typeof paise === "number" && !Number.isNaN(paise)
      ? paise
      : typeof amountPaise === "number" && !Number.isNaN(amountPaise)
        ? amountPaise
        : 0;
  const sign = signed ? (valuePaise > 0 ? "+" : valuePaise < 0 ? "−" : "") : "";
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "tabular-nums",
        signed && valuePaise > 0 && "text-success",
        signed && valuePaise < 0 && "text-destructive",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {sign}
      {formatMoney(Math.abs(valuePaise), currency)}
    </span>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/suppliers/supplier-table.tsx">
import React from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Search,
  ArrowUpDown,
  MoreHorizontal,
  ExternalLink,
  Edit2,
  Archive,
  RefreshCw,
  Trash2,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ShieldAlert,
  Calendar,
  Building,
  Mail,
  Phone,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { MoneyAmount } from "@/components/shared/money-amount";
import { DateLabel } from "@/components/shared/date-label";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/shared/status-badge";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { EnrichedSupplier } from "@/types";

interface SupplierTableProps {
  suppliers: EnrichedSupplier[];
  searchQuery: string;
  onSearchChange: (q: string) => void;
  statusFilter: "all" | "active" | "archived";
  onStatusFilterChange: (status: "all" | "active" | "archived") => void;
  riskFilter: "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy";
  onRiskFilterChange: (risk: "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy") => void;
  sortBy: "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability";
  onSortChange: (sort: "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability") => void;
  sortDir: "asc" | "desc";
  onSortDirToggle: () => void;
  onEdit: (supplier: EnrichedSupplier) => void;
  onArchive: (supplier: EnrichedSupplier) => void;
  onUnarchive: (supplier: EnrichedSupplier) => void;
  onDelete: (supplier: EnrichedSupplier) => void;
  onAddSupplier: () => void;
}

export function SupplierTable({
  suppliers,
  searchQuery,
  onSearchChange,
  statusFilter,
  onStatusFilterChange,
  riskFilter,
  onRiskFilterChange,
  sortBy,
  onSortChange,
  sortDir,
  onSortDirToggle,
  onEdit,
  onArchive,
  onUnarchive,
  onDelete,
  onAddSupplier,
}: SupplierTableProps) {
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = React.useState(1);
  const [localSearch, setLocalSearch] = React.useState(searchQuery);
  const pageSize = 10;

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setLocalSearch(searchQuery);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      if (localSearch !== searchQuery) {
        onSearchChange(localSearch);
      }
    }, 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [localSearch, searchQuery, onSearchChange]);

  // Reset pagination on search/filter changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
  }, [searchQuery, statusFilter, riskFilter, sortBy, sortDir]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(suppliers.length / pageSize) || 1;
  const paginatedSuppliers = suppliers.slice((currentPage - 1) * pageSize, currentPage * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Search & Filter Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="relative flex-1 sm:max-w-xs">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search suppliers, contacts, GSTIN..."
            value={localSearch}
            onChange={(e) => setLocalSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8 text-sm"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Status Filter */}
          <Select
            value={statusFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onStatusFilterChange(val as "all" | "active" | "archived")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[130px] text-xs">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Statuses</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="active">Active Only</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="archived">Archived Only</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Risk Filter */}
          <Select
            value={riskFilter}
            onValueChange={(val) => onRiskFilterChange(val as "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy")}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[130px] text-xs">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Risk Level" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All Risk Levels</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="at_risk">At Risk</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="healthy">Healthy</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Sort Selector */}
          <Select
            value={sortBy}
            onValueChange={(val) =>
              onSortChange(val as "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability")
            }
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[150px] text-xs">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Sort by" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="name">Sort by Name</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="outstanding">Sort by Outstanding</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="nextPayment">Sort by Next Due</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="reliability">Sort by Reliability</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="icon"
            onClick={onSortDirToggle}
            title={sortDir === "asc" ? "Ascending order" : "Descending order"}
            className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0"
          >
            <ArrowUpDown className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table Container */}
      {paginatedSuppliers.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Building}
          title={
            searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" || riskFilter !== "all"
              ? "No suppliers match your filters"
              : "No suppliers found"
          }
          description={
            searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" || riskFilter !== "all"
              ? "Try adjusting your search criteria, status, or risk filters."
              : "Register your first supplier to track purchase orders, bills, and payment terms."
          }
          actionLabel={
            searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" || riskFilter !== "all"
              ? "Reset filters"
              : "Add Supplier"
          }
          onAction={() => {
            if (searchQuery || statusFilter !== "all" || riskFilter !== "all") {
              onSearchChange("");
              onStatusFilterChange("all");
              onRiskFilterChange("all");
            } else {
              onAddSupplier();
            }
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead className="w-[240px]">Supplier</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[170px]">Contact Details</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Outstanding Balance</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-center">Open POs</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[140px]">Next Due Payment</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Payment Terms</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-center">Reliability & Risk</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right w-[80px]">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {paginatedSuppliers.map((supplier) => {
                const isArchived = supplier.status === "archived";

                return (
                  <TableRow
                    key={supplier.id}
                    className={isArchived ? "bg-muted/30 opacity-75" : undefined}
                  >
                    {/* Supplier Name */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex flex-col">
                        <Link
                          to="/suppliers/$supplierId"
                          params={{ supplierId: supplier.id }}
                          className="font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary hover:underline"
                        >
                          {supplier.name}
                        </Link>
                        <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {supplier.taxId && <span>{supplier.taxId}</span>}
                          {isArchived && (
                            <Badge
                              variant="outline"
                              className="px-1.5 py-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground"
                            >
                              Archived
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Contact Details */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="text-xs space-y-0.5">
                        {supplier.contactName && (
                          <div className="font-medium text-foreground">{supplier.contactName}</div>
                        )}
                        {supplier.email && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground">
                            <Mail className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{supplier.email}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {supplier.phone && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground">
                            <Phone className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{supplier.phone}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {!supplier.contactName && !supplier.email && !supplier.phone && (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">No contact details</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Outstanding Balance */}
                    <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-end">
                        <MoneyAmount paise={supplier.outstandingPaise} className="font-medium" />
                        {supplier.overdueAmountPaise > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-destructive">
                            {formatMoney(supplier.overdueAmountPaise)} overdue
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Open Purchase Orders */}
                    <TableCell className="text-center">
                      {supplier.openPoCount > 0 ? (
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="px-2 py-0.5 font-medium">
                          {supplier.openPoCount} open
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">None</span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Next Expected Payment */}
                    <TableCell>
                      {supplier.nextPaymentDate ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col text-xs">
                          <DateLabel iso={supplier.nextPaymentDate} />
                          {supplier.nextPaymentAmountPaise !== undefined && (
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                              {formatMoney(supplier.nextPaymentAmountPaise)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Payment Terms */}
                    <TableCell>
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                        Net {supplier.paymentTermsDays}d
                      </span>
                      {supplier.leadTimeDays && (
                        <span className="block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {supplier.leadTimeDays}d lead
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Reliability & Risk */}
                    <TableCell className="text-center">
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${
                              supplier.reliabilityScore >= 85
                                ? "bg-success"
                                : supplier.reliabilityScore >= 75
                                  ? "bg-warning"
                                  : "bg-destructive"
                            }`}
                          />
                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums">
                            {supplier.reliabilityScore}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {supplier.isAtRisk && (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 text-[10px] text-destructive py-0 px-1.5"
                          >
                            At risk
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    {/* Actions Menu */}
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      <DropdownMenu>
                        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8">
                            <MoreHorizontal className="h-4 w-4" />
                            <span className="sr-only">Actions</span>
                          </Button>
                        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                        <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-48">
                          <DropdownMenuLabel>Supplier Actions</DropdownMenuLabel>
                          <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                            <Link
                              to="/suppliers/$supplierId"
                              params={{ supplierId: supplier.id }}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                            >
                              <ExternalLink className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                              View Details
                            </Link>
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                          <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onEdit(supplier)}>
                            <Edit2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                            Edit Details
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                          {isArchived ? (
                            <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onUnarchive(supplier)}>
                              <RefreshCw className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-success" />
                              Reactivate Supplier
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                          ) : (
                            <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => onArchive(supplier)}>
                              <Archive className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-warning" />
                              Archive Supplier
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                          )}
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onClick={() => onDelete(supplier)}
                            className="text-destructive focus:text-destructive"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                            Delete Supplier
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        </DropdownMenuContent>
                      </DropdownMenu>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>

          {/* Pagination Footer */}
          {totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t px-4 py-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <div>
                Showing {(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1} to{" "}
                {Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, suppliers.length)} of {suppliers.length} suppliers
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                  disabled={currentPage === 1}
                  className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs"
                >
                  Previous
                </Button>
                <span className="px-2 text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                  Page {currentPage} of {totalPages}
                </span>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                  disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
                  className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs"
                >
                  Next
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/ui/select.tsx">
import * as React from "react";
import * as SelectPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-select";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronDownIcon, ChevronUpIcon } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

function Select({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Root data-slot="select" {...props} />;
}

function SelectGroup({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Group>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Group data-slot="select-group" {...props} />;
}

function SelectValue({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Value>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Value data-slot="select-value" {...props} />;
}

function SelectTrigger({
  className,
  size = "default",
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Trigger> & {
  size?: "sm" | "default";
}) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Trigger
      data-slot="select-trigger"
      data-size={size}
      className={cn(
        "border-input data-[placeholder]:text-muted-foreground [&_svg:not([class*='text-'])]:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50 flex w-fit items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-md border bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm whitespace-nowrap shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none focus-visible:ring-[3px] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 data-[size=default]:h-9 data-[size=sm]:h-8 *:data-[slot=select-value]:line-clamp-1 *:data-[slot=select-value]:flex *:data-[slot=select-value]:items-center *:data-[slot=select-value]:gap-2 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <SelectPrimitive.Icon asChild>
        <ChevronDownIcon className="size-4 opacity-50" />
      </SelectPrimitive.Icon>
    </SelectPrimitive.Trigger>
  );
}

function SelectContent({
  className,
  children,
  position = "popper",
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Portal>
      <SelectPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="select-content"
        className={cn(
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 relative z-50 max-h-(--radix-select-content-available-height) min-w-[8rem] origin-(--radix-select-content-transform-origin) overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-md border shadow-md",
          position === "popper" &&
            "data-[side=bottom]:translate-y-1 data-[side=left]:-translate-x-1 data-[side=right]:translate-x-1 data-[side=top]:-translate-y-1",
          className,
        )}
        position={position}
        {...props}
      >
        <SelectScrollUpButton />
        <SelectPrimitive.Viewport
          className={cn(
            "p-1",
            position === "popper" &&
              "h-[var(--radix-select-trigger-height)] w-full min-w-[var(--radix-select-trigger-width)]",
          )}
        >
          {children}
        </SelectPrimitive.Viewport>
        <SelectScrollDownButton />
      </SelectPrimitive.Content>
    </SelectPrimitive.Portal>
  );
}

function SelectLabel({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Label>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Label
      data-slot="select-label"
      className={cn("text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1.5 text-xs", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function SelectItem({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Item>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Item
      data-slot="select-item"
      className={cn(
        "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground [&_svg:not([class*='text-'])]:text-muted-foreground relative flex w-full cursor-default select-none items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-none data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <span className="absolute right-2 flex size-3.5 items-center justify-center">
        <SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>
          <CheckIcon className="size-4" />
        </SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>
      </span>
      <SelectPrimitive.ItemText>{children}</SelectPrimitive.ItemText>
    </SelectPrimitive.Item>
  );
}

function SelectSeparator({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Separator>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.Separator
      data-slot="select-separator"
      className={cn("bg-border pointer-events-none -mx-1 my-1 h-px", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function SelectScrollUpButton({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton
      data-slot="select-scroll-up-button"
      className={cn("flex cursor-default items-center justify-center py-1", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronUpIcon className="size-4" />
    </SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton>
  );
}

function SelectScrollDownButton({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton>) {
  return (
    <SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton
      data-slot="select-scroll-down-button"

      {...props}
    >
      <ChevronDownIcon className="size-4" />
    </SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton>
  );
}

import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest, setAuthToken, setActiveBusinessId, getAuthToken } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay } from "@/mocks/store";

export interface User {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
}

export interface BusinessSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  currency: string;
  openingCashPaise: number;
  safetyThresholdPaise: number;
}

export interface AuthSession {
  token: string;
  user: User;
  business: BusinessSummary;
  businesses: BusinessSummary[];
}

const AUTH_USER_KEY = "ripple_auth_user";
const AUTH_BIZ_KEY = "ripple_auth_biz";

export function getStoredUser(): User | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_USER_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getStoredBusiness(): BusinessSummary | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_BIZ_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

import { syncSimulatorStoreWithBusiness } from "@/lib/simulatorStore";

export function setStoredSession(session: AuthSession | null): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  if (session) {
    setAuthToken(session.token);
    setActiveBusinessId(session.business.id);
    localStorage.setItem(AUTH_USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(session.user));
    localStorage.setItem(AUTH_BIZ_KEY, JSON.stringify(session.business));
    syncSimulatorStoreWithBusiness(session.business.id, session.business.name);
  } else {
    setAuthToken(null);
    setActiveBusinessId(null);
    localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_USER_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_BIZ_KEY);
    syncSimulatorStoreWithBusiness();
  }
}

export function isUserAuthenticated(): boolean {
  if (DATA_MODE === "mock") return true;
  return !!getAuthToken();
}

export const authApi = {
  async login(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthSession> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(300);
      const session: AuthSession = {
        token: "demo_mock_jwt_token",
        user: {
          id: "usr_owner",
          email: email || "owner@rupiclothing.in",
          fullName: "Demo Owner",
        },
        business: {
          id: db.business.id,
          name: db.business.name,
          currency: db.business.currency,
          openingCashPaise: db.business.openingCashPaise,
          safetyThresholdPaise: db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000,

        businesses: [
          {
            id: db.business.id,

            currency: db.business.currency,
            openingCashPaise: db.business.openingCashPaise,
            safetyThresholdPaise: db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000,
          },
        ],
      };
      setStoredSession(session);

    }

    const res = await httpRequest<{
      access_token: string;
      token_type: string;
      user: { id: string; email: string; full_name: string };
      business: BusinessSummary;
      businesses: BusinessSummary[];
    }>("/api/auth/login", {
      method: "POST",
      body: { email, password },
    });

    const session: AuthSession = {
      token: res.access_token,
      user: {
        id: res.user.id,
        email: res.user.email,
        fullName: res.user.full_name,
      },
      business: res.business,
      businesses: res.businesses || [res.business],
    };
    setStoredSession(session);
    return session;
  },

  async register(
    email: string,

  ): Promise<AuthSession> {

      db.invoices = [];
      db.payments = [];
      db.cashFlowEvents = [];
      const session: AuthSession = {
        token: "demo_mock_jwt_token",
        user: {
          id: "usr_registered",
          email,
          fullName,
        },
        business: {
          id: "biz_registered",
          name: businessName,
          currency: "INR",
          openingCashPaise: 1_000_000,
          safetyThresholdPaise: 500_000,
        },
        businesses: [],
      };
      setStoredSession(session);
      return session;
    }

    const res = await httpRequest<{
      access_token: string;
      token_type: string;
      user: { id: string; email: string; full_name: string };
      business: BusinessSummary;
      businesses: BusinessSummary[];
    }>("/api/auth/register", {
      method: "POST",
      body: {
        email,
        password,
        full_name: fullName,
        business_name: businessName,
      },
    });

    const session: AuthSession = {
      token: res.access_token,
      user: {
        id: res.user.id,
        email: res.user.email,
        fullName: res.user.full_name,
      },
      business: res.business,
      businesses: res.businesses || [res.business],
    };
    setStoredSession(session);
    return session;
  },

  async getMe(): Promise<{ user: User; business: BusinessSummary; businesses: BusinessSummary[] }> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(100);
      return {
        user: {
          id: "usr_owner",
          email: "owner@rupiclothing.in",
          fullName: "Demo Owner",
        },
        business: {
          id: db.business.id,
          name: db.business.name,
          currency: db.business.currency,
          openingCashPaise: db.business.openingCashPaise,
          safetyThresholdPaise: db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000,
        },
        businesses: [
          {
            id: db.business.id,
            name: db.business.name,
            currency: db.business.currency,
            openingCashPaise: db.business.openingCashPaise,
            safetyThresholdPaise: db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000,
          },
        ],
      };
    }

    const res = await httpRequest<{
      user: { id: string; email: string; full_name: string };
      business: BusinessSummary;
      businesses: BusinessSummary[];
    }>("/api/auth/me");

    return {
      user: {
        id: res.user.id,
        email: res.user.email,
        fullName: res.user.full_name,
      },
      business: res.business,
      businesses: res.businesses || [],
    };
  },

  async switchBusiness(businessId: string): Promise<AuthSession> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(150);
      return await this.login("owner@rupiclothing.in", "password123");
    }

    const res = await httpRequest<{
      access_token: string;
      token_type: string;
      user: { id: string; email: string; full_name: string };
      business: BusinessSummary;
      businesses: BusinessSummary[];
    }>(`/api/auth/switch-business/${businessId}`, {
      method: "POST",
    });

    const session: AuthSession = {
      token: res.access_token,
      user: {
        id: res.user.id,
        email: res.user.email,
        fullName: res.user.full_name,
      },
      business: res.business,
      businesses: res.businesses || [res.business],
    };
    setStoredSession(session);
    return session;
  },

  logout(): void {
    setStoredSession(null);
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.location.href = "/login";
    }
  },
};
