<file path="src/lib/api/inventoryApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, nextId } from "@/mocks/store";
import type {
  Product,
  InventoryItem,
  InventoryItemWithDetails,
  InventorySummaryMetrics,
  InventoryMovement,
  ReorderRecommendation,
  InventoryRiskAlert,
  CreateProductInput,
  UpdateProductInput,
  RecordMovementInput,
  ApiListResponse,
  StockStatus,
  Supplier,
  PurchaseOrder,
  CustomerOrder,
} from "@/types";

export type InventoryRow = InventoryItemWithDetails;

export interface InventoryListParams {
  search?: string | undefined;
  category?: string | undefined;
  status?: StockStatus | "all" | undefined;
  sortBy?: "name" | "available" | "onHand" | "cost" | "status" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
  page?: number | undefined;
  pageSize?: number | undefined;
}

export interface ProductDetailResponse {
  product: Product;
  inventory: InventoryItem;
  stockOnHand: number;
  reservedStock: number;
  availableStock: number;
  incomingStock: number;
  reorderThreshold: number;
  unitCostPaise: number;
  inventoryValuationPaise?: number | undefined;
  status: StockStatus;
  statusLabel: string;
  preferredSupplier?: Supplier | undefined;
  movements: InventoryMovement[];
  purchaseOrders: PurchaseOrder[];
  customerOrders: (CustomerOrder & { customerName: string })[];
  forecastDemand: number;
  projectedStockoutDate?: string | undefined;
}

function computeStatus(
  stockOnHand: number,
  availableStock: number,
  incomingStock: number,
  reorderPoint: number,
  openCustomerDemand: number,
): { status: StockStatus; label: string } {
  // If zero physical stock on hand
  if (stockOnHand <= 0 && incomingStock > 0) {
    return { status: "incoming_stock", label: "Incoming stock" };
  }
  if (stockOnHand <= 0 && incomingStock <= 0) {
    return { status: "out_of_stock", label: "Out of stock" };
  }

  // If available stock is exhausted
  if (availableStock <= 0) {
    if (incomingStock > 0) {
      return { status: "incoming_stock", label: "Incoming stock" };
    }
    return { status: "out_of_stock", label: "Out of stock" };
  }

  // Stockout risk: Total stock on hand + incoming is insufficient for confirmed demand,
  // or available stock is critically thin (<= 25% of reorder point) with zero incoming POs
  if (
    stockOnHand + incomingStock < openCustomerDemand ||
    (incomingStock === 0 && availableStock <= Math.ceil(reorderPoint * 0.25))
  ) {
    return { status: "stockout_risk", label: "Stockout risk" };
  }

  // Low stock: Available stock is below reorder point, but incoming replenishment is active or buffer exists
  if (availableStock < reorderPoint) {
    return { status: "low_stock", label: "Low stock" };
  }

  return { status: "healthy", label: "Healthy" };
}

function enrichInventoryRow(product: Product): InventoryItemWithDetails {
  let inv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === product.id);
  if (!inv) {
    inv = {
      id: nextId("inv"),
      productId: product.id,
      quantityOnHand: 0,
      quantityReserved: 0,
      quantityOnOrder: 0,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    };
    db.inventory.push(inv);
  }

  const stockOnHand = inv.quantityOnHand;
  const reservedStock = inv.quantityReserved ?? 0;
  const availableStock = Math.max(0, stockOnHand - reservedStock);
  const incomingStock = inv.quantityOnOrder;
  const reorderThreshold = product.reorderPoint;
  const unitCostPaise = product.unitCostPaise;
  const inventoryValuationPaise = stockOnHand * unitCostPaise;

  // Find incoming PO
  const relatedPo = db.purchaseOrders
    .filter(
      (po) =>
        (po.productId === product.id || po.lineItems?.some((li) => li.productId === product.id)) &&
        (po.status === "confirmed" || po.status === "sent" || po.status === "partially_received"),
    )
    .sort((a, b) => a.expectedDeliveryDate.localeCompare(b.expectedDeliveryDate))[0];

  const nextExpectedDelivery = relatedPo?.expectedDeliveryDate ?? inv.expectedRestockDate;
  const nextDeliveryPoId = relatedPo?.id;

  // Calculate open customer demand
  const openCustomerDemand = db.customerOrders
    .filter((co) => co.productId === product.id && co.status === "confirmed")
    .reduce((sum, co) => sum + co.quantity, 0);

  const { status, label: statusLabel } = computeStatus(
    stockOnHand,
    availableStock,
    incomingStock,
    reorderThreshold,
    openCustomerDemand,
  );

  const preferredSupplier = product.preferredSupplierId
    ? db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === product.preferredSupplierId)
    : undefined;

  return {
    product,
    inventory: inv,
    stockOnHand,
    reservedStock,
    availableStock,
    incomingStock,
    reorderThreshold,
    nextExpectedDelivery,
    nextDeliveryPoId,
    unitCostPaise,
    inventoryValuationPaise,
    status,
    statusLabel,
    preferredSupplier,
  };
}

export const inventoryApi = {
  async list(params: InventoryListParams = {}): Promise<ApiListResponse<InventoryItemWithDetails>> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      let rows = db.products.map(enrichInventoryRow);

      // Search filter
      if (params.search && params.search.trim() !== "") {
        const q = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        rows = rows.filter(
          (r) =>
            r.product.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            r.product.sku.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            (r.product.category && r.product.category.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
        );
      }

      // Category filter
      if (params.category && params.category !== "all") {
        rows = rows.filter((r) => r.product.category === params.category);
      }

      // Status filter
      if (params.status && params.status !== "all") {
        rows = rows.filter((r) => r.status === params.status);
      }

      // Sorting
      const sortBy = params.sortBy ?? "name";
      const sortDir = params.sortDir ?? "asc";
      rows.sort((a, b) => {
        let cmp = 0;
        if (sortBy === "name") {
          cmp = a.product.name.localeCompare(b.product.name);
        } else if (sortBy === "available") {
          cmp = a.availableStock - b.availableStock;
        } else if (sortBy === "onHand") {
          cmp = a.stockOnHand - b.stockOnHand;
        } else if (sortBy === "cost") {
          cmp = a.unitCostPaise - b.unitCostPaise;
        } else if (sortBy === "status") {
          cmp = a.status.localeCompare(b.status);
        }
        return sortDir === "desc" ? -cmp : cmp;
      });

      const page = params.page ?? 1;
      const pageSize = params.pageSize ?? 50;
      const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
      const paginated = rows.slice(start, start + pageSize);

      return {
        data: paginated,
        total: rows.length,
        page,
        pageSize,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ApiListResponse<InventoryItemWithDetails>>("/api/inventory", {
      query: {
        search: params.search,
        category: params.category,
        status: params.status,
        sortBy: params.sortBy,
        sortDir: params.sortDir,
        page: params.page,
        pageSize: params.pageSize,
      },
    });
  },

  async getSummary(): Promise<InventorySummaryMetrics> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(150);
      const rows = db.products.map(enrichInventoryRow);

      const totalProducts = rows.length;
      const totalAvailableUnits = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.availableStock, 0);
      const lowStockCount = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "low_stock").length;
      const stockoutRiskCount = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "stockout_risk").length;
      const incomingUnits = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.incomingStock, 0);
      const estimatedValuationPaise = rows.reduce(
        (s, r) => s + (r.inventoryValuationPaise ?? 0),
        0,
      );

      return {
        totalProducts,
        totalAvailableUnits,
        lowStockCount,
        stockoutRiskCount,
        incomingUnits,
        estimatedValuationPaise,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<InventorySummaryMetrics>("/api/inventory/summary");
  },

  async getById(productId: string): Promise<ProductDetailResponse> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const product = db.products.find((p) => p.id === productId);
      if (!product) throw new Error(`Product ${productId} not found`);

      const enriched = enrichInventoryRow(product);

      const movements = db.inventoryMovements
        .filter((m) => m.productId === productId)
        .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

      const purchaseOrders = db.purchaseOrders.filter(
        (po) =>
          po.productId === productId || po.lineItems?.some((li) => li.productId === productId),
      );

      const customerOrders = db.customerOrders
        .filter((co) => co.productId === productId)
        .map((co) => {
          const customer = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === co.customerId);
          return {
            ...co,
            customerName: customer?.name ?? "Customer",
          };
        });

      // Calculate forecast demand: default 5 units/week or open order volume
      const totalCustomerQty = customerOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.quantity, 0);
      const forecastDemand = Math.max(5, Math.ceil(totalCustomerQty / 2));

      // Calculate projected stockout date
      let projectedStockoutDate: string | undefined = undefined;
      if (forecastDemand > 0) {
        const daysLeft = Math.floor((enriched.availableStock / forecastDemand) * 7);
        const today = new Date();
        const stockout = new Date(today);
        stockout.setDate(today.getDate() + daysLeft);
        projectedStockoutDate = stockout.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      }

      return {
        product: enriched.product,
        inventory: enriched.inventory,
        stockOnHand: enriched.stockOnHand,
        reservedStock: enriched.reservedStock,
        availableStock: enriched.availableStock,
        incomingStock: enriched.incomingStock,
        reorderThreshold: enriched.reorderThreshold,
        unitCostPaise: enriched.unitCostPaise,
        inventoryValuationPaise: enriched.inventoryValuationPaise,
        status: enriched.status,
        statusLabel: enriched.statusLabel,
        preferredSupplier: enriched.preferredSupplier,
        movements,
        purchaseOrders,
        customerOrders,
        forecastDemand,
        projectedStockoutDate,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ProductDetailResponse>(`/api/inventory/${productId}`);
  },

  async create(input: CreateProductInput): Promise<InventoryItemWithDetails> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      // Check SKU uniqueness
      const skuExists = db.products.some(
        (p) => p.sku.toLowerCase() === input.sku.toLowerCase().trim(),
      );
      if (skuExists) {
        throw new Error(`SKU "${input.sku}" is already in use.`);
      }

      const product: Product = {
        id: nextId("prd"),
        businessId: db.business.id,
        sku: input.sku.trim().toUpperCase(),
        name: input.name.trim(),
        category: input.category.trim(),
        description: input.description?.trim(),
        unitOfMeasure: input.unitOfMeasure?.trim() || "pieces",
        preferredSupplierId: input.preferredSupplierId,
        currency: input.currency ?? "INR",
        unitCostPaise: input.unitCostPaise ?? 0,
        unitPricePaise: Math.round((input.unitCostPaise ?? 0) * 1.6),
        reorderPoint: input.reorderPoint,
      };

      db.products.push(product);

      const initialQty = Math.max(0, input.initialStockQuantity ?? 0);
      const inv: InventoryItem = {
        id: nextId("inv"),
        productId: product.id,
        quantityOnHand: initialQty,
        quantityReserved: 0,
        quantityOnOrder: 0,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      };
      db.inventory.push(inv);

      if (initialQty > 0) {
        const movement: InventoryMovement = {
          id: nextId("mov"),
          businessId: db.business.id,
          productId: product.id,
          type: "receipt",
          quantity: initialQty,
          resultingBalance: initialQty,
          date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          referenceType: "manual",
          note: "Initial opening stock recorded on product creation",
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        };
        db.inventoryMovements.push(movement);
      }

      return enrichInventoryRow(product);
    }

    return httpRequest<InventoryItemWithDetails>("/api/inventory", {
      method: "POST",
      body: input,
    });
  },

  async update(productId: string, patch: UpdateProductInput): Promise<Product> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const product = db.products.find((p) => p.id === productId);
      if (!product) throw new Error(`Product ${productId} not found`);

      if (patch.sku && patch.sku !== product.sku) {
        const skuExists = db.products.some(
          (p) => p.id !== productId && p.sku.toLowerCase() === patch.sku?.toLowerCase().trim(),
        );
        if (skuExists) {
          throw new Error(`SKU "${patch.sku}" is already in use.`);
        }
        product.sku = patch.sku.trim().toUpperCase();
      }

      if (patch.name !== undefined) product.name = patch.name.trim();
      if (patch.category !== undefined) product.category = patch.category.trim();
      if (patch.description !== undefined) product.description = patch.description.trim();
      if (patch.unitOfMeasure !== undefined) product.unitOfMeasure = patch.unitOfMeasure.trim();
      if (patch.reorderPoint !== undefined) product.reorderPoint = patch.reorderPoint;
      if (patch.preferredSupplierId !== undefined)
        product.preferredSupplierId = patch.preferredSupplierId;
      if (patch.unitCostPaise !== undefined) product.unitCostPaise = patch.unitCostPaise;

      return product;
    }

    return httpRequest<Product>(`/api/inventory/${productId}`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: patch,
    });
  },

  async recordMovement(input: RecordMovementInput): Promise<InventoryMovement> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      if (input.quantity <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Movement quantity must be greater than zero.");
      }

      const product = db.products.find((p) => p.id === input.productId);
      if (!product) throw new Error(`Product ${input.productId} not found`);

      let inv = db.inventory.find((i) => i.productId === input.productId);
      if (!inv) {
        inv = {
          id: nextId("inv"),
          productId: input.productId,
          quantityOnHand: 0,
          quantityReserved: 0,
          quantityOnOrder: 0,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        };
        db.inventory.push(inv);
      }

      const movementDate = input.date ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      switch (input.type) {
        case "receipt": {
          inv.quantityOnHand += input.quantity;
          if (input.referenceType === "purchase_order" && input.referenceId) {
            // Check if PO exists and update received units
            const po = db.purchaseOrders.find(
              (p) => p.id === input.referenceId || p.poNumber === input.referenceId,
            );
            if (po) {
              inv.quantityOnOrder = Math.max(0, inv.quantityOnOrder - input.quantity);
              po.receivedQuantity = (po.receivedQuantity ?? 0) + input.quantity;
              const totalPoQty =
                po.quantity ?? po.lineItems?.reduce((s, li) => s + li.quantity, 0) ?? 0;
              if (po.receivedQuantity >= totalPoQty) {
                po.status = "received";
              } else {
                po.status = "partially_received";
              }
            }
          }
          break;
        }

        case "sale": {
          if (inv.quantityOnHand < input.quantity) {
            throw new Error(
              `Insufficient stock on hand (${inv.quantityOnHand} units) to fulfill sale.`,
            );
          }
          inv.quantityOnHand -= input.quantity;
          if ((inv.quantityReserved ?? 0) > 0) {
            inv.quantityReserved = Math.max(0, (inv.quantityReserved ?? 0) - input.quantity);
          }
          break;
        }

        case "reservation": {
          const available = inv.quantityOnHand - (inv.quantityReserved ?? 0);
          if (available < input.quantity) {
            throw new Error(
              `Insufficient available stock (${available} units) to reserve ${input.quantity} units.`,
            );
          }
          inv.quantityReserved = (inv.quantityReserved ?? 0) + input.quantity;
          break;
        }

        case "reservation_release": {
          inv.quantityReserved = Math.max(0, (inv.quantityReserved ?? 0) - input.quantity);
          break;
        }

        case "adjustment": {
          if (!input.note || input.note.trim() === "") {
            throw new Error("A reason note is required for stock adjustments.");
          }
          // Adjustment quantity delta can increase or decrease stock
          inv.quantityOnHand = Math.max(0, inv.quantityOnHand + input.quantity);
          break;
        }

        case "return": {
          inv.quantityOnHand += input.quantity;
          break;
        }
      }

      inv.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      const movement: InventoryMovement = {
        id: nextId("mov"),
        businessId: db.business.id,
        productId: input.productId,
        type: input.type,
        quantity: input.quantity,
        resultingBalance: inv.quantityOnHand,
        date: movementDate,
        referenceType: input.referenceType,
        referenceId: input.referenceId,
        note: input.note,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      };

      db.inventoryMovements.push(movement);
      return movement;
    }

    return httpRequest<InventoryMovement>("/api/inventory/transactions", {
      method: "POST",
      body: input,
    });
  },

  async getReorderRecommendations(): Promise<ReorderRecommendation[]> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(200);
      const recommendations: ReorderRecommendation[] = [];

      for (const product of db.products) {
        const enriched = enrichInventoryRow(product);
        const preferredSupplier = enriched.preferredSupplier;

        // Find customer orders commitments
        const customerOrders = db.customerOrders.filter(
          (co) => co.productId === product.id && co.status === "confirmed",
        );
        const customerCommitmentsAtRisk = customerOrders.map((co) => {
          const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === co.customerId);
          return `${cust?.name ?? "Customer"} (${co.quantity} units due ${co.deliveryDate ?? "soon"})`;
        });

        const isLow = enriched.availableStock < product.reorderPoint;
        const isStockoutRisk = enriched.status === "stockout_risk";
        const isOutOfStock = enriched.availableStock === 0;

        if (isLow || isStockoutRisk || isOutOfStock) {
          const leadDays = preferredSupplier?.paymentTermsDays ?? 15;
          const today = new Date();
          const deliveryDate = new Date(today);
          deliveryDate.setDate(today.getDate() + leadDays);
          const estimatedDeliveryDate = deliveryDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

          // Calculate suggested reorder: bring stock to 2x reorder point or minimum economic quantity
          const targetStock = Math.max(product.reorderPoint * 2, 20);
          const currentDeficit = targetStock - enriched.availableStock - enriched.incomingStock;
          const suggestedReorderQuantity = Math.max(10, currentDeficit > 0 ? currentDeficit : 10);

          const proposedPurchaseAmountPaise = suggestedReorderQuantity * product.unitCostPaise;
          const requiredAdvancePaise = preferredSupplier
            ? Math.round(proposedPurchaseAmountPaise * 0.15) // standard 15% advance for apparel mills
            : 0;

          const forecastDemand = Math.max(
            5,
            customerOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.quantity, 0),
          );

          let reason = "";
          if (enriched.stockOnHand === 0 && enriched.incomingStock === 0) {
            reason = "Zero stock on hand and no incoming purchase order.";
          } else if (isStockoutRisk) {
            reason = `Committed orders (${customerOrders.reduce((s, o) => s + o.quantity, 0)} units) exceed available stock (${enriched.availableStock} units).`;
          } else {
            reason = `Available stock (${enriched.availableStock} units) is below reorder threshold (${product.reorderPoint} units).`;
          }

          recommendations.push({
            productId: product.id,
            productName: product.name,
            sku: product.sku,
            category: product.category,
            currentAvailableStock: enriched.availableStock,
            reorderPoint: product.reorderPoint,
            incomingQuantity: enriched.incomingStock,
            forecastDemand,
            estimatedStockoutDate: enriched.nextExpectedDelivery,
            suggestedReorderQuantity,
            preferredSupplierId: preferredSupplier?.id,
            preferredSupplierName: preferredSupplier?.name,
            preferredSupplierLeadDays: leadDays,
            estimatedDeliveryDate,
            proposedPurchaseAmountPaise,
            requiredAdvancePaise,
            relatedCustomerOrderCount: customerOrders.length,
            customerCommitmentsAtRisk,
            reason,
            hasSufficientData: true,
          });
        }
      }

      return recommendations;
    }

    return httpRequest<ReorderRecommendation[]>("/api/inventory/reorder-recommendations");
  },

  async getRiskAlerts(): Promise<InventoryRiskAlert[]> {

<file path="src/lib/api/supplierApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, nextId } from "@/mocks/store";
import type {
  Supplier,
  CreateSupplierInput,
  UpdateSupplierInput,
  EnrichedSupplier,
  SupplierSummaryMetrics,
  SupplierDetailData,
  SupplierPaymentCommitment,
  ApiListResponse,
  ListParams,
  PurchaseOrder,
  PurchaseOrderLineItem,
  Invoice,
  Payment,
  Product,
} from "@/types";

export interface SupplierListFilterParams extends ListParams {
  status?: "all" | "active" | "archived" | undefined;
  riskStatus?: "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy" | undefined;
  sortBy?: "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

function enrichSupplier(s: Supplier): EnrichedSupplier {
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // Linked Purchase Orders
  const pos = db.purchaseOrders.filter((po) => po.supplierId === s.id);
  const openPos = pos.filter((po) => po.status !== "received" && po.status !== "cancelled");

  // Linked Payable Invoices
  const invoices = db.invoices.filter(
    (i) => (!i.type || i.type === "payable") && i.supplierId === s.id,
  );
  const openInvoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void");

  // Scheduled Outgoing Payments
  const payments = db.payments.filter(
    (p) =>
      p.direction === "outgoing" &&
      p.status === "scheduled" &&
      (p.supplierId === s.id ||
        pos.some((po) => po.id === p.purchaseOrderId) ||
        invoices.some((inv) => inv.id === p.invoiceId)),
  );

  payments.sort((a, b) => a.scheduledDate.localeCompare(b.scheduledDate));
  const nextPayment = payments[0];

  // Overdue calculation
  const overdueInvoices = invoices.filter(
    (i) =>
      i.status === "overdue" ||
      (i.dueDate < todayStr && i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void"),
  );
  const overdueAmountPaise = overdueInvoices.reduce(
    (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
    0,
  );

  // Dynamic outstanding calculation
  let calculatedOutstandingPaise = s.outstandingPaise;
  if (invoices.length > 0) {
    const invoiceOutstanding = openInvoices.reduce(
      (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
      0,
    );
    calculatedOutstandingPaise = Math.max(s.outstandingPaise, invoiceOutstanding);
  } else if (openPos.length > 0) {
    const poOutstanding = openPos.reduce(
      (sum, po) => sum + Math.max(0, po.totalPaise - po.advancePaidPaise),
      0,
    );
    calculatedOutstandingPaise = Math.max(s.outstandingPaise, poOutstanding);
  }

  const hasOverdue = overdueAmountPaise > 0;
  const riskReasons: string[] = [];

  if (s.reliabilityScore < 80) {
    riskReasons.push(`Reliability score is ${s.reliabilityScore}% (below 80% threshold)`);
  }
  if (hasOverdue) {
    riskReasons.push(`Overdue balance of ₹${(overdueAmountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`);
  }
  const delayedPo = openPos.find((po) => po.status === "delayed");
  if (delayedPo) {
    riskReasons.push(`Purchase order ${delayedPo.poNumber ?? delayedPo.id} is delayed`);
  }

  const isAtRisk = riskReasons.length > 0;

  return {
    ...s,
    status: s.status ?? "active",
    outstandingPaise: calculatedOutstandingPaise,
    openPoCount: openPos.length,
    totalPoCount: pos.length,
    nextPaymentDate: nextPayment?.scheduledDate,
    nextPaymentAmountPaise: nextPayment?.amountPaise,
    overdueAmountPaise,
    hasOverdue,
    isAtRisk,
    riskReasons,
    payableInvoicesCount: openInvoices.length,
  };
}

export const supplierApi = {
  async list(params: SupplierListFilterParams = {}): Promise<ApiListResponse<EnrichedSupplier>> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      let suppliers = db.suppliers.map(enrichSupplier);

      // Status filter
      if (params.status && params.status !== "all") {
        suppliers = suppliers.filter((s) => s.status === params.status);
      }

      // Risk status filter
      if (params.riskStatus === "at_risk") {
        suppliers = suppliers.filter((s) => s.isAtRisk);
      } else if (params.riskStatus === "healthy") {
        suppliers = suppliers.filter((s) => !s.isAtRisk);
      }

      // Search filter
      if (params.search && params.search.trim() !== "") {
        const q = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        suppliers = suppliers.filter(
          (s) =>
            s.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.contactName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.phone?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.taxId?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.address?.toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      }

      // Sorting
      const dir = params.sortDir === "desc" ? -1 : 1;
      if (params.sortBy === "name") {
        suppliers.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "outstanding") {
        suppliers.sort((a, b) => (a.outstandingPaise - b.outstandingPaise) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "nextPayment") {
        suppliers.sort((a, b) => {
          if (!a.nextPaymentDate && !b.nextPaymentDate) return 0;
          if (!a.nextPaymentDate) return 1;
          if (!b.nextPaymentDate) return -1;
          return a.nextPaymentDate.localeCompare(b.nextPaymentDate) * dir;
        });
      } else if (params.sortBy === "reliability") {
        suppliers.sort((a, b) => (a.reliabilityScore - b.reliabilityScore) * dir);
      } else {
        // Default sort: Active first, then by name
        suppliers.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.status !== b.status) {
            return a.status === "active" ? -1 : 1;
          }
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        });
      }

      const total = suppliers.length;
      const page = params.page ?? 1;
      const pageSize = params.pageSize ?? 50;
      const startIndex = (page - 1) * pageSize;
      const paginated = suppliers.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize);

      return {
        data: paginated,
        total,
        page,
        pageSize,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ApiListResponse<EnrichedSupplier>>("/api/suppliers", {
      query: {
        page: params.page,
        pageSize: params.pageSize,
        search: params.search,
        status: params.status,
        riskStatus: params.riskStatus,
        sortBy: params.sortBy,
        sortDir: params.sortDir,
      },
    });
  },

  async getSummaryMetrics(): Promise<SupplierSummaryMetrics> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const today = new Date();
      const todayStr = today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const sevenDaysLater = new Date(today.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
        .toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);

      const enriched = db.suppliers.map(enrichSupplier);
      const active = enriched.filter((s) => s.status === "active");
      const archived = enriched.filter((s) => s.status === "archived");

      const totalOutstandingPayablesPaise = active.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.outstandingPaise, 0);

      const overduePayablesPaise = active.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.overdueAmountPaise, 0);

      // Scheduled outgoing payments to active suppliers due within 7 days
      const dueInSevenDaysPaise = db.payments
        .filter((p) => {
          if (p.direction !== "outgoing" || p.status !== "scheduled") return false;
          if (p.scheduledDate < todayStr || p.scheduledDate > sevenDaysLater) return false;
          // check if linked to active supplier
          if (p.supplierId) {
            const sup = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === p.supplierId);
            return sup?.status !== "archived";
          }
          if (p.purchaseOrderId) {
            const po = db.purchaseOrders.find((o) => o.id === p.purchaseOrderId);
            const sup = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === po?.supplierId);
            return sup?.status !== "archived";
          }
          return true;
        })
        .reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountPaise, 0);

      const atRiskSuppliersCount = active.filter((s) => s.isAtRisk).length;

      return {
        totalSuppliers: db.suppliers.length,
        activeSuppliers: active.length,
        archivedSuppliers: archived.length,
        totalOutstandingPayablesPaise,
        dueInSevenDaysPaise,
        overduePayablesPaise,
        atRiskSuppliersCount,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<SupplierSummaryMetrics>("/api/suppliers/summary");
  },

  async getById(id: string): Promise<Supplier> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const found = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`Supplier "${id}" not found`);
      return found;
    }
    return httpRequest<Supplier>(`/api/suppliers/${id}`);
  },

  async getSupplierDetail(id: string): Promise<SupplierDetailData> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const supplier = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (!supplier) throw new Error(`Supplier "${id}" not found`);

      const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      // Linked Purchase Orders with line items and product details
      const rawPos = db.purchaseOrders.filter((po) => po.supplierId === id);
      const purchaseOrders = rawPos.map((po) => {
        const lineItems = po.lineItems ?? [];
        const lineItemsDetails = lineItems.map((li) => ({
          ...li,
          product: db.products.find((p) => p.id === li.productId),
        }));
        const orderedUnits = lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + li.quantity, 0) || po.quantity || 0;
        const receivedUnits =
          po.receivedQuantity ?? lineItems.reduce((s, li) => s + (li.receivedQuantity ?? 0), 0);
        const outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, po.totalPaise - po.advancePaidPaise);

        return {
          ...po,
          supplier,
          lineItemsDetails,
          orderedUnits,
          receivedUnits,
          outstandingPaise,
        };
      });

      // Linked Payable Invoices
      const invoices = db.invoices.filter(
        (i) => (!i.type || i.type === "payable") && i.supplierId === id,
      );

      // Linked Payments (both by supplierId directly or via linked PO or invoice)
      const allSupplierPayments = db.payments.filter(
        (p) =>
          p.direction === "outgoing" &&
          (p.supplierId === id ||
            rawPos.some((po) => po.id === p.purchaseOrderId) ||
            invoices.some((inv) => inv.id === p.invoiceId)),
      );

      const completedPayments = allSupplierPayments.filter((p) => p.status === "completed");

      const upcomingPayments: SupplierPaymentCommitment[] = allSupplierPayments
        .filter((p) => p.status === "scheduled")
        .map((p) => {
          const linkedPo = rawPos.find((po) => po.id === p.purchaseOrderId);
          const linkedInv = invoices.find((inv) => inv.id === p.invoiceId);
          const dueDate = p.scheduledDate;

          let cashFlowImpactNote = "Scheduled disbursement";
          if (dueDate <= todayStr) {
            cashFlowImpactNote = "Payment due today / pending settlement";
          } else {
            const diffDays = Math.ceil(
              (new Date(dueDate).getTime() - new Date(todayStr).getTime()) / (1000 * 3600 * 24),
            );
            cashFlowImpactNote = `Scheduled outflow in ${diffDays} day${diffDays === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
          }

          return {
            ...p,
            dueDate,
            linkedPoNumber: linkedPo?.poNumber ?? linkedPo?.id,
            linkedInvoiceNumber: linkedInv?.invoiceNumber ?? linkedInv?.id,
            linkedReference: linkedPo?.poNumber ?? linkedInv?.invoiceNumber ?? p.purchaseOrderId,
            cashFlowImpactNote,
          };
        });

      // Products supplied
      const products = db.products.filter((p) => p.preferredSupplierId === id);

      // Financial computations
      const totalPoPaise = purchaseOrders.reduce((sum, po) => sum + po.totalPaise, 0);
      const totalInvoicePaise = invoices.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + inv.amountPaise, 0);
      const totalPurchasesPaise = Math.max(totalPoPaise, totalInvoicePaise);

      const totalPaymentsMadePaise = completedPayments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountPaise, 0);

      const overdueInvoices = invoices.filter(
        (i) =>
          i.status === "overdue" ||
          (i.dueDate < todayStr && i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void"),
      );
      const overdueBalancePaise = overdueInvoices.reduce(
        (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
        0,
      );

      const openPos = purchaseOrders.filter(
        (po) => po.status !== "received" && po.status !== "cancelled",
      );
      const poOutstanding = openPos.reduce((sum, po) => sum + po.outstandingPaise, 0);
      const openInvoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "void");
      const invOutstanding = openInvoices.reduce(
        (sum, i) => sum + Math.max(0, i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
        0,
      );
      const outstandingPayablesPaise = Math.max(
        supplier.outstandingPaise,
        Math.max(poOutstanding, invOutstanding),
      );

      // Reliability and risk
      const riskFactors: string[] = [];
      if (supplier.reliabilityScore < 80) {
        riskFactors.push(`Reliability rating is ${supplier.reliabilityScore}% (sub-optimal)`);
      }
      if (overdueBalancePaise > 0) {
        riskFactors.push(
          `Overdue payments of ₹${(overdueBalancePaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`,
        );
      }
      const delayed = purchaseOrders.filter((po) => po.status === "delayed");
      if (delayed.length > 0) {
        riskFactors.push(`${delayed.length} purchase order(s) delayed`);
      }
      if (riskFactors.length === 0) {
        riskFactors.push("All payments and delivery terms in good standing");
      }

      const riskLevel: "low" | "medium" | "high" =
        supplier.reliabilityScore < 75 || overdueBalancePaise > 0
          ? "high"
          : supplier.reliabilityScore < 85
            ? "medium"
            : "low";

      // On-time delivery rate
      const deliveredPos = purchaseOrders.filter(
        (po) => po.status === "received" || po.status === "partially_received",
      );
      const onTimeDeliveryRate =
        deliveredPos.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              (deliveredPos.filter((po) => po.status !== "delayed").length / deliveredPos.length) *
                100,
            )
          : supplier.reliabilityScore;

      return {
        supplier: {
          ...supplier,
          status: supplier.status ?? "active",
        },
        metrics: {
          totalPurchasesPaise,
          totalPaymentsMadePaise,
          outstandingPayablesPaise,
          overdueBalancePaise,
          openPoCount: openPos.length,
          totalPoCount: purchaseOrders.length,
          onTimeDeliveryRate,
          reliabilityScore: supplier.reliabilityScore,
          riskLevel,
          riskFactors,
        },
        purchaseOrders,
        invoices,
        payments: allSupplierPayments,
        upcomingPayments,
        completedPayments,
        products,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<SupplierDetailData>(`/api/suppliers/${id}/details`);
  },

  async create(input: CreateSupplierInput): Promise<Supplier> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      const nameTrimmed = input.name.trim();
      if (!nameTrimmed || nameTrimmed.length < 2) {
        throw new Error("Supplier name must be at least 2 characters.");
      }

      const duplicate = db.suppliers.find(
        (s) => s.name.toLowerCase() === nameTrimmed.toLowerCase(),
      );
      if (duplicate) {
        throw new Error(`A supplier named "${nameTrimmed}" already exists.`);
      }

      if (input.email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(input.email)) {
        throw new Error("Please enter a valid email address.");
      }

      const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const supplier: Supplier = {
        id: nextId("sup"),
        businessId: db.business.id,
        name: nameTrimmed,
        contactName: input.contactName?.trim() || undefined,
        email: input.email?.trim() || undefined,
        phone: input.phone?.trim() || undefined,
        address: input.address?.trim() || undefined,
        taxId: input.taxId?.trim() || undefined,
        paymentTermsDays: input.paymentTermsDays ?? 30,
        outstandingPaise: 0,
        reliabilityScore: input.reliabilityScore ?? 90,
        status: input.status ?? "active",
        notes: input.notes?.trim() || undefined,
        leadTimeDays: input.leadTimeDays ?? 7,
        createdAt: todayStr,
        updatedAt: todayStr,
      };

      db.suppliers.push(supplier);
      return supplier;
    }

    return httpRequest<Supplier>("/api/suppliers", { method: "POST", body: input });
  },

  async update(id: string, patch: UpdateSupplierInput): Promise<Supplier> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const existing = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (!existing) throw new Error(`Supplier "${id}" not found`);

      if (patch.name) {
        const nameTrimmed = patch.name.trim();
        if (nameTrimmed.length < 2) {
          throw new Error("Supplier name must be at least 2 characters.");
        }
        const duplicate = db.suppliers.find(
          (s) => s.id !== id && s.name.toLowerCase() === nameTrimmed.toLowerCase(),
        );
        if (duplicate) {
          throw new Error(`A supplier named "${nameTrimmed}" already exists.`);
        }
      }

      if (patch.email && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(patch.email)) {
        throw new Error("Please enter a valid email address.");
      }

      const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const updated: Supplier = {
        ...existing,
        ...patch,
        id,
        name: patch.name ? patch.name.trim() : existing.name,
        contactName:
          patch.contactName !== undefined
            ? patch.contactName.trim() || undefined
            : existing.contactName,
        email: patch.email !== undefined ? patch.email.trim() || undefined : existing.email,
        phone: patch.phone !== undefined ? patch.phone.trim() || undefined : existing.phone,
        address: patch.address !== undefined ? patch.address.trim() || undefined : existing.address,
        taxId: patch.taxId !== undefined ? patch.taxId.trim() || undefined : existing.taxId,
        notes: patch.notes !== undefined ? patch.notes.trim() || undefined : existing.notes,
        reliabilityScore: patch.reliabilityScore ?? existing.reliabilityScore,
        updatedAt: todayStr,
      };

      db.suppliers = db.suppliers.map((s) => (s.id === id ? updated : s));
      return updated;
    }

    return httpRequest<Supplier>(`/api/suppliers/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: patch });
  },

  async archive(id: string): Promise<Supplier> {
    return this.update(id, { status: "archived" });
  },

  async unarchive(id: string): Promise<Supplier> {
    return this.update(id, { status: "active" });
  },

  async remove(id: string, options: { force?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const supplier = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === id);
      if (!supplier) throw new Error(`Supplier "${id}" not found`);

      // Check linked financial records to protect historical audit trails
      const hasPos = db.purchaseOrders.some((po) => po.supplierId === id);
      const hasInvoices = db.invoices.some(
        (inv) => (!inv.type || inv.type === "payable") && inv.supplierId === id,
      );
      const hasPayments = db.payments.some((p) => p.supplierId === id);

      if ((hasPos || hasInvoices || hasPayments) && !options.force) {
        throw new Error(
          `Cannot permanently delete supplier "${supplier.name}" because historical records (${[
            hasPos ? "purchase orders" : null,
            hasInvoices ? "payable invoices" : null,
            hasPayments ? "payments" : null,
          ]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(", ")}) exist. Archive the supplier instead to preserve financial history.`,
        );
      }

      db.suppliers = db.suppliers.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
      return;
    }

    return httpRequest<void>(`/api/suppliers/${id}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
      query: options.force !== undefined ? { force: options.force ? 1 : 0 } : undefined,
    });
  },
};

<file path="src/lib/config.ts">
/**
 * Runtime configuration.
 *
 * VITE_DATA_MODE: "mock" (default, fully local demo data) or "api" (live backend).
 * VITE_API_BASE_URL: base URL of the FastAPI backend, e.g. https://api.example.com
 */

function resolveDataMode(): "mock" | "api" {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem("ripple_data_mode");
      if (stored === "mock" || stored === "api") {
        return stored;
      }
    } catch {
      // Storage might be unavailable
    }
  }
  return import.meta.env["VITE_DATA_MODE"] === "api" ? "api" : "mock";
}

export const DATA_MODE: "mock" | "api" = resolveDataMode();

export function setDataMode(mode: "mock" | "api"): void {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("ripple_data_mode", mode);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    window.location.reload();
  }
}

export const API_BASE_URL: string = import.meta.env["VITE_API_BASE_URL"] || "http://127.0.0.1:8000";

export const IS_DEMO = DATA_MODE === "mock";

<file path="src/lib/formatters.ts">
import { format, parseISO, formatDistanceToNow } from "date-fns";
import type { CurrencyCode } from "@/types";

/** Format an integer amount in minor units (paise) as INR with Indian grouping. */
export function formatMoney(paise?: number | null, currency: CurrencyCode = "INR"): string {
  const safePaise = typeof paise === "number" && !Number.isNaN(paise) ? paise : 0;
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency,
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(safePaise / 100);
}

/** Compact money for tight spaces: ₹12.4k, ₹1.2L */
export function formatMoneyCompact(paise?: number | null): string {
  const safePaise = typeof paise === "number" && !Number.isNaN(paise) ? paise : 0;
  const rupees = safePaise / 100;
  const sign = rupees < 0 ? "−" : "";
  const abs = Math.abs(rupees);
  if (abs >= 100000) return `${sign}₹${(abs / 100000).toFixed(1)}L`;
  if (abs >= 1000) return `${sign}₹${(abs / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return `${sign}₹${abs.toFixed(0)}`;
}

export function formatDate(iso: string, pattern = "d MMM yyyy"): string {
  return format(parseISO(iso), pattern);
}

export function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  return format(parseISO(iso), "d MMM yyyy, h:mm a");
}

export function formatRelative(iso: string): string {
  return formatDistanceToNow(parseISO(iso), { addSuffix: true });
}

export function toISODate(date: Date): string {
  return format(date, "yyyy-MM-dd");
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery, useQueryClient, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { customerApi, enrichCustomer } from "@/lib/api/customerApi";
import { supplierApi } from "@/lib/api/supplierApi";
import { invoiceApi, type OverdueReminderPayload } from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";
import { CustomerDetailHeader } from "@/components/customers/customer-detail-header";
import { CustomerDetailMetrics } from "@/components/customers/customer-detail-metrics";
import { CustomerDetailTabs } from "@/components/customers/customer-detail-tabs";
import { CustomerDialog } from "@/components/customers/customer-dialog";
import { CustomerArchiveDialog } from "@/components/customers/customer-archive-dialog";
import { InvoiceDialog } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-dialog";
import { RecordPaymentDialog } from "@/components/invoices/record-payment-dialog";
import { OverdueReminderDialog } from "@/components/invoices/overdue-reminder-dialog";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type {
  CreateCustomerInput,
  UpdateCustomerInput,
  CreateInvoiceInput,
  RecordPaymentInput,
  Invoice,
} from "@/types";

const customerDetailQuery = (customerId: string) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["customers", "detail", customerId],
    queryFn: () => customerApi.getDetails(customerId),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/customers/$customerId")({
  loader: async ({ params, context }) => {
    await context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(customerDetailQuery(params.customerId));
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Customer Profile — Ripple" },
      { name: "description", content: "Customer detail, balance, orders, invoices and ratings." },
    ],
  }),
  component: CustomerDetailPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load customer"
      message={
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "The requested customer profile could not be found."
      }
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function CustomerDetailPage() {
  const { customerId } = Route.useParams();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data } = useSuspenseQuery(customerDetailQuery(customerId));
  const { customer, metrics } = data;

  // Dialogs
  const [editDialogOpen, setEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [archiveDialogOpen, setArchiveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [invoiceDialogOpen, setInvoiceDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [paymentDialogOpen, setPaymentDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedInvoiceForPayment, setSelectedInvoiceForPayment] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);

  const { data: customers = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["customers", "list-quick"],
    queryFn: () =>
      customerApi
        .list({ pageSize: 100 })
        .then((r) => r.data)
        .catch(() => []),
    enabled: invoiceDialogOpen,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const { data: suppliers = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["suppliers", "list-quick"],
    queryFn: () =>
      supplierApi
        .list({ pageSize: 100 })
        .then((r) => r.data)
        .catch(() => []),
    enabled: invoiceDialogOpen,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const [reminderDialogOpen, setReminderDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reminderData, setReminderData] = useState<OverdueReminderPayload | null>(null);

  const handleEditSubmit = async (formData: CreateCustomerInput | UpdateCustomerInput) => {
    await customerApi.update(customer.id, formData);
    toast.success(`Customer "${formData.name || customer.name}" updated successfully.`);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleArchiveConfirm = async () => {
    if (customer.status === "archived") {
      await customerApi.unarchive(customer.id);
    } else {
      await customerApi.archive(customer.id);
    }
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleCreateInvoice = async (formData: CreateInvoiceInput) => {
    await invoiceApi.create(formData);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleRecordPayment = (inv: Invoice) => {
    setSelectedInvoiceForPayment(inv);
    setPaymentDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePaymentSubmit = async (invoiceId: string, payInput: RecordPaymentInput) => {
    await invoiceApi.recordPayment(invoiceId, payInput);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleSendReminder = (inv: Invoice) => {
    try {
      const payload = invoiceApi.generateOverdueReminder(inv);
      setReminderData(payload);
      setReminderDialogOpen(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to generate reminder");
    }
  };

  const enrichedForArchive = enrichCustomer(customer);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <CustomerDetailHeader
        customer={customer}
        onEdit={() => setEditDialogOpen(true)}
        onArchiveToggle={() => setArchiveDialogOpen(true)}
        onCreateInvoice={() => setInvoiceDialogOpen(true)}
      />

      <CustomerDetailMetrics metrics={metrics} />

      <CustomerDetailTabs
        data={data}
        onRecordPayment={handleRecordPayment}
        onSendReminder={handleSendReminder}
        onCreateInvoice={() => setInvoiceDialogOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Edit Customer Dialog */}
      <CustomerDialog
        open={editDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditDialogOpen}
        customer={customer}
        onSubmit={handleEditSubmit}
      />

      {/* Archive Dialog */}
      <CustomerArchiveDialog
        open={archiveDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setArchiveDialogOpen}
        customer={enrichedForArchive}
        onConfirm={handleArchiveConfirm}
      />

      {/* Create Invoice Dialog */}
      <InvoiceDialog
        open={invoiceDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setInvoiceDialogOpen}
        customers={customers}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        initialType="receivable"
        preselectedCustomerId={customer.id}
        onSubmit={handleCreateInvoice}
      />

      {/* Record Payment Dialog */}
      <RecordPaymentDialog
        open={paymentDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPaymentDialogOpen}
        invoice={selectedInvoiceForPayment}
        onSubmit={handlePaymentSubmit}
      />

      {/* Overdue Reminder Dialog */}
      <OverdueReminderDialog
        open={reminderDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setReminderDialogOpen}
        reminderData={reminderData}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { invoiceApi, type OverdueReminderPayload } from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";
import { InvoiceDetailHeader } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-detail-header";
import { InvoiceDetailView } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-detail-view";
import { RecordPaymentDialog } from "@/components/invoices/record-payment-dialog";
import { OverdueReminderDialog } from "@/components/invoices/overdue-reminder-dialog";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Ban } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import type { RecordPaymentInput } from "@/types";

const invoiceDetailQuery = (invoiceId: string) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["invoices", "detail", invoiceId],
    queryFn: () => invoiceApi.getById(invoiceId),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/invoices/$invoiceId")({
  loader: async ({ params, context }) => {
    await context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(invoiceDetailQuery(params.invoiceId));
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Invoice Details — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content: "Invoice breakdown, payment history and counterparty details.",
      },
    ],
  }),
  component: InvoiceDetailPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load invoice"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "The requested invoice could not be found."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function InvoiceDetailPage() {
  const { invoiceId } = Route.useParams();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data } = useSuspenseQuery(invoiceDetailQuery(invoiceId));
  const { invoice } = data;

  // Dialogs
  const [paymentDialogOpen, setPaymentDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reminderDialogOpen, setReminderDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reminderData, setReminderData] = useState<OverdueReminderPayload | null>(null);

  const [cancelDialogOpen, setCancelDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCancelling, setIsCancelling] = useState(false);

  const handleRecordPayment = () => {
    setPaymentDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePaymentSubmit = async (invId: string, payInput: RecordPaymentInput) => {
    await invoiceApi.recordPayment(invId, payInput);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cash-flow"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleSendReminder = () => {
    try {
      const payload = invoiceApi.generateOverdueReminder(invoice);
      setReminderData(payload);
      setReminderDialogOpen(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to generate reminder");
    }
  };

  const handleCancelConfirm = async () => {
    try {
      setIsCancelling(true);
      await invoiceApi.cancel(invoice.id);
      toast.success(`Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber} cancelled.`);
      setCancelDialogOpen(false);
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      ]);
      void navigate({ to: "/invoices" });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to cancel invoice");
    } finally {
      setIsCancelling(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <InvoiceDetailHeader
        invoice={invoice}
        onRecordPayment={handleRecordPayment}
        onSendReminder={handleSendReminder}
        onCancelInvoice={() => setCancelDialogOpen(true)}
      />

      <InvoiceDetailView data={data} onRecordPayment={handleRecordPayment} />

      {/* Record Payment Dialog */}
      <RecordPaymentDialog
        open={paymentDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPaymentDialogOpen}
        invoice={invoice}
        onSubmit={handlePaymentSubmit}
      />

      {/* Overdue Reminder Dialog */}
      <OverdueReminderDialog
        open={reminderDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setReminderDialogOpen}
        reminderData={reminderData}
      />

      {/* Cancel Confirmation Dialog */}
      <AlertDialog open={cancelDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setCancelDialogOpen}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Ban className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />
              <AlertDialogTitle>Cancel Invoice {invoice.invoiceNumber}?</AlertDialogTitle>
            </div>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Cancelling will mark this invoice as void and reduce the counterparty outstanding
              balance. This action cannot be undone.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={isCancelling}>Keep Invoice</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                void handleCancelConfirm();
              }}
              disabled={isCancelling}
              className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
            >
              {isCancelling ? "Cancelling..." : "Cancel Invoice"}
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/routes/_app.suppliers.$supplierId.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { supplierApi } from "@/lib/api/supplierApi";
import { SupplierDetailHeader } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-detail-header";
import { SupplierDetailMetrics } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-detail-metrics";
import { SupplierDetailTabs } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-detail-tabs";
import { SupplierDialog } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-dialog";
import { SupplierArchiveDialog } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-archive-dialog";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import type { SupplierDetailData, UpdateSupplierInput } from "@/types";

const supplierDetailQuery = (supplierId: string) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["suppliers", "detail", supplierId],
    queryFn: () => supplierApi.getSupplierDetail(supplierId),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/suppliers/$supplierId")({
  loader: async ({ context, params }) => {
    await context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(supplierDetailQuery(params.supplierId));
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Supplier Details — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content:
          "Detailed supplier account with purchase order history, payable bills, and reliability.",
      },
      { property: "og:title", content: "Supplier Profile — Ripple" },
      {
        property: "og:description",
        content: "Vendor profile, payment terms, and delivery performance.",
      },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: SupplierDetailPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load supplier"
      message={
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "The requested supplier profile could not be found."
      }
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function SupplierDetailPage() {
  const { supplierId } = Route.useParams();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const { data } = useSuspenseQuery(supplierDetailQuery(supplierId));
  const supplierDetail: SupplierDetailData = data;

  const [editDialogOpen, setEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [archiveDialogOpen, setArchiveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [archiveMode, setArchiveMode] = useState<"archive" | "unarchive" | "delete">("archive");

  const handleUpdate = async (values: UpdateSupplierInput) => {
    await supplierApi.update(supplierId, values);
    toast.success(
      `Supplier "${values.name || supplierDetail.supplier.name}" updated successfully.`,
    );

    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["relationships"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleConfirmArchiveAction = async () => {
    if (archiveMode === "archive") {
      await supplierApi.archive(supplierId);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${supplierDetail.supplier.name}" archived.`);
    } else if (archiveMode === "unarchive") {
      await supplierApi.unarchive(supplierId);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${supplierDetail.supplier.name}" reactivated.`);
    } else if (archiveMode === "delete") {
      await supplierApi.remove(supplierId);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${supplierDetail.supplier.name}" permanently deleted.`);
      navigate({ to: "/suppliers" });
    }

    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["relationships"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const isArchived = supplierDetail.supplier.status === "archived";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header with Title, Badges, and Action Buttons */}
      <SupplierDetailHeader
        data={supplierDetail}
        onEdit={() => setEditDialogOpen(true)}
        onArchiveToggle={() => {
          setArchiveMode(isArchived ? "unarchive" : "archive");
          setArchiveDialogOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Financial & Delivery Metric Cards */}
      <SupplierDetailMetrics metrics={supplierDetail.metrics} />

      {/* Tabs: Overview, Purchase Orders, Payable Bills, Payments, Inventory */}
      <SupplierDetailTabs data={supplierDetail} />

      {/* Edit Form Modal */}
      <SupplierDialog
        open={editDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditDialogOpen}
        supplier={supplierDetail.supplier}
        onSubmit={handleUpdate}
      />

      {/* Safe Archive Confirmation Modal */}
      <SupplierArchiveDialog
        open={archiveDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setArchiveDialogOpen}
        supplier={supplierDetail.supplier}
        mode={archiveMode}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmArchiveAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

# Ripple — Project Context & Quick Reference

## Tech Stack

- **Framework & SSR**: TanStack Start (Nitro + Vite 8.1, React 19, TypeScript 5.8)
- **Routing**: TanStack Router (file-based routing with route tree generated in `src/routeTree.gen.ts`)
- **State & Data Fetching**: TanStack Query v5 (`queryOptions`, `useSuspenseQuery`, `ensureQueryData`)
- **Data Layer Architecture**: Typed API modules (`src/lib/api/*Api.ts`) branching on `DATA_MODE` (`src/lib/config.ts`):
  - `DATA_MODE="mock"` (default): reads/mutates in-memory store in `src/mocks/store.ts` seeded from `src/mocks/data.ts`
  - `DATA_MODE="api"`: calls backend via `src/lib/api/client.ts` using `VITE_API_BASE_URL`
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with OKLCH design tokens in `src/styles.css` (primary indigo, navy text, warm off-white background, success/warning/destructive status tokens)
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts
- **Testing & Tooling**: Vitest, React Testing Library, ESLint, Prettier

---

## Core Domain Rules

1. **Money**: All monetary amounts are integers in minor units (**paise** for INR, e.g. ₹1.00 = `100` paise). No floating-point math. Format using `formatMoney` from `src/lib/formatters.ts`.
2. **Dates**: ISO 8601 strings in data/API payloads (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Display formatting via `src/lib/formatters.ts` (`formatDate`, `DateLabel` with `iso` prop).
3. **Counterparty Invoices**:
   - Accounts Receivable (AR): customer invoices (`type: "receivable"`, `customerId`, `customerOrderId`).
   - Accounts Payable (AP): vendor bills (`type: "payable"`, `supplierId`, `purchaseOrderId`).
4. **Decoupled Fulfillment & Payments**: Goods receipt/delivery status is completely decoupled from payment settlement status.
5. **Data Preservation**: Archiving counterparties preserves all historical purchase orders, invoices, stock movements, and payment records.

---

```bash
npm run format        # Prettier formatting
npm run dev           # Start Vite local development server
```

---

## Targeted Task Workflow (Do NOT re-audit the codebase)

When implementing or modifying a specific feature:

1. **Types**: Check relevant interfaces in `src/types/index.ts`.
2. **API Layer**: Read/update only the relevant service in `src/lib/api/<feature>Api.ts` and its seed data in `src/mocks/data.ts`.
3. **Route**: Work directly in the route file (`src/routes/_app.<feature>.tsx`).
4. **Components**: Build or update components in `src/components/<feature>/` reusing `src/components/shared/` primitives.
5. **Verify**: Run `npm test` and `npm run build` to confirm correctness without touching unaffected modules.
