<file path="src/components/inventory/purchase-order-wizard.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  Check,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronLeft,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  AlertTriangle,
  IndianRupee,
  ExternalLink,
  FlaskConical,
  Truck,
  PackageCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { formatMoney, formatDate } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { Supplier, InventoryItemWithDetails, CreatePurchaseOrderInput } from "@/types";

interface PurchaseOrderWizardProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  suppliers: Supplier[];
  products: InventoryItemWithDetails[];
  prefilledProductId?: string | null | undefined;
  prefilledSupplierId?: string | null | undefined;
  onSubmit: (input: CreatePurchaseOrderInput) => Promise<string>; // returns created PO ID
  onSuccessNavigate?: (poId: string) => void;
}

interface LineItemState {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  quantity: number;
  unitPriceRupees: number;
}

export function PurchaseOrderWizard({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  suppliers,
  products,
  prefilledProductId,
  prefilledSupplierId,
  onSubmit,
  onSuccessNavigate,
}: PurchaseOrderWizardProps) {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5>(1);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [createdPoRef, setCreatedPoRef] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Form State
  const [selectedSupplierId, setSelectedSupplierId] = useState<string>("");
  const [supplierSearch, setSupplierSearch] = useState<string>("");
  const [lineItems, setLineItems] = useState<LineItemState[]>([]);
  const [orderDate, setOrderDate] = useState<string>(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [expectedDeliveryDate, setExpectedDeliveryDate] = useState<string>("");
  const [paymentTermsDays, setPaymentTermsDays] = useState<number>(30);
  const [advancePercent, setAdvancePercent] = useState<number>(0);
  const [advanceAmountRupees, setAdvanceAmountRupees] = useState<number>(0);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<string>("");

  const selectedSupplier = suppliers.find((s) => s.id === selectedSupplierId);

  // Initialize defaults on dialog open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setStep(1);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setCreatedPoRef(null);
      setIsSubmitting(false);

      const targetSupplierId = prefilledSupplierId || (suppliers[0]?.id ?? "");
      setSelectedSupplierId(targetSupplierId);

      const supplier = suppliers.find((s) => s.id === targetSupplierId);
      const terms = supplier?.paymentTermsDays ?? 30;
      setPaymentTermsDays(terms);

      const today = new Date();
      setOrderDate(today.toISOString().slice(0, 10));

      const deliv = new Date(today);
      deliv.setDate(today.getDate() + (supplier?.reliabilityScore ? Math.round(terms / 3) : 7));
      setExpectedDeliveryDate(deliv.toISOString().slice(0, 10));

      // Prefill product line item
      const initialProdId = prefilledProductId || (products[0]?.product.id ?? "");
      const prod = products.find((p) => p.product.id === initialProdId);
      const unitCost = prod ? prod.unitCostPaise / 100 : 350;

      setLineItems([
        {
          id: "item_1",
          productId: initialProdId,
          quantity: 20,
          unitPriceRupees: unitCost,
        },
      ]);
      setAdvancePercent(0);
      setAdvanceAmountRupees(0);
      setNotes("");
    }
  }, [open, prefilledProductId, prefilledSupplierId, suppliers, products]);

  // Calculations using decimal-safe integers
  const totalQuantity = lineItems.reduce((sum, item) => sum + (item.quantity || 0), 0);
  const subtotalPaise = lineItems.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + Math.round((item.quantity || 0) * (item.unitPriceRupees || 0) * 100),
    0,
  );
  const advancePaise = Math.round(advanceAmountRupees * 100);
  const balancePaise = Math.max(0, subtotalPaise - advancePaise);

  // Update advance amount when percent changes
  const handlePercentChange = (pct: number) => {
    setAdvancePercent(pct);
    const amountRupees = Math.round(((subtotalPaise / 100) * pct) / 100);
    setAdvanceAmountRupees(amountRupees);
  };

  const handleAdvanceAmountChange = (amount: number) => {
    setAdvanceAmountRupees(amount);
    const totalRupees = subtotalPaise / 100;
    if (totalRupees > 0) {
      setAdvancePercent(Math.round((amount / totalRupees) * 100));
    }
  };

  // Add line item
  const handleAddLineItem = () => {
    const availableProd =
      products.find((p) => !lineItems.some((li) => li.productId === p.product.id)) || products[0];
    if (!availableProd) return;

    setLineItems([
      ...lineItems,
      {
        id: `item_${Date.now()}`,
        productId: availableProd.product.id,
        quantity: 10,
        unitPriceRupees: availableProd.unitCostPaise / 100,
      },
    ]);
  };

  const handleRemoveLineItem = (id: string) => {
    if (lineItems.length <= 1) return;
    setLineItems(lineItems.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
  };

  const handleUpdateLineItem = (id: string, field: keyof LineItemState, value: unknown) => {
    setLineItems(
      lineItems.map((item) => {
        if (item.id !== id) return item;
        if (field === "productId") {
          const prod = products.find((p) => p.product.id === value);
          return {
            ...item,
            productId: String(value),
            unitPriceRupees: prod ? prod.unitCostPaise / 100 : item.unitPriceRupees,
          };
        }
        return { ...item, [field]: value };
      }),
    );
  };

  // Step Validations
  const validateStep = (currentStep: number): boolean => {
    setErrorMessage(null);
    if (currentStep === 1) {
      if (!selectedSupplierId) {
        setErrorMessage("Please select a supplier to proceed.");
        return false;
      }
    } else if (currentStep === 2) {
      if (lineItems.length === 0) {
        setErrorMessage("Please add at least one line item.");
        return false;
      }
      for (const item of lineItems) {
        if (!item.productId) {
          setErrorMessage("Please select a product for all line items.");
          return false;
        }
        if (item.quantity <= 0) {
          setErrorMessage("Quantity must be at least 1 unit.");
          return false;
        }
        if (item.unitPriceRupees < 0) {
          setErrorMessage("Unit price cannot be negative.");
          return false;
        }
      }
    } else if (currentStep === 3) {
      if (!orderDate) {
        setErrorMessage("Please specify the purchase order date.");
        return false;
      }
      if (!expectedDeliveryDate) {
        setErrorMessage("Please specify the expected delivery date.");
        return false;
      }
      if (advancePaise > subtotalPaise) {
        setErrorMessage("Advance payment cannot exceed the total order amount.");
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    if (validateStep(step)) {
      setStep((s) => (s < 5 ? ((s + 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5) : 5));
    }
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setStep((s) => (s > 1 ? ((s - 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5) : 1));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const payload: CreatePurchaseOrderInput = {
        supplierId: selectedSupplierId,
        orderDate,
        expectedDeliveryDate,
        paymentTermsDays,
        advanceAmountPaise: advancePaise,
        notes: notes || undefined,
        lineItems: lineItems.map((li) => ({
          productId: li.productId,
          quantity: li.quantity,
          unitPricePaise: Math.round(li.unitPriceRupees * 100),
        })),
      };

      const poId = await onSubmit(payload);
      setCreatedPoRef(poId);
      setStep(5);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error) {
        setErrorMessage(err.message);
      } else {
        setErrorMessage("Failed to create purchase order.");
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredSuppliers = suppliers.filter(
    (s) =>
      s.name.toLowerCase().includes(supplierSearch.toLowerCase()) ||
      s.contactName?.toLowerCase().includes(supplierSearch.toLowerCase()),
  );

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <DialogTitle>Create Purchase Order</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                Step {step} of 5: {step === 1 && "Select Supplier"}
                {step === 2 && "Configure Products & Line Items"}
                {step === 3 && "Timing & Payment Terms"}
                {step === 4 && "Review Financial Impact"}
                {step === 5 && "Confirmation & Summary"}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
            {/* Step indicator */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
                <div
                  key={s}
                  className={`h-2 w-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${
                    step === s ? "bg-primary" : step > s ? "bg-primary/40" : "bg-muted"
                  }`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        {errorMessage && (
          <Alert variant="destructive" className="my-2">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertTitle>Validation error</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{errorMessage}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {/* STEP 1: SELECT SUPPLIER */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Search suppliers</Label>
              <Input
                placeholder="Search supplier name or contact..."
                value={supplierSearch}
                onChange={(e) => setSupplierSearch(e.target.value)}
                className="mt-1 h-9"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {filteredSuppliers.map((supplier) => {
                const isSelected = selectedSupplierId === supplier.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={supplier.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedSupplierId(supplier.id);
                      setPaymentTermsDays(supplier.paymentTermsDays || 30);
                    }}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "border-primary bg-primary/5 ring-1 ring-primary/20"
                        : "hover:bg-muted/30"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">
                          {supplier.name}
                        </span>
                        {isSelected && (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="border-primary text-primary text-[10px]"
                          >
                            Selected
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex flex-wrap gap-x-3">
                        <span>Terms: {supplier.paymentTermsDays} days</span>
                        {supplier.contactName && <span>Contact: {supplier.contactName}</span>}
                        <span>Reliability: {supplier.reliabilityScore}%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">Outstanding</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                        {formatMoney(supplier.outstandingPaise)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 2: SELECT PRODUCTS */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Order Line Items</span>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleAddLineItem}
                className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add line item
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {lineItems.map((item, index) => {
                const selectedProd = products.find((p) => p.product.id === item.productId);
                const lineTotal = (item.quantity || 0) * (item.unitPriceRupees || 0);

                return (
                  <Card key={item.id} className="p-3 shadow-none border bg-card/60">
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-end gap-3">
                      {/* Product Selector */}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                        <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Product #{index + 1} <span className="text-destructive font-bold">*</span>
                        </Label>
                        <Select
                          value={item.productId}
                          onValueChange={(val) => handleUpdateLineItem(item.id, "productId", val)}
                        >
                          <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs mt-1 w-full">
                            <SelectValue placeholder="Select product" />
                          </SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectContent>
                            {products.map((p) => (
                              <SelectItem
                                key={p.product.id}
                                value={p.product.id}
                                className="text-xs"
                              >
                                {p.product.name} ({p.product.sku})
                              </SelectItem>
                            ))}
                          </SelectContent>
                        </Select>
                      </div>

                      {/* Quantity */}
                      <div className="w-full sm:w-24 shrink-0">
                        <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Qty <span className="text-destructive font-bold">*</span>
                        </Label>
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min={1}
                          placeholder="Qty"
                          value={
                            item.quantity === 0 ||
                            item.quantity === undefined ||
                            item.quantity === null
                              ? ""
                              : item.quantity
                          }
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            handleUpdateLineItem(item.id, "quantity", val === "" ? 0 : Number(val));
                          }}
                          className="h-8 text-xs mt-1 tabular-nums font-mono"
                        />
                      </div>

                      {/* Unit Price (₹) */}
                      <div className="w-full sm:w-28 shrink-0">
                        <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                          Price (₹)
                        </Label>
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min={0}
                          step="any"
                          placeholder="Price"
                          value={
                            item.unitPriceRupees === 0 || item.unitPriceRupees === undefined
                              ? ""
                              : item.unitPriceRupees
                          }
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            handleUpdateLineItem(
                              item.id,
                              "unitPriceRupees",
                              val === "" ? 0 : Number(val),
                            );
                          }}
                          className="h-8 text-xs mt-1 font-mono tabular-nums"
                        />
                      </div>

                      {/* Line Total */}
                      <div className="w-full sm:w-28 shrink-0 text-left sm:text-right">
                        <Label className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block font-medium">
                          Line Total
                        </Label>
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground leading-8 block tabular-nums">
                          {formatMoney(Math.round(lineTotal * 100))}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Remove */}
                      <div className="shrink-0 self-end">
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          disabled={lineItems.length <= 1}
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveLineItem(item.id)}
                          className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                          aria-label="Remove item"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Subtotal Banner */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/40 p-3 flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                Total Units: <span className="text-foreground font-bold">{totalQuantity}</span>
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Subtotal:</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                  {formatMoney(subtotalPaise)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 3: CONFIGURE TIMING & TERMS */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs">
                  Purchase Order Date <span className="text-destructive font-bold">*</span>
                </Label>
                <div className="relative mt-1">
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
                    value={orderDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setOrderDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="h-9 text-xs font-mono pr-9 cursor-text"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    aria-label="Pick order date"
                    className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                    value={orderDate?.slice(0, 10) || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      if (e.target.value) setOrderDate(e.target.value);
                    }}
                  />
                  <Calendar className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs">
                  Expected Delivery Date <span className="text-destructive font-bold">*</span>
                </Label>
                <div className="relative mt-1">
                  <Input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
                    value={expectedDeliveryDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setExpectedDeliveryDate(e.target.value)}
                    className="h-9 text-xs font-mono pr-9 cursor-text"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    aria-label="Pick delivery date"
                    className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                    value={expectedDeliveryDate?.slice(0, 10) || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      if (e.target.value) setExpectedDeliveryDate(e.target.value);
                    }}
                  />
                  <Calendar className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs">Payment Terms</Label>
                <Select
                  value={String(paymentTermsDays)}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setPaymentTermsDays(Number(val))}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="mt-1 h-9 text-xs">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Payment terms" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="0">Immediate / Due on receipt</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="15">Net 15 days</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="30">Net 30 days</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="45">Net 45 days</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="60">Net 60 days</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 block">
                  Supplier standard: {selectedSupplier?.paymentTermsDays || 30} days
                </span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label className="text-xs">Supplier Advance Payment</Label>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold text-primary">
                    Exact:{" "}
                    {subtotalPaise > 0
                      ? ((advancePaise / subtotalPaise) * 100).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "")
                      : "0"}
                    %
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                  <div className="w-24">
                    <Select
                      value={String(advancePercent)}
                      onValueChange={(val) => handlePercentChange(Number(val))}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger className="h-9 text-xs">
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value="0">0%</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="10">10%</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="15">15%</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="20">20%</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="25">25%</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="50">50%</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </div>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    placeholder="₹ advance"
                    value={advanceAmountRupees === 0 ? "" : advanceAmountRupees}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const val = e.target.value;
                      handleAdvanceAmountChange(val === "" ? 0 : Number(val));
                    }}
                    className="h-9 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  <span>Advance: {formatMoney(advancePaise)}</span>
                  <span>Balance on delivery: {formatMoney(balancePaise)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs">Notes or Delivery Instructions</Label>
              <Textarea
                placeholder="Include specifications, warehouse delivery dock, packing instructions..."
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                rows={2}
                className="mt-1 text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 4: REVIEW FINANCIAL IMPACT */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Supplier</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {selectedSupplier?.name}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Total Units & SKUs</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                  {totalQuantity} units across {lineItems.length} product(s)
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Order Total (Estimate)</span>
                <span className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                  {formatMoney(subtotalPaise)}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Advance Payable Now</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {advancePaise > 0 ? formatMoney(advancePaise) : "₹0 (No advance required)"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-2">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Remaining Balance Due</span>
                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {formatMoney(balancePaise)} (Net {paymentTermsDays}d after delivery)
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Expected Inventory Increase</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
                  +{totalQuantity} units on {formatDate(expectedDeliveryDate, "d MMM yyyy")}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Impact & Simulation Links */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-3 text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <FlaskConical className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                Working Capital & Forecast Impact
              </div>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed text-[11px]">
                Placing this order commits{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{formatMoney(subtotalPaise)}</span>{" "}
                in procurement outlays. You can review scheduled cash outflows on the cash flow
                forecast or simulate delay scenarios.
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-1">
                <Link
                  to="/cash-flow"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center text-primary font-medium hover:underline text-[11px]"
                >
                  Inspect Cash Flow <ExternalLink className="ml-1 h-3 w-3" />
                </Link>
                <Link
                  to="/simulator"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center text-primary font-medium hover:underline text-[11px]"
                >
                  Test in Ripple Simulator <ExternalLink className="ml-1 h-3 w-3" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground text-center">
              * Note: Calculations are projected operational estimates until the purchase order is
              confirmed.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* STEP 5: CONFIRMATION / SUCCESS */}
        {step === 5 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-6 text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-success/15 text-success">
              <PackageCheck className="h-8 w-8" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">Purchase Order Created</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
              Your purchase order reference has been logged. Incoming inventory stock counts,
              supplier commitments, and scheduled payments have been updated.
            </p>

            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 max-w-sm mx-auto text-xs space-y-1">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">PO Reference:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-foreground">{createdPoRef}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Supplier:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{selectedSupplier?.name}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Total Units:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{totalQuantity}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Total Outlay:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{formatMoney(subtotalPaise)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
                Close
              </Button>
              {createdPoRef && onSuccessNavigate && (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                    onSuccessNavigate(createdPoRef);
                  }}
                >
                  View Purchase Order
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Wizard Footer Controls */}
        {step < 5 && (
          <DialogFooter className="pt-4 border-t flex sm:justify-between items-center">
            <div>
              {step > 1 && (
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleBack}>
                  <ChevronLeft className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> Back
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>

              {step < 4 ? (
                <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={handleNext}>
                  Next <ChevronRight className="ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  {isSubmitting ? "Submitting Order..." : "Confirm & Place Purchase Order"}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </DialogFooter>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/components/inventory/stock-movement-dialog.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import * as z from "zod";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/ui/form";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Calendar } from "lucide-react";
import type {
  Product,
  InventoryItemWithDetails,
  InventoryMovementType,
  PurchaseOrder,
  CustomerOrder,
} from "@/types";

const movementSchema = z.object({
  productId: z.string().min(1, "Please select a product"),
  type: z.enum(["receipt", "sale", "reservation", "reservation_release", "adjustment", "return"]),
  quantity: z.coerce
    .number({ invalid_type_error: "Must be a valid number" })
    .int("Must be an integer")
    .min(1, "Quantity must be greater than zero"),
  date: z.string().min(1, "Date is required"),
  referenceType: z
    .enum(["purchase_order", "customer_order", "adjustment", "manual", "return"])
    .optional(),
  referenceId: z.string().optional(),
  note: z.string().optional(),
});

export type MovementFormValues = z.infer<typeof movementSchema>;

interface StockMovementDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  products: InventoryItemWithDetails[];
  purchaseOrders: PurchaseOrder[];
  customerOrders: CustomerOrder[];
  prefilledProductId?: string | null | undefined;
  onSubmit: (values: MovementFormValues) => Promise<void>;
}

export function StockMovementDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  products,
  purchaseOrders,
  customerOrders,
  prefilledProductId,
  onSubmit,
}: StockMovementDialogProps) {
  const [isReviewStep, setIsReviewStep] = useState(false);
  const [pendingValues, setPendingValues] = useState<MovementFormValues | null>(null);

  const form = useForm<MovementFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(movementSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      productId: prefilledProductId || "",
      type: "receipt",
      quantity: 1,
      date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      referenceType: "manual",
      referenceId: "",
      note: "",
    },
  });

  const selectedProductId = form.watch("productId");
  const selectedType = form.watch("type");
  const selectedQuantity = form.watch("quantity") || 0;

  const selectedProductRow = products.find((p) => p.product.id === selectedProductId);

  // Sync prefilled product
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setIsReviewStep(false);
      setPendingValues(null);
      form.reset({
        productId: prefilledProductId || products[0]?.product.id || "",
        type: "receipt",
        quantity: 1,
        date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        referenceType: "manual",
        referenceId: "",
        note: "",
      });
    }
  }, [open, prefilledProductId, products, form]);

  // Adjust reference type when movement type changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedType === "receipt") {
      form.setValue("referenceType", "purchase_order");
    } else if (
      selectedType === "sale" ||
      selectedType === "reservation" ||
      selectedType === "reservation_release"
    ) {
      form.setValue("referenceType", "customer_order");
    } else if (selectedType === "adjustment") {
      form.setValue("referenceType", "adjustment");
    } else if (selectedType === "return") {
      form.setValue("referenceType", "return");
    }
  }, [selectedType, form]);

  // Filter POs and COs for selected product
  const relevantPurchaseOrders = purchaseOrders.filter(
    (po) =>
      po.productId === selectedProductId ||
      po.lineItems?.some((li) => li.productId === selectedProductId),
  );

  const relevantCustomerOrders = customerOrders.filter((co) => co.productId === selectedProductId);

  // Check if material adjustment requires review step (> 10 units or > 20% of stock)
  const isMaterialAdjustment =
    selectedType === "adjustment" &&
    (selectedQuantity >= 10 ||
      (selectedProductRow &&
        selectedProductRow.stockOnHand > 0 &&
        selectedQuantity / selectedProductRow.stockOnHand >= 0.2));

  const handleFormSubmit = async (values: MovementFormValues) => {
    // If adjustment requires note
    if (values.type === "adjustment" && (!values.note || values.note.trim() === "")) {
      form.setError("note", { message: "A reason is mandatory for stock adjustments." });
      return;
    }

    // Material adjustment review step
    if (isMaterialAdjustment && !isReviewStep) {
      setPendingValues(values);
      setIsReviewStep(true);
      return;
    }

    try {
      await onSubmit(values);
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error) {
        form.setError("root", { message: err.message });
      }
    }
  };

  const confirmMaterialAdjustment = async () => {
    if (!pendingValues) return;
    try {
      await onSubmit(pendingValues);
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error) {
        form.setError("root", { message: err.message });
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 text-left">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary mt-0.5">
              <ArrowRight className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle>
                {isReviewStep ? "Review Material Stock Adjustment" : "Record Stock Movement"}
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-1 text-xs">
                {isReviewStep
                  ? "Please confirm this high-impact stock adjustment before applying."
                  : "Record stock receipts, sales fulfillments, reservations, or inventory adjustments."}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        {form.formState.errors.root && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertTitle>Operation error</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription>{form.formState.errors.root.message}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {isReviewStep && pendingValues && selectedProductRow ? (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-warning/50 bg-warning/10 p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-warning-foreground font-semibold text-sm">
                <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                Material Stock Adjustment Confirmation
              </div>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                You are adjusting stock for{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {selectedProductRow.product.name}
                </span>{" "}
                ({selectedProductRow.product.sku}) by{" "}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {pendingValues.quantity} units
                </span>
                .
              </p>
              <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="rounded bg-background/80 p-2 border">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">Current On-Hand</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">
                    {selectedProductRow.stockOnHand}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded bg-background/80 p-2 border">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">Reason</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{pendingValues.note}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <DialogFooter className="pt-4 border-t">
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsReviewStep(false)}>
                Back to Edit
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="destructive"
                onClick={confirmMaterialAdjustment}
                disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}
              >
                Confirm & Apply Adjustment
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Form {...form}>
            <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(handleFormSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Product Selector */}
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="productId"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>
                      Product <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Select value={field.value} onValueChange={field.onChange}>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder="Select product" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                          {products.map((p) => (
                            <SelectItem key={p.product.id} value={p.product.id}>
                              {p.product.name} ({p.product.sku}) — {p.stockOnHand} on hand
                            </SelectItem>
                          ))}
                        </SelectContent>
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                    {selectedProductRow && (
                      <FormDescription className="text-[11px]">
                        Available: {selectedProductRow.availableStock} · Reserved:{" "}
                        {selectedProductRow.reservedStock} · Reorder point:{" "}
                        {selectedProductRow.reorderThreshold}
                      </FormDescription>
                    )}
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              {/* Movement Type */}
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="type"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>
                      Movement type <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Select
                        value={field.value}
                        onValueChange={(val) => field.onChange(val as InventoryMovementType)}
                      >
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder="Select type" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                        <SelectContent>
                          <SelectItem value="receipt">Stock Receipt (PO / Vendor)</SelectItem>
                          <SelectItem value="sale">Sale / Customer Fulfillment</SelectItem>
                          <SelectItem value="reservation">Reserve Stock</SelectItem>
                          <SelectItem value="reservation_release">Release Reservation</SelectItem>
                          <SelectItem value="adjustment">
                            Stock Adjustment (Count / Shrinkage)
                          </SelectItem>
                          <SelectItem value="return">Return (Customer / Vendor)</SelectItem>
                        </SelectContent>
                      </Select>
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {/* Quantity */}
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="quantity"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>
                        Quantity <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                      </FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <Input
                          type="number"
                          min={1}
                          placeholder="Enter quantity"
                          value={
                            field.value === 0 || field.value === undefined || field.value === null
                              ? ""
                              : field.value
                          }
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            field.onChange(val === "" ? 0 : Number(val));
                          }}
                          className="tabular-nums"
                        />
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />

                {/* Date & Time */}
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="date"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>
                        Date &amp; Time <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                      </FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        <div className="relative">
                          <Input
                            type="text"
                            placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD"
                            className="pr-10 font-mono text-xs cursor-text"
                            value={field.value || ""}
                            onChange={(e) => field.onChange(e.target.value)}
                          />
                          <input
                            type="date"
                            aria-label="Pick date from calendar"
                            className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-6 h-6 opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                            value={field.value?.slice(0, 10) || ""}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              if (e.target.value) {
                                field.onChange(e.target.value);
                              }
                            }}
                          />
                          <Calendar className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        </div>
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Dynamic References */}
              {selectedType === "receipt" && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="referenceId"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Related Purchase Order</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        {relevantPurchaseOrders.length > 0 ? (
                          <Select
                            value={field.value || "manual"}
                            onValueChange={(val) => field.onChange(val === "manual" ? "" : val)}

                            <SelectTrigger>
                              <SelectValue placeholder="Select purchase order" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                              <SelectItem value="manual">None / Direct Supplier Invoice</SelectItem>

                                <SelectItem key={po.id} value={po.id}>
                                  {po.poNumber || po.id} ({po.quantity} units, status: {po.status})

                              ))}

                          <Input
                            placeholder="Enter PO number or invoice reference (e.g. PO-2026-001)"
                            {...field}
                          />
                        )}
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormDescription className="text-[11px]">
                        Receiving against a PO updates ordered and received unit counts.
                      </FormDescription>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {(selectedType === "sale" || selectedType === "reservation") && (
                <FormField
                  control={form.control}
                  name="referenceId"
                  render={({ field }) => (
                    <FormItem>
                      <FormLabel>Related Customer Order</FormLabel>
                      <FormControl>
                        {relevantCustomerOrders.length > 0 ? (
                          <Select
                            value={field.value || "manual"}
                            onValueChange={(val) => field.onChange(val === "manual" ? "" : val)}
                          >
                            <SelectTrigger>
                              <SelectValue placeholder="Select customer order" />
                            </SelectTrigger>
                            <SelectContent>
                              <SelectItem value="manual">None / Retail Sale</SelectItem>
                              {relevantCustomerOrders.map((co) => (
                                <SelectItem key={co.id} value={co.id}>
                                  {co.id} ({co.quantity} units, delivery: {co.deliveryDate || "TBD"}
                                  )
                                </SelectItem>
                              ))}
                            </SelectContent>
                          </Select>
                        ) : (
                          <Input placeholder="Enter customer order ID (e.g. CO-101)" {...field} />
                        )}
                      </FormControl>
                      <FormMessage />
                    </FormItem>
                  )}
                />
              )}

              {/* Note / Reason */}
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="note"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>
                      {selectedType === "adjustment" ? (
                        <>
                          Reason for adjustment{" "}
                          <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        "Optional note"
                      )}
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Textarea
                        placeholder={
                          selectedType === "adjustment"
                            ? "Mandatory explanation (e.g. physical cycle count discrepancy, damaged bolt, shrinkage)..."
                            : "Reference notes, delivery vehicle info, invoice number..."
                        }
                        rows={2}
                        {...field}
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <DialogFooter className="pt-4 border-t">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}>
                  {form.formState.isSubmitting ? "Recording..." : "Record Movement"}
                </Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </form>
          </Form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import { MarkerType, type Node, type Edge } from "@xyflow/react";
import type { RelationshipGraphData, RelationshipGraphNode, RelationshipGraphEdge } from "@/types";
import type { CustomNodeData, LaneHeaderData } from "./relationship-node";

// Deterministic stage positions (X-coordinates by process sequence)
export const STAGE_X: Record<string, number> = {

// Deterministic vertical positions (Y-coordinates)

// Exact ER Diagram Port / Handle Mappings to eliminate all edge overlaps
export const EDGE_HANDLES: Record<string, { sourceHandle: string; targetHandle: string }> = {
  // Chain 1: Primary Operating Cycle
  edge_sup_to_adv: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_adv_to_po: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_po_to_deliv: { sourceHandle: "right-upper", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_po_to_balpay: { sourceHandle: "right-lower", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_deliv_to_stock: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_deliv_to_risk: { sourceHandle: "bottom", targetHandle: "top" },
  edge_pay3_to_risk: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_stock_to_co: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_cus_to_co: { sourceHandle: "bottom", targetHandle: "top" },
  edge_co_to_inv: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_inv_to_rec: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },

  // Chain 2: Secondary Cycle (Mehta Fabrics)
  edge_sup2_to_po2: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_po2_to_deliv2: { sourceHandle: "right-upper", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_po2_to_pay: { sourceHandle: "right-lower", targetHandle: "left" },

  // Chain 3: Customer Receivables (Style Mart)
  edge_cus2_to_inv1999: { sourceHandle: "right-upper", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_cus2_to_co2: { sourceHandle: "right-lower", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_co2_to_inv2002: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
  edge_inv2002_to_rec2002: { sourceHandle: "right", targetHandle: "left" },
};

export interface GraphAdapterOptions {
  selectedNodeId?: string | null | undefined;
  filteredNodeIds?: Set<string> | undefined;
}

export function computeDependencySets(
  selectedNodeId: string | undefined | null,
  edges: RelationshipGraphEdge[],
) {
  const upstreamNodeIds = new Set<string>();
  const downstreamNodeIds = new Set<string>();
  const highlightedEdgeIds = new Set<string>();

  if (!selectedNodeId) {
    return { upstreamNodeIds, downstreamNodeIds, highlightedEdgeIds };
  }

  // Traverse upstream (incoming edges)
  const upstreamQueue = [selectedNodeId];
  while (upstreamQueue.length > 0) {
    const current = upstreamQueue.shift()!;
    const incomingEdges = edges.filter((e) => e.target === current);
    for (const edge of incomingEdges) {
      highlightedEdgeIds.add(edge.id);
      if (!upstreamNodeIds.has(edge.source)) {
        upstreamNodeIds.add(edge.source);
        upstreamQueue.push(edge.source);
      }
    }
  }

  // Traverse downstream (outgoing edges)
  const downstreamQueue = [selectedNodeId];
  while (downstreamQueue.length > 0) {
    const current = downstreamQueue.shift()!;
    const outgoingEdges = edges.filter((e) => e.source === current);
    for (const edge of outgoingEdges) {
      highlightedEdgeIds.add(edge.id);
      if (!downstreamNodeIds.has(edge.target)) {
        downstreamNodeIds.add(edge.target);
        downstreamQueue.push(edge.target);
      }
    }
  }

  return { upstreamNodeIds, downstreamNodeIds, highlightedEdgeIds };
}

export function adaptToReactFlow(
  data: RelationshipGraphData,
  options: GraphAdapterOptions = {},
): {
  nodes: Node<CustomNodeData | LaneHeaderData>[];
  edges: Edge[];
} {
  const { selectedNodeId, filteredNodeIds } = options;

  const { upstreamNodeIds, downstreamNodeIds, highlightedEdgeIds } = computeDependencySets(
    selectedNodeId,
    data.edges,
  );

  const isSelectionActive = Boolean(selectedNodeId);

  // Transform Nodes
  const nodes: Node<CustomNodeData>[] = data.nodes
    .filter((n) => !filteredNodeIds || filteredNodeIds.has(n.id))
    .map((node, index) => {
      const isSelected = node.id === selectedNodeId;
      const isUpstream = upstreamNodeIds.has(node.id);
      const isDownstream = downstreamNodeIds.has(node.id);
      const isConnected = isSelected || isUpstream || isDownstream;
      const isDimmed = isSelectionActive && !isConnected;

      // Deterministic layout with fallback grid
      const x = STAGE_X[node.id] ?? 80 + (index % 5) * 320;
      const y = STAGE_Y[node.id] ?? 100 + Math.floor(index / 5) * 160;

      return {
        id: node.id,
        type: "custom",
        position: { x, y },
        data: {
          node,
          isSelected,
          isUpstream,
          isDownstream,
          isDimmed,
        },
      };
    });

  // Lane Header Annotations for structured swimlanes
  const laneNodes: Node<LaneHeaderData>[] = [
    {
      id: "lane_1",
      type: "lane_header",
      position: { x: 60, y: -260 },
      data: {
        title: "Chain 1: Primary Operating Cycle",
        subtitle: "Shree Textiles → Fabrication → Urban Threads Boutique · Risk Point Day 5",
        badge: "Critical Path",
        badgeVariant: "destructive",
      },
      selectable: false,
      draggable: false,
    },
    {
      id: "lane_2",
      type: "lane_header",
      position: { x: 60, y: 570 },
      data: {
        title: "Chain 2: Secondary Procurement",
        subtitle: "Mehta Fabrics → Linen Shirt PO-2 & Day 11 Delivery · Net-45 Terms",
        badge: "Active Restock",
        badgeVariant: "secondary",
      },
      selectable: false,
      draggable: false,
    },
    {
      id: "lane_3",
      type: "lane_header",
      position: { x: 60, y: 1150 },
      data: {
        title: "Chain 3: Receivables & Collections",
        subtitle: "Style Mart → Overdue INV-1999 Collection & Day 39 Settlement",
        badge: "Overdue Attention",
        badgeVariant: "warning",
      },
      selectable: false,
      draggable: false,
    },
  ];

  const allNodes =
    filteredNodeIds && filteredNodeIds.size < data.nodes.length ? nodes : [...laneNodes, ...nodes];

  // Transform Edges
  const validNodeIds = new Set(nodes.map((n) => n.id));

  const edges: Edge[] = data.edges
    .filter((e) => validNodeIds.has(e.source) && validNodeIds.has(e.target))
    .map((edge) => {
      const isHighlighted = highlightedEdgeIds.has(edge.id);
      const isDimmed = isSelectionActive && !isHighlighted;
      const isAtRisk = edge.status === "at_risk";
      const isDelayed = edge.status === "delayed";
      const shouldShowLabel = isHighlighted || isAtRisk || isDelayed;

      const handles = EDGE_HANDLES[edge.id] || {
        sourceHandle: "right",
        targetHandle: "left",
      };

      return {
        id: edge.id,
        source: edge.source,
        target: edge.target,
        sourceHandle: handles.sourceHandle,
        targetHandle: handles.targetHandle,
        type: "custom",
        data: {
          description: edge.description,
          isHighlighted,
          isAtRisk,
          isDelayed,
          isDimmed,
          status: edge.status,
        },
        markerEnd: {
          type: MarkerType.ArrowClosed,
          width: 13,
          height: 13,
          color: isHighlighted
            ? "var(--primary)"
            : isAtRisk
              ? "var(--warning)"
              : isDelayed
                ? "var(--destructive)"
                : "var(--muted-foreground)",
        },
      };
    });

  return { nodes: allNodes, edges };
}

<file path="src/components/simulator/simulator-chart.tsx">
import {
  AreaChart,
  Area,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  CartesianGrid,
  Tooltip,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
} from "recharts";
import { format, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import { formatMoney, formatMoneyCompact } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { ForecastPoint } from "@/types";

export type ChartView = "both" | "baseline" | "scenario";

interface SimulatorChartProps {
  baselinePoints: ForecastPoint[];
  scenarioPoints: ForecastPoint[];
  horizonDays: number;
  view: ChartView;
}

interface ChartDataPoint {
  date: string;
  baseline: number;
  scenario: number;
}

function SimulatorTooltip({
  active,
  payload,
  label,
  view,
}: {
  active?: boolean | undefined;
  // Recharts hands over its own `Payload` shape, where name/value are widened
  // unions and may be absent. Mirroring that keeps the spread in <Tooltip /> legal
  // AND stops `entry.value * 100` from silently producing NaN.
  payload?:
    | Array<{
        name?: string | number | undefined;
        value?: string | number | ReadonlyArray<string | number> | undefined;
        color?: string | undefined;
      }>
    | undefined;
  label?: string | undefined;
  view: ChartView;
}) {
  if (!active || !payload || payload.length === 0 || !label) return null;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/80 bg-card px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-sm min-w-44">
      <div className="font-semibold text-foreground mb-1.5 pb-1 border-b border-border/40 text-[11px]">
        {format(parseISO(label), "d MMM yyyy")}
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1 tabular-nums">
        {payload.map((entry, index) => {
          const name = String(entry.name ?? `series-${index}`);
          const raw = entry.value;
          const value = Number(Array.isArray(raw) ? (raw[0] ?? 0) : (raw ?? 0));
          return (
            <div key={name} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color }}
                />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground capitalize text-[11px]">
                  {entry.name === "baseline" ? "Baseline" : "Simulated"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span
                className={
                  value < 0
                    ? "font-mono font-medium text-destructive"
                    : value < 5000
                      ? "font-mono font-medium text-warning-foreground"
                      : "font-mono font-medium text-foreground"
                }
              >
                {formatMoney(Math.round(value * 100))}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function SimulatorChart({
  baselinePoints,
  scenarioPoints,
  horizonDays,
  view,
}: SimulatorChartProps) {
  const showBaseline = view === "both" || view === "baseline";
  const showScenario = view === "both" || view === "scenario";

  // Merge both point arrays into a unified date-keyed series
  const dateSet = new Set<string>();
  baselinePoints.forEach((p) => dateSet.add(p.date));
  scenarioPoints.forEach((p) => dateSet.add(p.date));

  const baselineMap = new Map(baselinePoints.map((p) => [p.date, p]));
  const scenarioMap = new Map(scenarioPoints.map((p) => [p.date, p]));

  const chartData: ChartDataPoint[] = Array.from(dateSet)
    .sort()
    .map((date) => ({
      date,
      baseline: (baselineMap.get(date)?.projectedBalancePaise ?? 0) / 100,
      scenario: (scenarioMap.get(date)?.projectedBalancePaise ?? 0) / 100,
    }));

  // Compute Y-axis domain from visible series only
  const visibleValues = chartData.flatMap((d) => {
    const vals: number[] = [];
    if (showBaseline) vals.push(d.baseline);
    if (showScenario) vals.push(d.scenario);
    return vals;
  });
  const minValue = Math.min(...visibleValues, 0);
  const maxValue = Math.max(...visibleValues, 0);
  const padding = Math.max((maxValue - minValue) * 0.1, 500);

  const ariaLabel =
    view === "both"
      ? `Baseline vs simulated cash balance over ${horizonDays} days`
      : view === "baseline"
        ? `Baseline cash balance over ${horizonDays} days`
        : `Simulated cash balance over ${horizonDays} days`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {/* Chart Canvas: 320px desktop height, responsive */}
      <div className="h-72 sm:h-80 w-full" role="img" aria-label={ariaLabel}>
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <AreaChart data={chartData} margin={{ top: 8, right: 12, left: -4, bottom: 0 }}>
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="sim-baselineFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.12} />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--color-primary)" stopOpacity={0.0} />
              </linearGradient>
              <linearGradient id="sim-scenarioFill" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor="var(--color-warning)" stopOpacity={0.16} />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor="var(--color-warning)" stopOpacity={0.0} />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>

            <CartesianGrid
              strokeDasharray="2 2"
              stroke="var(--color-border)"
              strokeOpacity={0.4}
              vertical={false}
            />

            <XAxis
              dataKey="date"
              tickFormatter={(iso: string) => format(parseISO(iso), "d MMM")}
              tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={false}
              minTickGap={32}
            />

            <YAxis
              tickFormatter={(v: number) => formatMoneyCompact(Math.round(v * 100))}
              tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)" }}
              tickLine={false}
              axisLine={false}
              width={56}
              domain={[minValue - padding, maxValue + padding]}
            />

            <Tooltip content={(props) => <SimulatorTooltip {...props} view={view} />} />

            {/* Zero line */}
            <ReferenceLine
              y={0}
              stroke="var(--color-destructive)"
              strokeDasharray="3 3"
              strokeOpacity={0.5}
            />
            {/* Safety threshold ₹5,000 */}
            <ReferenceLine
              y={5000}
              stroke="var(--color-warning)"
              strokeDasharray="2 2"
              strokeOpacity={0.45}
              label={{
                value: "Safety buffer",
                position: "insideTopRight",
                fontSize: 10,
                fill: "var(--color-muted-foreground)",
              }}
            />

            {showBaseline && (
              <Area
                type="monotone"
                dataKey="baseline"
                name="baseline"
                stroke="var(--color-primary)"
                strokeWidth={1.5}
                fill="url(#sim-baselineFill)"
                dot={false}
                activeDot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 0, fill: "var(--color-primary)" }}
              />
            )}

            {showScenario && (
              <Area
                type="monotone"
                dataKey="scenario"
                name="scenario"
                stroke="var(--color-warning)"
                strokeWidth={2}
                strokeDasharray={view === "scenario" ? undefined : "5 3"}
                fill="url(#sim-scenarioFill)"
                dot={false}
                activeDot={{ r: 4, strokeWidth: 0, fill: "var(--color-warning)" }}
              />
            )}
          </AreaChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>

      {/* Subtle Legend Bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground px-1 pt-1 border-t border-border/40">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          {showBaseline && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-0.5 w-4 bg-primary rounded-full inline-block" />
              <span>Baseline trajectory</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {showScenario && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="h-0.5 w-4 border-b-2 border-dashed border-warning inline-block" />
              <span>Simulated outcome</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/75">Safety reserve: ₹5,000</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

                }

                    setField("supplierPaymentAmountPaise", null);

                    const num = parseFloat(val);
                    setField(
                      "supplierPaymentAmountPaise",

                className="h-8 text-xs tabular-nums"
              />

            {/* Supplier delay */}

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                  {Math.round(controls.orderQuantityMultiplier * 100)}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <Slider
                min={0.1}
                max={3.0}
                step={0.1}
                value={[controls.orderQuantityMultiplier]}
                onValueChange={([v]) => setField("orderQuantityMultiplier", v ?? 1.0)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Horizon */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Forecast horizon</Label>
              <Select
                value={String(controls.horizonDays)}
                onValueChange={(v) => setField("horizonDays", Number(v) as 7 | 14 | 30)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="7">7 days</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="14">14 days</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="30">30 days</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
