import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { MoneyAmount } from "@/components/shared/money-amount";
import { DateLabel } from "@/components/shared/date-label";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle,
  TrendingDown,
  Calendar,
  Package,
  Zap,
  Lightbulb,
  Info,
  Layers,
  Lock,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
} from "lucide-react";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SimulatorResult } from "@/lib/api/simulationApi";
import type { SimulatorTimelineNode } from "@/types";
import { SimulatorTrueMarginCard } from "./simulator-true-margin";
import { isCurrentBusinessDemo } from "@/lib/simulatorStore";
import { getStoredBusiness } from "@/lib/api/authApi";

interface SimulatorResultsProps {
  result: SimulatorResult;
}

function ScoreBar({ score }: { score: number }) {
  const color = score >= 70 ? "bg-destructive" : score >= 40 ? "bg-warning" : "bg-success";
  return (
    <div className="relative h-2 w-full rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
      <div
        className={cn("absolute inset-y-0 left-0 rounded-full transition-all", color)}
        style={{ width: `${score}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function FactorRow({
  label,
  value,
  max,
  description,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  max: number;
  description: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-0.5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
        <span className="tabular-nums font-medium">
          {value} / {max}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-1 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-primary/70"
          style={{ width: `${(value / max) * 100}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export function SimulatorResults({ result }: SimulatorResultsProps) {
  const [showDiagnostics, setShowDiagnostics] = useState(false);
  const {
    baselineClosingPaise,
    scenarioClosingPaise,
    baselineMinPaise,
    baselineMinDate,
    scenarioMinPaise,
    scenarioMinDate,
    shortfallPaise,
    affectedDependencies,
    rippleScore,
    recommendations,
  } = result;

  const deltaClosing = scenarioClosingPaise - baselineClosingPaise;
  const hasShortfall = shortfallPaise < 0;
  const isBelowThreshold = scenarioMinPaise < 500_000 && !hasShortfall;

  const scoreLabel =
    rippleScore.totalScore >= 70 ? "High Risk" : rippleScore.totalScore >= 40 ? "Moderate" : "Low";
  const scoreSentiment =
    rippleScore.totalScore >= 70
      ? "text-destructive"
      : rippleScore.totalScore >= 40
        ? "text-warning-foreground"
        : "text-success";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ── Level 1: Primary Risk Banner if Shortfall ── */}
      {hasShortfall && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="mt-0.5 rounded-full p-1.5 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive shrink-0">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-destructive">
                Cash shortage risk identified: -{formatMoney(Math.abs(shortfallPaise))}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                Simulated balance drops below safety reserve on{" "}
                <DateLabel iso={scenarioMinDate} className="inline font-medium text-foreground" />.
                {recommendations[0] ? ` Action: ${recommendations[0].title}.` : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-xs shrink-0 font-medium"
          >
            Risk Mitigation Required
          </Badge>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Level 1: Clean 4-Metric Summary Row with Subtle Dividers ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card divide-y md:divide-y-0 md:divide-x divide-border/60 shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] overflow-hidden">
        {/* 1. Simulated Closing Cash */}
        <div className="p-4">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Simulated closing
          </p>
          <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
            <span
              className={cn(
                "text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums",
                hasShortfall ? "text-destructive" : "text-foreground",
              )}
            >
              {formatMoney(scenarioClosingPaise)}
            </span>
            {deltaClosing !== 0 && (
              <MoneyAmount paise={deltaClosing} signed className="text-xs font-mono font-medium" />
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            Baseline closing: {formatMoney(baselineClosingPaise)}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Minimum Cash Balance */}
        <div className="p-4">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Min cash balance
          </p>
          <p
            className={cn(
              "mt-1 text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums",
              scenarioMinPaise < 0
                ? "text-destructive"
                : isBelowThreshold
                  ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                  : "text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {formatMoney(scenarioMinPaise)}
          </p>
          <DateLabel
            iso={scenarioMinDate}
            className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block"
          />
        </div>

        {/* 3. Change Against Baseline / Shortfall */}
        <div className="p-4">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            {hasShortfall ? "Cash shortfall" : "Change vs baseline"}
          </p>
          <p
            className={cn(
              "mt-1 text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums",
              hasShortfall
                ? "text-destructive"
                : deltaClosing < 0
                  ? "text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"
                  : "text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {hasShortfall
              ? `-${formatMoney(Math.abs(shortfallPaise))}`
              : deltaClosing === 0
                ? "₹0.00"
                : deltaClosing > 0
                  ? `+${formatMoney(deltaClosing)}`
                  : `-${formatMoney(Math.abs(deltaClosing))}`}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {hasShortfall ? "Below safety threshold" : "Net scenario variance"}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* 4. Affected Downstream Events */}
        <div className="p-4">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
            Affected events
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-foreground">
            {affectedDependencies.length}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            {affectedDependencies.length === 0
              ? "No cascading shifts"
              : `${affectedDependencies.length} downstream shift${affectedDependencies.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Feature B: Ripple-Adjusted True Margin Card ── */}
      {result.trueMargin && <SimulatorTrueMarginCard margin={result.trueMargin} />}

      {/* ── Level 3: Deep Risk Diagnostics & Recommendations (Expandable) ── */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card p-4 space-y-3 shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowDiagnostics((v) => !v)}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <span>Risk analysis & recommendations</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground hidden sm:inline">
              · Downstream impact, ripple score & mitigation advice
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-primary flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
            {showDiagnostics ? "Hide details ▲" : "View calculation & details ▼"}
          </span>
        </button>

        <div
          className={cn(
            "grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/60",
            !showDiagnostics && "hidden",
          )}
        >
          {/* Affected dependencies */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-muted/15 p-3.5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-border/40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Downstream Impact</h4>
              </div>
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="text-[10px] font-mono border-border/60 text-muted-foreground"
              >
                {affectedDependencies.length} event{affectedDependencies.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-snug">
              {affectedDependencies.length === 0
                ? "No downstream events are impacted by this scenario."
                : `${affectedDependencies.length} event${affectedDependencies.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} shifted or modified`}
            </p>
            {affectedDependencies.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4 text-center">
                <CheckCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-success mb-1.5" aria-hidden />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No cascading impacts detected</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="space-y-2 divide-y divide-border/40">
                {affectedDependencies.map((dep) => (
                  <li key={dep.entityId} className="pt-2 first:pt-0">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate">{dep.label}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                          {dep.impactDescription}
                        </p>
                        {dep.originalDate && dep.shiftedDate && (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                            <DateLabel iso={dep.originalDate} className="inline" /> →{" "}
                            <DateLabel iso={dep.shiftedDate} className="inline" />
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {dep.shiftDays !== 0 && (
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className="shrink-0 border-transparent bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground text-[10px]"
                        >
                          +{dep.shiftDays}d
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Ripple Impact Score */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-muted/15 p-3.5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-border/40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Ripple Impact Score</h4>
              </div>
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className={cn(
                  "text-[10px] font-semibold",
                  rippleScore.totalScore >= 70
                    ? "border-transparent bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
                    : rippleScore.totalScore >= 40
                      ? "border-transparent bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground"
                      : "border-transparent bg-success/10 text-success",
                )}
              >
                {scoreLabel}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between pt-1">
              <span className={cn("text-2xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums", scoreSentiment)}>
                {rippleScore.totalScore}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                0 (no risk) – 100 (critical)
              </span>
            </div>
            <ScoreBar score={rippleScore.totalScore} />

            <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-1">
              <FactorRow
                label="Cash shortfall severity"
                value={rippleScore.cashShortfallFactor}
                max={40}
                description="Negative balance depth and safety-threshold breach"
              />
              <FactorRow
                label="Delay magnitude"
                value={rippleScore.delayMagnitudeFactor}
                max={25}
                description="Combined supplier + customer delay days"
              />
              <FactorRow
                label="Downstream count"
                value={rippleScore.downstreamCountFactor}
                max={20}
                description="Number of cascading affected events"
              />
              <FactorRow
                label="Liquidity gap"
                value={rippleScore.liquidityGapFactor}
                max={15}
                description="Difference between baseline and simulated minimums"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Recommendations */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-muted/15 p-3.5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-border/40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Lightbulb className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Actionable Steps</h4>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                {recommendations.length} action{recommendations.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-snug">
              Steps to protect liquidity based on scenario output.
            </p>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {recommendations.map((rec) => (
                <div
                  key={rec.id}
                  className={cn(
                    "rounded-md border p-2.5 space-y-1 bg-card",
                    rec.priority === "high"
                      ? "border-destructive/30"
                      : rec.priority === "medium"
                        ? "border-warning/30"
                        : "border-border/60",
                  )}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground leading-snug">{rec.title}</p>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className={cn(
                        "shrink-0 text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider",
                        rec.priority === "high"
                          ? "border-transparent bg-destructive/10 text-destructive"
                          : rec.priority === "medium"
                            ? "border-transparent bg-warning/15 text-warning-foreground"
                            : "border-transparent bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      {rec.priority}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                    {rec.rationale}
                  </p>
                  {rec.impactPaise !== undefined && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-medium text-primary">
                      Impact: {formatMoney(rec.impactPaise)}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Empty state shown before first simulation run
export function SimulatorEmptyState() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center space-y-3 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-border bg-muted/20">
      <div className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center">
        <TrendingDown className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" aria-hidden />
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Adjust controls, then run simulation</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Baseline and simulated cash flow will appear here with a full impact analysis.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Error state
export function SimulatorErrorState({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5">
      <AlertTriangle className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" aria-hidden />
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Simulation failed</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-sm">{message}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Canonical Timeline / Dependency View ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SimulatorEventTimelineProps {
  result: SimulatorResult;
  onInspectNode?: (node: SimulatorTimelineNode) => void;
  onAutoPhaseClick?: (node: SimulatorTimelineNode) => void;
  onSplitEscrowClick?: (node: SimulatorTimelineNode) => void;
  onRevertRescues?: () => void;
}

export function SimulatorEventTimeline({
  result,
  onInspectNode,
  onAutoPhaseClick,
  onSplitEscrowClick,
  onRevertRescues,
}: SimulatorEventTimelineProps) {
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const toggleNode = (nodeId: string) => {
    setExpandedId((prev) => (prev === nodeId ? null : nodeId));
  };

  const isDemo = isCurrentBusinessDemo();
  const storedBiz = typeof window !== "undefined" ? getStoredBusiness() : null;
  const bizName = storedBiz?.name || "Your Business";

  // Use authoritative timelineNodes if provided, else construct sensible defaults
  const nodes: SimulatorTimelineNode[] = result.timelineNodes ?? (isDemo ? [
    {
      id: "node-apex",
      label: "Apex Corp (INV-2001)",
      type: "customer_receivable",
      dayLabel: "Day 15 (Delayed to Day 31)",
      date: "Day 31",
      amountPaise: 50_000_000,
      direction: "incoming",
      status: "Delayed +16d",
      counterparty: "Apex Corp",
      description: "Customer invoice receivable delayed from Day 15 to Day 31.",
      fragility: {
        nodeId: "node-apex",
        multiplier: 20.0,
        isKeystone: true,
        badgeText: "Ripple Risk: 20x",
        badgeVariant: "destructive",
        downstreamValueAtRiskPaise: 80_000_000,
        invoiceAmountPaise: 4_000_000,
        exposedOrders: ["Kaveri Timber (PO-1) ₹1.2L", "Metro Retail (ORD-801) ₹1.65L"],
      },
    },
    {
      id: "node-kaveri",
      label: "Kaveri Timber (PO-1)",
      type: "supplier_payable",
      dayLabel: "Day 18",
      date: "Day 18",
      amountPaise: 12_000_000,
      direction: "outgoing",
      status: "At Risk (₹20k Shortfall)",
      counterparty: "Kaveri Timber",
      description: "Raw material timber commitment required for Metro Retail fulfillment.",
      isEligibleForAutoPhase: true,
      isEligibleForSplitEscrow: true,
    },
    {
      id: "node-metro",
      label: "Metro Retail (ORD-801)",
      type: "downstream_fulfillment",
      dayLabel: "Day 25",
      date: "Day 25",
      amountPaise: 16_500_000,
      direction: "incoming",
      status: "Downstream Endangered",
      counterparty: "Metro Retail",
      description: "Downstream order blocked if timber from Kaveri Timber is halted.",
    },
  ] : [
    {
      id: "node_opening_cash",
      label: "Opening Cash Reserve",
      type: "cash_reserve",
      dayLabel: "Day 0",
      date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      amountPaise: storedBiz?.openingCashPaise ?? 1_000_000,
      direction: "balance",
      status: "completed",
      counterparty: `${bizName} Treasury`,
      description: `Initial usable balance with ₹${Math.round((storedBiz?.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000) / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")} safety buffer.`,
    },
  ]);

  const hasActiveRescue = result.hasAutoPhaseRescue || result.hasSplitEscrowRescue;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card overflow-hidden shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-4 border-b border-border/60 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" aria-hidden />
            Chronological Scenario Timeline & Dependency Graph
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            Interactive financial dependency nodes, fragility multipliers, and real-time cash flow
            rescues.
          </p>
        </div>

        {hasActiveRescue && onRevertRescues && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={onRevertRescues}
            className="text-xs h-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive border-dashed border-border/70"
          >
            Revert Scenario Rescues
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Active Rescue Banner */}
      {hasActiveRescue && (
        <div className="border-b border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 px-4 sm:px-6 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              <strong>Active Financial Rescue Applied:</strong> Cash flows, safety buffers, and
              margins are dynamically protected.
            </span>
          </div>
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/20 text-[10px]"
          >
            {result.hasAutoPhaseRescue ? "Auto-Phased" : "Tri-Party Escrow Locked"}
          </Badge>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bypass Arc Visual Banner if Split-Escrow is active */}
      {nodes.some((n) => n.hasBypassArc) && (
        <div className="border-b border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-4 sm:px-6 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground font-medium">
            <Lock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
            <span>Tri-Party Split-Escrow Bypass Active:</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">
              {(() => {
                const srcNode = nodes.find((n) => n.hasBypassArc);
                const targetNode = nodes.find((n) => n.id === srcNode?.bypassTargetId);
                if (srcNode && targetNode) {
                  return `${srcNode.counterparty} Receivable (${srcNode.dayLabel}) directly satisfies ${targetNode.counterparty} (${targetNode.dayLabel}). Ordinary business cash outflow is ₹0.`;
                }
                return "Customer receivable directly satisfies supplier commitment with zero ordinary business cash outflow.";
              })()}
            </span>
          </div>
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20 text-[10px]"
          >
            Zero-Cash Bypass
          </Badge>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Chronological Timeline Nodes List */}
      <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
        {nodes.map((node) => {
          const fragility = node.fragility;
          const isStressedFragile = node.isMostFragileUnderStress;
          const isExpanded = expandedId === node.id;

          return (
            <div
              key={node.id}
              className={cn(
                "group relative transition-colors",
                isStressedFragile
                  ? "bg-purple-50/40 dark:bg-purple-950/15"
                  : node.hasBypassArc
                    ? "bg-primary/5"
                    : "hover:bg-muted/30",
              )}
            >
              {/* Row header */}
              <div className="p-3.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                  {/* Sequence dot */}
                  <div className="pt-0.5 sm:pt-0 shrink-0">
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ring-4 ring-background transition-transform",
                        isStressedFragile
                          ? "bg-purple-600 ring-purple-100 dark:ring-purple-900/40"
                          : node.direction === "incoming"
                            ? "bg-emerald-500"
                            : node.direction === "outgoing"
                              ? "bg-slate-400 dark:bg-slate-600"
                              : "bg-primary",
                      )}
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Timing & Counterparty */}
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:gap-4">
                    <div className="shrink-0 w-36 sm:w-44">
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono font-medium text-muted-foreground block truncate">
                        {node.dayLabel}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground truncate block">
                        {node.counterparty}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Event title & Badges */}
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 mt-1 sm:mt-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate">
                          {node.label}
                        </span>

                        {/* Fragility Multiplier Badge */}
                        {fragility && (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            onClick={() => onInspectNode && onInspectNode(node)}
                            className={cn(
                              "cursor-pointer text-[10px] font-semibold transition-all hover:scale-105",
                              fragility.isKeystone
                                ? "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive shadow-xs"
                                : "border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground",
                            )}
                          >
                            <Zap className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                            {fragility.badgeText}
                          </Badge>
                        )}

                        {/* Purple Stress-Test Badge */}
                        {isStressedFragile && (
                          <Badge className="bg-purple-600 text-white hover:bg-purple-700 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-xs">
                            <Zap className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 fill-white" />
                            MOST FRAGILE UNDER STRESS
                          </Badge>
                        )}

                        {/* Node Status Badge */}
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal border-border/60"
                        >
                          {node.status}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate mt-0.5 hidden md:block">
                        {node.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Right side: Amount + Contextual Actions + Disclosure */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end gap-3 shrink-0 pt-2 sm:pt-0 border-t sm:border-t-0 border-border/40">
                  <div className="text-left sm:text-right">
                    <p
                      className={cn(
                        "text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold font-mono tabular-nums",
                        node.direction === "incoming"
                          ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                          : "text-foreground",
                      )}
                    >
                      {node.direction === "incoming"
                        ? "+"
                        : node.direction === "outgoing"
                          ? "-"
                          : ""}
                      {formatMoney(node.amountPaise)}
                    </p>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase font-medium">
                      {node.direction}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Contextual actions: only on eligible rows! */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    {node.isEligibleForAutoPhase && onAutoPhaseClick && (
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => onAutoPhaseClick(node)}
                        className="h-7 text-xs gap-1 border-primary/30 text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 shadow-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Auto-Phase Inventory
                      </Button>
                    )}

                    {node.isEligibleForSplitEscrow && onSplitEscrowClick && (
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => onSplitEscrowClick(node)}
                        className="h-7 text-xs gap-1 border-primary/30 text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 shadow-xs font-medium"
                      >
                        <Lock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow
                      </Button>
                    )}

                    {/* Disclosure Control */}
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => toggleNode(node.id)}
                      className="h-7 px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
                    >
                      <span className="hidden sm:inline">Inspect</span>
                      <ChevronDown
                        className={cn(
                          "h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform duration-200",
                          isExpanded && "rotate-180",
                        )}
                      />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Expandable inline detail panel */}
              {isExpanded && (
                <div className="px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 bg-muted/20 border-t border-border/50 text-xs space-y-3 animate-in fade-in-50">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                        Event Details
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-foreground mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                        {node.description}
                      </p>
                      <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground space-y-0.5 font-mono">
                        <p>
                          Type: <span className="text-foreground">{node.type}</span>
                        </p>
                        <p>
                          Effective Date: <span className="text-foreground">{node.date}</span>
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                        Downstream Impact & Dependencies
                      </p>
                      {fragility ? (
                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1.5">
                          <p className="text-xs text-foreground">
                            Keystone node with{" "}
                            <span className="font-semibold text-destructive">
                              {fragility.multiplier}x propagation fragility
                            </span>
                            .
                          </p>
                          {fragility.exposedOrders && fragility.exposedOrders.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">Exposed orders: </span>
                              {fragility.exposedOrders.join(", ")}
                            </div>
                          )}
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                            Value at risk:{" "}
                            <span className="font-mono font-medium text-destructive">
                              {formatMoney(fragility.downstreamValueAtRiskPaise)}
                            </span>
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                          Standard operational commitment. No critical fragility multipliers
                          assigned.
                        </p>
                      )}

                      <div className="pt-2">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => onInspectNode && onInspectNode(node)}
                          className="h-7 text-xs text-primary p-0 hover:bg-transparent hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
                        >
                          <Info className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          Inspect Downstream Dependencies
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import * as z from "zod";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/ui/form";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Building2 } from "lucide-react";
import type { Supplier, CreateSupplierInput, UpdateSupplierInput } from "@/types";

const supplierFormSchema = z.object({
  name: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(2, "Supplier name must be at least 2 characters")
    .max(100, "Supplier name cannot exceed 100 characters"),
  contactName: z.string().trim().max(100).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  email: z.string().trim().email("Please enter a valid email address").optional().or(z.literal("")),
  phone: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(/^[+0-9\s-()]{7,20}$/, "Please enter a valid phone number")
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal("")),
  address: z.string().trim().max(250).optional().or(z.literal("")),
  taxId: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9]{5,20}$/, "Tax ID must be 5-20 alphanumeric characters (e.g. GSTIN)")
    .optional()
    .or(z.literal("")),
  paymentTermsDays: z
    .number({ invalid_type_error: "Must be a valid number of days" })
    .int("Must be an integer")
    .min(0, "Payment terms cannot be negative")
    .max(365, "Payment terms cannot exceed 365 days"),
  // NOTE: no `.default()` here. A zod default makes the schema's *input* type
  // optional while `z.infer` yields the *output* type where the field is required,
  // which desynchronises `zodResolver(schema)` from `useForm<SupplierFormValues>`.
  // Defaults live in `defaultValues` / `form.reset` instead.
  leadTimeDays: z
    .number({ invalid_type_error: "Must be a valid number of days" })
    .int("Must be an integer")
    .min(0, "Lead time cannot be negative")
    .max(365, "Lead time cannot exceed 365 days"),
  status: z.enum(["active", "archived"]),
  notes: z.string().trim().max(500).optional().or(z.literal("")),
});

export type SupplierFormValues = z.infer<typeof supplierFormSchema>;

interface SupplierDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  supplier?: Supplier | null; // null for Create, Supplier object for Edit
  onSubmit: (values: CreateSupplierInput | UpdateSupplierInput) => Promise<void>;
}

export function SupplierDialog({ open, onOpenChange, supplier, onSubmit }: SupplierDialogProps) {
  const isEditing = Boolean(supplier);

  const form = useForm<SupplierFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(supplierFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: "",
      contactName: "",
      email: "",
      phone: "",
      address: "",
      taxId: "",
      paymentTermsDays: 30,
      leadTimeDays: 7,
      status: "active",
      notes: "",
    },
  });

  const { isSubmitting } = form.formState;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      if (supplier) {
        form.reset({
          name: supplier.name,
          contactName: supplier.contactName ?? "",
          email: supplier.email ?? "",
          phone: supplier.phone ?? "",
          address: supplier.address ?? "",
          taxId: supplier.taxId ?? "",
          paymentTermsDays: supplier.paymentTermsDays ?? 30,
          leadTimeDays: supplier.leadTimeDays ?? 7,
          status: supplier.status ?? "active",
          notes: supplier.notes ?? "",
        });
      } else {
        form.reset({
          name: "",
          contactName: "",
          email: "",
          phone: "",
          address: "",
          taxId: "",
          paymentTermsDays: 30,
          leadTimeDays: 7,
          status: "active",
          notes: "",
        });
      }
    }
  }, [open, supplier, form]);

  const handleSubmit = async (values: SupplierFormValues) => {
    const payload: CreateSupplierInput = {
      name: values.name.trim(),
      contactName: values.contactName?.trim() || undefined,
      email: values.email?.trim() || undefined,
      phone: values.phone?.trim() || undefined,
      address: values.address?.trim() || undefined,
      taxId: values.taxId?.trim() || undefined,
      paymentTermsDays: values.paymentTermsDays,
      leadTimeDays: values.leadTimeDays,
      status: values.status,
      notes: values.notes?.trim() || undefined,
    };

    try {
      await onSubmit(payload);
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save supplier";
      if (message.toLowerCase().includes("name") && message.toLowerCase().includes("exists")) {
        form.setError("name", { message });
      } else {
        form.setError("root", { message });
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[560px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-left">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary mt-0.5">
              <Building2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle>{isEditing ? "Edit Supplier" : "Add New Supplier"}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
                {isEditing
                  ? "Update vendor contact details, tax identification, and settlement terms."
                  : "Register a verified counterparty for purchase orders, payable invoices, and stock deliveries."}
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        <Form {...form}>
          <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(handleSubmit)} className="space-y-4">
            {form.formState.errors.root && (
              <div className="rounded-md bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-sm font-medium text-destructive">
                {form.formState.errors.root.message}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="name"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <FormLabel>
                      Supplier / Company Name{" "}
                      <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="e.g. Shree Textiles Pvt Ltd" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="contactName"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Primary Contact Person</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="e.g. Anil Shree" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="taxId"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Tax Identifier (GSTIN)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="e.g. 24AAACS1234F1Z8" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="email"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Email Address</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input type="email" placeholder="orders@supplier.in" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="phone"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Phone Number</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input placeholder="+91 98200 12345" {...field} />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="paymentTermsDays"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>
                      Payment Terms (Days){" "}
                      <span className="text-destructive font-bold ml-0.5">*</span>
                    </FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        max="365"
                        placeholder="30"
                        value={field.value === 0 || field.value === undefined ? "" : field.value}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          field.onChange(e.target.value === "" ? 0 : Number(e.target.value))
                        }
                        className="tabular-nums"
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormDescription className="text-xs">
                      Default invoice credit window (e.g. Net 30)
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}
                name="leadTimeDays"
                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem>
                    <FormLabel>Fulfillment Lead Time (Days)</FormLabel>
                    <FormControl>
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        min="0"
                        max="365"
                        placeholder="7"
                        value={field.value === 0 || field.value === undefined ? "" : field.value}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          field.onChange(e.target.value === "" ? 0 : Number(e.target.value))
                        }
                        className="tabular-nums"
                      />
                    </FormControl>
                    <FormDescription className="text-xs">
                      Expected days from PO dispatch to warehouse delivery
                    </FormDescription>
                    <FormMessage />
                  </FormItem>
                )}
              />

              <FormField
                control={form.control}

                render={({ field }) => (
                  <FormItem className="sm:col-span-2">
                    <FormLabel>Operational Status</FormLabel>
                    <Select onValueChange={field.onChange} value={field.value}>
                      <FormControl>
                        <SelectTrigger>
                          <SelectValue placeholder="Select status" />
                        </SelectTrigger>
                      </FormControl>
                      <SelectContent>

<file path="src/lib/api/client.ts">
import { API_BASE_URL } from "@/lib/config";
import type { ApiErrorBody } from "@/types";

/**
 * Centralized HTTP client for the FastAPI backend.
 * Used only when VITE_DATA_MODE=api. Mock mode never touches the network.
 */

const AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = "ripple_auth_token";
const ACTIVE_BIZ_KEY = "ripple_active_biz_id";

function safeStorage(): Storage | null {
  try {
    if (
      typeof window !== "undefined" &&
      window.localStorage &&
      typeof window.localStorage.getItem === "function"
    ) {
      return window.localStorage;
    }
  } catch {
    // localStorage might be blocked or unavailable
  }
  return null;
}

export function getAuthToken(): string | null {
  const storage = safeStorage();
  return storage ? storage.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY) : null;
}

export function setAuthToken(token: string | null): void {
  const storage = safeStorage();
  if (!storage) return;
  if (token) {
    storage.setItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
  } else {
    storage.removeItem(AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
  }
}

export function getActiveBusinessId(): string | null {
  const storage = safeStorage();
  return storage ? storage.getItem(ACTIVE_BIZ_KEY) : null;
}

export function setActiveBusinessId(id: string | null): void {
  const storage = safeStorage();
  if (!storage) return;
  if (id) {
    storage.setItem(ACTIVE_BIZ_KEY, id);
  } else {
    storage.removeItem(ACTIVE_BIZ_KEY);
  }
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    public code: string,
    message: string,
    public fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

interface RequestOptions {
  method?: "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "PUT" | "DELETE" | undefined;
  body?: unknown;
  signal?: AbortSignal | undefined;
  query?: Record<string, string | number | undefined> | undefined;
  headers?: Record<string, string> | undefined;
}

export async function httpRequest<T>(path: string, options: RequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
  const { method = "GET", body, signal, query, headers: extraHeaders = {} } = options;

  const baseUrl =
    API_BASE_URL ||
    (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location.origin
      ? window.location.origin
      : "http://127.0.0.1:8000");

  const cleanBase = baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "");
  const cleanPath = path.replace(/^\//, "");
  const url = new URL(path.startsWith("http") ? path : `${cleanBase}/${cleanPath}`);

  if (query) {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
      if (value !== undefined) url.searchParams.set(key, String(value));
    }
  }

  const token = getAuthToken();
  const activeBizId = getActiveBusinessId();

  const reqHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
    ...extraHeaders,
  };

  if (body !== undefined) {
    reqHeaders["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
  }

  if (token) {
    reqHeaders["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }

  if (activeBizId) {
    reqHeaders["x-business-id"] = activeBizId;
  }

  let response!: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
      method,
      headers: reqHeaders,
      ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
      ...(body !== undefined ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === "AbortError") throw err;

    // On Windows, 'localhost' resolves to IPv6 '::1' first, which may timeout if the backend
    // binds only to IPv4 (0.0.0.0 / 127.0.0.1). Retry once directly using 127.0.0.1.
    let retried = false;
    if (url.hostname === "localhost") {
      try {
        const retryUrl = new URL(url.toString());
        retryUrl.hostname = "127.0.0.1";
        response = await fetch(retryUrl.toString(), {
          method,
          headers: reqHeaders,
          ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
          ...(body !== undefined ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}),
        });
        retried = true;
      } catch {
        // Fall through to error reporting
      }
    }

    if (!retried) {
      const isHttps = typeof window !== "undefined" && window.location.protocol === "https:";
      const targetIsHttp = url.protocol === "http:";
      if (isHttps && targetIsHttp) {
        throw new ApiError(
          0,
          "network_error",
          `Mixed Content blocked: Insecure HTTP backend (${url.origin}) cannot be called from an HTTPS page. Switch to Demo Mode or use an HTTPS backend proxy.`,
        );
      }
      throw new ApiError(
        0,
        "network_error",
        `Could not reach the server at ${url.origin}. Please ensure the backend is running.`,
      );
    }
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorBody: ApiErrorBody | undefined;
    try {
      errorBody = (await response.json()) as ApiErrorBody;
    } catch {
      // non-JSON error body
    }

    // Handle 401 unauthorized
    if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined") {
      const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
      if (!currentPath.includes("/login") && !currentPath.includes("/register")) {
        setAuthToken(null);
        // Dispatch custom event or redirect
        window.location.href = "/login";
      }
    }

    const detailMsg = errorBody?.detail || errorBody?.error?.message;
    throw new ApiError(
      response.status,
      errorBody?.error?.code ?? (response.status === 401 ? "unauthorized" : "http_error"),
      detailMsg ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`,
      errorBody?.error?.fieldErrors,
    );
  }

  // Handle empty responses (204 No Content, empty body) safely.
  const text = await response.text();
  if (!text) return undefined as T;
  return JSON.parse(text) as T;
}

import * as seed from "./data";

/**
 * In-memory mock store. Mutations persist for the session (shared across
 * pages) and reset on reload — no backend required.
 */

function clone<T>(value: T): T {
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T;
}

export function delay(ms = 350): Promise<void> {

export function nextId(prefix: string): string {

<file path="src/routes/_app.cash-flow.tsx">
import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { forecastApi } from "@/lib/api/forecastApi";
import {
  CashFlowHeader,
  type ForecastHorizon,
  type CashFlowViewMode,
} from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-header";
import { CashFlowSummaryCards } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-summary-cards";
import { CashFlowScenarioBanner } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-scenario-banner";
import { CashFlowChartView } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-chart-view";
import { CashFlowLedgerView } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-ledger-view";
import { CashFlowTimelineView } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-timeline-view";
import { CashFlowSafetyDialog } from "@/components/cash-flow/cash-flow-safety-dialog";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/formatters";
import type { ForecastResponse, SimulationScenario } from "@/types";

interface CashFlowSearchParams {
  horizon?: ForecastHorizon | undefined;
  view?: CashFlowViewMode | undefined;
  scenarioId?: string | undefined;
  threshold?: number | undefined;
}

const scenariosQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["simulations", "scenarios"],
  queryFn: () => forecastApi.getScenarios(),
});

const makeForecastQuery = (
  horizon: ForecastHorizon = 30,
  scenarioId?: string,
  thresholdPaise?: number,
) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["forecast", { horizon, scenarioId, thresholdPaise }],
    queryFn: () =>
      forecastApi.getForecast({
        days: horizon,
        scenarioId,
        safetyThresholdPaise: thresholdPaise,
      }),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/cash-flow")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): CashFlowSearchParams => {
    const rawHorizon = Number(search["horizon"]);
    const validHorizons: ForecastHorizon[] = [7, 14, 30, 60, 90];
    const horizon: ForecastHorizon = validHorizons.includes(rawHorizon as ForecastHorizon)
      ? (rawHorizon as ForecastHorizon)
      : 30;

    const rawView = search["view"];
    const view: CashFlowViewMode =
      rawView === "ledger" || rawView === "timeline" ? rawView : "chart";

    const scenarioId =
      typeof search["scenarioId"] === "string" && search["scenarioId"].trim() !== ""
        ? search["scenarioId"]
        : undefined;

    const rawThreshold = Number(search["threshold"]);
    const threshold = !isNaN(rawThreshold) && rawThreshold >= 0 ? rawThreshold : undefined;

    return {
      horizon,
      view,
      scenarioId,
      threshold,
    };
  },
  loader: async ({ context, location }) => {
    const rawSearch = location.search as CashFlowSearchParams;
    const horizon = rawSearch.horizon ?? 30;
    const scenarioId = rawSearch.scenarioId;
    const threshold = rawSearch.threshold;

    await Promise.all([
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(scenariosQuery),
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(makeForecastQuery(horizon, scenarioId, threshold)),
    ]);
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Cash Flow — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content:
          "Day-by-day cash flow forecast, daily ledger, upcoming timeline, safety threshold analysis and simulation comparison for Rupi Clothing.",
      },
      { property: "og:title", content: "Cash Flow — Ripple" },
      {
        property: "og:description",
        content: "Understand your future cash position before commitments become problems.",
      },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: CashFlowPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load Cash Flow forecast"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load forecast data."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function CashFlowPage() {
  const search = Route.useSearch();
  const navigate = Route.useNavigate();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const horizon: ForecastHorizon = search.horizon ?? 30;
  const viewMode: CashFlowViewMode = search.view ?? "chart";
  const scenarioId = search.scenarioId;
  const thresholdPaise = search.threshold;

  const [safetyDialogOpen, setSafetyDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  // Queries
  const { data: scenariosData } = useSuspenseQuery(scenariosQuery);
  const scenarios: SimulationScenario[] = scenariosData ?? [];

  const { data: forecastData, refetch } = useSuspenseQuery(
    makeForecastQuery(horizon, scenarioId, thresholdPaise),
  );
  const forecast: ForecastResponse = forecastData;

  // Handlers for URL search parameter synchronization
  const handleHorizonChange = useCallback(
    (newHorizon: ForecastHorizon) => {
      navigate({
        search: (prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          horizon: newHorizon,
        }),
      });
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  const handleViewModeChange = useCallback(
    (newView: CashFlowViewMode) => {
      navigate({
        search: (prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          view: newView,
        }),
      });
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  const handleScenarioChange = useCallback(
    (newScenarioId: string | undefined) => {
      navigate({
        search: (prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          scenarioId: newScenarioId,
        }),
      });
    },
    [navigate],
  );

  const handleSaveSafetyThreshold = async (newThresholdPaise: number) => {
    try {
      await forecastApi.updateSafetyThreshold(newThresholdPaise);
      navigate({
        search: (prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          threshold: newThresholdPaise,
        }),
      });
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["forecast"] });
      toast.success(`Safety threshold updated to ${formatMoney(newThresholdPaise)}`);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to update safety threshold.");
    }
  };

  // CSV Export action
  const handleExportCsv = useCallback(() => {
    if (!forecast || !forecast.dailyLedger) return;

    const headers = [
      "Date",
      "Opening Cash (INR)",
      "Expected Inflows (INR)",
      "Other Inflows (INR)",
      "Total Inflows (INR)",
      "Supplier Payments (INR)",
      "Operating Expenses (INR)",
      "Other Outflows (INR)",
      "Total Outflows (INR)",
      "Net Movement (INR)",
      "Closing Cash (INR)",
      "Safety Buffer (INR)",
      "Shortfall (INR)",
      "Status",
      "Transactions Count",
      "Events Summary",
    ];

    const rows = forecast.dailyLedger.map((entry) => {
      const eventsSummary =
        entry.events.length === 0
          ? "No events scheduled"
          : entry.events
              .map(
                (e) =>
                  `${e.label.replace(/["\r\n,]+/g, " ")} (${e.direction === "incoming" ? "+INR " : "-INR "}${(e.amountPaise / 100).toFixed(2)})`,
              )
              .join("; ");

      return [
        entry.date,
        (entry.openingBalancePaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.expectedIncomingPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.otherInflowsPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.totalInflowsPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.supplierPaymentsPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.operatingExpensesPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.otherOutflowsPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.totalOutflowsPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.netMovementPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.closingBalancePaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (forecast.safetyThresholdPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        (entry.shortfallPaise / 100).toFixed(2),
        entry.status,
        entry.events.length,
        `"${eventsSummary.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      ];
    });

    const csvContent = [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((r) => r.join(","))].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    const filename = `ripple-cash-flow-forecast-${horizon}d-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;

    link.setAttribute("href", url);
    link.setAttribute("download", filename);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    toast.success(`Exported ${horizon}-day forecast to CSV (${forecast.dailyLedger.length} days)`);
  }, [forecast, horizon]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page Header with Horizon, View, Threshold, and Scenario controls */}
      <CashFlowHeader
        horizon={horizon}
        onHorizonChange={handleHorizonChange}
        viewMode={viewMode}
        onViewModeChange={handleViewModeChange}
        safetyThresholdPaise={forecast.safetyThresholdPaise}
        onOpenSafetyDialog={() => setSafetyDialogOpen(true)}
        selectedScenarioId={scenarioId}
        onScenarioChange={handleScenarioChange}
        scenarios={scenarios}
        onExportCsv={handleExportCsv}
      />

      {/* Scenario comparison banner (when scenario active) */}
      {forecast.scenario && (
        <CashFlowScenarioBanner
          scenario={forecast.scenario}
          onClearScenario={() => handleScenarioChange(undefined)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Attention Highlight: Chart, Ledger, or Timeline first directly after info/header controls */}
      {viewMode === "chart" && <CashFlowChartView forecast={forecast} />}

      {viewMode === "ledger" && (
        <CashFlowLedgerView
          ledger={forecast.dailyLedger}
          safetyThresholdPaise={forecast.safetyThresholdPaise}
        />
      )}

      {viewMode === "timeline" && (
        <CashFlowTimelineView
          events={forecast.events}
          safetyThresholdPaise={forecast.safetyThresholdPaise}
        />
      )}

      {/* Financial Summary Metrics */}
      <div className="pt-2">
        <CashFlowSummaryCards forecast={forecast} />
      </div>

      {/* Safety Threshold configuration modal */}
      <CashFlowSafetyDialog
        open={safetyDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSafetyDialogOpen}
        currentThresholdPaise={forecast.safetyThresholdPaise}
        onSave={handleSaveSafetyThreshold}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  queryOptions,
  useSuspenseQuery,
  useQueryClient,
  useQuery,
  keepPreviousData,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { CustomerSummaryCards } from "@/components/customers/customer-summary-cards";
import { CustomerTable } from "@/components/customers/customer-table";
import { CustomerDialog } from "@/components/customers/customer-dialog";
import { CustomerArchiveDialog } from "@/components/customers/customer-archive-dialog";
import { customerApi, type CustomerListFilterParams } from "@/lib/api/customerApi";
import { PlusCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { EnrichedCustomer, CreateCustomerInput, UpdateCustomerInput } from "@/types";

interface CustomersSearchParams {
  search?: string | undefined;
  status?: "all" | "active" | "archived" | undefined;
  overdueStatus?: "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy" | undefined;
  sortBy?: "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

const customerSummaryQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["customers", "summary"],
  queryFn: () => customerApi.getSummaryMetrics(),
});

const customersListQuery = (params: CustomerListFilterParams) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["customers", "list", params],
    queryFn: () => customerApi.list(params),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/customers/")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): CustomersSearchParams => {
    const s = typeof search["search"] === "string" ? search["search"] : undefined;
    const status =
      search["status"] === "active" || search["status"] === "archived" || search["status"] === "all"
        ? (search["status"] as "all" | "active" | "archived")
        : "all";
    const overdueStatus =
      search["overdueStatus"] === "has_overdue" ||
      search["overdueStatus"] === "healthy" ||
      search["overdueStatus"] === "all"
        ? (search["overdueStatus"] as "all" | "has_overdue" | "healthy")
        : "all";
    const sortBy =
      search["sortBy"] === "name" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "outstanding" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "reliability"
        ? (search["sortBy"] as "name" | "outstanding" | "reliability")
        : "name";
    const sortDir = search["sortDir"] === "desc" ? "desc" : "asc";

    return {
      search: s,
      status,
      overdueStatus,
      sortBy,
      sortDir,
    };
  },
  loader: async ({ context }) => {
    await Promise.all([
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(customerSummaryQuery),
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(customersListQuery({})),
    ]);
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Customers — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content: "Customer directory, credit terms, receivables, and payment reliability ratings.",
      },
    ],
  }),
  component: CustomersIndexPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load customers"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load customer records."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function CustomersIndexPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const searchParams = Route.useSearch();
  const navigate = Route.useNavigate();

  const { data: metrics } = useSuspenseQuery(customerSummaryQuery);
  const { data: listResponse = { data: [], total: 0, page: 1, limit: 50 } } = useQuery({
    ...customersListQuery(searchParams),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  // Dialog state
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedForEdit, setSelectedForEdit] = useState<EnrichedCustomer | null>(null);

  const [archiveDialogOpen, setArchiveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedForArchive, setSelectedForArchive] = useState<EnrichedCustomer | null>(null);

  const updateSearch = (patch: Partial<CustomersSearchParams>) => {
    void navigate({
      search: (prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        ...patch,
      }),
    });
  };

  const handleCreateCustomer = () => {
    setSelectedForEdit(null);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditCustomer = (customer: EnrichedCustomer) => {
    setSelectedForEdit(customer);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleArchiveToggle = (customer: EnrichedCustomer) => {
    setSelectedForArchive(customer);
    setArchiveDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleFormSubmit = async (data: CreateCustomerInput | UpdateCustomerInput) => {
    if (selectedForEdit) {
      await customerApi.update(selectedForEdit.id, data);
      toast.success(`Customer "${data.name || selectedForEdit.name}" updated successfully.`);
    } else {
      await customerApi.create(data as CreateCustomerInput);
      toast.success(`Customer "${data.name}" created successfully.`);
    }
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleArchiveConfirm = async () => {
    if (!selectedForArchive) return;
    if (selectedForArchive.status === "archived") {
      await customerApi.unarchive(selectedForArchive.id);
    } else {
      await customerApi.archive(selectedForArchive.id);
    }
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Customers"
        description="Every customer account, credit payment terms, receivables ledger, and payment reliability ratings."
        actions={
          <Button onClick={handleCreateCustomer} size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
            <PlusCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            New Customer
          </Button>
        }
      />

      <CustomerSummaryCards metrics={metrics} />

      <CustomerTable
        customers={listResponse.data}
        search={searchParams.search ?? ""}
        onSearchChange={(search) => updateSearch({ search: search || undefined })}
        statusFilter={searchParams.status ?? "all"}
        onStatusFilterChange={(status) => updateSearch({ status })}
        overdueFilter={searchParams.overdueStatus ?? "all"}
        onOverdueFilterChange={(overdueStatus) => updateSearch({ overdueStatus })}
        sortBy={searchParams.sortBy ?? "name"}
        onSortByChange={(sortBy) => updateSearch({ sortBy })}
        onEdit={handleEditCustomer}
        onArchiveToggle={handleArchiveToggle}
      />

      {/* Create / Edit Dialog */}
      <CustomerDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        customer={selectedForEdit}
        onSubmit={handleFormSubmit}
      />

      {/* Archive Confirmation Dialog */}
      <CustomerArchiveDialog
        open={archiveDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setArchiveDialogOpen}
        customer={selectedForArchive}
        onConfirm={handleArchiveConfirm}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
