function InventoryPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const navigate = useNavigate({ from: Route.fullPath });
  const searchParams = Route.useSearch();

  // Suspense Queries
  const {
    data: inventoryData,
    isLoading,
    error,
    refetch: refetchInventory,
  } = useSuspenseQuery(inventoryListQuery);
  const { data: summaryMetrics } = useSuspenseQuery(inventorySummaryQuery);
  const { data: suppliersData } = useSuspenseQuery(suppliersQuery);
  const { data: purchaseOrdersData } = useSuspenseQuery(purchaseOrdersQuery);
  const { data: reordersData } = useSuspenseQuery(reorderRecommendationsQuery);
  const { data: alertsData } = useSuspenseQuery(inventoryRiskAlertsQuery);

  const items = inventoryData?.data ?? [];
  const suppliers = suppliersData?.data ?? [];
  const purchaseOrders = purchaseOrdersData?.data ?? [];
  const reorders = reordersData ?? [];
  const alerts = alertsData ?? [];

  // Local UI State
  const activeTab = searchParams.tab || "items";
  const searchFilter = searchParams.search || "";
  const categoryFilter = searchParams.category || "all";
  const statusFilter = searchParams.status || "all";
  const selectedProductId = searchParams.selectedProductId || null;
  const selectedPoId = searchParams.selectedPoId || null;

  // Dialog States
  const [isProductDialogOpen, setIsProductDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingProduct, setEditingProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  const [isMovementDialogOpen, setIsMovementDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [movementPrefillProductId, setMovementPrefillProductId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [isPoWizardOpen, setIsPoWizardOpen] = useState(false);
  const [poPrefillProductId, setPoPrefillProductId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [poPrefillSupplierId, setPoPrefillSupplierId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Detail Sheet Query for Selected Product
  const selectedProductDetailQuery = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["inventory", "detail", selectedProductId],
    queryFn: () => (selectedProductId ? inventoryApi.getById(selectedProductId) : null),
    enabled: Boolean(selectedProductId),
  });

  // Selected PO Detail
  const selectedPoDetail = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedPoId) return null;
    return purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === selectedPoId) || null;
  }, [selectedPoId, purchaseOrders]);

  // Distinct categories
  const categories = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const item of items) {
      if (item.product.category) set.add(item.product.category);
    }
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [items]);

  // Filtered Inventory Items
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    return items.filter((item) => {
      if (searchFilter.trim()) {
        const q = searchFilter.toLowerCase().trim();
        const matchesName = item.product.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesSku = item.product.sku.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesCat = item.product.category?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!matchesName && !matchesSku && !matchesCat) return false;
      }
      if (categoryFilter !== "all" && item.product.category !== categoryFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      if (statusFilter !== "all" && item.status !== statusFilter) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [items, searchFilter, categoryFilter, statusFilter]);

  // Handlers for URL search params updates
  const handleUpdateSearch = (patch: Partial<InventorySearchParams>) => {
    navigate({
      search: (prev) => {
        const updated = { ...prev, ...patch };
        // Clean undefined or empty strings
        if (!updated.search) delete updated.search;
        if (updated.category === "all") delete updated.category;
        if (updated.status === "all") delete updated.status;
        if (!updated.selectedProductId) delete updated.selectedProductId;
        if (!updated.selectedPoId) delete updated.selectedPoId;
        return updated;
      },
    });
  };

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    navigate({
      search: (prev) => ({
        tab: prev.tab,
      }),
    });
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = Boolean(
    searchFilter.trim() !== "" || categoryFilter !== "all" || statusFilter !== "all",
  );

  // Invalidate all inventory-related queries
  const invalidateAll = async () => {
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["inventory"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["purchase-orders"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard", "summary"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["forecast"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["relationships", "graph"] }),
    ]);
  };

  // Product Add / Edit Handler
  const handleProductSubmit = async (values: ProductFormValues, isEdit: boolean) => {
    if (isEdit && editingProduct) {
      await inventoryApi.update(editingProduct.id, {
        name: values.name,
        sku: values.sku,
        category: values.category,
        description: values.description,
        unitOfMeasure: values.unitOfMeasure,
        reorderPoint: values.reorderPoint,
        preferredSupplierId: values.preferredSupplierId,
        unitCostPaise: values.unitCostRupees ? Math.round(values.unitCostRupees * 100) : 0,
      });
      toast.success(`Product "${values.name}" updated successfully.`);
    } else {
      await inventoryApi.create({
        name: values.name,
        sku: values.sku,
        category: values.category,
        description: values.description,
        unitOfMeasure: values.unitOfMeasure,
        initialStockQuantity: values.initialStockQuantity,
        reorderPoint: values.reorderPoint,
        preferredSupplierId: values.preferredSupplierId,
        unitCostPaise: values.unitCostRupees ? Math.round(values.unitCostRupees * 100) : 0,
        currency: values.currency,
      });
      toast.success(`Product "${values.name}" created with SKU ${values.sku}.`);
    }

    await invalidateAll();
    setIsProductDialogOpen(false);
    setEditingProduct(null);
  };

  // Record Stock Movement Handler
  const handleRecordMovementSubmit = async (values: MovementFormValues) => {
    const mov = await inventoryApi.recordMovement({
      productId: values.productId,
      type: values.type,
      quantity: values.quantity,
      date: values.date,
      referenceType: values.referenceType,
      referenceId: values.referenceId,
      note: values.note,
    });

    const prod = items.find((p) => p.product.id === values.productId);
    toast.success(
      `Recorded ${values.type.replace(/_/g, " ")} of ${values.quantity} units for ${
        prod?.product.name || "product"
      }. New balance: ${mov.resultingBalance} units.`,
    );

    await invalidateAll();
    setIsMovementDialogOpen(false);
  };

  // Create Purchase Order Handler
  const handleCreatePoSubmit = async (input: CreatePurchaseOrderInput): Promise<string> => {
    const po = await purchaseOrderApi.create(input);
    toast.success(`Purchase order ${po.poNumber || po.id} created successfully.`);
    await invalidateAll();
    return po.id;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* A. Inventory Header & Controls */}
      <InventoryHeader
        businessName="Rupi Clothing"
        currency="INR"
        search={searchFilter}
        onSearchChange={(search) => handleUpdateSearch({ search })}
        category={categoryFilter}
        onCategoryChange={(category) => handleUpdateSearch({ category })}
        status={statusFilter}
        onStatusChange={(status) => handleUpdateSearch({ status })}
        categories={categories}
        onAddProduct={() => {
          setEditingProduct(null);
          setIsProductDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onRecordMovement={() => {
          setMovementPrefillProductId(null);
          setIsMovementDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onCreatePurchaseOrder={() => {
          setPoPrefillProductId(null);
          setPoPrefillSupplierId(null);
          setIsPoWizardOpen(true);
        }}
        onClearFilters={handleClearFilters}
        hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
      />

      {/* Summary Metrics Cards */}
      <InventorySummaryCards
        metrics={summaryMetrics}
        activeStatusFilter={statusFilter}
        onSelectStatusFilter={(status) => handleUpdateSearch({ status })}
        onNavigateToPurchaseOrders={() => handleUpdateSearch({ tab: "purchase_orders" })}
      />

      {/* Module Tabs Navigation */}
      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onValueChange={(tab) => handleUpdateSearch({ tab: tab as InventorySearchParams["tab"] })}
        className="w-full space-y-4"
      >
        <TabsList className="grid grid-cols-4 w-full sm:w-[540px] h-9">
          <TabsTrigger value="items" className="text-xs">
            Inventory ({items.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="purchase_orders" className="text-xs">
            Purchase Orders ({purchaseOrders.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="reorders" className="text-xs">
            Reorders ({reorders.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="alerts" className="text-xs">
            Risk Alerts ({alerts.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        {/* TAB 1: Inventory Table */}
        <TabsContent value="items" className="space-y-4">
          <InventoryTable
            items={filteredItems}
            isLoading={isLoading}
            error={error}
            onRetry={refetchInventory}
            onSelectProduct={(id) => handleUpdateSearch({ selectedProductId: id })}
            onRecordMovement={(id) => {
              setMovementPrefillProductId(id);
              setIsMovementDialogOpen(true);
            }}
            onCreatePurchaseOrder={(id) => {
              const prod = items.find((p) => p.product.id === id);
              setPoPrefillProductId(id);
              setPoPrefillSupplierId(prod?.product.preferredSupplierId || null);
              setIsPoWizardOpen(true);
            }}
            onEditProduct={(product) => {
              setEditingProduct(product);
              setIsProductDialogOpen(true);
            }}
            onViewInGraph={(id) => {
              navigate({
                to: "/relationships",
                search: { selectedId: `node_stock_1` },
              });
            }}
            onSimulate={(id, name) => {
              navigate({
                to: "/simulator",
                search: {
                  eventId: `node_stock_1`,
                  eventName: `${name} Restock`,
                },
              });
            }}
            onAddProduct={() => {
              setEditingProduct(null);
              setIsProductDialogOpen(true);
            }}
            onClearFilters={handleClearFilters}
            hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        {/* TAB 2: Purchase Orders Tracking */}
        <TabsContent value="purchase_orders" className="space-y-4">
          <PurchaseOrderList
            orders={purchaseOrders}
            suppliers={suppliers}
            isLoading={false}
            onSelectPo={(poId) => handleUpdateSearch({ selectedPoId: poId })}
            onCreatePo={() => {
              setPoPrefillProductId(null);
              setPoPrefillSupplierId(null);
              setIsPoWizardOpen(true);
            }}
            onReceiveItems={(poId) => {
              const po = purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === poId);
              const firstItem = po?.lineItemsDetails?.[0];
              if (firstItem) {
                setMovementPrefillProductId(firstItem.productId);
              }
              setIsMovementDialogOpen(true);
            }}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        {/* TAB 3: Reorder Recommendations */}
        <TabsContent value="reorders" className="space-y-4">
          <ReorderRecommendationsPanel
            recommendations={reorders}
            isLoading={false}
            onSelectProduct={(id) => handleUpdateSearch({ selectedProductId: id })}
            onCreatePurchaseOrder={(productId, supplierId) => {
              setPoPrefillProductId(productId);
              setPoPrefillSupplierId(supplierId || null);
              setIsPoWizardOpen(true);
            }}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        {/* TAB 4: Inventory Risk Alerts */}
        <TabsContent value="alerts" className="space-y-4">
          <InventoryRiskAlertsPanel
            alerts={alerts}
            isLoading={false}
            onSelectProduct={(id) => handleUpdateSearch({ selectedProductId: id })}
            onSelectPurchaseOrder={(poId) => handleUpdateSearch({ selectedPoId: poId })}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      {/* Product Creation & Editing Dialog */}
      <ProductDialog
        open={isProductDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          setIsProductDialogOpen(open);
          if (!open) setEditingProduct(null);
        }}
        product={editingProduct}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        categories={categories}
        onSubmit={handleProductSubmit}
      />

      {/* Stock Movement Recording Dialog */}
      <StockMovementDialog
        open={isMovementDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsMovementDialogOpen}
        products={items}
        purchaseOrders={purchaseOrders}
        customerOrders={items.flatMap((p) => [])}
        prefilledProductId={movementPrefillProductId}
        onSubmit={handleRecordMovementSubmit}
      />

      {/* Purchase Order 5-Step Creation Wizard */}
      <PurchaseOrderWizard
        open={isPoWizardOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsPoWizardOpen}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        products={items}
        prefilledProductId={poPrefillProductId}
        prefilledSupplierId={poPrefillSupplierId}
        onSubmit={handleCreatePoSubmit}
        onSuccessNavigate={(poId) => {
          handleUpdateSearch({ tab: "purchase_orders", selectedPoId: poId });
        }}
      />

      {/* Product Detail Side Panel */}
      <ProductDetailSheet
        open={Boolean(selectedProductId)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) handleUpdateSearch({ selectedProductId: undefined });
        }}
        data={selectedProductDetailQuery.data}
        isLoading={selectedProductDetailQuery.isLoading}
        onRecordMovement={(id) => {
          setMovementPrefillProductId(id);
          setIsMovementDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onCreatePurchaseOrder={(id) => {
          const prod = items.find((p) => p.product.id === id);
          setPoPrefillProductId(id);
          setPoPrefillSupplierId(prod?.product.preferredSupplierId || null);
          setIsPoWizardOpen(true);
        }}
        onEditProduct={() => {
          if (selectedProductDetailQuery.data) {
            setEditingProduct(selectedProductDetailQuery.data.product);
            setIsProductDialogOpen(true);
          }
        }}
        onViewPoDetails={(poId) => {
          handleUpdateSearch({
            selectedProductId: undefined,
            selectedPoId: poId,
            tab: "purchase_orders",
          });
        }}
      />

      {/* Purchase Order Detail Sheet */}
      <PurchaseOrderDetailSheet
        open={Boolean(selectedPoId)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) handleUpdateSearch({ selectedPoId: undefined });
        }}
        order={selectedPoDetail}
        onReceiveStock={(poId) => {
          const po = purchaseOrders.find((p) => p.id === poId);
          const firstItem = po?.lineItemsDetails?.[0];
          if (firstItem) {
            setMovementPrefillProductId(firstItem.productId);
          }
          setIsMovementDialogOpen(true);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="src/routes/_app.invoices.index.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  queryOptions,
  useSuspenseQuery,
  useQueryClient,
  useQuery,
  keepPreviousData,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { InvoiceSummaryCards } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-summary-cards";
import { InvoiceTable } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-table";
import { InvoiceDialog } from "@/components/invoices/invoice-dialog";
import { RecordPaymentDialog } from "@/components/invoices/record-payment-dialog";
import { OverdueReminderDialog } from "@/components/invoices/overdue-reminder-dialog";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import {
  invoiceApi,
  type InvoiceListFilterParams,
  type OverdueReminderPayload,
} from "@/lib/api/invoiceApi";
import { customerApi } from "@/lib/api/customerApi";
import { supplierApi } from "@/lib/api/supplierApi";
import { PlusCircle, Ban } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { EnrichedInvoice, CreateInvoiceInput, RecordPaymentInput, AgingBucket } from "@/types";

interface InvoicesSearchParams {
  search?: string | undefined;
  type?: "all" | "receivable" | "payable" | undefined;
  status?: "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled" | undefined;
  aging?: "all" | AgingBucket | undefined;
  sortBy?: "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

const invoiceSummaryQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["invoices", "summary"],
  queryFn: () => invoiceApi.getSummaryMetrics(),
});

const invoicesListQuery = (params: InvoiceListFilterParams) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["invoices", "list", params],
    queryFn: () => invoiceApi.list(params),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/invoices/")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): InvoicesSearchParams => {
    const s = typeof search["search"] === "string" ? search["search"] : undefined;
    const type =
      search["type"] === "receivable" || search["type"] === "payable" || search["type"] === "all"
        ? (search["type"] as "all" | "receivable" | "payable")
        : "all";
    const status =
      search["status"] === "unpaid" ||
      search["status"] === "partially_paid" ||
      search["status"] === "paid" ||
      search["status"] === "overdue" ||
      search["status"] === "cancelled" ||
      search["status"] === "all"
        ? (search["status"] as
            "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled")
        : "all";
    const aging =
      search["aging"] === "1_7" ||
      search["aging"] === "8_30" ||
      search["aging"] === "31_60" ||
      search["aging"] === "over_60" ||
      search["aging"] === "all"
        ? (search["aging"] as "all" | AgingBucket)
        : "all";
    const sortBy =
      search["sortBy"] === "dueDate" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "amount" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "status" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "invoiceNumber" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "overdue"
        ? (search["sortBy"] as "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue")
        : "dueDate";
    const sortDir = search["sortDir"] === "desc" ? "desc" : "asc";

    return {
      search: s,
      type,
      status,
      aging,
      sortBy,
      sortDir,
    };
  },
  loader: async ({ context }) => {
    await Promise.all([
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(invoiceSummaryQuery),
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(invoicesListQuery({})),
    ]);
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Invoices & Payments — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content:
          "Accounts receivable, accounts payable bills, payments, and overdue aging timeline.",
      },
    ],
  }),
  component: InvoicesIndexPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load invoices"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load invoices records."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function InvoicesIndexPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const searchParams = Route.useSearch();
  const navigate = Route.useNavigate();

  const { data: metrics } = useSuspenseQuery(invoiceSummaryQuery);
  const { data: listResponse = { data: [], total: 0, page: 1, limit: 50 } } = useQuery({
    ...invoicesListQuery(searchParams),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  // Dialog states
  const [createDialogOpen, setCreateDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [paymentDialogOpen, setPaymentDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedForPayment, setSelectedForPayment] = useState<EnrichedInvoice | null>(null);

  const { data: customers = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["customers", "list-quick"],
    queryFn: () =>
      customerApi
        .list({ pageSize: 100 })
        .then((r) => r.data)
        .catch(() => []),
    enabled: createDialogOpen,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const { data: suppliers = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["suppliers", "list-quick"],
    queryFn: () =>
      supplierApi
        .list({ pageSize: 100 })
        .then((r) => r.data)
        .catch(() => []),
    enabled: createDialogOpen,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const [reminderDialogOpen, setReminderDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reminderData, setReminderData] = useState<OverdueReminderPayload | null>(null);

  const [cancelDialogOpen, setCancelDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedForCancel, setSelectedForCancel] = useState<EnrichedInvoice | null>(null);
  const [isCancelling, setIsCancelling] = useState(false);

  const updateSearch = (patch: Partial<InvoicesSearchParams>) => {
    void navigate({
      search: (prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        ...patch,
      }),
    });
  };

  const handleCreateSubmit = async (formData: CreateInvoiceInput) => {
    await invoiceApi.create(formData);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleRecordPayment = (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => {
    setSelectedForPayment(invoice);
    setPaymentDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handlePaymentSubmit = async (invoiceId: string, payInput: RecordPaymentInput) => {
    await invoiceApi.recordPayment(invoiceId, payInput);
    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cash-flow"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleSendReminder = (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => {
    try {
      const payload = invoiceApi.generateOverdueReminder(invoice);
      setReminderData(payload);
      setReminderDialogOpen(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to generate reminder");
    }
  };

  const handleCancelClick = (invoice: EnrichedInvoice) => {
    setSelectedForCancel(invoice);
    setCancelDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCancelConfirm = async () => {
    if (!selectedForCancel) return;
    try {
      setIsCancelling(true);
      await invoiceApi.cancel(selectedForCancel.id);
      toast.success(`Invoice ${selectedForCancel.invoiceNumber} has been cancelled.`);
      setCancelDialogOpen(false);
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      ]);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to cancel invoice");
    } finally {
      setIsCancelling(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Invoices & Payments"
        description="Unified sub-ledger for customer receivables and supplier payables with aging analytics and settlement tracking."
        actions={
          <Button onClick={() => setCreateDialogOpen(true)} size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
            <PlusCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            New Invoice / Bill
          </Button>
        }
      />

      {/* Summary KPI Cards & Aging Breakdown */}
      <InvoiceSummaryCards
        metrics={metrics}
        selectedAging={searchParams.aging}
        onSelectAging={(aging) => updateSearch({ aging })}
      />

      {/* Filterable Table */}
      <InvoiceTable
        invoices={listResponse.data}
        search={searchParams.search ?? ""}
        onSearchChange={(search) => updateSearch({ search: search || undefined })}
        typeFilter={searchParams.type ?? "all"}
        onTypeFilterChange={(type) => updateSearch({ type })}
        statusFilter={searchParams.status ?? "all"}
        onStatusFilterChange={(status) => updateSearch({ status })}
        agingFilter={searchParams.aging ?? "all"}
        onAgingFilterChange={(aging) => updateSearch({ aging })}
        sortBy={searchParams.sortBy ?? "dueDate"}
        onSortByChange={(sortBy) => updateSearch({ sortBy })}
        onRecordPayment={handleRecordPayment}
        onSendReminder={handleSendReminder}
        onCancelInvoice={handleCancelClick}
      />

      {/* Create Invoice Dialog */}
      <InvoiceDialog
        open={createDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setCreateDialogOpen}
        customers={customers}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit}
      />

      {/* Record Payment Dialog */}
      <RecordPaymentDialog
        open={paymentDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPaymentDialogOpen}
        invoice={selectedForPayment}
        onSubmit={handlePaymentSubmit}
      />

      {/* Overdue Reminder Dialog */}
      <OverdueReminderDialog
        open={reminderDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setReminderDialogOpen}
        reminderData={reminderData}
      />

      {/* Cancel Confirmation Dialog */}
      <AlertDialog open={cancelDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setCancelDialogOpen}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Ban className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />
              <AlertDialogTitle>
                Cancel Invoice {selectedForCancel?.invoiceNumber}?
              </AlertDialogTitle>
            </div>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              Cancelling will mark this invoice as void and adjust the counterparty outstanding
              balance. This action cannot be undone.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel disabled={isCancelling}>Keep Invoice</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                void handleCancelConfirm();
              }}
              disabled={isCancelling}
              className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90"
            >
              {isCancelling ? "Cancelling..." : "Cancel Invoice"}
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Network,
  Share2,
  AlertTriangle,
  FlaskConical,
  Layers,
  ArrowRight,
  TrendingDown,
} from "lucide-react";
import { relationshipsApi } from "@/lib/api/relationshipsApi";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { MetricCard } from "@/components/shared/metric-card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

const relationshipsQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["relationships", "graph"],

interface RelationshipsSearchParams {

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/relationships")({

    selectedId: typeof search["selectedId"] === "string" ? search["selectedId"] : undefined,

        content: "Interactive dependency graph and cash-flow intelligence for small businesses.",
      },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: RelationshipsPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (

    />
  ),

function RelationshipsPage() {
  const { data } = useSuspenseQuery(relationshipsQuery);
  const search = Route.useSearch();
  const graph: RelationshipGraphData = data;

  const totalTouchpoints = graph.summary.totalNodes;
  const totalDependencies = graph.summary.totalEdges;
  const atRiskCount = graph.summary.atRiskCount;
  const cashAtRiskPaise = graph.summary.totalCashAtRiskPaise;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <PageHeader
        title="Relationships"
        description="See how suppliers, inventory, sales, invoices, and payments are connected."
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" asChild className="gap-1.5 shadow-xs">
              <Link to="/simulator">
                <FlaskConical className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Simulate a Delay</span>
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {/* High-level Metric Cards */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <MetricCard
          label="Operating Touchpoints"
          value={String(totalTouchpoints)}
          icon={Layers}
          hint="Suppliers, orders, inventory & receipts"
        />
        <MetricCard
          label="Active Dependencies"
          value={String(totalDependencies)}
          icon={Share2}
          hint="Known causal sequence edges"
        />
        <MetricCard
          label="Bottlenecks & At Risk"
          value={String(atRiskCount)}
          icon={AlertTriangle}
          trend={{
            direction: atRiskCount > 0 ? "down" : "flat",
            label: `${atRiskCount} events need operational attention`,
            sentiment: atRiskCount > 0 ? "bad" : "good",
          }}
        />
        <MetricCard
          label="Liquidity at Risk"
          value={formatMoney(cashAtRiskPaise)}
          icon={TrendingDown}
          trend={{
            direction: "down",
            label: "Day 5 shortfall & overdue receipts",
            sentiment: "bad",
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Dependency Graph Canvas + Toolbar + Details Drawer */}
      <RelationshipGraphView data={graph} initialSelectedId={search.selectedId} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { queryOptions, useSuspenseQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { settingsApi } from "@/lib/api/settingsApi";
import { BusinessProfileSection } from "@/components/settings/business-profile-section";
import { FinancialPreferencesSection } from "@/components/settings/financial-preferences-section";
import { NotificationsSection } from "@/components/settings/notifications-section";
import { DataPrivacySection } from "@/components/settings/data-privacy-section";
import { AppSettingsSection } from "@/components/settings/app-settings-section";
import type { AppSettings, UpdateSettingsInput } from "@/types";

const settingsQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["settings"],
  queryFn: () => settingsApi.getSettings(),
});

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/settings")({
  loader: ({ context }) => context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(settingsQuery),
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Settings — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content: "Business profile, financial preferences, alerts, and system configuration.",
      },
      { property: "og:title", content: "Settings — Ripple" },
      { property: "og:description", content: "Configure your Ripple workspace." },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: SettingsPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load settings"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load application settings."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function SettingsPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: settings } = useSuspenseQuery(settingsQuery);

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (input: UpdateSettingsInput) => settingsApi.updateSettings(input),
    onSuccess: (updated: AppSettings) => {
      queryClient.setQueryData(["settings"], updated);
      // Invalidate dependent queries so dashboard forecasts and thresholds update synchronously
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["forecast"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["customers"] });
      toast.success("Settings updated successfully.");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to update settings.");
    },
  });

  const resetMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => settingsApi.resetDemoData(),
    onSuccess: (res) => {
      // Invalidate all queries across the entire app
      queryClient.invalidateQueries();
      toast.success(res.message);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(err.message || "Failed to reset demo data.");
    },
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="Settings"
        description="Manage your business profile, liquidity alerts, notification rules, and workspace preferences."
      />

      <Tabs defaultValue="business" className="space-y-6">
        <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 h-auto p-1 gap-1">
          <TabsTrigger value="business" className="py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            Business Profile
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="financial" className="py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            Financial
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="notifications" className="py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            Notifications
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="data-privacy" className="py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            Data & Privacy
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="app" className="py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            App Settings
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="business" className="space-y-4">
          <BusinessProfileSection
            business={settings.business}
            onSave={async (businessData) => {
              await updateMutation.mutateAsync({ business: businessData });
            }}
            isSaving={updateMutation.isPending}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="financial" className="space-y-4">
          <FinancialPreferencesSection
            business={settings.business}
            onSave={async (financialData) => {
              await updateMutation.mutateAsync({ business: financialData });
            }}
            isSaving={updateMutation.isPending}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="notifications" className="space-y-4">
          <NotificationsSection
            notifications={settings.notifications}
            onSave={async (notificationsData) => {
              await updateMutation.mutateAsync({ notifications: notificationsData });
            }}
            isSaving={updateMutation.isPending}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="data-privacy" className="space-y-4">
          <DataPrivacySection
            business={settings.business}
            dataMode={settings.dataMode}
            onResetDemoData={async () => {
              await resetMutation.mutateAsync();
            }}
            isResetting={resetMutation.isPending}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="app" className="space-y-4">
          <AppSettingsSection
            appPreferences={settings.app}
            onSave={async (appData) => {
              await updateMutation.mutateAsync({ app: appData });
            }}
            isSaving={updateMutation.isPending}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/routes/_app.suppliers.index.tsx">
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  queryOptions,
  useSuspenseQuery,
  useQueryClient,
  useQuery,
  keepPreviousData,
} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { supplierApi, type SupplierListFilterParams } from "@/lib/api/supplierApi";
import { SupplierHeader } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { SupplierSummaryCards } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-summary-cards";
import { SupplierTable } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-table";
import { SupplierDialog } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-dialog";
import { SupplierArchiveDialog } from "@/components/suppliers/supplier-archive-dialog";
import type { EnrichedSupplier, CreateSupplierInput, UpdateSupplierInput } from "@/types";

interface SuppliersSearchParams {
  search?: string | undefined;
  status?: "all" | "active" | "archived" | undefined;
  riskStatus?: "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy" | undefined;
  sortBy?: "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

const supplierSummaryQuery = queryOptions({
  queryKey: ["suppliers", "summary"],
  queryFn: () => supplierApi.getSummaryMetrics(),
});

const suppliersListQuery = (params: SupplierListFilterParams) =>
  queryOptions({
    queryKey: ["suppliers", "list", params],
    queryFn: () => supplierApi.list(params),
  });

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/suppliers/")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): SuppliersSearchParams => {
    const s = typeof search["search"] === "string" ? search["search"] : undefined;
    const status =
      search["status"] === "active" || search["status"] === "archived" || search["status"] === "all"
        ? (search["status"] as "all" | "active" | "archived")
        : "all";
    const riskStatus =
      search["riskStatus"] === "at_risk" ||
      search["riskStatus"] === "healthy" ||
      search["riskStatus"] === "all"
        ? (search["riskStatus"] as "all" | "at_risk" | "healthy")
        : "all";
    const sortBy =
      search["sortBy"] === "name" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "outstanding" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "nextPayment" ||
      search["sortBy"] === "reliability"
        ? (search["sortBy"] as "name" | "outstanding" | "nextPayment" | "reliability")
        : "name";
    const sortDir = search["sortDir"] === "desc" ? "desc" : "asc";

    return {
      search: s,
      status,
      riskStatus,
      sortBy,
      sortDir,
    };
  },
  loader: async ({ context }) => {
    await Promise.all([
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(supplierSummaryQuery),
      context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(suppliersListQuery({})),
    ]);
  },
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Suppliers — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content:
          "Vendor directory, credit terms, payables, and delivery reliability for Rupi Clothing.",
      },
      { property: "og:title", content: "Suppliers — Ripple" },
      { property: "og:description", content: "Manage suppliers and accounts payable." },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: SuppliersPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load suppliers"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load supplier records."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

function SuppliersPage() {
  const navigate = Route.useNavigate();
  const searchParams = Route.useSearch();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data: metrics } = useSuspenseQuery(supplierSummaryQuery);
  const { data: suppliersResponse = { data: [], total: 0, page: 1, limit: 50 } } = useQuery({
    ...suppliersListQuery(searchParams),
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  // Dialog states
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSupplierForEdit, setSelectedSupplierForEdit] = useState<EnrichedSupplier | null>(
    null,
  );

  const [archiveDialogOpen, setArchiveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [targetSupplierForAction, setTargetSupplierForAction] = useState<EnrichedSupplier | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [archiveMode, setArchiveMode] = useState<"archive" | "unarchive" | "delete">("archive");

  const updateSearch = (newParams: Partial<SuppliersSearchParams>) => {
    navigate({
      search: (prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        ...newParams,
      }),
    });
  };

  const handleCreateOrUpdate = async (values: CreateSupplierInput | UpdateSupplierInput) => {
    if (selectedSupplierForEdit) {
      await supplierApi.update(selectedSupplierForEdit.id, values);
      toast.success(
        `Supplier "${values.name || selectedSupplierForEdit.name}" updated successfully.`,
      );
    } else {
      await supplierApi.create(values as CreateSupplierInput);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${values.name}" created successfully.`);
    }

    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["relationships"] }),
    ]);
  };

  const handleConfirmArchiveAction = async () => {
    if (!targetSupplierForAction) return;

    if (archiveMode === "archive") {
      await supplierApi.archive(targetSupplierForAction.id);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${targetSupplierForAction.name}" archived.`);
    } else if (archiveMode === "unarchive") {
      await supplierApi.unarchive(targetSupplierForAction.id);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${targetSupplierForAction.name}" reactivated.`);
    } else if (archiveMode === "delete") {
      await supplierApi.remove(targetSupplierForAction.id);
      toast.success(`Supplier "${targetSupplierForAction.name}" permanently deleted.`);
    }

    await Promise.all([
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["suppliers"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] }),
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["relationships"] }),
    ]);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page Header */}
      <SupplierHeader
        onAddSupplier={() => {
          setSelectedSupplierForEdit(null);
          setDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        totalSuppliers={metrics.totalSuppliers}
      />

      {/* Summary KPI Cards */}
      <SupplierSummaryCards metrics={metrics} />

      {/* Main Suppliers Table */}
      <SupplierTable
        suppliers={suppliersResponse.data}
        searchQuery={searchParams.search ?? ""}
        onSearchChange={(q) => updateSearch({ search: q || undefined })}
        statusFilter={searchParams.status ?? "all"}
        onStatusFilterChange={(status) => updateSearch({ status })}
        riskFilter={searchParams.riskStatus ?? "all"}
        onRiskFilterChange={(riskStatus) => updateSearch({ riskStatus })}
        sortBy={searchParams.sortBy ?? "name"}
        onSortChange={(sortBy) => updateSearch({ sortBy })}
        sortDir={searchParams.sortDir ?? "asc"}
        onSortDirToggle={() =>
          updateSearch({ sortDir: searchParams.sortDir === "desc" ? "asc" : "desc" })
        }
        onEdit={(sup) => {
          setSelectedSupplierForEdit(sup);
          setDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onArchive={(sup) => {
          setTargetSupplierForAction(sup);
          setArchiveMode("archive");
          setArchiveDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onUnarchive={(sup) => {
          setTargetSupplierForAction(sup);
          setArchiveMode("unarchive");
          setArchiveDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onDelete={(sup) => {
          setTargetSupplierForAction(sup);
          setArchiveMode("delete");
          setArchiveDialogOpen(true);
        }}
        onAddSupplier={() => {
          setSelectedSupplierForEdit(null);
          setDialogOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Create / Edit Form Modal */}
      <SupplierDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        supplier={selectedSupplierForEdit}
        onSubmit={handleCreateOrUpdate}
      />

      {/* Safe Archive / Delete Confirmation Modal */}
      <SupplierArchiveDialog
        open={archiveDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setArchiveDialogOpen}
        supplier={targetSupplierForAction}
        mode={archiveMode}
        onConfirm={handleConfirmArchiveAction}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

# Ripple — Architecture Rules

- Routing: TanStack Router file-based routes. App pages live under the pathless layout `src/routes/_app.tsx` (sidebar + header shell); leaf pages are `src/routes/_app.<name>.tsx`. `/` redirects to `/dashboard`.
- Data layer: all data goes through typed modules in `src/lib/api/*Api.ts`. Each module branches on `DATA_MODE` (from `src/lib/config.ts`): mock mode reads/mutates the in-memory store in `src/mocks/store.ts`; api mode calls the FastAPI backend via `src/lib/api/client.ts` using `VITE_API_BASE_URL`. Never fetch directly from components.
- Money: integer paise everywhere (`*Paise` fields); format with `src/lib/formatters.ts` (`formatMoney`, INR, en-IN grouping). No floating-point financial math in the frontend.
- Dates: ISO 8601 strings in data; format only at display time with date-fns helpers in `src/lib/formatters.ts`.
- Mock data: single coherent business "Rupi Clothing" seeded in `src/mocks/data.ts` with cross-referenced IDs; dates are relative to today so the demo stays current. UI must only depend on the TypeScript interfaces in `src/types/index.ts`, never on mock shapes.
- Styling: Tailwind v4 tokens in `src/styles.css` only (oklch). Deep indigo primary, navy text, warm off-white background; status colors success/warning/destructive. No hardcoded color utilities in components.
- Shared UI lives in `src/components/shared/` and `src/components/layout/`; reuse PageHeader, MetricCard, StatusBadge, MoneyAmount, DateLabel, EmptyState, ErrorState, skeletons before creating new primitives.
- Data fetching in routes: loader `ensureQueryData` + `useSuspenseQuery` with shared `queryOptions` (see `_app.dashboard.tsx`).

## Efficiency & Inspection Rules (No Full-Codebase Re-Audits)

- **Do NOT perform full-codebase audits, recursive directory walks, or mass file scans** before implementing features.
- Consult `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md` for architecture, file locations, conventions, and test commands.
- Inspect **ONLY** the files directly relevant to the current task:
  1. The specific route file (e.g., `src/routes/_app.<feature>.tsx`)
  2. The relevant API service (e.g., `src/lib/api/<feature>Api.ts`)
  3. The domain types in `src/types/index.ts`
  4. Specific components under `src/components/<feature>/`
- Verify changes with targeted test runs (`npm test` or `npx vitest run src/test/<feature>.test.tsx`) and `npm run build`.

type StatusTone = "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" | "neutral";

const toneByStatus: Record<string, StatusTone> = {
  // invoices
  paid: "success",
  sent: "info",
  partially_paid: "warning",
  overdue: "danger",
  draft: "neutral",
  void: "neutral",
  // inventory
  healthy: "success",
  low_stock: "warning",
  stockout_risk: "danger",
  out_of_stock: "danger",
  incoming_stock: "info",
  // orders & shipments
  confirmed: "info",
  partially_received: "warning",
  received: "success",
  fulfilled: "success",
  delayed: "danger",
  cancelled: "neutral",
  quote: "neutral",
  // payments
  completed: "success",
  scheduled: "info",
  failed: "danger",
  // risk
  critical: "danger",
  warning: "warning",
  info: "info",
  high: "danger",
  medium: "warning",
  low: "success",
  // counterparties
  active: "success",
  archived: "neutral",
};

const toneClasses: Record<StatusTone, string> = {
  success: "border-transparent bg-success/10 text-success",
  warning: "border-warning/30 bg-warning/20 text-warning-foreground font-medium",
  danger: "border-transparent bg-destructive/10 text-destructive",
  info: "border-transparent bg-primary/10 text-primary",
  neutral: "border-transparent bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
};

const labelByStatus: Record<string, string> = {
  partially_paid: "Partially paid",
  partially_received: "Partially received",
  low_stock: "Low stock",
  stockout_risk: "Stockout risk",
  out_of_stock: "Out of stock",
  incoming_stock: "Incoming stock",
};

export function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const tone = toneByStatus[status] ?? "neutral";
  const formattedDefault = status.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/^\w/, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
  const label = labelByStatus[status] ?? formattedDefault;
  return (
    <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("font-medium", toneClasses[tone])}>
      {label}
    </Badge>
  );
}

<file path="src/lib/api/invoiceApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay, nextId } from "@/mocks/store";
import { differenceInCalendarDays, parseISO } from "date-fns";
import type {
  Invoice,
  Payment,
  EnrichedInvoice,
  InvoiceSummaryMetrics,
  InvoiceDetailData,
  CreateInvoiceInput,
  UpdateInvoiceInput,
  RecordPaymentInput,
  AgingBucket,
  ApiListResponse,
  ListParams,
  CashFlowEvent,
} from "@/types";

export interface InvoiceListFilterParams extends ListParams {
  type?: "all" | "receivable" | "payable" | undefined;
  status?: "all" | "unpaid" | "partially_paid" | "paid" | "overdue" | "cancelled" | undefined;
  aging?: "all" | AgingBucket | undefined;
  sortBy?: "dueDate" | "amount" | "status" | "invoiceNumber" | "overdue" | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

export interface OverdueReminderPayload {
  recipientName: string;
  recipientEmail: string;
  invoiceNumber: string;
  dueDate: string;
  daysOverdue: number;
  outstandingPaise: number;
  subject: string;
  body: string;
}

export function enrichInvoice(inv: Invoice): EnrichedInvoice {
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const today = parseISO(todayStr);
  const dueDate = parseISO(inv.dueDate);

  const outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, inv.amountPaise - (inv.amountPaidPaise || 0));
  const isPaid = outstandingPaise === 0 && inv.amountPaise > 0;
  const isVoid = inv.status === "void" || inv.status === "cancelled";

  let counterpartyName = "Unknown";
  let counterpartyType: "customer" | "supplier" = "customer";

  if (inv.customerId) {
    const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === inv.customerId);
    if (cust) counterpartyName = cust.name;
    counterpartyType = "customer";
  } else if (inv.supplierId) {
    const supp = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === inv.supplierId);
    if (supp) counterpartyName = supp.name;
    counterpartyType = "supplier";
  }

  const rawDaysOverdue = differenceInCalendarDays(today, dueDate);
  const isOverdue = !isPaid && !isVoid && (inv.status === "overdue" || rawDaysOverdue > 0);
  const daysOverdue = isOverdue ? Math.max(1, rawDaysOverdue) : 0;

  let agingBucket: AgingBucket = "current";
  if (isOverdue) {
    if (daysOverdue <= 7) agingBucket = "1_7";
    else if (daysOverdue <= 30) agingBucket = "8_30";
    else if (daysOverdue <= 60) agingBucket = "31_60";
    else agingBucket = "over_60";
  }

  // Derive normalized status
  let status = inv.status;
  if (isVoid) {
    status = "void";
  } else if (isPaid) {
    status = "paid";
  } else if (isOverdue) {
    status = "overdue";
  } else if (inv.amountPaidPaise > 0) {
    status = "partially_paid";
  }

  return {
    ...inv,
    status,
    counterpartyName,
    counterpartyType,
    daysOverdue,
    agingBucket,
    isOverdue,
    outstandingPaise,
  };
}

export const invoiceApi = {
  async list(params: InvoiceListFilterParams = {}): Promise<ApiListResponse<EnrichedInvoice>> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();

      let invoices = db.invoices.map(enrichInvoice);

      // Type filter
      if (params.type && params.type !== "all") {
        invoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.type === params.type);
      }

      // Status filter
      if (params.status && params.status !== "all") {
        if (params.status === "unpaid") {
          invoices = invoices.filter(
            (i) =>
              (i.amountPaidPaise === 0 || !i.amountPaidPaise) &&
              !i.isOverdue &&
              i.status !== "void",
          );
        } else if (params.status === "partially_paid") {
          invoices = invoices.filter(
            (i) => i.amountPaidPaise > 0 && i.outstandingPaise > 0 && i.status !== "void",
          );
        } else if (params.status === "paid") {
          invoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.status === "paid");
        } else if (params.status === "overdue") {
          invoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.isOverdue);
        } else if (params.status === "cancelled") {
          invoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.status === "void" || i.status === "cancelled");
        }
      }

      // Aging filter
      if (params.aging && params.aging !== "all") {
        invoices = invoices.filter((i) => i.agingBucket === params.aging);
      }

      // Search filter
      if (params.search && params.search.trim() !== "") {
        const q = params.search.toLowerCase().trim();
        invoices = invoices.filter(
          (i) =>
            i.invoiceNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            i.counterpartyName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            i.notes?.toLowerCase().includes(q),
        );
      }

      // Sorting
      const dir = params.sortDir === "desc" ? -1 : 1;
      if (params.sortBy === "amount") {
        invoices.sort((a, b) => (a.amountPaise - b.amountPaise) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "overdue") {
        invoices.sort((a, b) => (a.daysOverdue - b.daysOverdue) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "invoiceNumber") {
        invoices.sort((a, b) => a.invoiceNumber.localeCompare(b.invoiceNumber) * dir);
      } else if (params.sortBy === "status") {
        invoices.sort((a, b) => a.status.localeCompare(b.status) * dir);
      } else {
        // default by dueDate
        invoices.sort((a, b) => a.dueDate.localeCompare(b.dueDate) * dir);
      }

      return {
        data: invoices,
        total: invoices.length,
        page: 1,
        pageSize: invoices.length,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<ApiListResponse<EnrichedInvoice>>("/api/invoices", {
      query: {
        page: params.page,
        pageSize: params.pageSize,
        search: params.search,
        type: params.type,
        status: params.status,
      },
    });
  },

  async getSummaryMetrics(): Promise<InvoiceSummaryMetrics> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const enriched = db.invoices.map(enrichInvoice);

      const receivables = enriched.filter((i) => i.type === "receivable" || !i.type);
      const payables = enriched.filter((i) => i.type === "payable");

      const totalReceivablesPaise = receivables.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountPaise, 0);
      const totalPayablesPaise = payables.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.amountPaise, 0);

      const outstandingReceivablesPaise = receivables
        .filter((i) => i.status !== "void")
        .reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0);

      const outstandingPayablesPaise = payables
        .filter((i) => i.status !== "void")
        .reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0);

      const overdueReceivablesPaise = receivables
        .filter((i) => i.isOverdue)
        .reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0);

      const overduePayablesPaise = payables
        .filter((i) => i.isOverdue)
        .reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0);

      const overdueInvoicesCount = enriched.filter((i) => i.isOverdue).length;
      const paidPaise = enriched.reduce((sum, i) => sum + (i.amountPaidPaise || 0), 0);

      // Overdue aging breakdown
      const overdueList = enriched.filter((i) => i.isOverdue);
      const b1 = overdueList.filter((i) => i.agingBucket === "1_7");
      const b2 = overdueList.filter((i) => i.agingBucket === "8_30");
      const b3 = overdueList.filter((i) => i.agingBucket === "31_60");
      const b4 = overdueList.filter((i) => i.agingBucket === "over_60");

      return {
        totalInvoices: enriched.length,
        totalReceivablesPaise,
        totalPayablesPaise,
        outstandingReceivablesPaise,
        outstandingPayablesPaise,
        overdueReceivablesPaise,
        overduePayablesPaise,
        overdueInvoicesCount,
        paidPaise,
        aging: {
          bucket1to7Paise: b1.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0),
          bucket1to7Count: b1.length,
          bucket8to30Paise: b2.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0),
          bucket8to30Count: b2.length,
          bucket31to60Paise: b3.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0),
          bucket31to60Count: b3.length,
          bucketOver60Paise: b4.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.outstandingPaise, 0),
          bucketOver60Count: b4.length,
        },
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<InvoiceSummaryMetrics>("/api/invoices/summary");
  },

  async getById(id: string): Promise<InvoiceDetailData> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const raw = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === id);
      if (!raw) throw new Error(`Invoice ${id} not found`);

      const enriched = enrichInvoice(raw);
      const payments = db.payments.filter((p) => p.invoiceId === id);

      const customer = raw.customerId
        ? db.customers.find((c) => c.id === raw.customerId)
        : undefined;
      const supplier = raw.supplierId
        ? db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === raw.supplierId)
        : undefined;
      const customerOrder = raw.customerOrderId
        ? db.customerOrders.find((co) => co.id === raw.customerOrderId)
        : undefined;
      const purchaseOrder = raw.purchaseOrderId
        ? db.purchaseOrders.find((po) => po.id === raw.purchaseOrderId)
        : undefined;

      return {
        invoice: enriched,
        customer,
        supplier,
        customerOrder,
        purchaseOrder,
        payments,
      };
    }

    return httpRequest<InvoiceDetailData>(`/api/invoices/${id}`);
  },

  async create(input: CreateInvoiceInput): Promise<Invoice> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      if (!input.amountPaise || input.amountPaise <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Invoice amount must be greater than zero.");
      }

      if (input.type === "receivable" && !input.customerId) {
        throw new Error("A customer must be selected for accounts receivable invoices.");
      }

      if (input.type === "payable" && !input.supplierId) {
        throw new Error("A supplier must be selected for accounts payable vendor bills.");
      }

      const id = nextId("inv");
      const defaultNumber =
        input.invoiceNumber?.trim() ||
        (input.type === "receivable"
          ? `INV-2026-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`
          : `BILL-2026-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`);

      const invoice: Invoice = {
        id,
        invoiceNumber: defaultNumber,
        type: input.type,
        customerId: input.customerId,
        customerOrderId: input.customerOrderId,
        supplierId: input.supplierId,
        purchaseOrderId: input.purchaseOrderId,
        amountPaise: input.amountPaise,
        amountPaidPaise: 0,
        status: input.status ?? "sent",
        issueDate: input.issueDate,
        dueDate: input.dueDate,
        notes: input.notes?.trim() || undefined,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      };

      db.invoices.unshift(invoice);

      // Update counterparty balance
      if (input.type === "receivable" && input.customerId) {
        const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === input.customerId);
        if (cust) {
          cust.outstandingPaise = (cust.outstandingPaise || 0) + input.amountPaise;
        }
      } else if (input.type === "payable" && input.supplierId) {
        const supp = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === input.supplierId);
        if (supp) {
          supp.outstandingPaise = (supp.outstandingPaise || 0) + input.amountPaise;
        }
      }

      return invoice;
    }

    return httpRequest<Invoice>("/api/invoices", { method: "POST", body: input });
  },

  async update(id: string, patch: UpdateInvoiceInput): Promise<Invoice> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const existing = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === id);
      if (!existing) throw new Error(`Invoice ${id} not found`);

      const updated: Invoice = {
        ...existing,
        ...patch,
        id,
        invoiceNumber: patch.invoiceNumber ?? existing.invoiceNumber,
        status: patch.status ?? existing.status,
      };
      db.invoices = db.invoices.map((i) => (i.id === id ? updated : i));
      return updated;
    }
    return httpRequest<Invoice>(`/api/invoices/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: patch });
  },

  async recordPayment(invoiceId: string, input: RecordPaymentInput): Promise<Payment> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const invoice = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceId);
      if (!invoice) throw new Error(`Invoice ${invoiceId} not found`);

      if (invoice.status === "void" || invoice.status === "cancelled") {
        throw new Error("Cannot record payment for a cancelled or void invoice.");
      }

      if (!input.amountPaise || input.amountPaise <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Payment amount must be greater than zero.");
      }

      const remainingPaise = Math.max(0, invoice.amountPaise - invoice.amountPaidPaise);
      if (input.amountPaise > remainingPaise) {
        throw new Error(
          `Payment amount (₹${(input.amountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}) exceeds remaining invoice balance (₹${(remainingPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}).`,
        );
      }

      const payDate = input.paymentDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const isReceivable = invoice.type === "receivable" || !invoice.type;

      const record: Payment = {
        id: nextId("pay"),
        direction: isReceivable ? "incoming" : "outgoing",
        invoiceId,
        customerId: invoice.customerId,
        supplierId: invoice.supplierId,
        amountPaise: input.amountPaise,
        status: "completed",
        scheduledDate: payDate,
        completedDate: payDate,
        method: input.method || "Bank Transfer",
      };

      db.payments.push(record);

      // Update invoice balances
      invoice.amountPaidPaise += input.amountPaise;
      if (invoice.amountPaidPaise >= invoice.amountPaise) {
        invoice.status = "paid";
      } else {
        invoice.status = "partially_paid";
      }

      // Update counterparty balance
      if (isReceivable && invoice.customerId) {
        const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === invoice.customerId);
        if (cust) {
          cust.outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, (cust.outstandingPaise || 0) - input.amountPaise);
        }
      } else if (!isReceivable && invoice.supplierId) {
        const supp = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === invoice.supplierId);
        if (supp) {
          supp.outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, (supp.outstandingPaise || 0) - input.amountPaise);
        }
      }

      // Record cash flow event
      const event: CashFlowEvent = {
        id: nextId("evt"),
        type: isReceivable ? "customer_payment" : "supplier_payment",
        label: `${isReceivable ? "Receipt" : "Payment"} - ${invoice.invoiceNumber}`,
        direction: record.direction,
        amountPaise: input.amountPaise,
        date: payDate,
        relatedInvoiceId: invoice.id,
        isProjected: false,
        status: "completed",
        counterpartyName: isReceivable
          ? db.customers.find((c) => c.id === invoice.customerId)?.name
          : db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === invoice.supplierId)?.name,
      };
      db.cashFlowEvents.push(event);

      return record;
    }

    return httpRequest<Payment>(`/api/invoices/${invoiceId}/payments`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: input,
    });
  },

  async cancel(invoiceId: string): Promise<Invoice> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      const invoice = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceId);
      if (!invoice) throw new Error(`Invoice ${invoiceId} not found`);

      if (invoice.amountPaidPaise >= invoice.amountPaise && invoice.amountPaise > 0) {
        throw new Error("Cannot cancel a fully settled invoice.");
      }

      invoice.status = "void";

      // Decrement counterparty outstanding
      const remainingPaise = Math.max(0, invoice.amountPaise - invoice.amountPaidPaise);
      if (invoice.customerId) {
        const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === invoice.customerId);
        if (cust) {
          cust.outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, (cust.outstandingPaise || 0) - remainingPaise);
        }
      } else if (invoice.supplierId) {
        const supp = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === invoice.supplierId);
        if (supp) {
          supp.outstandingPaise = Math.max(0, (supp.outstandingPaise || 0) - remainingPaise);
        }
      }

      return { ...invoice };
    }

    return httpRequest<Invoice>(`/api/invoices/${invoiceId}/cancel`, { method: "POST" });
  },

  generateOverdueReminder(invoiceOrId: string | Invoice | EnrichedInvoice): OverdueReminderPayload {
    let invoice: Invoice;
    let enriched: EnrichedInvoice;

    if (typeof invoiceOrId === "object" && invoiceOrId !== null) {
      invoice = invoiceOrId;
      enriched =
        "counterpartyName" in invoiceOrId && invoiceOrId.counterpartyName
          ? (invoiceOrId as EnrichedInvoice)
          : enrichInvoice(invoiceOrId);
    } else {
      const found = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === invoiceOrId);
      if (!found) throw new Error(`Invoice ${invoiceOrId} not found`);
      invoice = found;
      enriched = enrichInvoice(found);
    }

    let recipientName = enriched.counterpartyName || "Accounts Team";
    let recipientEmail = "accounts@customer.com";

    if (invoice.customerId) {
      const cust = db.customers.find((c) => c.id === invoice.customerId);
      if (cust) {
        recipientName = cust.contactName || cust.name;
        recipientEmail = cust.email || "accounts@customer.com";
      }
    } else if (invoice.supplierId) {
      const supp = db.suppliers.find((s) => s.id === invoice.supplierId);
      if (supp) {
        recipientName = supp.contactName || supp.name;
        recipientEmail = supp.email || "accounts@vendor.com";
      }
    }

    const amountFormatted = `₹${(enriched.outstandingPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`;
    const subject = `Urgent Reminder: Overdue Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber} (${amountFormatted})`;

    const body = `Dear ${recipientName},

I hope this email finds you well.

This is a courtesy reminder regarding Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber}, which was due on ${invoice.dueDate}. According to our records, an outstanding balance of ${amountFormatted} is currently ${enriched.daysOverdue} days overdue.

Details:
• Invoice Number: ${invoice.invoiceNumber}
• Original Amount: ₹${(invoice.amountPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
• Amount Already Settled: ₹${(invoice.amountPaidPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
• Outstanding Due: ${amountFormatted}
• Due Date: ${invoice.dueDate} (${enriched.daysOverdue} days overdue)

Payment Details:
• Account Name: Rupi Clothing Pvt Ltd
• Bank: HDFC Bank, Indiranagar Branch
• Account Number: 50200088991122
• IFSC: HDFC0000128
• UPI ID: rupiclothing@hdfcbank

Please arrange settlement at your earliest convenience, or let us know if you have already initiated this transaction. If there are any discrepancies, please reply to this email immediately.

Warm regards,
Finance & Accounts
Rupi Clothing Pvt Ltd
accounts@rupiclothing.in
+91 80 4123 4567`;

    return {
      recipientName,
      recipientEmail,
      invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,
      dueDate: invoice.dueDate,
      daysOverdue: enriched.daysOverdue,
      outstandingPaise: enriched.outstandingPaise,
      subject,
      body,
    };
  },

  createInvoice(input: CreateInvoiceInput): Promise<Invoice> {
    return this.create(input);
  },
};
</file>

/**
 * Clean markdown-to-JSX renderer supporting bold, headers, bullet points, and code spans
 */
function FormattedMessage({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const lines = text.split("\n");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed">
      {lines.map((line, idx) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        // Empty line
        if (!trimmed) {
          return <div key={idx} className="h-1.5" />;
        }

        // Heading 3: ###
        if (trimmed.startsWith("### ")) {
          return (
            <h3
              key={idx}
              className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground pt-1.5 pb-0.5 border-b border-border/40"
            >
              {renderInlineStyles(trimmed.slice(4))}
            </h3>
          );
        }

        // Heading 4 or bold title
        if (trimmed.startsWith("#### ")) {
          return (
            <h4 key={idx} className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground pt-1">
              {renderInlineStyles(trimmed.slice(5))}
            </h4>
          );
        }

        // Bullet point: • or - or *
        if (trimmed.startsWith("• ") || trimmed.startsWith("- ") || trimmed.startsWith("* ")) {
          const content = trimmed.slice(2);
          return (
            <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 pl-1">
              <span className="text-primary font-bold select-none leading-5">•</span>
              <span className="flex-1">{renderInlineStyles(content)}</span>
            </div>
          );
        }

        // Numbered list: e.g. 1.
        const numMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$/);
        if (numMatch && numMatch[1] && numMatch[2]) {
          return (
            <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 pl-1">
              <span className="text-primary font-semibold text-xs tabular-nums select-none mt-0.5">
                {numMatch[1]}.
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1">{renderInlineStyles(numMatch[2])}</span>
            </div>
          );
        }

        // Standard paragraph
        return (
          <p key={idx} className="text-foreground/90">
            {renderInlineStyles(trimmed)}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function renderInlineStyles(str: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  // Regex parsing **bold**, *italic*, `code`
  const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  const regex = /(\*\*.*?\*\*|\*.*?\*|`.*?`)/g;
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      parts.push(str.substring(lastIndex, match.index));
    }
    const token = match[0];
    if (token.startsWith("**") && token.endsWith("**")) {
      parts.push(
        <strong key={match.index} className="font-semibold text-foreground">
          {token.slice(2, -2)}
        </strong>,
      );
    } else if (token.startsWith("*") && token.endsWith("*")) {
      parts.push(
        <em key={match.index} className="italic text-foreground/80">
          {token.slice(1, -1)}
        </em>,
      );
    } else if (token.startsWith("`") && token.endsWith("`")) {
      parts.push(
        <code
          key={match.index}
          className="rounded bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono text-primary font-medium"
        >
          {token.slice(1, -1)}
        </code>,
      );
    }
    lastIndex = regex.lastIndex;
  }

  if (lastIndex < str.length) {
    parts.push(str.substring(lastIndex));
  }

  return parts;
}
