  );

  // Send a message: try Google Gemini API, or deterministically fall back to safety net
  async function sendMessage(textToSend: string) {
    const trimmed = textToSend.trim();
    if (!trimmed || loading) return;

    // Append user message
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user_${Date.now()}`,
      role: "user",
      text: trimmed,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInput("");
    setLoading(true);

    // Snapshot live cross-page state
    const liveState = getLiveCrossPageState();

    // Plain English directive if simpleMode is active
    const systemInstruction = simpleMode
      ? `${liveState.systemPromptString}\n\n[PLAIN ENGLISH DIRECTIVE]: Speak in simple, everyday language that a retail clothing shop owner immediately understands. Avoid complex financial jargon. Keep answers punchy and under 130 words, bold key ₹ amounts and dates, use simple bullet points, and conclude with one clear, practical recommended action.`
      : liveState.systemPromptString;

    try {
      // 1. Attempt live Google AI Studio API call (Gemini Flash)
      const geminiResponse = await callGeminiAPI({
        prompt: trimmed,
        systemInstruction,
        history: messages.slice(-6).map((m) => ({ role: m.role, text: m.text })),
      });

      // Derive relevant action pills based on query context
      const pills: ActionPill[] = [];
      const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
      if (lower.includes("simulat") || lower.includes("apex") || lower.includes("delay")) {
        pills.push({ id: "load_apex", label: "Load Apex Flagship (+16d) Scenario" });
        pills.push({ id: "open_simulator", label: "Open in Ripple Simulator →" });
      }
      if (lower.includes("supplier") || lower.includes("phase") || lower.includes("batch") || lower.includes("kaveri")) {
        pills.push({ id: "apply_auto_phase", label: "Execute Auto-Phase Inventory" });
      }
      if (lower.includes("escrow") || lower.includes("cash") || lower.includes("crunch") || lower.includes("improve")) {
        pills.push({ id: "apply_split_escrow", label: "Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow" });
      }
      if (pills.length === 0) {
        pills.push({ id: "apply_split_escrow", label: "Lock Tri-Party Split-Escrow" });
        pills.push({ id: "apply_auto_phase", label: "Execute Auto-Phase Inventory" });
        pills.push({ id: "open_simulator", label: "Open in Ripple Simulator →" });
      }

      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `bot_${Date.now()}`,
          role: "bot",
          text: geminiResponse.text,
          actionPills: pills,
          isFallback: false,
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
        },
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Gemini API call failed or offline, engaging Hackathon Safety Net:", err);

      // 2. Deterministic, smart context-aware local response generator
      const fallbackReply = generateSmartLocalResponse(trimmed, liveState);

      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `bot_${Date.now()}`,
          role: "bot",
          text: fallbackReply.text,
          actionPills: fallbackReply.actionPills,
          isFallback: true,
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const handleSaveKeyDialog = () => {
    setGeminiApiKey(keyInput.trim());
    setKeySource(getGeminiApiKeySource());
    setIsKeyDialogOpen(false);
    if (keyInput.trim()) {
      toast.success("Gemini API Key Saved", {
        description: "Google AI Studio API is now active for live queries.",
      });
    } else {
      toast.info("Gemini API Key Cleared", {
        description: "Insights will run using the Hackathon Safety Net.",
      });
    }
  };

  const currentLive = getLiveCrossPageState();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-5rem)] max-w-4xl mx-auto px-2 sm:px-4 py-3 gap-3">
      {/* Header Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-2.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">Insights & AI</h1>
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="bg-primary/5 text-primary border-primary/20 text-[11px] font-semibold"
              >
                Google Gemini Flash
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Autonomous Financial Copilot deeply linked to live cross-page state
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live Context & Status Actions */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant={simpleMode ? "default" : "outline"}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              const next = !simpleMode;
              setSimpleMode(next);
              toast.info(
                next
                  ? "Plain English Mode Enabled (Simpler & Punchier)"
                  : "Detailed Analysis Mode Enabled",
              );
            }}
            className="h-8 text-xs gap-1.5"
          >
            <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{simpleMode ? "Plain English: ON" : "Plain English: OFF"}</span>
          </Button>

          {keySource !== "none" ? (
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs gap-1.5 py-1 px-2.5"
            >
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              Live API Connected
            </Badge>
          ) : (
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className="border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs gap-1.5 py-1 px-2.5"
            >
              <Wifi className="w-3 h-3" />
              Safety Net Engine Active
            </Badge>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setIsKeyDialogOpen(true)}
            className="h-8 text-xs gap-1.5 border-border/70"
          >
            <KeyRound className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            API Key
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Cross-Page Live State Linking Ribbon */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-card/60 p-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground shadow-xs flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
          <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">Live App State Connected:</span>
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">
            Cash: <strong className="text-foreground">{currentLive.overview.availableCashOnHandFormatted}</strong>
            {" · "}
            Active Preset: <strong className="text-foreground">{currentLive.simulator.activePreset}</strong>
            {" · "}
            True Margin: <strong className="text-foreground">{currentLive.simulator.trueRippleMarginPercent}</strong>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {currentLive.simulator.activeRescues.autoPhaseApplied && (
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20">
              Auto-Phase Active
            </Badge>
          )}
          {currentLive.simulator.activeRescues.splitEscrowLocked && (
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-500/20">
              Split-Escrow Locked
            </Badge>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate({ to: "/simulator" })}
            className="text-[11px] font-medium text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            View Simulator <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chat Messages Window */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-3.5 bg-card rounded-2xl border border-border/80 p-4 min-h-0 shadow-inner">
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div
            key={msg.id}
            className={`flex gap-2.5 ${msg.role === "user" ? "justify-end" : "justify-start"}`}
          >
            {msg.role === "bot" && (
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 border border-primary/20">
                <Bot className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
            )}

            <div
              className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl p-4 leading-relaxed shadow-xs ${
                msg.role === "user"
                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-br-xs"
                  : "bg-muted/40 text-foreground border border-border/70 rounded-bl-xs"
              }`}
            >
              {msg.role === "user" ? (
                <div className="text-sm">{msg.text}</div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <FormattedMessage text={msg.text} />

                  {/* Interactive Action Buttons / Pills */}
                  {msg.actionPills && msg.actionPills.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-border/60 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {msg.actionPills.map((pill) => (
                        <button
                          key={pill.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleActionPill(pill.id)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-all shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                        >
                          {pill.id === "open_simulator" && <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          {pill.id === "load_apex" && <Sliders className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          {pill.id === "apply_auto_phase" && <Layers className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          {pill.id === "apply_split_escrow" && <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />}
                          <span>{pill.label}</span>
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {msg.isFallback && (
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 pt-1 opacity-75">
                      <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                      <span>Answered via Live Deterministic Financial Engine (Hackathon Safety Net)</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {msg.role === "user" && (
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-muted flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5 border border-border">
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}

        {loading && (
          <div className="flex gap-2.5 justify-start">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-primary/20">
              <Bot className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="bg-muted/40 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-xs px-4 py-3 border border-border/70 flex gap-1.5 items-center">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-bounce [animation-delay:0ms]" />
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-bounce [animation-delay:150ms]" />
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-bounce [animation-delay:300ms]" />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pl-2 font-medium">
                Analyzing loop contagion & live cash flows…
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Starter Prompt Chips */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
        {STARTER_CHIPS.map((chip) => (
          <button
            key={chip}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => sendMessage(chip)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="text-xs border border-border/80 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/80 hover:text-foreground hover:border-primary/50 transition-all cursor-pointer font-medium disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {chip}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Input Row */}
      <form
        className="flex gap-2"
        onSubmit={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          sendMessage(input);
        }}
      >
        <input
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Ask anything about cash shortages, True Margin, Apex Corp, or rescues…"
          disabled={loading}
          className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/40 shadow-xs"
        />
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!input.trim() || loading}
          className="rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-5 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-40 hover:opacity-90 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Ask Gemini</span>
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* API Key Modal Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={isKeyDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsKeyDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
              </div>
              <DialogTitle>Google AI Studio API Key</DialogTitle>
            </div>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
              Paste your Google AI Studio API Key to query <strong>Gemini 2.5 Flash</strong> directly.
              Keys stored in <code className="text-xs font-mono">localStorage</code> take precedence during live presentations.
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Gemini API Key</Label>
              <Input
                type="password"
                placeholder="AQ... or AIzaSy... (Paste key here)"
                value={keyInput}
                onChange={(e) => setKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                className="text-xs font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/40 p-3 text-xs space-y-1 text-muted-foreground border">
              <p className="font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                Hackathon Wi-Fi Safety Net
              </p>
              <p>
                If the key is empty, network drops, or rate limits occur, the assistant will seamlessly generate answers using the local financial engine with zero error alerts.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setIsKeyDialogOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSaveKeyDialog} className="font-semibold">
              Save Key
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="src/lib/api/forecastApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay } from "@/mocks/store";
import { buildDetailedForecast } from "@/mocks/data";
import type { ForecastResponse, GetForecastParams, SimulationScenario } from "@/types";

export const forecastApi = {
  async getForecast(paramsOrDays?: number | GetForecastParams): Promise<ForecastResponse> {
    const params: GetForecastParams =
      typeof paramsOrDays === "number" ? { days: paramsOrDays } : (paramsOrDays ?? {});
    const days = params.days ?? db.business.defaultForecastHorizonDays ?? 30;
    const scenarioId = params.scenarioId;
    const safetyThresholdPaise =
      params.safetyThresholdPaise ?? db.business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000;
    const businessId = params.businessId ?? db.business.id;

    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      return buildDetailedForecast(
        db.cashFlowEvents,
        db.business.openingCashPaise,
        days,
        safetyThresholdPaise,
        scenarioId,
      );
    }

    const res = await httpRequest<ForecastResponse>("/api/forecast", {
      query: {
        business_id: businessId,
        days,
        scenario_id: scenarioId,
        safety_threshold: safetyThresholdPaise,
      },
    });

    if (res && res.points && Array.isArray(res.points)) {
      return Object.assign([...res.points], res) as ForecastResponse;
    }
    return res;
  },

  async updateSafetyThreshold(
    safetyThresholdPaise: number,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; safetyThresholdPaise: number }> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(200);
      db.business.safetyThresholdPaise = safetyThresholdPaise;
      return { success: true, safetyThresholdPaise };
    }

    return httpRequest<{ success: boolean; safetyThresholdPaise: number }>(
      "/api/business/safety-threshold",
      {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: { safetyThresholdPaise },
      },
    );
  },

  async getScenarios(): Promise<SimulationScenario[]> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(150);
      return db.simulationScenarios;
    }

    return httpRequest<SimulationScenario[]>("/api/simulations/scenarios");
  },
};
</file>

function NotFoundComponent() {
  return (

function ErrorComponent({ error, reset }: ErrorComponentProps) {
  console.error(error);
  const router = useRouter();

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center px-4">
      <div className="max-w-md text-center">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground">
          This page didn't load
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {error instanceof Error && error.message
            ? error.message
            : "Something went wrong on our end. You can try refreshing or head back home."}
        </p>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              router.invalidate();
              reset();
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-primary-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-primary/90"
          >
            Try again
          </button>
          <a
            href="/"
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
          >
            Go home
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      },

  shellComponent: RootShell,
  component: RootComponent,
  notFoundComponent: NotFoundComponent,
  errorComponent: ErrorComponent,

const themeInitScript = `(function() {
  try {
    var stored = localStorage.getItem("ripple_theme");
    var prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
    var isDark = stored === "dark" || ((!stored || stored === "system") && prefersDark);
    if (isDark) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark");
    }
  } catch (e) {}
})();`;

function RootShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeInitScript }} />
        <HeadContent />
      </head>
      <body>
        {children}
        <Scripts />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

function RootComponent() {
  const { queryClient } = Route.useRouteContext();

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      {/* Required: nested routes render here. Removing <Outlet /> breaks all child routes. */}
      <Outlet />
      <Toaster richColors position="bottom-right" />
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

function DashboardPage() {

    "receivable",
  );

  const { data: customers = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["customers", "list-quick"],
    queryFn: () =>
      customerApi
        .list({ pageSize: 100 })
        .then((r) => r.data)
        .catch(() => []),
    enabled: invoiceDialogOpen,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const { data: suppliers = [] } = useQuery({

  });

  const handleCreateInvoice = async (payload: CreateInvoiceInput) => {
    try {
      await invoiceApi.create(payload);
      toast.success(
        payload.type === "receivable"
          ? "Customer invoice created successfully!"
          : "Supplier bill recorded successfully!",
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["dashboard"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["invoices"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["cash-flow"] });

  const minPoint =

          projectedBalancePaise: summary.cashOnHandPaise,
          inflowsPaise: 0,
          outflowsPaise: 0,

import { useEffect, Suspense } from "react";
import { Outlet, createFileRoute, redirect } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/layout/app-sidebar";
import { AppHeader } from "@/components/layout/app-header";
import { settingsApi } from "@/lib/api/settingsApi";
import { applyTheme, applyCompactTables } from "@/lib/theme";
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { isUserAuthenticated } from "@/lib/api/authApi";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app")({
  beforeLoad: () => {
    if (DATA_MODE === "api" && !isUserAuthenticated()) {
      throw redirect({ to: "/login" });
    }
  },
  component: AppLayout,
});

function AppLayout() {
  const { data: settings } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["settings"],
    queryFn: () => settingsApi.getSettings(),
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (settings?.app) {
      applyTheme(settings.app.theme);
      applyCompactTables(settings.app.compactTables);
    }
  }, [settings?.app]);

  return (
    <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={false}>
      <div className="flex min-h-screen w-full">
        <AppSidebar />
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <AppHeader />
          <main className="flex-1 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 lg:py-8">
            <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl">
              <Suspense
                fallback={
                  <div className="flex h-64 w-full items-center justify-center">
                    <div className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent" />
                  </div>
                }
              >
                <Outlet />
              </Suspense>
            </div>
          </main>
        </div>
      </div>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}

<file path="src/components/relationships/relationship-graph-view.tsx">
import React, { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import {
  ReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  Background,
  Controls,
  MiniMap,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  useReactFlow,
  BackgroundVariant,
  type NodeMouseHandler,
  type Node,
} from "@xyflow/react";
import { Network, Sparkles, FilterX, Maximize2, Minimize2, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { adaptToReactFlow } from "./graph-adapter";
import {
  RelationshipCustomNode,
  LaneHeaderNode,
  type CustomNodeData,
  type LaneHeaderData,
} from "./relationship-node";
import { RelationshipCustomEdge } from "./relationship-edge";
import { RelationshipToolbar, type FilterState } from "./relationship-toolbar";
import { RelationshipDetailsPanel } from "./relationship-details-panel";
import { RelationshipLegend } from "./relationship-legend";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/shared/empty-state";
import type { RelationshipGraphData } from "@/types";

interface RelationshipGraphViewProps {
  data: RelationshipGraphData;
  initialSelectedId?: string | undefined;
}

const nodeTypes = {
  custom: RelationshipCustomNode,
  lane_header: LaneHeaderNode,
};

const edgeTypes = {
  custom: RelationshipCustomEdge,
};

const initialFilters: FilterState = {
  search: "",
  type: "all",
  status: "all",
  partner: "all",
  riskOnly: false,
};

function InnerGraphView({ data, initialSelectedId }: RelationshipGraphViewProps) {
  const reactFlowInstance = useReactFlow();
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const resolvedInitialId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!initialSelectedId) return "node_delivery_1";
    const found = data.nodes.find(
      (n) => n.id === initialSelectedId || n.entityId === initialSelectedId,
    );
    return found ? found.id : initialSelectedId;
  }, [data.nodes, initialSelectedId]);

  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState<string | null>(resolvedInitialId);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialSelectedId) {
      const found = data.nodes.find(
        (n) => n.id === initialSelectedId || n.entityId === initialSelectedId,
      );
      setSelectedNodeId(found ? found.id : initialSelectedId);
    }
  }, [initialSelectedId, data.nodes]);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>(initialFilters);

  // Escape key handler for fullscreen
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isFullscreen) {
        setIsFullscreen(false);
        setTimeout(() => reactFlowInstance?.fitView({ padding: 0.15, duration: 300 }), 100);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isFullscreen, reactFlowInstance]);

  // Filter nodes according to active filters
  const filteredNodeIds = useMemo(() => {
    const query = filters.search.toLowerCase().trim();
    const typeFilter = filters.type;
    const statusFilter = filters.status;
    const partnerFilter = filters.partner;
    const riskOnly = filters.riskOnly;

    return new Set(
      data.nodes
        .filter((node) => {
          if (query) {
            const matchesQuery =
              node.label.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
              node.type.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
              Boolean(node.metadata.referenceNumber?.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
              Boolean(node.metadata.partnerName?.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
              Boolean(node.metadata.productName?.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
              Boolean(node.metadata.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(query));
            if (!matchesQuery) return false;
          }

          if (typeFilter !== "all" && node.type !== typeFilter) {
            return false;
          }

          if (statusFilter !== "all" && node.status !== statusFilter) {
            return false;
          }

          if (partnerFilter !== "all") {
            const matchesPartner =
              Boolean(
                node.metadata.partnerName?.toLowerCase().includes(partnerFilter.toLowerCase()),
              ) || node.entityId === partnerFilter;
            if (!matchesPartner) return false;
          }

          if (riskOnly) {
            const isRisk =
              node.status === "at_risk" ||
              node.status === "delayed" ||
              node.type === "cash_flow_risk" ||
              Boolean(node.metadata.riskSeverity);
            if (!isRisk) return false;
          }

          return true;
        })
        .map((n) => n.id),
    );
  }, [data.nodes, filters]);

  // Compute React Flow nodes & edges
  const { nodes: flowNodes, edges: flowEdges } = useMemo(() => {
    return adaptToReactFlow(data, {
      selectedNodeId,
      filteredNodeIds,
    });
  }, [data, selectedNodeId, filteredNodeIds]);

  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] =
    useNodesState<Node<CustomNodeData | LaneHeaderData>>(flowNodes);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState(flowEdges);

  // Sync state when dependencies or selection changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setNodes(flowNodes);
    setEdges(flowEdges);
  }, [flowNodes, flowEdges, setNodes, setEdges]);

  // Handle fitView on initial render
  const initialFitDone = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialFitDone.current && reactFlowInstance && flowNodes.length > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        reactFlowInstance.fitView({ padding: 0.15, duration: 400 });
        initialFitDone.current = true;
      }, 100);
    }
  }, [reactFlowInstance, flowNodes.length]);

  // Handle Reset View
  const handleResetView = useCallback(() => {
    if (reactFlowInstance) {
      reactFlowInstance.fitView({ padding: 0.2, duration: 400 });
    }
  }, [reactFlowInstance]);

  // Focus and select node
  const handleSelectNode = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      setSelectedNodeId(id);
      const targetNode = nodes.find((n) => n.id === id);
      if (targetNode && reactFlowInstance) {
        reactFlowInstance.setCenter(targetNode.position.x + 130, targetNode.position.y + 60, {
          zoom: 1.1,
          duration: 450,
        });
      }
    },
    [nodes, reactFlowInstance],
  );

  const handleNodeClick: NodeMouseHandler = useCallback((_event, node) => {
    if (node.type === "lane_header") return;
    setSelectedNodeId(node.id);
  }, []);

  const handlePaneClick = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  }, []);

  const handleResetFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setFilters(initialFilters);
  }, []);

  // Check if active selection exists in filtered results
  const isSelectedVisible = selectedNodeId && filteredNodeIds.has(selectedNodeId);

  const toggleFullscreen = useCallback(() => {
    setIsFullscreen((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      setTimeout(() => reactFlowInstance?.fitView({ padding: 0.15, duration: 300 }), 150);
      return next;
    });
  }, [reactFlowInstance]);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-full">
      {/* Top Toolbar */}
      <RelationshipToolbar
        filters={filters}
        onFilterChange={setFilters}
        onResetView={handleResetView}
        onResetFilters={handleResetFilters}
        matchCount={filteredNodeIds.size}
        totalCount={data.nodes.length}
        isFullscreen={isFullscreen}
        onToggleFullscreen={toggleFullscreen}
      />

      {/* Main Workspace: Graph Canvas + Details Panel */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 items-start">
        {/* Graph Canvas Container */}
        <div
          className={
            isFullscreen
              ? "fixed inset-0 z-50 h-screen w-screen bg-background/95 backdrop-blur-md p-4 flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
              : "lg:col-span-8 xl:col-span-8 flex flex-col rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden h-[620px] sm:h-[680px] relative"
          }
        >
          {filteredNodeIds.size === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-8">
              <EmptyState
                icon={FilterX}
                title="No matching events found"
                description="Adjust your search query or reset filters to view all connected business events."
                actionLabel="Reset all filters"
                onAction={handleResetFilters}
              />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {isFullscreen && (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b mb-3 shrink-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Network className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-foreground text-sm">
                        Business Relationship Graph — Fullscreen View
                      </span>
                      <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden sm:inline">
                        (Press Esc to exit)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleResetView}
                      className="h-8 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      Fit view
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="default"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={toggleFullscreen}
                      className="h-8 gap-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Minimize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Exit Fullscreen</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="relative flex-1 w-full h-full">
                <ReactFlow
                  nodes={nodes}
                  edges={edges}
                  onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
                  onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
                  onNodeClick={handleNodeClick}
                  onPaneClick={handlePaneClick}
                  nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
                  edgeTypes={edgeTypes}
                  nodesDraggable={false}
                  nodesConnectable={false}
                  elementsSelectable={true}
                  minZoom={0.25}
                  maxZoom={2.0}
                  defaultViewport={{ x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 0.8 }}
                  fitView
                  fitViewOptions={{ padding: 0.15 }}
                  className="select-none"
                >
                  <Background
                    variant={BackgroundVariant.Lines}
                    gap={28}
                    size={1}
                    color="color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-border) 70%, transparent)"
                  />
                  <Controls
                    showInteractive={false}
                    position="bottom-left"
                    className="m-3 shadow-xs"
                  />
                  <MiniMap
                    nodeStrokeWidth={2}
                    zoomable
                    pannable
                    position="bottom-right"
                    className="hidden md:block m-3"
                    nodeColor={(n) => {
                      if (n.id === selectedNodeId) return "var(--color-primary)";
                      return "var(--color-muted-foreground)";
                    }}
                  />
                </ReactFlow>

                {/* Fullscreen & Quick Jump buttons on top-left of canvas */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 z-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const next = !isFullscreen;
                      setIsFullscreen(next);
                      setTimeout(
                        () => reactFlowInstance?.fitView({ padding: 0.15, duration: 300 }),
                        150,
                      );
                    }}
                    className="h-8 gap-1.5 text-xs bg-card/90 shadow-xs backdrop-blur-xs cursor-pointer font-medium"
                  >
                    {isFullscreen ? (
                      <Minimize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    ) : (
                      <Maximize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span>{isFullscreen ? "Exit Fullscreen" : "Fullscreen"}</span>
                  </Button>

                  <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center rounded-lg border bg-card/90 p-0.5 shadow-xs backdrop-blur-xs text-xs">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => reactFlowInstance?.fitView({ padding: 0.15, duration: 400 })}
                      className="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Fit all workflows"
                    >
                      Fit All
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        reactFlowInstance?.setCenter(1840, 160, { zoom: 0.5, duration: 450 })
                      }
                      className="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Focus on Primary Operating Cycle"
                    >
                      Chain 1
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        reactFlowInstance?.setCenter(665, 850, { zoom: 0.8, duration: 450 })
                      }
                      className="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Focus on Mehta Fabrics cycle"
                    >
                      Chain 2
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        reactFlowInstance?.setCenter(900, 1450, { zoom: 0.75, duration: 450 })
                      }
                      className="rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      title="Focus on Style Mart receivables"
                    >
                      Chain 3
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Collapsible Legend mounted at top-right inside canvas (hidden if details panel is open in fullscreen) */}
                {(!isFullscreen || !isSelectedVisible) && (
                  <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-10 max-w-sm">
                    <RelationshipLegend />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Canvas status hint bar */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-16 z-10 hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border bg-card/90 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground shadow-xs backdrop-blur-xs">
                  <Network className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                  <span>Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Click any node to trace impact</span>
                </div>

                {/* Floating Details Drawer in Fullscreen Mode */}
                {isFullscreen && isSelectedVisible && (
                  <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-20 w-96 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl rounded-xl">
                    <RelationshipDetailsPanel
                      nodeId={selectedNodeId}
                      graph={data}
                      onSelectNode={handleSelectNode}
                      onClose={() => setSelectedNodeId(null)}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Side Details Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-4 h-[620px] sm:h-[680px]">
          {isSelectedVisible ? (
            <RelationshipDetailsPanel
              nodeId={selectedNodeId}
              graph={data}
              onSelectNode={handleSelectNode}
              onClose={() => setSelectedNodeId(null)}
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center h-full rounded-xl border border-dashed bg-card/50 p-6">
              <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary mb-3">
                <Sparkles className="h-6 w-6" />
              </div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">Select a business event</h4>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
                Click any node on the graph to inspect its upstream dependencies, downstream
                consequences, cash-flow impact, and simulate delays.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-2 w-full max-w-xs">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                  Featured workflows
                </p>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleSelectNode("node_delivery_1")}
                  className="justify-between text-xs h-8"
                >
                  <span>Inventory Delivery (Day 4)</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Upcoming</span>
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleSelectNode("node_pay_3")}
                  className="justify-between text-xs h-8"
                >
                  <span>PO Balance Payment (₹30,000)</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-destructive">Day 4 Outflow</span>
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleSelectNode("node_risk_1")}
                  className="justify-between text-xs h-8"
                >
                  <span>Cash Shortfall Risk (Day 5)</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-warning">Critical</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function RelationshipGraphView(props: RelationshipGraphViewProps) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <InnerGraphView {...props} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

<file path="src/lib/api/dashboardApi.ts">
import { DATA_MODE } from "@/lib/config";
import { httpRequest } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { db, delay } from "@/mocks/store";
import { buildForecast } from "@/mocks/data";
import type { ForecastPoint, RiskAlert, Recommendation, CashFlowEvent } from "@/types";

export interface DashboardSummary {
  businessName?: string;
  currency?: string;
  cashOnHandPaise: number;
  receivablesPaise: number;
  payablesPaise: number;
  overdueReceivablesPaise: number;
  lowStockCount: number;
  openInvoiceCount: number;
  forecast: ForecastPoint[];
  alerts: RiskAlert[];
  recommendations: Recommendation[];
  upcomingEvents: CashFlowEvent[];
}

interface DashboardActivity {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  title: string;
  amountPaise: number;
  status: string;
  date: string;
}

function computeSummary(): DashboardSummary {
  const forecast = buildForecast(db.cashFlowEvents, db.business.openingCashPaise);
  const cashOnHandPaise = forecast[0]?.projectedBalancePaise ?? db.business.openingCashPaise;

  const openInvoices = db.invoices.filter(
    (i) =>
      (!i.type || i.type === "receivable") &&
      (i.status === "sent" || i.status === "partially_paid" || i.status === "overdue"),
  );
  const receivablesPaise = openInvoices.reduce(
    (s, i) => s + (i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise),
    0,
  );
  const overdueReceivablesPaise = db.invoices
    .filter((i) => (!i.type || i.type === "receivable") && i.status === "overdue")
    .reduce((s, i) => s + (i.amountPaise - i.amountPaidPaise), 0);

  const payablesPaise = db.payments
    .filter((p) => p.direction === "outgoing" && p.status === "scheduled")
    .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountPaise, 0);

  const lowStockCount = db.inventory.filter((item) => {
    const product = db.products.find((p) => p.id === item.productId);
    return product ? item.quantityOnHand < product.reorderPoint : false;
  }).length;

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const upcomingEvents = db.cashFlowEvents
    .filter((e) => e.date >= todayStr)
    .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
    .slice(0, 6);

  const notifs = db.notifications;
  let filteredAlerts = db.riskAlerts;
  if (notifs) {
    filteredAlerts = db.riskAlerts.filter((alert) => {
      if (
        !notifs.lowCash &&
        (alert.id === "risk_1" ||
          alert.title.toLowerCase().includes("cash shortfall") ||
          alert.title.toLowerCase().includes("low cash"))
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        !notifs.overdueInvoices &&
        (alert.id === "risk_2" || alert.title.toLowerCase().includes("overdue"))
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      if (
        !notifs.delayedDeliveries &&
        (alert.id === "risk_3" ||
          alert.title.toLowerCase().includes("delivery") ||
          alert.title.toLowerCase().includes("reorder"))
      ) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }

  return {
    businessName: db.business.name,
    currency: db.business.currency,
    cashOnHandPaise,
    receivablesPaise,
    payablesPaise,
    overdueReceivablesPaise,
    lowStockCount,
    openInvoiceCount: openInvoices.length,
    forecast,
    alerts: filteredAlerts,
    recommendations: db.recommendations,
    upcomingEvents,
  };
}

export const dashboardApi = {
  async getSummary(): Promise<DashboardSummary> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      return computeSummary();
    }
    const data = await httpRequest<DashboardSummary>("/api/dashboard/summary");
    return {
      ...data,
      forecast: data?.forecast || [],
      alerts: data?.alerts || [],
      recommendations: data?.recommendations || [],
      upcomingEvents: data?.upcomingEvents || [],
    };
  },

  async getRecentActivity(): Promise<{ activities: DashboardActivity[] }> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay();
      return {
        activities: db.invoices.slice(0, 5).map((inv) => ({
          id: `act_inv_${inv.id}`,
          type: "invoice",
          title: `Invoice ${inv.invoiceNumber} (${inv.type})`,
          amountPaise: inv.amountPaise,
          status: inv.status,
          date: inv.issueDate,
        })),
      };
    }
    return httpRequest<{ activities: DashboardActivity[] }>("/api/dashboard/recent-activity");
  },
};

    changeMagnitude: 30,
    createdAt: dp(1),
  },
];

/** Deterministic forecast built from opening cash + events. */
export function buildForecast(
  events: CashFlowEvent[] = cashFlowEvents,
  openingCashPaise: number = business.openingCashPaise,
  days = 30,
): ForecastPoint[] {
  const points: ForecastPoint[] = [];
  let balance = openingCashPaise;
  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const date = d(i);
    const dayEvents = events.filter((e) => e.date === date);
    const inflows = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "incoming")
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);
    const outflows = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "outgoing")
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);
    const net = inflows - outflows;
    const dayOpening = balance;
    balance += net;
    points.push({
      date,
      projectedBalancePaise: balance,
      inflowsPaise: inflows,
      outflowsPaise: outflows,
      isShortfall: balance < 0,
      netMovementPaise: net,
      openingBalancePaise: dayOpening,
    });
  }
  return points;
}

export function buildDetailedForecast(
  events: CashFlowEvent[] = cashFlowEvents,
  openingCashPaise: number = business.openingCashPaise,
  days = 30,
  safetyThresholdPaise: number = business.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 500_000,
  scenarioId?: string,
): ForecastResponse {
  let runningBalance = openingCashPaise;
  const points: ForecastPoint[] = [];
  const dailyLedger: DailyLedgerEntry[] = [];
  const breachDates: string[] = [];

  let totalInflows = 0;
  let totalOutflows = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < days; i++) {
    const date = d(i);
    const dayEvents = events.filter((e) => e.date === date);

    const expectedIncoming = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "incoming" && e.type === "customer_payment")
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);

    const otherInflows = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "incoming" && e.type !== "customer_payment")
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);

    const dayInflows = expectedIncoming + otherInflows;

    const supplierPayments = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "outgoing" && e.type === "supplier_payment")
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);

    const operatingExpenses = dayEvents
      .filter((e) => e.direction === "outgoing" && (e.type === "rent" || e.type === "payroll"))
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);

    const otherOutflows = dayEvents
      .filter(
        (e) =>
          e.direction === "outgoing" &&
          e.type !== "supplier_payment" &&
          e.type !== "rent" &&
          e.type !== "payroll",
      )
      .reduce((s, e) => s + e.amountPaise, 0);

    const dayOutflows = supplierPayments + operatingExpenses + otherOutflows;
    const netMovement = dayInflows - dayOutflows;
    const dayOpening = runningBalance;
    runningBalance += netMovement;
    const closingBalance = runningBalance;

    totalInflows += dayInflows;
    totalOutflows += dayOutflows;

    const isBelowThreshold = closingBalance < safetyThresholdPaise;
    const isDeficit = closingBalance < 0;
    if (isBelowThreshold) {
      breachDates.push(date);
    }

    const shortfallPaise = isBelowThreshold ? safetyThresholdPaise - closingBalance : 0;
    const status: "healthy" | "warning" | "shortfall" = isDeficit
      ? "shortfall"
      : isBelowThreshold
        ? "warning"
        : "healthy";

    const point: ForecastPoint = {
      date,
      projectedBalancePaise: closingBalance,
      inflowsPaise: dayInflows,
      outflowsPaise: dayOutflows,
      isShortfall: isDeficit,
      netMovementPaise: netMovement,
      openingBalancePaise: dayOpening,
      shortfallPaise,
    };
    points.push(point);

    dailyLedger.push({
      date,
      openingBalancePaise: dayOpening,
      expectedIncomingPaise: expectedIncoming,
      otherInflowsPaise: otherInflows,
      totalInflowsPaise: dayInflows,
      supplierPaymentsPaise: supplierPayments,
      operatingExpensesPaise: operatingExpenses,
      otherOutflowsPaise: otherOutflows,
      totalOutflowsPaise: dayOutflows,
      netMovementPaise: netMovement,
      closingBalancePaise: closingBalance,
      status,
      shortfallPaise,
      isHistorical: false,
      events: dayEvents,
    });
  }

  const minPoint =
    points.length > 0
      ? points.reduce((min, p) => (p.projectedBalancePaise < min.projectedBalancePaise ? p : min))
      : { projectedBalancePaise: openingCashPaise, date: d(0) };

  let scenarioData = undefined;
  if (scenarioId) {
    const scenario = simulationScenarios.find((s) => s.id === scenarioId);
    if (scenario) {
      const modifiedEvents = events.map((e) => {
        if (e.id === scenario.targetEventId) {
          if (scenario.id === "sim_shree_delay") {
            return { ...e, date: d(11), riskNote: "Scenario: Shifted to Day 11 (+7 days)" };
          }
          if (scenario.id === "sim_urban_discount") {
            return {
              ...e,
              date: d(10),
              amountPaise: 784_000,
              riskNote: "Scenario: Collected Day 10 (2% settlement discount)",
            };
          }
          if (scenario.id === "sim_stylemart_delay") {
            return { ...e, date: d(69), riskNote: "Scenario: Delayed to Day 69 (+30 days)" };
          }
        }
        return e;
      });

      const scenarioForecast = buildForecast(modifiedEvents, openingCashPaise, days);
      const scenarioMinPoint = scenarioForecast.reduce(
        (min, p) => (p.projectedBalancePaise < min.projectedBalancePaise ? p : min),
        scenarioForecast[0] ?? { projectedBalancePaise: openingCashPaise, date: d(0) },
      );
      const scenarioBreachDates = scenarioForecast
        .filter((p) => p.projectedBalancePaise < safetyThresholdPaise)
        .map((p) => p.date);

      scenarioForecast.forEach((sp, idx) => {
        if (points[idx]) {
          points[idx].scenarioBalancePaise = sp.projectedBalancePaise;
        }
      });

      let assumptionsText = "";
      if (scenario.id === "sim_shree_delay") {
        assumptionsText =
          "Shree Textiles approves a 7-day payment delay on PO-1 delivery balance. Eliminates immediate Day 5 cash deficit.";
      } else if (scenario.id === "sim_urban_discount") {
        assumptionsText =
          "Urban Threads accepts a 2% early-settlement incentive (₹160 discount), accelerating ₹7,840 net inflow to Day 10.";
      } else if (scenario.id === "sim_stylemart_delay") {
        assumptionsText =
          "Stress test simulating extended buyer delay: Style Mart defers INV-2002 payment by 30 days.";
      }

      scenarioData = {
        scenarioId: scenario.id,
        scenarioName: scenario.name,
        description: scenario.description ?? "",
        assumptions: assumptionsText,
        targetEventId: scenario.targetEventId,
        baselineMinBalancePaise: minPoint.projectedBalancePaise,
        baselineMinBalanceDate: minPoint.date,
        scenarioMinBalancePaise: scenarioMinPoint.projectedBalancePaise,
        scenarioMinBalanceDate: scenarioMinPoint.date,
        minBalanceDifferencePaise:
          scenarioMinPoint.projectedBalancePaise - minPoint.projectedBalancePaise,
        baselineBreachDates: breachDates,
        scenarioBreachDates,
        scenarioPoints: scenarioForecast,
      };
    }
  }

  const confidenceMetadata = {
    confidenceScore: 94,
    reconciliationStatus: "verified" as const,
    lastReconciledAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    actualsThroughDate: d(0),
    invoicedCoveragePercent: 89,
    isDemo: true,
  };

  const relevantEvents = events.filter((e) => e.date >= d(0) && e.date <= d(days - 1));

  const result = Object.assign(points, {
    periodDays: days,
    period: `${days} days`,
    currency: "INR" as const,
    openingBalancePaise: openingCashPaise,
    closingBalancePaise: runningBalance,
    totalInflowsPaise: totalInflows,
    totalOutflowsPaise: totalOutflows,
    netMovementPaise: totalInflows - totalOutflows,
    minBalancePaise: minPoint.projectedBalancePaise,
    minBalanceDate: minPoint.date,
    safetyThresholdPaise,
    breachDates,
    daysBelowThreshold: breachDates.length,
    points,
    dailyLedger,
    events: relevantEvents,
    confidenceMetadata,
    scenario: scenarioData,
  }) as ForecastResponse;

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build a deterministic dependency graph from the Rupi Clothing mock data.
 * Returns edges that represent "if X is delayed, Y shifts by lagDays".
 */
function buildDependencyEdges(): DependencyEdge[] {
  return [
    // po_1 delivery -> customer order co_1 fulfillment
    {
      id: "dep_po1_co1",
      sourceId: "po_1",
      sourceType: "purchase_order",
      targetId: "co_1",
      targetType: "customer_order",
      label: "PO-1 delivery enables CO-1 fulfillment",
      lagDays: 2,
    },
    // co_1 fulfillment -> invoice INV-2001 issue
    {
      id: "dep_co1_inv2001",
      sourceId: "co_1",
      sourceType: "customer_order",
      targetId: "inv_2001",
      targetType: "invoice",
      label: "CO-1 fulfillment generates INV-2001",
      lagDays: 0,
    },
    // inv_2001 issue -> payment pay_2
    {
      id: "dep_inv2001_pay2",
      sourceId: "inv_2001",
      sourceType: "invoice",
      targetId: "pay_2",
      targetType: "payment",
      label: "INV-2001 due triggers pay_2 collection",
      lagDays: 15,
    },
    // pay_2 expected -> cash event cfe_3
    {
      id: "dep_pay2_cfe3",
      sourceId: "pay_2",
      sourceType: "payment",
      targetId: "cfe_3",
      targetType: "payment",
      label: "Customer receipt cfe_3 depends on pay_2",
      lagDays: 0,
    },
  ];
}

/**
 * Propagate a supplier delivery delay through the dependency graph.
 * Returns the set of cash-flow event IDs whose dates should shift, and by how many days.
 */
function propagateDeliveryDelay(
  deliveryDelayDays: number,
  events: CashFlowEvent[],
): Map<string, number> {
  // Event IDs that depend on po_1 delivery (Day 4) in the seed data
  const shiftMap = new Map<string, number>();
  if (deliveryDelayDays === 0) return shiftMap;

  // The balance payment for po_1 (cfe_2) happens on delivery → shift by delivery delay
  shiftMap.set("cfe_2", deliveryDelayDays);

  // co_1 delivery triggers invoice on Day 6 (cfe_3 is receipt, shifts too)
  // cfe_3 is the Urban Threads receipt which depends on co_1 being fulfilled
  // co_1 delivery needs po_1 stock → shifts by delivery delay
  shiftMap.set("cfe_3", deliveryDelayDays);

  return shiftMap;
}

/**
 * Propagate a customer payment delay through the graph.
 * Only shifts the customer receipt event(s).
 */
function propagatePaymentDelay(
  paymentDelayDays: number,
  events: CashFlowEvent[],
): Map<string, number> {
  const shiftMap = new Map<string, number>();
  if (paymentDelayDays === 0) return shiftMap;

  // cfe_3 = Urban Threads INV-2001 receipt
  shiftMap.set("cfe_3", paymentDelayDays);

  return shiftMap;
}

/**
 * Apply all scenario controls to the event list and return modified events.
 */
function applyControls(
  events: CashFlowEvent[],
  controls: SimulatorControls,
  horizon: number,
): CashFlowEvent[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const d = (offset: number) => toISODate(addDays(today, offset));

  // Build shift maps
  const delivShifts = propagateDeliveryDelay(controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays, events);
  const payShifts = propagatePaymentDelay(controls.customerPaymentDelayDays, events);

  // Merge: take the max shift for each event (conservative)
  const allShifts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const [id, days] of delivShifts) {
    allShifts.set(id, Math.max(allShifts.get(id) ?? 0, days));
  }
  for (const [id, days] of payShifts) {
    allShifts.set(id, Math.max(allShifts.get(id) ?? 0, days));
  }

  return events.map((event): CashFlowEvent => {
    let modified = { ...event };

    // Apply date shifts from dependency propagation
    const shiftDays = allShifts.get(event.id) ?? 0;
    if (shiftDays > 0) {
      const originalDate = new Date(event.date);
      modified = {
        ...modified,
        date: toISODate(addDays(originalDate, shiftDays)),
        riskNote: `Scenario: shifted +${shiftDays} days from ${event.date}`,
      };
    }

    // Customer payment amount override (applies to incoming customer_payment events)
    if (
      controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise !== null &&
      event.direction === "incoming" &&
      event.type === "customer_payment" &&
      event.id === "cfe_3"
    ) {
      modified = { ...modified, amountPaise: controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise };
    }

    // Supplier payment amount override (applies to outgoing supplier_payment events)
    if (
      controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise !== null &&
      event.direction === "outgoing" &&
      event.type === "supplier_payment" &&
      (event.id === "cfe_2" || event.id === "cfe_1")
    ) {
      // Scale: adjust by ratio of new vs original amount
      const original = seedEvents.find((e) => e.id === event.id)?.amountPaise ?? event.amountPaise;
      if (original > 0) {
        const ratio = controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise / original;
        modified = { ...modified, amountPaise: Math.round(event.amountPaise * ratio) };
      }
    }

    // Order quantity multiplier: scale co_1 related inflows/outflows
    if (controls.orderQuantityMultiplier !== 1.0 && event.id === "cfe_3") {
      modified = {
        ...modified,
        amountPaise: Math.round(modified.amountPaise * controls.orderQuantityMultiplier),
      };
    }

    return modified;
  });
}

/**
 * Run the full simulation: baseline + scenario forecasts.
 */
function runMockSimulation(controls: SimulatorControls): SimulatorResult {
  const horizon = controls.horizonDays;
  const openingCash = db.business.openingCashPaise;
  const baselineEvents = db.cashFlowEvents;
  const scenarioEvents = applyControls([...baselineEvents], controls, horizon);

  const baselinePoints = buildForecast(baselineEvents, openingCash, horizon);
  const scenarioPoints = buildForecast(scenarioEvents, openingCash, horizon);

  // Closing balances
  const baselineClosingPaise =
    baselinePoints.length > 0
      ? baselinePoints[baselinePoints.length - 1]!.projectedBalancePaise
      : openingCash;
  const scenarioClosingPaise =
    scenarioPoints.length > 0
      ? scenarioPoints[scenarioPoints.length - 1]!.projectedBalancePaise
      : openingCash;

  // Min balance points
  const baselineMin =
    baselinePoints.length > 0
      ? baselinePoints.reduce((a, b) =>
          a.projectedBalancePaise <= b.projectedBalancePaise ? a : b,
        )
      : { projectedBalancePaise: openingCash, date: toISODate(new Date()) };

  const scenarioMin =
    scenarioPoints.length > 0
      ? scenarioPoints.reduce((a, b) =>
          a.projectedBalancePaise <= b.projectedBalancePaise ? a : b,
        )
      : { projectedBalancePaise: openingCash, date: toISODate(new Date()) };

  const shortfallPaise = Math.min(scenarioMin.projectedBalancePaise, 0);

  // Build affected dependencies
  const affectedDeps = buildAffectedDependencies(controls, baselineEvents, scenarioEvents);

  // Ripple score
  const rippleScore = computeRippleScore(
    controls,
    scenarioMin.projectedBalancePaise,
    baselineMin.projectedBalancePaise,
    affectedDeps.length,
    shortfallPaise,
  );

  // Recommendations
  const recommendations = buildRecommendations(
    controls,
    shortfallPaise,
    scenarioMin.projectedBalancePaise,
    baselineClosingPaise,
    scenarioClosingPaise,
    affectedDeps,
  );

  const effectiveContagionDays = Math.max(0, controls.customerPaymentDelayDays);
  const lostDiscount = effectiveContagionDays > 0 ? 360_000 : 0;
  const haltFees = effectiveContagionDays * 250_000;
  const slaPenalties = effectiveContagionDays * 300_000;
  const floatDrag = effectiveContagionDays * 140_000;
  const totalContagion = lostDiscount + haltFees + slaPenalties + floatDrag;

  const currentBiz = typeof window !== "undefined" ? getStoredBusiness() : null;
  const isDemo = !currentBiz || currentBiz.name === "Rupi Clothing" || currentBiz.id === "biz_1";
  const bizName = currentBiz?.name || "Rupi Clothing";
  const openingCashPaise = currentBiz?.openingCashPaise ?? 15_000_000;
  const safetyBufferPaise = currentBiz?.safetyThresholdPaise ?? 5_000_000;

  const mockTrueMargin = isDemo
    ? {
        revenuePaise: 50_000_000,
        directCogsPaise: 37_500_000,
        paperMarginPaise: 12_500_000,
        paperMarginPercent: 25.0,
        contagionDays: effectiveContagionDays,
        breakdown: {
          lostDiscountPaise: lostDiscount,
          supplierHaltFeesPaise: haltFees,
          slaPenaltiesPaise: slaPenalties,
          workingCapitalDragPaise: floatDrag,
          floatFeePaise: 0,
        },
        totalContagionCostPaise: totalContagion,
        trueRippleMarginPaise: 12_500_000 - totalContagion,
        trueRippleMarginPercent: Math.round(((12_500_000 - totalContagion) / 50_000_000) * 10000) / 100,
        explanation: `Paper Margin of 25% reduced by ₹${(totalContagion / 100).toLocaleString()} in ripple contagion to True Margin of ${Math.round(((12_500_000 - totalContagion) / 50_000_000) * 10000) / 100}%.`,
      }
    : (controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0 || controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise || controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0 || controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise)
      ? {
          revenuePaise: controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 10_000_000,
          directCogsPaise: controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 7_500_000,
          paperMarginPaise: (controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 10_000_000) - (controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 7_500_000),
          paperMarginPercent: 25.0,
          contagionDays: effectiveContagionDays,
          breakdown: {
            lostDiscountPaise: lostDiscount,
            supplierHaltFeesPaise: haltFees,
            slaPenaltiesPaise: slaPenalties,
            workingCapitalDragPaise: floatDrag,
            floatFeePaise: 0,
          },
          totalContagionCostPaise: totalContagion,
          trueRippleMarginPaise: Math.max(0, ((controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 10_000_000) - (controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 7_500_000)) - totalContagion),
          trueRippleMarginPercent: Math.max(0, 25.0 - (effectiveContagionDays * 1.5)),
          explanation: `Simulated scenario evaluated with contagion impact of ₹${(totalContagion / 100).toLocaleString()}.`,
        }
      : {
          revenuePaise: 0,
          directCogsPaise: 0,
          paperMarginPaise: 0,
          paperMarginPercent: 0.0,
          contagionDays: 0,
          breakdown: {
            lostDiscountPaise: 0,
            supplierHaltFeesPaise: 0,
            slaPenaltiesPaise: 0,
            workingCapitalDragPaise: 0,
            floatFeePaise: 0,
          },
          totalContagionCostPaise: 0,
          trueRippleMarginPaise: 0,
          trueRippleMarginPercent: 0.0,
          explanation: `Ready for ${bizName}. Add invoices in the Ledger or test hypothetical payment delays in the Ripple Simulator.`,
        };

  const openingNode: SimulatorTimelineNode = {
    id: "node_opening_cash",
    label: "Opening Cash Reserve",
    type: "cash_reserve",
    dayLabel: "Day 0",
    date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    amountPaise: openingCashPaise,
    direction: "balance",
    status: "completed",
    counterparty: `${bizName} Treasury`,
    description: `Initial usable balance with ₹${Math.round(safetyBufferPaise / 100).toLocaleString("en-IN")} protected safety buffer.`,
  };

  let mockTimelineNodes: SimulatorTimelineNode[];

  if (isDemo) {
    mockTimelineNodes = [
      openingNode,
      {
        id: "node_apex_corp",
        label: "Apex Corp — Customer Invoice #INV-APEX",
        type: "customer_receivable",
        dayLabel: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
        date: new Date(Date.now() + (15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays) * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10),
        amountPaise: controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 50_000_000,
        direction: "incoming",
        status: controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0 ? "delayed" : "upcoming",
        counterparty: "Apex Corp",
        description: "Customer receivable protecting downstream supply chain fulfillment.",
        fragility: {
          nodeId: "node_apex_corp",
          invoiceAmountPaise: 4_000_000,

      {

        dayLabel: `Day ${22 + controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}`,
        date: new Date(Date.now() + (22 + controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays) * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10),
        amountPaise: 16_500_000,
        direction: "incoming",
        status: effectiveContagionDays > 0 ? "at_risk" : "active",
        counterparty: "Metro Retail",
        description:
          effectiveContagionDays > 0
            ? "Exposed to secondary SLA delay penalty."
            : "Inventory gate unlocked.",
        fragility: {
          nodeId: "node_metro_retail",
          invoiceAmountPaise: 16_500_000,
          downstreamValueAtRiskPaise: 16_500_000,
          multiplier: 1.0,
          isKeystone: false,
          badgeText: "Fulfillment Gate",
          badgeVariant: "outline",
          exposedOrders: ["Direct Customer Delivery"],
        },
      },
    ];
  } else {
    // Non-demo registered account
    mockTimelineNodes = [openingNode];
    if (controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise || controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0) {
      const simAmt = controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 10_000_000;
      mockTimelineNodes.push({
        id: "node_sim_customer",
        label: "Simulated Customer Receivable",
        type: "customer_receivable",
        dayLabel: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
        date: new Date(Date.now() + (15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays) * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10),
        amountPaise: simAmt,
        direction: "incoming",
        status: controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0 ? "delayed" : "upcoming",
        counterparty: "Simulated Customer",
        description: `Hypothetical customer receivable ${controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0 ? `(delayed +${controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}d)` : "on schedule"}.`,
        fragility: {
          nodeId: "node_sim_customer",
          invoiceAmountPaise: simAmt,
          downstreamValueAtRiskPaise: simAmt,
          multiplier: 1.0,
          isKeystone: false,
          badgeText: "Simulated Inflow",
          badgeVariant: "outline",
          exposedOrders: [],
        },
      });
    }
    if (controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise || controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0) {
      const simAmt = controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 5_000_000;
      mockTimelineNodes.push({
        id: "node_sim_supplier",
        label: "Simulated Supplier Commitment",
        type: "supplier_payable",
        dayLabel: `Day ${18 + controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}`,
        date: new Date(Date.now() + (18 + controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays) * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10),
        amountPaise: simAmt,
        direction: "outgoing",
        status: controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0 ? "delayed" : "upcoming",
        counterparty: "Simulated Supplier",
        description: `Hypothetical supplier commitment ${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0 ? `(delayed +${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}d)` : "on schedule"}.`,
        fragility: {
          nodeId: "node_sim_supplier",
          invoiceAmountPaise: simAmt,
          downstreamValueAtRiskPaise: simAmt,
          multiplier: 1.0,
          isKeystone: false,
          badgeText: "Simulated Outflow",
          badgeVariant: "outline",
          exposedOrders: [],
        },
      });
    }
  }

  const finalRecommendations = isDemo
    ? recommendations
    : (controls.customerPaymentDelayDays === 0 && controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays === 0 && !controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise && !controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise)
      ? [
          {
            id: "rec_onboarding",

            priority: "medium" as const,
            impactPaise: 0,
            rescueType: "none" as const,
          },
        ]
      : recommendations;

  return {
    baselinePoints,

    scenarioClosingPaise,
    baselineMinPaise: baselineMin.projectedBalancePaise,
    baselineMinDate: baselineMin.date,
    scenarioMinPaise: scenarioMin.projectedBalancePaise,
    scenarioMinDate: scenarioMin.date,
    shortfallPaise,
    affectedDependencies: affectedDeps,
    rippleScore,
    recommendations: finalRecommendations,
    trueMargin: mockTrueMargin,
    timelineNodes: mockTimelineNodes,
  };
}

function buildAffectedDependencies(
  controls: SimulatorControls,
  baseline: CashFlowEvent[],
  scenario: CashFlowEvent[],
): DependencyImpact[] {
  const impacts: DependencyImpact[] = [];

  // Compare event dates/amounts between baseline and scenario
  for (const scenarioEvent of scenario) {
    const baseEvent = baseline.find((e) => e.id === scenarioEvent.id);
    if (!baseEvent) continue;

    const dateDiff =
      scenarioEvent.date !== baseEvent.date
        ? Math.round(
            (new Date(scenarioEvent.date).getTime() - new Date(baseEvent.date).getTime()) /
              86400000,
          )
        : 0;
    const amountDiff = scenarioEvent.amountPaise - baseEvent.amountPaise;

    if (dateDiff !== 0 || amountDiff !== 0) {
      impacts.push({
        entityId: scenarioEvent.id,
        entityType: scenarioEvent.type,
        label: scenarioEvent.label,
        originalDate: baseEvent.date,
        shiftedDate: scenarioEvent.date,
        shiftDays: dateDiff,
        amountPaise: scenarioEvent.amountPaise,
        impactDescription:
          dateDiff !== 0
            ? `Date shifted by +${dateDiff} day${dateDiff !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
            : `Amount changed by ${amountDiff > 0 ? "+" : ""}${(amountDiff / 100).toFixed(0)}`,
      });
    }
  }

  // If supplier delivery was delayed, show inventory + order impact
  if (controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0) {
    impacts.push({
      entityId: "inv_1",
      entityType: "inventory",
      label: "Cotton Kurti inventory arrival",
      shiftDays: controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays,
      impactDescription: `Delayed by ${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays} days — stock unavailable until restocked`,
    });
    impacts.push({
      entityId: "co_1",
      entityType: "customer_order",
      label: "Urban Threads order CO-1 (10x Cotton Kurti)",
      shiftDays: controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays,
      impactDescription: `Fulfillment delayed: stock arrives ${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}d late`,
    });
  }

  return impacts;
}

function computeRippleScore(
  controls: SimulatorControls,
  scenarioMinPaise: number,
  baselineMinPaise: number,
  affectedCount: number,
  shortfallPaise: number,
): RippleScoreBreakdown {
  // Cash shortfall factor: 0–40 pts
  let cashShortfallFactor = 0;
  if (shortfallPaise < 0) {
    // Negative balance — severity based on depth
    const depthK = Math.abs(shortfallPaise) / 100_000; // in units of ₹1000
    cashShortfallFactor = Math.min(40, 15 + depthK * 2);
  } else if (scenarioMinPaise < 500_000) {
    // Below safety threshold
    cashShortfallFactor = Math.min(30, 5 + ((500_000 - scenarioMinPaise) / 100_000) * 2);
  }

  // Delay magnitude factor: 0–25 pts
  const totalDelayDays = controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays;
  const delayMagnitudeFactor = Math.min(25, totalDelayDays * 0.83);

  // Downstream count factor: 0–20 pts
  const downstreamCountFactor = Math.min(20, affectedCount * 3);

  // Liquidity gap factor: 0–15 pts
  const liquidityGapPaise = baselineMinPaise - scenarioMinPaise;
  const liquidityGapFactor = Math.min(15, Math.max(0, liquidityGapPaise / 100_000));

  const totalScore = Math.round(
    cashShortfallFactor + delayMagnitudeFactor + downstreamCountFactor + liquidityGapFactor,
  );

  return {
    cashShortfallFactor: Math.round(cashShortfallFactor),
    delayMagnitudeFactor: Math.round(delayMagnitudeFactor),
    downstreamCountFactor: Math.round(downstreamCountFactor),
    liquidityGapFactor: Math.round(liquidityGapFactor),
    totalScore: Math.min(100, totalScore),
  };
}

function buildRecommendations(
  controls: SimulatorControls,
  shortfallPaise: number,
  scenarioMinPaise: number,
  baselineClosingPaise: number,
  scenarioClosingPaise: number,
  affectedDeps: DependencyImpact[],
): SimulatorRecommendation[] {
  const recs: SimulatorRecommendation[] = [];

  // Shortfall recommendations
  if (shortfallPaise < 0) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_shortfall_1",
      title: "Request a payment extension from Shree Textiles",
      rationale: `The simulated scenario results in a cash shortfall of ${Math.abs(shortfallPaise / 100).toFixed(0)} rupees. Deferring the ₹30,000 PO-1 balance payment by 7 days would eliminate the shortfall.`,
      priority: "high",
      impactPaise: 3_000_000,
    });
  }

  if (controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 7) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_cust_delay",
      title: "Offer a 2% early-payment discount to Urban Threads",
      rationale: `A ${controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}-day delay in customer receipt significantly tightens working capital. Offering a small incentive to collect sooner can prevent a liquidity gap.`,
      priority: controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 14 ? "high" : "medium",
      impactPaise: 800_000,
    });
  }

  if (controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 3) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_sup_delay",
      title: "Activate backup inventory from existing stock",
      rationale: `A ${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}-day supplier delivery delay risks the Day 6 customer order. With only 12 units on hand, consider partially fulfilling CO-1 from available stock.`,
      priority: "medium",
      impactPaise: undefined,
    });
  }

  if (scenarioClosingPaise < baselineClosingPaise - 1_000_000) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_liquidity",
      title: "Consider a short-term working capital credit line",
      rationale:
        "The simulated cash position is significantly below baseline. A revolving credit facility can bridge timing gaps between outflows and inflows.",
      priority: "low",
      impactPaise: undefined,
    });
  }

  if (scenarioMinPaise < 500_000 && shortfallPaise >= 0) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_threshold",
      title: "Cash falls below safety threshold — follow up on receivables",
      rationale:
        "The scenario pushes minimum cash below the ₹5,000 safety threshold. Send payment reminders for overdue invoices to bolster the buffer.",
      priority: "medium",
      impactPaise: 130_000,
    });
  }

  if (recs.length === 0) {
    recs.push({
      id: "rec_all_good",
      title: "Cash position remains healthy under this scenario",
      rationale:
        "No significant liquidity risk was detected. Continue monitoring supplier delivery timelines and customer payment dates.",
      priority: "low",
    });
  }

  return recs;
}

export const simulatorApi = {
  /**

   * Mock mode: fully deterministic local engine.
   * API mode: delegates to POST /api/simulator/simulate.
   */
  async simulate(controls: SimulatorControls): Promise<SimulatorResult> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(700);
      return runMockSimulation(controls);
    }
    return httpRequest<SimulatorResult>("/api/simulator/simulate", {
      method: "POST",
      body: controls,
    });
  },
