  /**
   * Auto-Phase Inventory preview
   */
  async previewAutoPhase(params: {
    supplierCommitmentPaise?: number;
    actualAvailableCashPaise?: number;
    safetyBufferPaise?: number;
    originalPaymentDate?: string;
    customerPaymentDate?: string;
  }): Promise<AutoPhasePreview> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(200);
      const commitment = params.supplierCommitmentPaise ?? 12_000_000;
      const cash = params.actualAvailableCashPaise ?? 15_000_000;
      const buffer = params.safetyBufferPaise ?? 5_000_000;
      const usable = Math.max(0, cash - buffer);
      const shortfall = Math.max(0, commitment - usable);
      return {
        supplierCommitmentPaise: commitment,
        actualAvailableCashPaise: cash,
        safetyBufferPaise: buffer,
        usableFreeCashPaise: usable,
        shortfallPaise: shortfall,
        batch1: {
          amountPaise: commitment - shortfall,
          date: params.originalPaymentDate || "Day 18",
          label: `Batch 1 (₹${((commitment - shortfall) / 100).toLocaleString()})`,
          purpose: "Immediate dispatch within available usable free cash",
        },
        batch2: {
          amountPaise: shortfall,
          date: "Day 32",
          label: `Batch 2 (₹${(shortfall / 100).toLocaleString()})`,
          purpose: "Deferred settlement aligned with customer inflow",
        },
        safetyBufferPreserved: true,
        explanation: `Splits ₹${(commitment / 100).toLocaleString()} into Batch 1 (₹${((commitment - shortfall) / 100).toLocaleString()}) on Day 18 and Batch 2 (₹${(shortfall / 100).toLocaleString()}) on Day 32, safeguarding the safety buffer.`,
      };
    }
    return httpRequest<AutoPhasePreview>("/api/simulator/rescues/auto-phase/preview", {
      method: "POST",
      body: params,
    });
  },

   * Apply Auto-Phase Inventory rescue

    actualAvailableCashPaise?: number;
    safetyBufferPaise?: number;

    return httpRequest("/api/simulator/rescues/auto-phase/apply", {

    });
  },

  /**
   * Tri-Party Split-Escrow preview
   */
  async previewSplitEscrow(params: {
    customerInvoicePaise?: number;
    supplierCommitmentPaise?: number;

      };

// Re-export old simulationApi for backward compat with existing code
export const simulationApi = {
  async runScenario(
    input: Omit<SimulationScenario, "id" | "createdAt">,
  ): Promise<SimulationResult> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(600);
      const scenario: SimulationScenario = {
        ...input,
        id: nextId("sim"),
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      const baseline = buildForecast(db.cashFlowEvents, db.business.openingCashPaise);
      const min =
        baseline.length > 0
          ? baseline.reduce((a, b) => (a.projectedBalancePaise <= b.projectedBalancePaise ? a : b))
          : { projectedBalancePaise: 0, date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
      return {
        scenarioId: scenario.id,
        baselineForecast: baseline,
        scenarioForecast: baseline,
        impactedEventIds: [scenario.targetEventId],
        minBalancePaise: min.projectedBalancePaise,
        minBalanceDate: min.date,
        summary: `Scenario "${scenario.name}" applied to event ${scenario.targetEventId}.`,
      };
    }
    return httpRequest<SimulationResult>("/api/simulations", { method: "POST", body: input });
  },

  async getScenarios(): Promise<SimulationScenario[]> {
    if (DATA_MODE === "mock") {
      await delay(150);
      return db.simulationScenarios;
    }
    return httpRequest<SimulationScenario[]>("/api/simulations/scenarios");
  },
};

import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/shared/page-header";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/shared/error-state";
import { SimulatorControlPanel } from "@/components/simulator/simulator-controls";
import { SimulatorChart, type ChartView } from "@/components/simulator/simulator-chart";
import {
  SimulatorResults,
  SimulatorEmptyState,
  SimulatorErrorState,
  SimulatorEventTimeline,
} from "@/components/simulator/simulator-results";
import {
  AutoPhaseDialog,
  SplitEscrowDialog,
  NodeInspectionDialog,
} from "@/components/simulator/simulator-rescues";
import {
  simulatorApi,
  type SimulatorControls,
  type SimulatorResult,
} from "@/lib/api/simulationApi";
import type {
  SimulatorTimelineNode,
  AutoPhasePreview,
  SplitEscrowPreview,
  ChaosStressTestResult,
} from "@/types";

import {
  simulatorStore,
  DEFAULT_CONTROLS,
  FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS,
} from "@/lib/simulatorStore";

// ─── Validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface SimulatorSearchParams {
  eventId?: string | undefined;
  eventName?: string | undefined;
}

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_app/simulator")({
  validateSearch: (search: Record<string, unknown>): SimulatorSearchParams => ({
    eventId: typeof search["eventId"] === "string" ? search["eventId"] : undefined,
    eventName: typeof search["eventName"] === "string" ? search["eventName"] : undefined,
  }),
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { title: "Ripple Simulator — Ripple" },
      {
        name: "description",
        content:
          "What-if simulation engine: change one event and watch the impact ripple through your operating cycle.",
      },
      { property: "og:title", content: "Ripple Simulator — Ripple" },
      { property: "og:description", content: "See the impact before it happens." },
      { property: "og:type", content: "website" },
      { name: "twitter:card", content: "summary" },
    ],
  }),
  component: SimulatorPage,
  errorComponent: ({ error, reset }) => (
    <ErrorState
      title="Could not load simulator"
      message={error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load simulator engine."}
      onRetry={reset}
    />
  ),
});

// ─── Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SimulatorPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const searchParams = Route.useSearch();

  const [isBaselineDialogOpen, setIsBaselineDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [initCustomerRupees, setInitCustomerRupees] = useState("8000");
  const [initSupplierRupees, setInitSupplierRupees] = useState("5000");

  const [controls, setControlsState] = useState<SimulatorControls>(
    () => simulatorStore.getState().controls,
  );
  const [result, setResult] = useState<SimulatorResult | null>(
    () => simulatorStore.getState().result,
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [chartView, setChartView] = useState<ChartView>("both");
  const [saveDialogOpen, setSaveDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scenarioName, setScenarioName] = useState("");

  const setControls = useCallback(
    (c: SimulatorControls | ((prev: SimulatorControls) => SimulatorControls)) => {
      setControlsState((prev) => {
        const next = typeof c === "function" ? c(prev) : c;
        simulatorStore.setControls(next);
        return next;
      });
    },
    [],
  );

  // Subscribe to external store changes (e.g. from Insights AI chat)
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = simulatorStore.subscribe((state) => {
      setControlsState((prev) => {
        if (JSON.stringify(prev) !== JSON.stringify(state.controls)) {
          return state.controls;
        }
        return prev;
      });
    });
    return unsub;
  }, []);

  // ── Features A, C, D states ──
  const [chaosResult, setChaosResult] = useState<ChaosStressTestResult | null>(
    () => simulatorStore.getState().chaosResult,
  );
  const [inspectNode, setInspectNode] = useState<SimulatorTimelineNode | null>(null);
  const [isInspectOpen, setIsInspectOpen] = useState(false);
  const [autoPhasePreview, setAutoPhasePreview] = useState<AutoPhasePreview | null>(null);
  const [isAutoPhaseOpen, setIsAutoPhaseOpen] = useState(false);
  const [splitEscrowPreview, setSplitEscrowPreview] = useState<SplitEscrowPreview | null>(null);
  const [isSplitEscrowOpen, setIsSplitEscrowOpen] = useState(false);

  // ── Run simulation mutation ──
  const runMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (c: SimulatorControls) => simulatorApi.simulate(c),
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setResult(data);
      simulatorStore.setResult(data);
      setError(null);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
      setResult(null);
      simulatorStore.setResult(null);
      toast.error("Simulation failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  // ── Feature A: Chaos Stress-Test Mutation ──
  const chaosMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => simulatorApi.runChaosStressTest(controls),
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setChaosResult(data);
      simulatorStore.setChaosResult(data);
      if (data.stressedResult) {
        setResult(data.stressedResult);
        simulatorStore.setResult(data.stressedResult);
      }
      toast.success("Chaos Stress-Test Applied (+5d shock)", {
        description: `Most fragile node identified: ${data.mostFragileNodeLabel} (${data.mostFragileMultiplier}x multiplier)`,
      });
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Chaos test failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  const handleExitChaos = useCallback(() => {
    setChaosResult(null);
    simulatorStore.setChaosResult(null);
    runMutation.mutate(controls);
    toast.info("Returned to baseline scenario");
  }, [controls, runMutation]);

  // ── Feature C: Auto-Phase Inventory ──
  const previewAutoPhaseMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      simulatorApi.previewAutoPhase({
        supplierCommitmentPaise: controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 12_000_000,
        actualAvailableCashPaise: 15_000_000,
        safetyBufferPaise: 5_000_000,
        customerPaymentDate: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
      }),
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setAutoPhasePreview(data);
      setIsAutoPhaseOpen(true);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Auto-Phase preview failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  const applyAutoPhaseMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      simulatorApi.applyAutoPhase({
        supplierCommitmentPaise: controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 12_000_000,
        actualAvailableCashPaise: 15_000_000,
        safetyBufferPaise: 5_000_000,
        customerPaymentDate: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
      }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      setIsAutoPhaseOpen(false);
      setIsInspectOpen(false);
      simulatorStore.applyAutoPhase();
      runMutation.mutate(controls);
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulator"] });
      toast.success("Auto-Phase Inventory Applied", {
        description:
          "Supplier order split into Batch 1 (Day 18) and Batch 2 (Day 32). Safety buffer preserved.",
      });
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Auto-Phase failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  // ── Feature D: Tri-Party Split-Escrow ──
  const previewSplitEscrowMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      simulatorApi.previewSplitEscrow({
        customerInvoicePaise: controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 50_000_000,
        supplierCommitmentPaise: controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 12_000_000,
        supplierFundingDate: "Day 18",
        customerSettlementDate: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
      }),
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setSplitEscrowPreview(data);
      setIsSplitEscrowOpen(true);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Split-Escrow preview failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  const applySplitEscrowMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      simulatorApi.applySplitEscrow({
        customerInvoicePaise: controls.customerPaymentAmountPaise ?? 50_000_000,
        supplierCommitmentPaise: controls.supplierPaymentAmountPaise ?? 12_000_000,
        supplierFundingDate: "Day 18",
        customerSettlementDate: `Day ${15 + controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}`,
      }),
    onSuccess: () => {
      setIsSplitEscrowOpen(false);
      setIsInspectOpen(false);
      simulatorStore.applySplitEscrow();
      runMutation.mutate(controls);
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulator"] });
      toast.success("Tri-Party Split-Escrow Locked", {
        description:
          "Zero business cash outlay on Day 18. Customer receivable assigned with bypass arc.",
      });
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Split-Escrow failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  // ── Revert Rescues Mutation ──
  const revertRescuesMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => simulatorApi.revertAllRescues(),
    onSuccess: () => {
      simulatorStore.revertRescues();
      runMutation.mutate(controls);
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulator"] });
      toast.info("Scenario rescues reverted to baseline");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Revert failed", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  // ── Preset Handler ──
  const handleSelectPreset = useCallback(
    (preset: "flagship" | "baseline") => {
      if (preset === "flagship") {
        const flagship = { ...FLAGSHIP_CONTROLS };
        setControls(flagship);
        simulatorStore.loadPreset("flagship");
        setChaosResult(null);
        toast.info("Loaded Apex Corp Flagship Scenario", {
          description:
            "₹5L Customer Receivable delayed +16d (Day 31); ₹1.2L Kaveri Timber payable Day 18.",
        });
      } else {
        const base = { ...DEFAULT_CONTROLS };
        setControls(base);
        simulatorStore.loadPreset("baseline");
        setChaosResult(null);
        toast.info("Reset to Baseline Scenario");
      }
    },
    [setControls],
  );

  const handleInspectNode = useCallback((node: SimulatorTimelineNode) => {
    setInspectNode(node);
    setIsInspectOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const handleTriggerAutoPhaseFromNode = useCallback(
    (_node?: SimulatorTimelineNode) => {
      previewAutoPhaseMutation.mutate();
    },
    [previewAutoPhaseMutation],
  );

  const handleTriggerSplitEscrowFromNode = useCallback(
    (_node?: SimulatorTimelineNode) => {
      previewSplitEscrowMutation.mutate();
    },
    [previewSplitEscrowMutation],
  );

  // ── Dynamic simulation trigger on mount & whenever controls change ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      runMutation.mutate(controls);
    }, 150);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [controls]);

  // ── Save scenario mutation ──
  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ name, c, r }: { name: string; c: SimulatorControls; r: SimulatorResult }) =>
      simulatorApi.saveScenario(name, c, r),
    onSuccess: () => {
      setSaveDialogOpen(false);
      setScenarioName("");
      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["simulator", "scenarios"] });
      toast.success("Scenario saved");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error("Failed to save scenario", { description: err.message });
    },
  });

  const handleRun = useCallback(() => {
    setError(null);
    setChaosResult(null);
    runMutation.mutate(controls);
  }, [controls, runMutation]);

  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
    setControls(DEFAULT_CONTROLS);
    setChaosResult(null);
    setError(null);
    setChartView("both");
  }, []);

  const handleSaveClick = useCallback(() => {
    if (!result) return;
    // Suggest a name based on controls
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays > 0)
      parts.push(`+${controls.supplierDeliveryDelayDays}d supplier delay`);
    if (controls.customerPaymentDelayDays > 0)
      parts.push(`+${controls.customerPaymentDelayDays}d payment delay`);
    if (controls.orderQuantityMultiplier !== 1.0)
      parts.push(`${Math.round(controls.orderQuantityMultiplier * 100)}% demand`);
    setScenarioName(parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : "Baseline scenario");
    setSaveDialogOpen(true);
  }, [controls, result]);

  const handleSaveConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    if (!result || !scenarioName.trim()) return;
    saveMutation.mutate({ name: scenarioName.trim(), c: controls, r: result });
  }, [result, scenarioName, controls, saveMutation]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Page header */}
      <PageHeader
        title="Ripple Simulator"
        description="See how a delayed payment affects your cash flow and connected orders."
        actions={
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setIsBaselineDialogOpen(true)}
              className="h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground border-border/70 font-medium gap-1.5"
            >
              <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
              Custom Amounts
            </Button>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground bg-muted/40 border border-border/60">
              <FlaskConical className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
              What-if Engine
            </span>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {/* Main layout: left controls + right chart/results */}
      <div className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[300px_1fr]">
        {/* ── Left: scenario controls ── */}
        <div>
          <SimulatorControlPanel
            controls={controls}
            isRunning={runMutation.isPending}
            isSaving={saveMutation.isPending}
            hasResult={result !== null}
            onChange={setControls}
            onReset={handleReset}
            onRun={handleRun}
            onSave={handleSaveClick}
            onChaosStressTest={() => chaosMutation.mutate()}
            isChaosTesting={chaosMutation.isPending}
            chaosStressTestResult={chaosResult}
            onExitChaosStressTest={handleExitChaos}
            onSelectPreset={handleSelectPreset}
          />
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: chart + results ── */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Chart card */}
          <Card className="shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] border-border/70 rounded-xl bg-card">
            <CardHeader className="pb-2 pt-4 px-4 sm:px-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                    Cash Flow Comparison
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-0.5 text-muted-foreground">
                    {result
                      ? `${controls.horizonDays}-day projection · Baseline vs. simulated scenario`
                      : "Run a simulation to compare baseline and scenario forecasts"}
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>

                {/* Series toggle — only visible once there's a result */}
                {result && (
                  <div className="flex items-center rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-muted/30 p-0.5 gap-0.5">
                    {(
                      [
                        { key: "baseline", label: "Baseline" },
                        { key: "both", label: "Both" },
                        { key: "scenario", label: "Simulated" },
                      ] as { key: ChartView; label: string }[]
                    ).map(({ key, label }) => (
                      <button
                        key={key}
                        onClick={() => setChartView(key)}
                        className={[
                          "rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer",
                          chartView === key
                            ? "bg-background text-foreground shadow-xs font-semibold"
                            : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
                        ].join(" ")}
                      >
                        {label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {runMutation.isPending ? (
                <div className="h-72 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-muted-foreground">
                  <div className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-primary border-t-transparent" />
                  <p className="text-sm">Calculating simulation…</p>
                </div>
              ) : error ? (
                <SimulatorErrorState message={error} />
              ) : result ? (
                <SimulatorChart
                  baselinePoints={result.baselinePoints}
                  scenarioPoints={result.scenarioPoints}
                  horizonDays={controls.horizonDays}
                  view={chartView}
                />
              ) : (
                <SimulatorEmptyState />
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Results panel */}
          {result && !runMutation.isPending && <SimulatorResults result={result} />}

          {/* Timeline panel */}
          {result && !runMutation.isPending && (
            <SimulatorEventTimeline
              result={result}
              onInspectNode={handleInspectNode}
              onAutoPhaseClick={handleTriggerAutoPhaseFromNode}
              onSplitEscrowClick={handleTriggerSplitEscrowFromNode}
              onRevertRescues={() => revertRescuesMutation.mutate()}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Baseline Configuration Dialog: Optional quick prompt to specify custom amounts */}
      <Dialog open={isBaselineDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsBaselineDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                <FlaskConical className="h-4 w-4" />
              </div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-base">Configure Simulation Amounts</DialogTitle>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              Specify custom baseline customer and supplier payment amounts for this simulation:
            </p>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Customer Payment Amount (₹)</Label>
              <Input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                placeholder="e.g. 8000"
                value={initCustomerRupees}
                onChange={(e) => setInitCustomerRupees(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums"
              />
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Inflow amount expected from customer (normally ₹8,000 for INV-2001)
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-medium">Supplier Payment Amount (₹)</Label>
              <Input
                type="number"
                min={0}
                placeholder="e.g. 5000"
                value={initSupplierRupees}
                onChange={(e) => setInitSupplierRupees(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums"
              />
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Advance outlay commitment to supplier (normally ₹5,000 for PO-1)
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 border-t flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setIsBaselineDialogOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs"
              onClick={() => {
                const custRupees = parseFloat(initCustomerRupees);
                const suppRupees = parseFloat(initSupplierRupees);
                setControls((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  customerPaymentAmountPaise: isNaN(custRupees)
                    ? null
                    : Math.round(custRupees * 100),
                  supplierPaymentAmountPaise: isNaN(suppRupees)
                    ? null
                    : Math.round(suppRupees * 100),
                }));
                setIsBaselineDialogOpen(false);
              }}
            >
              Apply Amounts
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Save scenario dialog */}
      <Dialog open={saveDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setSaveDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Save Scenario</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="scenario-name" className="text-sm">
                Scenario name
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="scenario-name"
                value={scenarioName}
                onChange={(e) => setScenarioName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. +7d supplier delay stress test"
                className="text-sm"
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter") handleSaveConfirm();
                }}
              />
            </div>
            {result && (
              <div className="rounded-md bg-muted/40 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-0.5">
                <p>
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">Ripple Score:</span>{" "}
                  {result.rippleScore.totalScore}/100
                </p>
                <p>
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">Horizon:</span>{" "}
                  {controls.horizonDays} days
                </p>
                <p>
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">Affected events:</span>{" "}
                  {result.affectedDependencies.length}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setSaveDialogOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleSaveConfirm}
              disabled={!scenarioName.trim() || saveMutation.isPending}
            >
              {saveMutation.isPending ? "Saving…" : "Save Scenario"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Node Inspection Dialog (Feature A) */}
      <NodeInspectionDialog
        open={isInspectOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsInspectOpen}
        node={inspectNode}
        onTriggerAutoPhase={() => handleTriggerAutoPhaseFromNode(inspectNode ?? undefined)}
        onTriggerSplitEscrow={() => handleTriggerSplitEscrowFromNode(inspectNode ?? undefined)}
      />

      {/* Auto-Phase Inventory Rescue Dialog (Feature C) */}
      <AutoPhaseDialog
        open={isAutoPhaseOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsAutoPhaseOpen}
        preview={autoPhasePreview}
        isLoading={applyAutoPhaseMutation.isPending}
        onConfirm={() => applyAutoPhaseMutation.mutate()}
      />

      {/* Zero-Cash Tri-Party Split-Escrow Dialog (Feature D) */}
      <SplitEscrowDialog
        open={isSplitEscrowOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsSplitEscrowOpen}
        preview={splitEscrowPreview}
        isLoading={applySplitEscrowMutation.isPending}
        onConfirm={() => applySplitEscrowMutation.mutate()}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

<div align="center">

# 🌊 Ripple

**Next-Gen Working Capital Resilience & Supply-Chain Contagion Platform**

*Stop guessing cash flow. Model dependency networks, simulate stress shocks, and deploy automated financial rescues.*

[![React 19](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-blue.svg?style=flat-square&logo=react)](https://react.dev/)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.8-blue.svg?style=flat-square&logo=typescript)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
[![TanStack Router](https://img.shields.io/badge/Routing-TanStack_Router-emerald.svg?style=flat-square)](https://tanstack.com/router)
[![Tailwind CSS v4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Styling-Tailwind_v4-38bdf8.svg?style=flat-square&logo=tailwindcss)](https://tailwindcss.com/)
[![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Backend-FastAPI_0.115-009688.svg?style=flat-square&logo=fastapi)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)
[![Zero Float Math](https://img.shields.io/badge/Financial_Math-Integer_Paise_(Zero_Float)-orange.svg?style=flat-square)](#-financial-integrity--design-rules)

</div>

---

## 📌 Overview

Traditional SME ERPs and accounting systems treat invoices and vendors as isolated ledger rows. When a supplier delays raw materials or a major buyer defaults on an invoice, traditional systems only show the damage **after** the business runs out of cash.

**Ripple** bridges the gap between **supply chain operations** and **treasury liquidity**. It constructs a living, interactive dependency graph of counterparties and orders, stress-tests cascading risks via a deterministic **Contagion Engine**, and models financial rescues to keep operations solvent.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 1. 🔬 The Ripple Simulator (`/simulator`)
- **Stress-Test Contagion**: Inject operational shocks (e.g., *Customer X pays 21 days late*, *Supplier Y prices rise 15%*, *Demand drops 30%*).
- **Domino Effect Analysis**: Automatically tracks downstream order failures, zero-cash dates, and total contagion cost across the timeline.
- **Hypothetical Rescues**:
  - **Auto-Phasing**: Breaks bulk vendor commitments into milestone-linked disbursements.
  - **Split-Escrow Settlement**: Ring-fences incoming receivables directly to Tier-1 supplier commitments.
  - **Invoice Factoring / Early Payment Discounts**: Weighs liquidity gains against capital cost.

### 2. 🕸️ Dependency Graph & Fragility Network (`/relationships`)
- Powered by `@xyflow/react` node graphs.
- Visualizes buyers, orders, suppliers, and logistics tiers.
- Computes single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities and counterparty exposure scores.

### 3. 📊 Treasury & Cash-Flow Runway (`/dashboard`, `/cash-flow`)
- Real-time forecast of inflows, outflows, and net liquidity troughs.
- Granular daily, weekly, and monthly timeline horizons.

### 4. 🤖 AI Financial Copilot & Advisory (`/insights`)
- Contextual chat assistant analyzing overdue receivables, working capital crunches, and vendor credit limits.
- Quick-action suggestion pills providing immediate scenario diagnostics.

### 5. 📦 Supply & Invoicing Core (`/suppliers`, `/customers`, `/inventory`, `/invoices`)
- Full lifecycle management for Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP).
- Decoupled physical goods fulfillment from financial settlement.

---

## 🏗️ Architecture & Tech Stack

```mermaid
graph TD
    Client["Frontend (React 19 + TanStack Router + Tailwind v4)"]
    APIClient["Typed API Layer (src/lib/api/*Api.ts)"]
    MockStore[("In-Memory Store (src/mocks/store.ts)\nDefault Demo Mode")]
    FastAPI["FastAPI Backend (backend/app)\nSQLAlchemy + SQLite/Postgres"]

    Client --> APIClient
    APIClient -->|DATA_MODE=mock| MockStore
    APIClient -->|DATA_MODE=api| FastAPI
```

| Layer | Technologies |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Frontend Framework** | [TanStack Start](https://tanstack.com/start) / Vite 8 / React 19 / TypeScript 5.8 |
| **Routing & Querying** | TanStack Router (file-based routing) & TanStack Query v5 |
| **Interactive Graphs** | `@xyflow/react` (React Flow), Recharts |
| **Styling & UI** | Tailwind CSS v4 (OKLCH tokens), Radix UI primitives, Lucide Icons |
| **Backend & DB** | FastAPI (Python 3.11+), SQLAlchemy 2.0, Alembic, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2 |
| **Precision Math** | Strict Integer Arithmetic (All currencies held in integer minor units / paise) |

## ⚡ Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- **Node.js** (v18+) & **npm**
- **Python** (3.10+) *(Optional if running in mock mode)*

### 1. Clone & Install Frontend
```bash
git clone <repo-url>
cd 404NotFound
npm install
```

### 2. Run the App

#### Mode A: Standalone Demo (Instant — No Backend Required)
By default, `VITE_DATA_MODE="mock"` is enabled. The app boots immediately with the rich "Rupi Clothing" business dataset:
```bash
npm run dev
```
Open **[http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173)** in your browser.

---

#### Mode B: Full Stack (Frontend + FastAPI Backend)

**Terminal 1 — Backend:**
```bash
cd backend
python -m venv venv
# Windows:
.\venv\Scripts\activate
# macOS/Linux:
source venv/bin/activate

pip install -r requirements.txt
python run.py
```
> FastAPI server starts at `http://localhost:8000`.

**Terminal 2 — Frontend (Pointing to Live API):**
```bash
# In the project root, set DATA_MODE to api:
npm run dev
```

## 🛡️ Financial Integrity & Design Rules

1. **Integer Minor Units Everywhere**: All currency values are stored as integers in **paise** (`₹1.00 = 100 paise`). Floating-point arithmetic is strictly forbidden in financial calculations to eliminate rounding decay.
2. **Strict Simulation Sandbox**: Running what-if experiments or applying financial rescues in the Simulator never modifies underlying historical invoices, payments, or records. Rescues exist as distinct simulation scenario branches.
3. **Decoupled Goods & Payments**: Physical receipt of inventory and financial settlement are separate state machines, reflecting real-world commercial trade credit.

/**
 * Ripple domain models.
 *
 * Conventions:
 * - Every persistent entity has an `id`. Relationships are modeled through IDs,
 *   never display names.
 * - Monetary amounts are integers in minor units (paise for INR) to avoid
 *   floating-point arithmetic on financial values.
 * - Dates are ISO 8601 strings in API payloads; format for display only.
 */

export type CurrencyCode = "INR" | "USD" | "EUR";

export interface Business {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  currency: CurrencyCode;
  openingCashPaise: number;
  safetyThresholdPaise?: number;
  industry?: string;
  ownerName?: string;
  ownerEmail?: string;
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
  taxRatePercent?: number; // default tax rate e.g. 18 for GST
  defaultSupplierPaymentTermsDays?: number;
  defaultCustomerPaymentTermsDays?: number;
  defaultForecastHorizonDays?: 7 | 14 | 30;
}

export interface NotificationPreferences {
  overduePayments: boolean;
  upcomingSupplierPayments: boolean;
  overdueInvoices: boolean;
  lowCash: boolean;
  delayedDeliveries: boolean;
  highRippleImpact: boolean;
}

export interface AppPreferences {
  theme: "light" | "dark" | "system";
  compactTables: boolean;
  version?: string;
}

export interface AppSettings {
  business: Business;
  notifications: NotificationPreferences;
  app: AppPreferences;
  dataMode: "mock" | "api";
}

export type UpdateSettingsInput = {
  business?: Partial<Business>;
  notifications?: Partial<NotificationPreferences>;
  app?: Partial<AppPreferences>;
};

    "supplier" | "purchase_order" | "inventory" | "customer_order" | "invoice" | "payment";
  targetId: string;
  targetType:
    "supplier" | "purchase_order" | "inventory" | "customer_order" | "invoice" | "payment";
  label: string;
  lagDays: number;
}

  id: string;
  severity: RiskSeverity;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  relatedEntityId?: string | undefined;
  relatedEntityType?: string | undefined;
  createdAt: string;
  acknowledged: boolean;
}

export interface SimulationScenario {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string | undefined;
  /** Event ID being changed, e.g. an invoice payment date. */
  targetEventId: string;
  changeType: "delay_payment" | "advance_payment" | "cancel_order" | "price_change";
  changeMagnitude: number; // days for delays, percent for price changes
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface SimulationResult {
  scenarioId: string;
  baselineForecast: ForecastPoint[];
  scenarioForecast: ForecastPoint[];
  impactedEventIds: string[];
  minBalancePaise: number;
  minBalanceDate: string;
  summary: string;
}

export interface Recommendation {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  rationale: string;
  impactPaise?: number | undefined;
  priority: "low" | "medium" | "high";
  relatedEntityId?: string | undefined;
}

/** Standard API envelope returned by the backend. */
export interface ApiListResponse<T> {
  data: T[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
}

export interface ApiErrorBody {
  error: {
    code: string;
    message: string;
    fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>;
  };
  /**
   * FastAPI's native error envelope. The backend returns `{ detail: "..." }`
   * alongside (or instead of) the Ripple `error` object, so it has to be part of
   * the declared shape — otherwise the message is silently dropped.
   */
  detail?: string | undefined;
}

export interface ListParams {
  page?: number | undefined;
  pageSize?: number | undefined;
  limit?: number | undefined;
  search?: string | undefined;
  sortBy?: string | undefined;
  sortDir?: "asc" | "desc" | undefined;
}

/*
 * Simulator domain types.
 *
 * These previously lived in `src/lib/api/simulationApi.ts`, which forced
 * `ChaosStressTestResult.stressedResult` to be `any` (a shared type cannot
 * reference an API-module type without inverting the layering) and made UI
 * components import their types from an API module. They live here now;
 * `simulationApi.ts` re-exports them so existing imports keep working.
 */

export interface SimulatorControls {
  supplierDeliveryDelayDays: number;
  customerPaymentDelayDays: number;
  customerPaymentAmountPaise: number | null; // null = unchanged
  supplierPaymentAmountPaise: number | null; // null = unchanged
  orderQuantityMultiplier: number; // 1.0 = unchanged
  horizonDays: 7 | 14 | 30;
}

export interface DependencyImpact {
  entityId: string;
  entityType: string;
  label: string;
  originalDate?: string;
  shiftedDate?: string;
  shiftDays: number;
  amountPaise?: number;
  impactDescription: string;
}

export interface RippleScoreBreakdown {
  cashShortfallFactor: number; // 0–40 pts: is there a shortfall, how deep?
  delayMagnitudeFactor: number; // 0–25 pts: combined delay days
  downstreamCountFactor: number; // 0–20 pts: # affected dependencies
  liquidityGapFactor: number; // 0–15 pts: baseline vs simulated delta
  totalScore: number; // 0–100
}

export interface SimulatorRecommendation {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  rationale: string;
  priority: "high" | "medium" | "low";
  impactPaise?: number | undefined;
}

export interface SimulatorResult {
  baselinePoints: ForecastPoint[];
  scenarioPoints: ForecastPoint[];
  baselineClosingPaise: number;
  scenarioClosingPaise: number;
  baselineMinPaise: number;
  baselineMinDate: string;
  scenarioMinPaise: number;
  scenarioMinDate: string;
  shortfallPaise: number; // > 0 means scenario went negative
  affectedDependencies: DependencyImpact[];
  rippleScore: RippleScoreBreakdown;
  recommendations: SimulatorRecommendation[];
  savedScenarioId?: string;
  trueMargin?: TrueMarginData | undefined;
  timelineNodes?: SimulatorTimelineNode[] | undefined;
  /** Rescue actions currently applied to the simulated scenario. */
  activeRescues?: ActiveRescue[] | undefined;
  isAutoPhaseApplied?: boolean | undefined;
  isSplitEscrowApplied?: boolean | undefined;
  hasAutoPhaseRescue?: boolean | undefined;
  hasSplitEscrowRescue?: boolean | undefined;
}

/** A mitigation currently applied to a scenario (auto-phase inventory or split escrow). */
export interface ActiveRescue {
  id: string;
  type: "auto_phase" | "split_escrow";
  label?: string | undefined;
  appliedAt?: string | undefined;
}

export interface ChaosStressTestResult {
  isStressTestActive: boolean;
  baselineMinCashPaise: number;

  mostFragileMultiplier: number;

  stressedTrueMargin: TrueMarginData;
  /** Full simulator result produced by the stressed run; drives the results panel. */
  stressedResult?: SimulatorResult | undefined;
  summary: string;
}
